In flat regions the left–right or up–down differences are small and the response is close to 0; near edges the differences are large and the response is larger. The two output images each find where the change along the corresponding direction is fast.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 Sobel：找变化快的地方 (slides 29, 30)

wall.zh: S_x 在平坦区域与竖直边缘处响应分别是多少？
wall.en: What is the response of S_x in a flat region and at a vertical edge, respectively?

misconception.zh: 以为 S_x 找的是水平方向的边缘线（实际找沿 x 方向变化快处）。
misconception.en: Thinking S_x finds horizontal edge lines (it actually finds where the change along the x direction is fast).

about.zh: 二维图像 f(x,y) 的梯度是 ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ。幅度 ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) 表示变化有多强，方向 θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) 表示变化最快的方向。
about.en: The gradient of a 2D image f(x,y) is ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ. The magnitude ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) indicates how strong the change is, and the direction θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) indicates the direction of fastest change.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/05-image-formation-ii.md §3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 40)

wall.zh: 给定 ∂f/∂x=3、∂f/∂y=4，梯度幅度是多少？
wall.en: Given ∂f/∂x=3 and ∂f/∂y=4, what is the gradient magnitude?

misconception.zh: 把梯度方向当成边缘的走向。
misconception.en: Taking the gradient direction to be the direction in which the edge runs.

term.zh: 彩色图像滤波（多通道卷积核）

about.zh: RGB 图像除空间维度外还有通道维度，颜色滤波器尺寸可以是 K_h×K_w×3。它同时看同一邻域的 R、G、B，把所有乘积加在一起得到一个输出数值。常见错误是把 height×width×channel 当成普通二维图像，忘记核还要覆盖通道维度。
about.en: Besides its spatial dimensions, an RGB image also has a channel dimension, so a colour filter can have size K_h×K_w×3. It looks at R, G and B in the same neighbourhood at once and sums all the products to give a single output value. A common mistake is to treat height×width×channel as an ordinary 2D image and forget that the kernel must also cover the channel dimension.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 彩色图像的滤波核多了一个维度 (slide 31)

wall.zh: 一个 3×3×3 核作用于 RGB 图像一个位置，输出几个数？
wall.en: When a 3×3×3 kernel is applied to an RGB image at one position, how many numbers does it output?

misconception.zh: 以为彩色滤波得到三个输出值或只对一个通道操作。
misconception.en: Thinking colour filtering produces three output values, or operates on only one channel.

term.zh: 像素换算成传感器毫米再求焦距
term.en: Converting pixels to sensor millimetres to find focal length

about.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图像中高 100 像素，所以它在传感器上高 h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm。物体实际高 h_o = 120 mm、距离 z = 600 mm，由相似三角形 h_i/f = h_o/z 得 f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm。重点是先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，不能直接把像素和毫米放进同一个比例式。
about.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels, and the object is 100 pixels high in the image, so its height on the sensor is h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm. The object's real height is h_o = 120 mm and its distance is z = 600 mm, so by similar triangles h_i/f = h_o/z, giving f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm. The key point is to convert pixels into millimetres on the sensor first; you cannot put pixels and millimetres directly into the same proportion.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · 用传感器尺寸求焦距

wall.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图中占 100 像素，实高 120 mm、距离 600 mm，焦距是多少毫米？
wall.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels; an object occupies 100 pixels in the image, is 120 mm tall in reality and is 600 mm away. What is the focal length in millimetres?

misconception.zh: 直接把 100 像素当作 h_i 代入，得到单位混乱的 f = 100×600/120 = 500。
misconception.en: Substituting the 100 pixels directly as h_i, giving f = 100×600/120 = 500 with muddled units.

term.zh: OpenCV 尺寸 (width, height) 与 NumPy 形状 (height, width, channels)
term.en: OpenCV (width, height) vs NumPy (height, width, channels)

about.zh: OpenCV 的大小 tuple 是 (width, height)，NumPy 形状却通常写成 (height, width, channels)。所以不能把 NumPy 的形状原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸，否则宽和高会对调。
about.en: An OpenCV size tuple is (width, height), whereas a NumPy shape is usually written (height, width, channels). So you cannot use a NumPy shape as-is as an OpenCV resize size, or the width and height will be swapped.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝

wall.zh: 为什么 NumPy 的形状不能原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸？
wall.en: Why can a NumPy shape not be used as-is as an OpenCV resize size?

misconception.zh: 把 image.shape[:2] 直接传给 OpenCV 的缩放函数。
misconception.en: Passing image.shape[:2] straight to OpenCV's resize function.

term.zh: OpenCV 的 BGR 与 Matplotlib 的 RGB

about.zh: cv2.imread 默认读入 BGR，但 matplotlib.pyplot.imshow 按 RGB 显示，所以显示前要用 cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) 转换。这只改变通道顺序，不改变图像内容或空间尺寸。
about.en: cv2.imread reads images as BGR by default, but matplotlib.pyplot.imshow displays them as RGB, so convert with cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) before displaying. This changes only the channel order, not the image content or spatial size.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV 和 Matplotlib 的颜色顺序

wall.zh: 用 cv2.imread 读图后直接 plt.imshow，红色物体会显示成什么颜色？为什么？
wall.en: If you read an image with cv2.imread and pass it straight to plt.imshow, what colour will a red object appear? Why?

misconception.zh: 显示时红蓝颠倒，却以为图片本身坏了；或以为转换会改变图像尺寸。
misconception.en: Seeing red and blue swapped on display and thinking the image itself is broken; or thinking the conversion changes the image size.

about.zh: 把投影偏移转换成像素并平移原点。
about.en: Convert projected offset into pixels and translate its origin.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 and §2 (slides 11, 15, 18)

wall.zh: 为什么负投影偏移仍可以对应正的列坐标？
wall.en: Why can a negative projected offset have a positive column coordinate?

misconception.zh: 将像素偏移直接当作图像列坐标。
misconception.en: Treating signed pixel offset as an image column.

about.zh: 逐个值相乘
about.en: Multiply value by value

why.zh: 投影要乘焦距，乘法接不出来
why.en: Projection multiplies by the focal length

about.zh: 逐个值相除
about.en: Divide value by value

why.zh: 投影要除以距离
why.en: Projection divides by the distance

about.zh: 逐个值相加
about.en: Add value by value

why.zh: 基本算术
why.en: Basic arithmetic

about.zh: 固定的数
about.en: A fixed number

why.zh: 其余元件造不出一个固定的数
why.en: No other part makes a fixed number

about.zh: 逐个值相减
about.en: Subtract value by value

why.zh: 差值是滤波和坐标里最常见的运算
why.en: Differences are the commonest operation in filters and coordinates

about.zh: 按坐标取像素
about.en: Read a pixel at coordinates

why.zh: 其余元件都在原位置上算，取不到别处的值
why.en: Every other part computes in place

about.zh: 给定宽高的两张坐标图
about.en: The two coordinate images of a size

why.zh: 没有元件能从两个数造出一整张图
why.en: No part makes a whole image from two numbers

about.zh: 向下取整
about.en: Round down

why.zh: 算术只给出连续的数，取像素要整数
why.en: Arithmetic gives continuous numbers; lookup needs whole ones

about.zh: 图的宽和高
about.en: An image's width and height

why.zh: 电路只拿到图时读不出它的尺寸
why.en: A circuit given only the image cannot read its size

about.zh: 平方根
about.en: Square root

why.zh: 梯度的大小要开平方，算术接不出来
why.en: The gradient's size needs a square root

about.zh: 取出彩色像素第 c 个位置的灰度图
about.en: The grey image of position c of each colour pixel

why.zh: 逐个值的算术拆不开一个像素的三个数
why.en: Value-by-value arithmetic cannot take a pixel's three numbers apart

about.zh: 三张灰度图合成彩色图
about.en: Three grey images made one colour image

why.zh: 没有元件能从灰度图造出彩色图
why.en: No other part makes a colour image from grey ones

about.zh: 投影：X、Z、f → u
about.en: Projection: X, Z, f → u

about.zh: 裁剪：从 (x0, y0) 起取 w × h
about.en: Crop: w × h from (x0, y0)

about.zh: 行滤波器：左中右三个权重的滑动加权和
about.en: Row filter: a sliding weighted sum of left, centre, right

about.zh: 列滤波器：上中下三个权重的滑动加权和
about.en: Column filter: a sliding weighted sum of above, centre, below

about.zh: 二维滤波器：先横后竖
about.en: 2D filter: across, then down

about.zh: 高斯模糊
about.en: Gaussian blur

about.zh: Sobel：gx、gy
about.en: Sobel: gx, gy

about.zh: 用 Sobel 响应计算边缘强度
about.en: Compute edge strength from Sobel responses

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

why.zh: 从一台理想的针孔相机起步。
why.en: Starting from an ideal pinhole camera.

task.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
task.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

question.zh: 先造相机的投影部件。图中 O 是<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>，虚线标出<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>，f 指向<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>。本实验所有长度共用模型单位，采用正像的虚像平面。固定参照一直保留：每次只改变 X、Z、f 中的一个，先预测，再检查。
question.en: Build the projection part of the camera. O marks the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>, the dashed line the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, and f locates the <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>. All lengths share model units and the virtual image is upright. Keep the reference in view: change one of X, Z and f at a time, predict, then check.

chain.zh: 以固定参照比较 X、Z、f 单独改变时的光路；先预测再检查。
chain.en: Compare each isolated X, Z and f change against a fixed reference; predict before checking.

chain.zh: 让一个电路覆盖独立变化的三个输入。
chain.en: Build one circuit covering independently varying inputs.

naive.zh: 把点放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：光线穿过小孔后，横向位置按 f/Z = 2/4 缩小了一半。
naive.en: With the point at X = 1 the image lands at u = 0.5 only: through the hole, the sideways position shrinks by f/Z = 2/4, to half.

task.zh: 输入像点位置 u、像平面距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
task.en: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X.

question.zh: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>能从场景得到图像，但反过来是否唯一？保留 H=1、Z=4、f=2 的参照，让一支至少高一倍的箭拍出相同的像。之后只在额外给定 Z 的条件下倒推位置。
question.en: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> maps a scene to an image. Is the reverse unique? Keep the H=1, Z=4, f=2 reference and construct an arrow at least twice as tall with the same image. Then invert a point position only when Z is supplied.

chain.zh: 另造一个场景：调 H 和 Z：像高仍为 0.5，但 H 至少为 2。所有长度共用模型单位；对照参照图再检查。
chain.en: Another scene: Adjust H and Z: keep image height 0.5 with H at least 2. All lengths share model units. Compare with the reference, then check.

chain.zh: 倒推：输入像点位置 u、像平面距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
chain.en: Work back: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X.

naive.zh: 只把箭加高：距离不变，像也跟着加倍成 1。要让像不变，距离得和物高一起加倍。
naive.en: Only making the arrow taller: at the same distance its image doubles to 1. For the same image the distance must double with the height.

task.zh: 传感器高 24 mm；本实验只看竖直方向。调 f，让全视场为 90°；用上下两条边界光线核对，不要只看上半角。
task.en: The sensor is 24 mm tall and this experiment uses a vertical slice. Set f for a full field of view of 90°. Check both boundary rays rather than only the upper half-angle.

question.zh: 固定传感器时，焦距怎样改变全视场？
question.en: How does focal length change the full field of view of a fixed sensor?

chain.zh: 在等比例图里对照上下边界与全角、半角。
chain.en: Compare both edges, full angle and half-angle in an equal-scale construction.

chain.zh: 预测并检查新的焦距；保持传感器尺寸不变。
chain.en: Predict and check a focal length, keeping sensor size fixed.

naive.zh: 只把箭加高：距离不变，像也跟着加倍成 1。要让像不变，距离得和物高一起加倍。
naive.en: Only making the arrow taller: at the same distance its image doubles to 1. For the same image the distance must double with the height.

title.en: A picture is a table of numbers

task.zh: 输入一张灰度图和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
task.en: Given a grey image and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

question.zh: 这条路线从数表开始，不需要先会相机几何。通过<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>查看表示约定：指出位置、改变一格，再让电路读取右邻和当前位置的差。彩色样例约定按 R、G、B 排列，数值在 0 到 1。
question.en: This route starts from tables and needs no camera geometry. Open <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> and the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> for the representation: locate a cell, change one cell, then wire the difference between it and its right neighbour. Colour examples use R, G, B order with values from 0 to 1.

chain.zh: 指坐标：写出高亮那一格的坐标 (x, y)。
chain.en: Name a cell: Write the coordinates (x, y) of the highlighted cell.

chain.zh: 改一个彩色像素：把 (1, 0) 的像素改成纯红，其他格子不动。
chain.en: Change a colour pixel: Change the pixel at (1, 0) to pure red, leaving every other cell as it is.

chain.zh: 读相邻像素：输入一张灰度图和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
chain.en: Read neighbours: Given a grey image and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

naive.zh: 这是先写行、再写列（矩阵的习惯）：图像坐标先写 x（列），再写 y（行），高亮的格子在第 1 行第 2 列，是 (2, 1)。
naive.en: That gives the row first, the matrix way: image coordinates give x, the column, first and y, the row, second; the highlighted cell is in row 1, column 2, so (2, 1).

task.zh: 输入 X、Z、像素焦距 f_px 和主点 c_x：交出像点的像素横坐标 u。
task.en: Given X, Z, the focal length in pixels f_px and the principal point c_x, give the image's pixel column u.

question.zh: 两条路线在这里汇合：<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>给出相对光轴的偏移，<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>让你能在数表中定位。先在横向坐标条上做两步：按<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>换单位，再用<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>换原点；最后接成像素相机。
question.en: The routes meet here: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> gives an offset from the axis, while the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> locates cells in the table. On the horizontal strip, first convert units using <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>, then move the origin using the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>; finally compose a pixel camera.

chain.zh: 在横向坐标条上把毫米偏移换成像素偏移。
chain.en: Convert physical offset into pixel offset on a horizontal strip.

chain.zh: 保留符号，再从主点平移到图像原点。
chain.en: Keep the sign, then shift from principal point to image origin.

chain.zh: 组合投影与坐标平移，并检验不同主点。
chain.en: Compose projection and coordinate translation, testing different principal points.

naive.zh: 以为焦距等于传感器高度时视场是 90°：那时半高 12 mm 只有焦距的一半，视场约 53°，杆顶出了画面。焦距要等于半高 12 mm。
naive.en: Taking a focal length equal to the sensor's height for 90°: then the half-height, 12 mm, is half the focal length, the view about 53° and the pole's top out of frame. The focal length must equal the half-height, 12 mm.

task.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
task.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

question.zh: 现在只保留画面的一部分，用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>完成。先把选中的区域搬进小图，再追踪新图的每一格来自原图哪里；新图左上角不再对应原图左上角。
question.en: Keep only part of the image using <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>. Move the selected region into a smaller image, then track where each new cell comes from. The two top-left corners no longer coincide.

chain.zh: 手裁：从 (1, 1) 起裁出 2 × 2 的一块（宽 2、高 2）。
chain.en: By hand: Crop the 2 × 2 region (width 2, height 2) starting at (1, 1).

chain.zh: 裁剪电路：输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
chain.en: Crop circuit: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

naive.zh: 这是从 (0, 0) 起裁的：新图的 (0, 0) 要取原图的 (1, 1)，每个坐标都加上左上角的偏移。
naive.en: That crops from (0, 0): the new (0, 0) must read the original (1, 1); every coordinate adds the corner's offset.

task.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
task.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

question.zh: 改过输出尺寸后，题目直接给出原图中的采样位置。用<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>完成这次读取，比较 0.4 和 0.5 附近的结果。本题约定距离相同时取坐标较大的一边，图外取最近边界。
question.en: After changing output size, the task supplies sample positions in the original. Use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> and compare positions around 0.4 and 0.5. Ties take the larger coordinate and positions outside use the nearest boundary.

chain.zh: 手算：这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的像素的值。
chain.en: By hand: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the pixel nearest each position.

chain.zh: 接成电路：输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
chain.en: Wire it: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

naive.zh: 这是一律向下取整：1.6 离 2 比离 1 近，却取了 1 的值；0.5 离两边一样近，按约定取 1。最近的整数是加 0.5 再向下取整。
naive.en: That rounds every position down: 1.6 is nearer 2 than 1 but read 1; 0.5 is equally near both and by the convention reads 1. The nearest whole number is add 0.5, then round down.

task.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
task.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance.

question.zh: 保持与最近邻相同的采样位置，改用<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>。先看一行上靠左、靠右两点怎样变化，再把这个做法用于四个角；图外仍取最近边界。
question.en: Keep the same sample positions but use <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>. First compare points near either end of a row, then extend that reasoning to four corners. Outside positions still use the nearest boundary.

chain.zh: 一行：[0, 4] 在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25 处取值：按到左右两个像素的距离加权，写出每个值。
chain.en: A row: Read [0, 4] at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25, weighting the pixels either side by distance: write each value.

chain.zh: 四个邻居：这张 2 × 2 的图在 x、y 都取 −1/6、0.5、7/6 的 9 个位置取值：写出 3 × 3 的结果。
chain.en: Four neighbours: Read this 2 × 2 image at the nine positions where x and y are each −1/6, 0.5 or 7/6: write the 3 × 3 result.

chain.zh: 接成电路：输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
chain.en: Wire it: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance.

naive.zh: 这是照抄最近的像素：0.25 和 0.75 位置不同，拿到的却是两端的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
naive.en: That copies the nearest pixel: 0.25 and 0.75 sit apart yet read the ends. Weighted by distance, 0.25 reads 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

task.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出焦距 f（毫米）。
task.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the focal length f in millimetres.

question.zh: Workshop 2 的一道题：知道物体多高、多远，从照片里量出它占多少像素，反推镜头的焦距。照片里量的是像素，相似三角形要的是传感器上的毫米。
question.en: A Workshop 2 exercise: knowing how tall and how far an object is, measure how many pixels it covers in the photo and work back to the lens's focal length. The photo gives pixels; similar triangles want millimetres on the sensor.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出焦距 f（毫米）。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the focal length f in millimetres.

chain.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
chain.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert pixels to millimetres on the sensor first, then h/f = H/Z; pixels and millimetres never share a proportion.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

title.en: Width, height and a centre crop

task.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
task.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

question.zh: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>：NumPy 给出图的形状时先写行数（高）、再写列数（宽）；OpenCV 要尺寸时却先写宽、再写高。Workshop 2 要从图的正中间裁出一块，两种顺序一混，裁出的位置就偏了。
question.en: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>: NumPy gives an image's shape as rows (height) first, then columns (width); OpenCV asks for a size as width first, then height. Workshop 2 crops a region from the very centre, and mixing the two orders puts it off-centre.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

chain.zh: 形状先高后宽，尺寸先宽后高；<wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref>从余量的一半起。
chain.en: A shape is height first, a size width first; a <wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref> starts half the spare room in.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

why.zh: 相机只会按位置取值，不会把邻居合起来算。
why.en: The camera only reads values at positions and cannot combine neighbours.

task.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
task.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

question.zh: 已经会按坐标读取，现在要让一个输出同时依赖周围的值。打开<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>和<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>，用窗口逐格跟踪<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>。本关只算三个邻居都在图内的位置。
question.en: Coordinate lookup is ready; now one output must depend on surrounding values. Open <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>, then follow the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> with the movable window. Only positions with three neighbours inside the image are used.

chain.zh: 手算：权重左 1、中 0、右 −1 滑过这一行：写出三格都在图里的每个位置的加权和。
chain.en: By hand: Slide the weights left 1, centre 0, right −1 along this row: write the weighted sum at each position whose three cells are all inside.

chain.zh: 接成电路：输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
chain.en: Wire it: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

naive.zh: 这是右邻减左邻：权重左 1、右 −1，是左邻减右邻。权重跟着位置走，不要颠倒。
naive.en: That is right less left: with the left weight 1 and the right −1 it is left less right. The weights go with their positions.

task.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：输出和原图一样宽，每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0。
task.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give an output as wide as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside.

question.zh: 相邻处理要继续组合，不能每次都悄悄缩小画面。本关选用<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>中的补零规则，保留所有中心位置；比较边缘和中间同样的输入，看看输出是否还相同。
question.en: To compose local operations, the frame must not silently shrink each time. Use zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> and retain every centre position. Compare equal inputs at the edge and in the interior: do their outputs stay equal?

chain.zh: 手算：三个权重都是 1/3（求左中右的平均），图外补 0：写出和原图一样宽的结果。
chain.en: By hand: All three weights 1/3 (the average of left, here and right), 0 outside: write the result, as wide as the row.

chain.zh: 行滤波器：输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：输出和原图一样宽，每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0。
chain.en: Row filter: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give an output as wide as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside.

naive.zh: 这是图外取最近的边：题目约定图外补 0，两端只有两个 3 和一个 0，平均是 2。
naive.en: That reads the nearest edge outside: here 0 is padded outside, so each end averages two 3s and a 0, giving 2.

task.zh: 输入一张图和卷积核 k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出卷积的结果，图外补 0。
task.en: Given an image and the kernel k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the convolution, 0 outside.

question.zh: 这条必修路线研究权重的方向，不必等待列处理。用<wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>检查<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：沿窗口追踪唯一亮点分别遇到哪个权重，再让电路符合题目要求的翻转约定。
question.en: This required route studies weight orientation without waiting for column processing. Use an <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref> to inspect <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: track which weight meets the single bright sample, then make the circuit obey the requested flip convention.

chain.zh: 脉冲：不翻转，权重左 1、中 2、右 3 滑过这一行脉冲，图外补 0：写出结果。
chain.en: An impulse: Without flipping, slide the weights left 1, centre 2, right 3 over this impulse, 0 outside: write the result.

chain.zh: 真正的卷积：输入一张图和卷积核 k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出卷积的结果，图外补 0。
chain.en: True convolution: Given an image and the kernel k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the convolution, 0 outside.

naive.zh: 以为脉冲出来的就是核 [1, 2, 3]：亮点在左边那一格的右邻，乘的是右权重 3。不翻转时，出来的是倒过来的 [3, 2, 1]。
naive.en: Expecting the kernel [1, 2, 3] back: for the cell to its left, the bright cell is the right neighbour and meets the right weight 3. Without the flip, out comes [3, 2, 1] reversed.

task.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
task.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

question.zh: 这条必修路线把<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>转向上下，不依赖核方向路线。先在窗口里追踪一列：保持 x 不动，只改变 y，再把刚验证的读取方式推广到整张图。
question.en: This required route turns <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> vertically, independently of the kernel-orientation route. Track one column in the window: keep x fixed, vary y, then extend the checked addressing to the image.

chain.zh: 在可移动窗口里保持 x 不变，沿 y 追踪三个邻居。
chain.en: Keep x fixed and track three y-neighbours in the movable window.

chain.zh: 接出列滤波器：输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
chain.en: Wire the column filter: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

chain.zh: 横、竖处理的代数结构一致，差别落在“读哪个邻居”。用非方形图与不对称内容测试，才能让误把 y 改成 x 的接法显出差异。
chain.en: Horizontal and vertical operations share an algebraic structure; the addressed neighbours differ. Non-square images with asymmetric content expose a circuit that changes x where y was intended.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

facet.zh: 同一个滑动加权和，邻居换成上下：方向不同，计算一样
facet.en: The same sliding weighted sum with the neighbours above and below: another direction, the same computation

task.zh: 输入一张图、行权重 h1、h2、h3 和列权重 v1、v2、v3：交出先横后竖两次滤波的结果。
task.en: Given an image, row weights h1, h2, h3 and column weights v1, v2, v3, give the result of filtering across, then down.

question.zh: 两条路线在这里汇合：方向约定已经核对，也能分别读行与列。用<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>思考两次处理如何组合；先追踪一个输入位置到各输出位置的贡献，再组合已搭好的部件。
question.en: The routes meet here: orientation is checked and both rows and columns can be addressed. Use <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> to reason about composition. Track one input contribution across output positions before combining the built parts.

chain.zh: 合成的核：行权重 [1,2,1]、列权重 [1,0,−1]。追踪每个行权重经由列处理的贡献，写出组合后的 3×3 权重表。
chain.en: The merged kernel: Row weights [1,2,1], column weights [1,0,−1]. Track each horizontal contribution through the column pass and fill the combined 3×3 weights.

chain.zh: 二维滤波器：输入一张图、行权重 h1、h2、h3 和列权重 v1、v2、v3：交出先横后竖两次滤波的结果。
chain.en: 2D filter: Given an image, row weights h1, h2, h3 and column weights v1, v2, v3, give the result of filtering across, then down.

naive.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重：竖直方向也要乘上列权重，第 1 行整行乘 2。
naive.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows: the column weights multiply too, doubling row 1.

task.zh: 输入一张图：交出横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤过的模糊图。
task.en: Given an image, give it filtered across and down by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4].

question.zh: 这一支用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>处理细碎变化。先检查一个亮点向周围传播的结果，再用同样的部件处理一条明暗分界；本关给定行、列权重 [1/4,1/2,1/4]，图外补零。
question.en: This branch uses <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> for fine-scale variation. Check how one bright sample spreads, then apply the same parts to an intensity step. Row and column weights are [1/4,1/2,1/4], with zero outside.

chain.zh: 一个亮点：这张图只有 (1, 1) 是 16：横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤一遍，图外补 0，写出结果。
chain.en: A bright point: Only (1, 1) of this image is 16: filter across and down with [1/4, 1/2, 1/4], 0 outside, and write the result.

chain.zh: 高斯模糊：输入一张图：交出横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤过的模糊图。
chain.en: Gaussian blur: Given an image, give it filtered across and down by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4].

naive.zh: 这是只横着滤了一遍：竖直方向也要滤，亮点向上下扩散，中心只剩 4。
naive.en: That filters across only: down must be filtered too, spreading the point up and down and leaving 4 at the centre.

task.zh: 输入一张图：交出 gx（横向权重 −1、0、1，竖向 1、2、1）和 gy（横向 1、2、1，竖向 −1、0、1）。
task.en: Given an image, give gx (across −1, 0, 1; down 1, 2, 1) and gy (across 1, 2, 1; down −1, 0, 1).

question.zh: 这一支要找变化而不是保留平均值。先比较一行的左右邻居，保留正负，再用<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>同时处理两个方向；使用直接按窗口对齐的权重约定。
question.en: This branch seeks change rather than an average. First compare left and right neighbours, retaining the sign, then use <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> in both directions with weights aligned directly to the window.

chain.zh: 正还是负：只看横向：每格算右邻减左邻（图外补 0），写出结果。
chain.en: Plus or minus: Across only: at each cell take the right neighbour less the left (0 outside) and write the result.

chain.zh: Sobel 滤波器：输入一张图：交出 gx（横向权重 −1、0、1，竖向 1、2、1）和 gy（横向 1、2、1，竖向 −1、0、1）。
chain.en: Sobel filter: Given an image, give gx (across −1, 0, 1; down 1, 2, 1) and gy (across 1, 2, 1; down −1, 0, 1).

naive.zh: 这是只看变化有多大：响应带符号，从亮到暗的地方右邻比左邻暗，是负的。
naive.en: That records only how big the change is: the response is signed, and where it goes bright to dark the right neighbour is darker, so it is negative.

title.en: The gradient: how strong, which way

task.zh: 输入一张图：输出每个位置的变化强度。大小相同而方向相反的响应，应得到同样的强度。
task.en: Given an image, output change strength at each position. Equal-sized responses pointing in opposite directions must have equal strength.

question.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>已有两个带符号的响应。现在用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>比较不同朝向的变化强度：先在响应表中检验转向和正负是否改变强度，再造一块可复用部件。
question.en: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> provides two signed responses. Use the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> to compare change strength across orientations: first test rotations and sign changes in a response table, then build a reusable part.

chain.zh: 比较等长而朝向不同的响应向量，排除直接相加。
chain.en: Compare equal-length response vectors pointing in different directions, rejecting signed addition.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入一张图：输出每个位置的变化强度。大小相同而方向相反的响应，应得到同样的强度。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given an image, output change strength at each position. Equal-sized responses pointing in opposite directions must have equal strength.

chain.zh: 相同强度的变化可以指向不同方向，两个响应直接相加会相消，无法稳定比较。把响应作为两个互相垂直的分量处理，才可在保留方向信息的同时另取一个非负强度。
chain.en: Equally strong changes can point in different directions. Adding signed responses can cancel them and fails as a stable comparison. Treating them as perpendicular components lets direction remain distinct from nonnegative strength.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

task.zh: 输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各通道模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
task.en: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred channels, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs.

question.zh: 把两条路线装进同一台处理器。先按 wr、wg、wb 选择要观察的颜色组合，用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>减弱细碎变化，再调用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>的强度部件检查剩下的分界。输出处理后的图与它的边缘强度，两者都要通过测试。
question.en: Assemble both routes into one processor. Select a colour mixture with wr, wg and wb, reduce fine variation with <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>, then call the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> strength part to inspect the remaining transitions. Output both the processed image and its edge strength.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各通道模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred channels, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs.

chain.zh: 这次<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>不只把部件摆在一起：权重决定看哪些通道，平滑改变进入求变化部件的信号。两张输出让你检查“保留了什么”与“哪里变化强”；这仍是局部处理，不等于识别物体。
chain.en: This <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> composes a real signal path: weights select channels and smoothing changes what reaches the change detector. The two outputs show what remains and where it changes strongly. These local operations do not recognise objects.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

task.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
task.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

question.zh: Workshop 2 里用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，三个数按 B、G、R 存；交给 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示，红蓝就对调了，蓝天变成橙色。另一个坑：照片常用 uint8 存，0 到 255，算出来超出范围会绕回去。
question.en: In Workshop 2 a photo read with OpenCV stores its three numbers as B, G, R; shown by Matplotlib as R, G, B, red and blue trade places and a blue sky turns orange. Another trap: photos are often uint8, 0 to 255, and a result out of range wraps around.

chain.zh: 换回 RGB：输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
chain.en: Back to RGB: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

chain.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>的差别和<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>的坑：先换好顺序，算之前换成更宽的类型。
chain.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref> difference and the <wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref> trap: swap the order before handing over, widen the type before computing.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

why.zh: 几何与数组路线互不调用对方的部件，像素相机组合时才共同需要。
why.en: Geometry and arrays do not use each other's parts; the pixel-camera join needs both.

why.zh: 核方向与竖直读取是独立问题，二维处理汇合时同时使用。
why.en: Kernel orientation and vertical addressing are independent; the 2D construction joins them.

why.zh: 平滑与变化响应从同一个二维滤波器出发，最终处理器实际调用两边部件。
why.en: Smoothing and change responses share the 2D filter; the finale calls parts from both.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

body.zh: 固定传感器尺寸，焦距增加使同一场景的投影变大，落在传感器边界内的场景范围变小。比较全角时应同时看两条边界光线。这里先用物理长度讨论几何；像素单位的换算在像素相机关卡练习。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 15。
body.en: For a fixed sensor size, increasing focal length enlarges the scene projection and reduces the region fitting inside the sensor. Compare both boundary rays when considering the full angle. This geometry uses physical lengths; pixel-unit conversion is practised in the pixel-camera level. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 15.

body.zh: 在相机坐标中，三维点 P=(X,Y,Z) 在正像的虚像平面上投到 (fX/Z,fY/Z)。由相似三角形可得这两个比例；X、Y、Z、f 使用一致的长度单位。一个投影位置对应一条视线，不能单凭它确定深度。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slides 11、18。
body.en: In camera coordinates, a point P=(X,Y,Z) projects to (fX/Z,fY/Z) on the upright virtual image plane. Similar triangles give these proportions; X, Y, Z and f use one length unit. An image position specifies a line of sight and does not determine depth on its own. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 18.

body.zh: 图像可按行、列存成数表。灰度图的形状是高 × 宽；RGB 图是高 × 宽 × 3，每格三个分量。这里讨论数学表示，按 (x,y) 指定列与行。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 22。
body.en: An image is a table of rows and columns: height × width in greyscale, height × width × 3 in RGB. This is a mathematical representation; (x,y) specifies column and row. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 22.

body.zh: 固定传感器尺寸，焦距增加使同一场景的投影变大，落在传感器边界内的场景范围变小。比较全角时应同时看两条边界光线。这里先用物理长度讨论几何；像素单位的换算在像素相机关卡练习。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 15。

This geometry uses physical lengths; pixel-unit conversion is practised in the pixel-camera level. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 15.

ops.zh: 先比较场景与参照的数值；如果只把物点移得更远，像点应当离<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>更远，还是更近？
ops.en: Compare trial and reference measurements first. If only the scene point moves farther away, should its image move farther from the axis or nearer? (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 两条路线在这里汇合：<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>给出相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的偏移，<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>让你能在数表中定位。先在横向坐标条上做两步：按<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>换单位，再用<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>换原点；最后接成<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>相机。
ops.en: The routes meet here: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> gives an offset from the axis, while the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> locates cells in the table. On the horizontal strip, first convert units using <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>, then move the origin using the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>; finally compose a <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> camera. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 横向<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>宽 8 mm、16 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>，物点 X=−1 mm、Z=4 mm，f=2 mm。预测相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的像素偏移。
ops.en: Horizontal <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>: 8 mm across 16 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>; X=−1 mm, Z=4 mm, f=2 mm. Predict the signed image offset in pixel. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 先看条上的单位和原点。第一步只换单位；第二步保留这个偏移，再看<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>在哪里。
ops.en: Check the units and origin on the strip. First change only the unit; then retain that offset and locate the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 这里需要的单位或原点与这个数不同；检查后对照“毫米偏移 → <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>偏移 → 列坐标”。
ops.en: That number uses the wrong unit or origin. After checking compare physical offset, <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> offset and column.

ops.zh: 横向<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>宽 8 mm、16 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>，物点 X=−1 mm、Z=4 mm，f=2 mm。预测从图像原点读取的列坐标；负偏移仍可能落在画面内。
ops.en: Horizontal <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>: 8 mm across 16 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>; X=−1 mm, Z=4 mm, f=2 mm. Predict the column from the image origin; a negative offset can still be inside the frame.

ops.zh: 先看条上的单位和原点。第一步只换单位；第二步保留这个偏移，再看<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>在哪里。
ops.en: Check the units and origin on the strip. First change only the unit; then retain that offset and locate the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 这里需要的单位或原点与这个数不同；检查后对照“毫米偏移 → <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>偏移 → 列坐标”。
ops.en: That number uses the wrong unit or origin. After checking compare physical offset, <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> offset and column.

ops.zh: 输入 X、Z、<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px 和<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x：交出像点的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>横坐标 u。
ops.en: Given X, Z, the <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px and the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x, give the image's <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> column u.

ops.zh: 先只接带符号的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>偏移，检查 X=0 与 X<0 两种情况，再决定图像原点要怎样平移。
ops.en: First wire only the signed <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> offset. Check X=0 and X<0, then decide how the image origin shifts it.

ops.zh: 现在要能处理新的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>、物点和<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>位置。坐标条使用居中的<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>作示例，这块电路的输入 c_x 可以不同；不要写死图像中心。
ops.en: Now handle new focal lengths, scene points and principal-point positions. The strip used a centred example; this circuit accepts different c_x values, so do not hard-code the centre. (<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>) (<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>) (<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 把 (1, 0) 的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>改成纯红，其他格子不动。
ops.en: Change the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> at (1, 0) to pure red, leaving every other cell as it is.

ops.zh: 一个彩色<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>是三个数，按红、绿、蓝的顺序。
ops.en: A colour <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> is three numbers, in the order red, green, blue.

ops.zh: 取<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的两个坐标口，哪个是列、哪个是行？
ops.en: Of the lookup's two coordinate inputs, which is the column and which the row? (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 需要在 x 的右侧再取一次值。使用取<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>、常数、相加和相减元件；坐标口上的 x、y 与前面格子的约定一致。
ops.en: Read once more to the right of x. Use lookup, constant, addition and subtraction parts; x and y follow the same grid convention as before. (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 一整张新图的每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>都要算出它在原图的坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>：给定宽和高，给出两张坐标图，x 图每格是自己的 x，y 图每格是自己的 y；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>接上坐标图，就一次取出整张图。
ops.en: Every <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> of a whole new image needs its coordinates in the original. New part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>: given a width and a height it gives two coordinate images, each cell of x holding its own x and of y its own y; fed coordinate images, <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads a whole image at once.

ops.zh: 这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的值。
ops.en: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> nearest each position.

ops.zh: 0.5 离 0 和 1 一样近；2.2 最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>是哪个？
ops.en: 0.5 is as near 0 as 1; which <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> is nearest 2.2?

ops.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的值。
ops.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> nearest each position.

ops.zh: 保持与<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>相同的采样位置，改用<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>。先看一行上靠左、靠右两点怎样变化，再把这个做法用于四个角；图外仍取最近边界。
ops.en: Keep the same sample positions but use <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>. First compare points near either end of a row, then extend that reasoning to four corners. Outside positions still use the nearest boundary. (<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: [0, 4] 在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25 处取值：按到左右两个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的距离加权，写出每个值。
ops.en: Read [0, 4] at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25, weighting the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> either side by distance: write each value.

ops.zh: 这是照抄最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>：0.25 和 0.75 位置不同，拿到的却是两端的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
ops.en: That copies the nearest <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>: 0.25 and 0.75 sit apart yet read the ends. Weighted by distance, 0.25 reads 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

ops.zh: 有限大小的<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>只接住部分光线。固定它的高度，只改变<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>，观察上下两条边界：怎样让<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>正好为 90°？这一关不涉及<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>换算。
ops.en: A finite <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> captures only some rays. Keep its height fixed and change the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>: how can the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> become exactly 90°? No <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> conversion is needed here.

ops.zh: 图中两条边界同时向<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>收拢，说明固定画幅下，放大投影会舍去更多外围场景。这里用<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>描述这个取舍；全角必须同时包含上、下两半。
ops.en: Both boundary rays close toward the axis: for a fixed frame, enlarging the projection excludes more of the surrounding scene. <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> describes that trade-off; the full angle includes both halves. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 24 mm；本实验只看竖直方向。调 f，让全视场为 90°；用上下两条边界光线核对，不要只看上半角。
ops.en: The <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is 24 mm tall and this experiment uses a vertical slice. Set f for a full field of view of 90°. Check both boundary rays rather than only the upper half-angle.

ops.zh: 全角是 90° 时，上半角是多少？在等比例图里，f 与<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>半高怎样比较？
ops.en: For a full angle of 90°, what is the upper half-angle? In the equal-scale drawing, how does f compare with the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> half-height?

ops.zh: 把全高当作半高时，边界光线与<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的夹角不再是 45°。检查后看全角与半角两个读数。
ops.en: Using the full height as the half-height does not give a 45° edge ray. After checking compare the full and half-angle readings. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: Workshop 2 的一道题：知道物体多高、多远，从照片里量出它占多少<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>，反推镜头的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>。照片里量的是像素，<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>要的是<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的毫米。
ops.en: A Workshop 2 exercise: knowing how tall and how far an object is, measure how many <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> it covers in the photo and work back to the lens's <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>. The photo gives pixel; <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> want millimetres on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 这一关的问题是：<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>和毫米怎样换算，才能代进<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>？<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 smm 毫米、spx 像素；物体在图里高 hpx 像素，实际高 H、距离 Z（毫米）。
ops.en: This level asks: how are <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> and millimetres converted before the <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>? The <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is smm millimetres and spx pixel high; the object covers hpx pixel and is H tall and Z away, in millimetres.

ops.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>换成<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
ops.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> to millimetres on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> first, then h/f = H/Z; pixel and millimetres never share a proportion.

ops.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f（毫米）。
ops.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f in millimetres.

ops.zh: 一个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>在<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上有多少毫米？
ops.en: How many millimetres of <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is one <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>?

ops.zh: 窗口平移时，权重的位置保持固定，读到的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>随位置改变。边缘缺邻居，所以当前输出更窄；<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>的运算与“在哪些位置计算”是两个不同决定。
ops.en: The window moves while weight positions stay fixed and sampled <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> change. Missing edge neighbours make this output narrower: the <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref> and the choice of output positions are separate decisions.

ops.zh: 输出的每格要取原图的三个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>：它们的 x 各是多少？
ops.en: Each output cell reads three <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> of the original: what is each one's x?

ops.zh: 尺寸保住了，边界却加入了人为假设：补零会在边缘引入与内部不同的邻居。输出两端变暗不能直接当成场景中的真实边缘，后面找变化时也必须记得这一点。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: The size is preserved, but an artificial boundary assumption was added. Zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> introduces neighbours unlike the interior. Darkened ends need not be real scene boundaries; remember this when detecting changes.

ops.zh: 以为脉冲出来的就是核 [1, 2, 3]：亮点在左边那一格的右邻，乘的是右权重 3。不翻转时，出来的是倒过来的 [3, 2, 1]。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Expecting the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> [1, 2, 3] back: for the cell to its left, the bright cell is the right neighbour and meets the right weight 3. Without the flip, out comes [3, 2, 1] reversed.

ops.zh: 输入一张图和<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出卷积的结果，图外补 0。
ops.en: Given an image and the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the convolution, 0 outside.

ops.zh: 这条必修路线把<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>转向上下，不依赖核方向路线。先在窗口里追踪一列：保持 x 不动，只改变 y，再把刚验证的读取方式推广到整张图。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: This required route turns <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> vertically, independently of the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>-orientation route. Track one column in the window: keep x fixed, vary y, then extend the checked addressing to the image.

ops.zh: 使用上、中、下权重 [1,0,−1]，图外补零，写出每格结果。窗口可左右选择列、上下移动中心。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Use above/centre/below weights [1,0,−1] with zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>. Write every result. Choose a column and move its centre vertically.

ops.zh: 横向结果成为纵向输入时，两次权重会相乘，而不是相加。这个贡献路径解释了为何能合成二维权重；它只覆盖可分解的核，不能据此把任意二维核都拆开。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: When the horizontal result becomes the vertical input, the two weights multiply rather than add. That contribution path explains the combined 2D weights. It covers separable <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>, not every possible 2D kernel.

ops.zh: 同一条分界从暗到亮与从亮到暗，响应的符号相反；把符号丢掉，就不能判断增亮方向。平坦区域即使很亮也可以没有响应，图像边界的补零却可能制造额外响应。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Reversing a step from dark-to-bright to bright-to-dark reverses the response sign. Losing it loses the brightening direction. A bright flat region can have zero response, while zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> can create extra responses at image boundaries.

ops.zh: 输入一张图，使用已搭好的 <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> 部件输出每个位置的梯度幅度；图外补零。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Given an image, uses the built <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> part to output gradient magnitude at each position, with zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 这次<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>不只把部件摆在一起：权重决定看哪些<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>，平滑改变进入求变化部件的信号。两张输出让你检查“保留了什么”与“哪里变化强”；这仍是局部处理，不等于识别物体。
ops.en: This <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> composes a real signal path: weights select channels and smoothing changes what reaches the change detector. The two outputs show what remains and where it changes strongly. These local operations do not recognise objects. (<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
ops.en: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred channels, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs. (<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 先把三个<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>分开，各自模糊，再乘权重。
ops.en: First take the three channels apart, blur each, then weight them. (<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 一章一章造出视觉的机器。先造一台相机：把场景投影成<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>、在任意位置取值；再造一台卷积器：把邻居加权合起来，搭出模糊器和边缘检测器。每个部件都会在后面直接复用。
ops.en: Build the machines of vision chapter by chapter. First a camera: project a scene into <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> and read it at any position; then a convolver: weigh neighbours together into a blur and an edge detector. Every part is reused later.

ops.zh: 一次拍照可分为：光源 → 表面反射 → 镜头／光学 → <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> → 电信号 → 数字值。最重要的困难是现实世界是三维、普通照片只有二维：一个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>通常告诉我们“这里有多亮”，却不能单独告诉我们这个点离相机多远。因此视觉需要相机模型、多视图、深度传感器或学习模型来补回缺失信息。常见的误解：以为知道一个像素的坐标和亮度就能求出对应的三维点。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§1 成像：三维世界怎样变成二维图像 (slide 8)。
ops.en: Taking a photo can be broken down into: light source → surface reflection → lens/optics → <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> → electrical signal → digital values. The most important difficulty is that the real world is 3D while an ordinary photo is only 2D: a <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> usually tells us ‘how bright it is here’, but cannot on its own tell us how far that point is from the camera. Vision therefore needs camera models, multiple views, depth sensor or learned models to recover the missing information. A common mistake: Thinking that knowing a pixel's coordinates and brightness is enough to work out the corresponding 3D point. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §1 (slide 8).

ops.zh: 在相机坐标中，三维点 P=(X,Y,Z) 在正像的<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>上投到 (fX/Z,fY/Z)。由<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>可得这两个比例；X、Y、Z、f 使用一致的长度单位。一个投影位置对应一条视线，不能单凭它确定深度。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slides 11、18。
ops.en: In camera coordinates, a point P=(X,Y,Z) projects to (fX/Z,fY/Z) on the upright <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>. <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> give these proportions; X, Y, Z and f use one length unit. An image position specifies a line of sight and does not determine depth on its own. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 18.

ops.zh: 同一张图可以提出不同问题，答案形式也不同：识别／分类回答整张图主要是什么类别（如 dog）；检测回答哪些物体在哪里（类别 + 边界框）；分割回答每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>属于什么。关键区分是：分类只给一个或少量类别标签，检测还要给位置，分割要把答案细化到像素。常见的误解：以为检测只是“更准的分类”；检测必须同时输出位置（边界框）。也容易以为分类分数高就代表系统理解了场景。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲笔记，§1 先分清几种常见任务 (slide 7)。
ops.en: The same image can be asked different questions, and the answers take different forms: recognition/classification answers what category the whole image mainly shows (e.g. dog); detection answers which objects are where (category + bounding box); segmentation answers what each <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> belongs to. The key distinction is that classification gives only one or a few category labels, detection must also give locations, and segmentation refines the answer down to individual pixel. A common mistake: Thinking detection is just ‘more accurate classification’; detection must also output locations (bounding boxes). It is also easy to assume that a high classification score means the system has understood the scene. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1 notes, §1 (slide 7).

ops.zh: 固定<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>尺寸，<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>增加使同一场景的投影变大，落在传感器边界内的场景范围变小。比较全角时应同时看两条边界光线。这里先用物理长度讨论几何；<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>单位的换算在像素相机关卡练习。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 15。
ops.en: For a fixed <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> size, increasing <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> enlarges the scene projection and reduces the region fitting inside the sensor. Compare both boundary rays when considering the full angle. This geometry uses physical lengths; <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>-unit conversion is practised in the pixel-camera level. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 15.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>通常从左上角开始：x 向右增加，y 向下增加，并且通常从 0 开始编号。这和数学课上 y 轴向上的笛卡尔坐标不一样。常见的误解：以为 y 轴向上增大；或以为数组下标先写 x 再写 y。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§3 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>坐标、数据类型和文件格式 (slide 26)。
ops.en: Image arrays usually start from the top-left corner: x increases to the right, y increases downwards, and numbering usually starts from 0. This differs from the Cartesian coordinates of maths lessons, where the y-axis points upwards. A common mistake: Thinking y increases upwards; or thinking array indices are written with x first and then y. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §3 (slide 26). (<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>) (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: Crop 从原数组取一个子区域，已有<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>数值不变；Resize 改变数组尺寸，必须为新位置计算像素数值。直接把 768×512 压成 512×512 会改变宽高比，物体可能变胖或变瘦；若保持比例，目标尺寸应接近 512×341。常见的误解：以为裁剪也要插值，或以为缩放只是“截掉一部分”。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 裁剪与缩放不是一回事 (slide 34)。
ops.en: Cropping takes a sub-region of the original array, and the existing <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> values are unchanged; resizing changes the size of the array, so pixel values must be computed for the new positions. Squashing 768×512 straight to 512×512 changes the aspect ratio, so objects may become fatter or thinner; if the proportions are kept, the target size should be about 512×341. A common mistake: Thinking cropping also requires interpolation, or that resizing is just ‘cutting off a part’. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 (slide 34).

ops.zh: 最近邻插值对每个新<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>，找到原图中最近的像素，直接复制它的值。优点是快、边缘硬；缺点是放大或缩小时容易出现明显的块状感或锯齿。常见的误解：以为最近邻会产生原图中没有的新数值；它只复制已有值。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 最近邻插值 (slide 35)。
ops.en: For each new <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>, nearest-neighbour interpolation finds the nearest pixel in the original image and copies its value directly. Its advantages are speed and hard edges; its drawback is that enlarging or shrinking easily produces obvious blockiness or jagged edges. A common mistake: Thinking nearest neighbour produces new values not present in the original image; it only copies existing values. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 (slide 35).

ops.zh: 新位置落在四个旧<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>之间时，设横向距离为 H、纵向距离为 V，四个权重是 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV；它们加起来等于 1，所以双线性插值本质上是四个邻居的加权平均。它通常比<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>平滑，但会让非常锐利的边缘稍微软化，老师说它把模糊并入了采样步骤；缩图时仍要根据采样比例检查是否需要额外抗混叠。常见的误解：把权重配反（让离得远的像素权重更大）；或以为双线性插值不会改变锐利边缘。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 双线性插值 (slide 36)。
ops.en: When a new position falls between four old <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>, let the horizontal distance be H and the vertical distance be V; the four weights are (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V and HV. They sum to 1, so bilinear interpolation is essentially a weighted average of the four neighbours. It is usually smoother than <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>, but slightly softens very sharp edges; the lecturer says it folds blurring into the sampling step. When downsizing, you should still check, based on the sampling ratio, whether extra anti-aliasing is needed. A common mistake: Assigning the weights the wrong way round (giving more distant pixel larger weights); or thinking bilinear interpolation does not alter sharp edges. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 (slide 36).

ops.zh: 逐<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>运算的输出位置 (i,j) 只看输入同一位置的像素，例如变亮、变暗或 gamma correction，各位置独立计算。局部运算会看 (i,j) 周围的一个小区域（邻域），模糊、锐化和边缘检测都属于这一类。局部运算改变的是邻居之间的关系，例如葡萄图中加强邻域差异会让轮廓更明显，也可能放大颗粒感。常见的误解：以为 gamma correction 这类亮度调整也需要邻域。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 三种运算：看一个点、看邻居、做加权和 (slides 6, 8)。
ops.en: In a <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> operation, the output at position (i,j) looks only at the input pixel at the same position, e.g. brightening, darkening or gamma correction; each position is computed independently. A local operation looks at a small region (neighbourhood) around (i,j); blurring, sharpening and edge detection all belong to this category. Local operations change the relationships between neighbours: for example, in the grapes image, strengthening the differences within a neighbourhood makes the outlines more visible, but may also amplify graininess. A common mistake: Thinking brightness adjustments such as gamma correction also need a neighbourhood. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1 (slides 6, 8).

ops.zh: 线性滤波器是局部运算的一种：把邻域中的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>分别乘以权重再相加。这些权重排成的小矩阵叫<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>或滤波器。它与一般局部运算的区别在于组合方式固定为加权和。常见的误解：把所有局部运算都当成线性滤波。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 线性滤波器。
ops.en: A linear filter is one kind of local operation: it multiplies each <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> in the neighbourhood by a weight and then adds them up. The small matrix formed by these weights is called the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> or filter. What distinguishes it from general local operations is that the way of combining is fixed as a weighted sum. A common mistake: Treating every local operation as linear filtering. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1.

ops.zh: 把<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>放在图像的一个位置，对齐后逐项相乘再相加，写作 g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v)，其中 f 是输入、h 是核权重、g 是输出、(u,v) 是邻域内偏移。式中的 i−u、j−v 表示卷积；按窗口直接对齐相乘的互相关则读作 i+u、j+v。中心权重为 1、其余为 0 时两者都只是复制当前<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>。常见的误解：以为公式里的 i−u 与窗口直接对齐相乘是同一件事。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>到底在算什么 (slide 9)。
ops.en: Place the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> at one position in the image, align it, multiply element by element and then add up, written as g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v), where f is the input, h the kernel weights, g the output and (u,v) the offset within the neighbourhood. The i−u, j−v in the formula denote convolution; cross-correlation, which multiplies directly with the window aligned, reads i+u, j+v instead. When the centre weight is 1 and all others are 0, both copy the current <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>. A common mistake: Thinking the i−u in the formula is the same thing as multiplying directly with the window aligned. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1 (slide 9). (<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 在图像外补<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>可使输出与输入同尺寸。Constant/zero 补固定值，简单但可能制造黑边；Wrap 把左接右、上接下，适合 tileable 纹理而不适合普通照片；Clamp/replicate 把边缘像素向外延伸，普通照片通常较自然；Reflect 镜像延伸，常能减少人工边界。没有一种规则永远最好，要看图像是否周期性、任务是否关心边缘及滤波器性质。常见的误解：以为补零总是最好的默认选择。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§4 四种常见边界规则 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45)。
ops.en: Padding <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> outside the image lets the output be the same size as the input. Constant/zero fills with a fixed value, which is simple but may create black borders; Wrap joins left to right and top to bottom, which suits tileable textures but not ordinary photos; Clamp/replicate extends the edge pixel outwards, which usually looks more natural for ordinary photos; Reflect extends by mirroring and often reduces artificial borders. No rule is always best; it depends on whether the image is periodic, whether the task cares about the edges and the properties of the filter. A common mistake: Thinking zero padding is always the best default choice. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §4 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45).

ops.zh: 两者都做“滑动、相乘、相加”，唯一关键区别是卷积先把核旋转 180° 再使用，互相关直接使用。核关于中心对称时两者结果相同；核不对称时方向会改变。手算前要先确定是否翻核。常见的误解：以为翻转只是左右翻，或以为任何核卷积与互相关结果都不同。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 互相关和卷积 (slide 17)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Both do ‘slide, multiply, add’; the only key difference is that convolution first rotates the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> by 180° before using it, whereas cross-correlation uses it directly. When the kernel is symmetric about its centre the two give the same result; when it is not, the direction changes. Before calculating by hand, first decide whether to flip the kernel. A common mistake: Thinking the flip is only a left–right flip, or thinking convolution and cross-correlation give different results for every kernel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1 (slide 17).

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>满足交换律 f*h=h*f、结合律 f*h₁*h₂=f*(h₁*h₂)、分配律（滤波器可分配到相加的图像上）和标量结合律 k(f*h)=(kf)*h=f*(kh)。这些性质帮助重排计算。理论上可以交换或合并操作，但实际还要考虑图像大小、内存访问、是否需要中间结果和程序库实现。常见的误解：以为数学上可交换就一定更快。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§3 线性滤波的四个代数性质 (slide 37)。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> satisfies commutativity f*h=h*f, associativity f*h₁*h₂=f*(h₁*h₂), distributivity (a filter distributes over images that are added together) and scalar associativity k(f*h)=(kf)*h=f*(kh). These properties help rearrange the computation. In theory operations can be swapped or combined, but in practice you also have to consider image size, memory access, whether intermediate results are needed and the library's implementation. A common mistake: Thinking that being mathematically interchangeable necessarily makes it faster. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §3 (slide 37).

ops.zh: 若二维核可写成一个列向量与一个行向量的外积，就叫可分离，此时可先对每一行做一维滤波，再对每一列做一维滤波。k×k 核每<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>约需 k² 次乘法，拆开后约需 2k 次，k 大时差别明显。高斯核常常接近或可以构造成可分离核。常见的误解：以为任何二维核都能拆成两个一维核。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§3 可分离滤波：把二维计算拆成两次一维计算 (slides 39, 40)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: If a 2D <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> can be written as the outer product of a column vector and a row vector, it is called separable; you can then first apply a 1D filter to each row and then a 1D filter to each column. A k×k kernel needs about k² multiplications per <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>; split up, it needs about 2k, and the difference is significant when k is large. Gaussian kernel are often close to separable or can be constructed to be separable. A common mistake: Thinking any 2D kernel can be split into two 1D kernel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §3 (slides 39, 40).

ops.zh: 均值滤波给邻域每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>相同权重；高斯滤波离中心越近权重越大，形式为 G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²))。σ 控制影响范围，σ 越大模糊越强。模糊核通常归一化使权重和为 1，以免改变整体平均亮度；两种核都减少细节，但权重分配不同，保留的细节也不同。常见的误解：以为高斯模糊和均值模糊效果完全一样，或忘记归一化。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§2 模糊：让变化变慢 (slides 27, 28)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: A mean filter gives every <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> in the neighbourhood the same weight; a Gaussian filter gives larger weights the closer a pixel is to the centre, in the form G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²)). σ controls the extent of the influence: the larger σ, the stronger the blur. Blur <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> are usually normalised so that the weights sum to 1, so as not to change the overall average brightness; both kernel reduce detail, but they distribute the weights differently, so they preserve different detail. A common mistake: Thinking Gaussian blur and mean blur have exactly the same effect, or forgetting to normalise. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 (slides 27, 28).

ops.zh: Sobel 用相互垂直的两组权重近似求强度变化。本游戏直接按窗口对齐相乘：g_x 的横向权重为 [−1,0,1]、纵向为 [1,2,1]；g_y 交换两个方向，所以沿坐标正方向从暗到亮为正。数学卷积采用相反的核写法；不能把互相关的符号约定与翻转后的核混用。[1,2,1] 的和为 4，本游戏不额外归一化。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 29–30。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Sobel approximates intensity changes with two perpendicular sets of weights. This game aligns weights directly with the window: g_x uses [−1,0,1] across and [1,2,1] down; g_y swaps the directions. Dark to bright along a positive coordinate direction is therefore positive. Mathematical convolution writes the flipped <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>; do not mix conventions. The [1,2,1] weights sum to 4 and are not normalised here. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 29–30.

ops.zh: RGB 图像除空间维度外还有<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>维度，颜色滤波器尺寸可以是 K_h×K_w×3。它同时看同一邻域的 R、G、B，把所有乘积加在一起得到一个输出数值。常见错误是把 height×width×channel 当成普通二维图像，忘记核还要覆盖颜色通道维度。常见的误解：以为彩色滤波得到三个输出值或只对一个颜色通道操作。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§2 彩色图像的滤波核多了一个维度 (slide 31)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Besides its spatial dimensions, an RGB image also has a <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> dimension, so a colour filter can have size K_h×K_w×3. It looks at R, G and B in the same neighbourhood at once and sums all the products to give a single output value. A common mistake is to treat height×width×colour channel as an ordinary 2D image and forget that the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> must also cover the colour channel dimension. A common mistake: Thinking colour filtering produces three output values, or operates on only one colour channel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 (slide 31).

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 20 mm 对应 200 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>，物体在图像中高 100 像素，所以它在传感器上高 h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm。物体实际高 h_o = 120 mm、距离 z = 600 mm，由<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> h_i/f = h_o/z 得 f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm。重点是先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，不能直接把像素和毫米放进同一个比例式。常见的误解：直接把 100 像素当作 h_i 代入，得到单位混乱的 f = 100×600/120 = 500。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · 用传感器尺寸求<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>。
ops.en: A <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>, and the object is 100 pixel high in the image, so its height on the sensor is h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm. The object's real height is h_o = 120 mm and its distance is z = 600 mm, so by <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> h_i/f = h_o/z, giving f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm. The key point is to convert pixel into millimetres on the sensor first; you cannot put pixel and millimetres directly into the same proportion. A common mistake: Substituting the 100 pixel directly as h_i, giving f = 100×600/120 = 500 with muddled units. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 ·. (<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: cv2.imread 默认读入 BGR，但 matplotlib.pyplot.imshow 按 RGB 显示，所以显示前要用 cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) 转换。这只改变<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>顺序，不改变图像内容或空间尺寸。常见的误解：显示时红蓝颠倒，却以为图片本身坏了；或以为转换会改变图像尺寸。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV 和 Matplotlib 的颜色顺序。
ops.en: cv2.imread reads images as BGR by default, but matplotlib.pyplot.imshow displays them as RGB, so convert with cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) before displaying. This changes only the <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> order, not the image content or spatial size. A common mistake: Seeing red and blue swapped on display and thinking the image itself is broken; or thinking the conversion changes the image size. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV Matplotlib.

ops.zh: Workshop 中对 BGR 图像把红色<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>改成蓝色与绿色颜色通道的平均值：R'(x,y) = (G(x,y)+B(x,y))/2。如果原数组是 uint8，要先用较宽或浮点类型做计算，再明确 cast，避免溢出或隐式截断。常见的误解：在 BGR 数组里把第 0 个颜色通道当成红色；或直接用 uint8 相加后再除以 2。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝。
ops.en: In the workshop, the red <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> of a BGR image is replaced by the average of the blue and green channels: R'(x,y) = (G(x,y)+B(x,y))/2. If the original array is uint8, first do the calculation in a wider or floating-point type, then cast explicitly, to avoid overflow or implicit truncation. A common mistake: Treating colour channel 0 of a BGR array as red; or adding directly in uint8 and then dividing by 2. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 ·.

ops.zh: 穿过<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>、垂直于像平面的参考直线。本游戏以它为 Z 方向，物点的横向偏移和像点的带符号偏移都相对它测量。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The reference line through the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> perpendicular to the image plane. It is the Z direction here; lateral scene and image offsets are measured relative to it. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

ops.zh: 理想针孔模型中所有投影光线经过的点 O，也是相机坐标的原点。<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>在它前方。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The point O through which all projection rays pass in the ideal pinhole model, and the origin of camera coordinates. The <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref> is in front of it. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

ops.zh: 为避免倒像而假想放在相机前方的成像平面，离<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>的距离是 f。真实针孔后的屏幕会倒像；这里不混用这两种约定。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: An imaginary image plane in front of the camera, at distance f from its centre, used to avoid inversion. A screen behind a real pinhole gives an inverted image; the two conventions are not mixed here. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22. (<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 本课程理想投影模型中的 f 表示<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>到<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>的距离。物体位置不变时，f 越大，投影的长度或偏移越大。真实镜头的完整光学模型不由这一个参数描述。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: In this ideal projection model f is the distance from the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> to the <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>. For a fixed scene, a larger f gives a larger projected length or offset. One parameter does not describe the full optics of a real lens. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

ops.zh: 对应角相等、对应边成比例的三角形。针孔侧视图里，物点和像点与<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>构成的两个直角三角形共用一个角，因此 u/f = X/Z。图若纵横缩放不同，比例关系由标注数值而非画面角度判断。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: Triangles with equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides. In the pinhole slice, the right triangles from scene and image points share an angle at the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>, so u/f = X/Z. In a stretched schematic use the measurements rather than apparent angles. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

ops.zh: 将到达平面的光记录为数字读数的器件。在本游戏的几何图里，用一段有限宽或高的区域表示它；光轴居中、<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>间距均匀是示例的假设。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The device recording incoming light as digital measurements. In these geometric views it is a finite width or height; a centred optical axis and uniform <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> spacing are assumptions of the examples. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

ops.zh: 从<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>向<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上、下边缘看去，两条边界光线之间的全角。对居中的传感器，高 S、<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f 时，半角满足 tan(θ/2)=S/(2f)，所以全角为 2 arctan(S/(2f))。水平视场将高度换成宽度。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The full angle between rays from the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> to the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> top and bottom edges. For a centred sensor of height S and <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f, tan(θ/2)=S/(2f), giving θ=2 arctan(S/(2f)). For horizontal field of view use width instead of height. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

ops.zh: 彩色图像中同一类分量组成的二维数表。本游戏主线约定一个彩色<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>按 R、G、B 排列，每个值在 0 到 1 之间；取一个通道不改变空间位置。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 22–25。
ops.en: A 2D table of one component of a colour image. Main-path examples use R, G, B order with values from 0 to 1; extracting a channel preserves spatial locations. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 22–25. (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 相邻<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>中心在<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的物理距离。均匀采样时，传感器宽 W、横向 N 个像素，间距 s=W/N。物理偏移除以 s 才得到像素偏移。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The physical distance between adjacent <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> centres on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>. With uniform sampling, a width W containing N pixel has pitch s=W/N. Divide a physical offset by s to obtain an offset in pixel. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>与像平面的交点。用图像坐标表示为 (c_x,c_y)，不一定在图像中心。本游戏坐标条假设居中；<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>中心索引从 0 到 N−1 时，居中位置为 (N−1)/2，<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>两边界为 −0.5 和 N−0.5。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The intersection of the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref> and image plane, at image coordinates (c_x,c_y); it need not be at the image centre. These strips assume it is centred: with centre indices 0 to N−1, its coordinate is (N−1)/2 and <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> edges are −0.5 and N−0.5. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22. (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 把物理<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f 除以对应方向的<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref> s，得到 f_px=f/s。横向和纵向间距不同时两个方向的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>焦距也不同。它是单位换算，并没有移动相机或改变光路。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The physical <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f divided by the <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref> s in the relevant direction: f_px=f/s. Different horizontal and vertical pitches give different values. This converts units without moving the camera or changing its rays. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22. (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 在横向相机切面里，物点横向 X、深度 Z 的带符号投影偏移是 f_px X/Z；从图像左侧的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>中心原点读坐标时，还需加上<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>坐标 c_x：x=f_px X/Z+c_x。偏移可以为负，列坐标的原点不同。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: In a horizontal camera slice the signed projected offset is f_px X/Z for lateral X and depth Z. To express it from the image <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>-centre origin, add the principal-point coordinate c_x: x=f_px X/Z+c_x. Signed offset and column coordinate have different origins. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22. (<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 只有一个位置非零的图像。移动窗口时，观察这个位置分别被哪一个权重乘到，可以辨别核的方向。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 3, slide 17。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: An image with a single nonzero location. Tracking which weight meets that location as the window moves reveals the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> orientation. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slide 17.

step.why: Revise Chapters 1–2: independent required routes, controlled experiments and clickable terminology

inverse.zh: 只有一个位置非零的图像。移动窗口时，观察这个位置分别被哪一个权重乘到，可以辨别核的方向。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 3, slide 17。
inverse.en: An image with a single nonzero location. Tracking which weight meets that location as the window moves reveals the kernel orientation. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slide 17.

inverse.zh: 在横向相机切面里，物点横向 X、深度 Z 的带符号投影偏移是 f_px X/Z；从图像左侧的像素中心原点读坐标时，还需加上主点坐标 c_x：x=f_px X/Z+c_x。偏移可以为负，列坐标的原点不同。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: In a horizontal camera slice the signed projected offset is f_px X/Z for lateral X and depth Z. To express it from the image pixel-centre origin, add the principal-point coordinate c_x: x=f_px X/Z+c_x. Signed offset and column coordinate have different origins. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 把物理焦距 f 除以对应方向的像素间距 s，得到 f_px=f/s。横向和纵向间距不同时两个方向的像素焦距也不同。它是单位换算，并没有移动相机或改变光路。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: The physical focal length f divided by the pixel pitch s in the relevant direction: f_px=f/s. Different horizontal and vertical pitches give different values. This converts units without moving the camera or changing its rays. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 光轴与像平面的交点。用图像坐标表示为 (c_x,c_y)，不一定在图像中心。本游戏坐标条假设居中；像素中心索引从 0 到 N−1 时，居中位置为 (N−1)/2，传感器两边界为 −0.5 和 N−0.5。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: The intersection of the optical axis and image plane, at image coordinates (c_x,c_y); it need not be at the image centre. These strips assume it is centred: with centre indices 0 to N−1, its coordinate is (N−1)/2 and sensor edges are −0.5 and N−0.5. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 相邻像素中心在传感器上的物理距离。均匀采样时，传感器宽 W、横向 N 个像素，间距 s=W/N。物理偏移除以 s 才得到像素偏移。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: The physical distance between adjacent pixel centres on the sensor. With uniform sampling, a width W containing N pixels has pitch s=W/N. Divide a physical offset by s to obtain an offset in pixels. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 彩色图像中同一类分量组成的二维数表。本游戏主线约定一个彩色像素按 R、G、B 排列，每个值在 0 到 1 之间；取一个通道不改变空间位置。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 22–25。
inverse.en: A 2D table of one component of a colour image. Main-path examples use R, G, B order with values from 0 to 1; extracting a channel preserves spatial locations. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 22–25.

inverse.zh: 从相机中心向传感器上、下边缘看去，两条边界光线之间的全角。对居中的传感器，高 S、焦距 f 时，半角满足 tan(θ/2)=S/(2f)，所以全角为 2 arctan(S/(2f))。水平视场将高度换成宽度。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: The full angle between rays from the camera centre to the sensor top and bottom edges. For a centred sensor of height S and focal length f, tan(θ/2)=S/(2f), giving θ=2 arctan(S/(2f)). For horizontal field of view use width instead of height. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 将到达平面的光记录为数字读数的器件。在本游戏的几何图里，用一段有限宽或高的区域表示它；光轴居中、像素间距均匀是示例的假设。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: The device recording incoming light as digital measurements. In these geometric views it is a finite width or height; a centred optical axis and uniform pixel spacing are assumptions of the examples. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 对应角相等、对应边成比例的三角形。针孔侧视图里，物点和像点与相机中心构成的两个直角三角形共用一个角，因此 u/f = X/Z。图若纵横缩放不同，比例关系由标注数值而非画面角度判断。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: Triangles with equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides. In the pinhole slice, the right triangles from scene and image points share an angle at the camera centre, so u/f = X/Z. In a stretched schematic use the measurements rather than apparent angles. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 本课程理想投影模型中的 f 表示相机中心到虚像平面的距离。物体位置不变时，f 越大，投影的长度或偏移越大。真实镜头的完整光学模型不由这一个参数描述。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: In this ideal projection model f is the distance from the camera centre to the virtual image plane. For a fixed scene, a larger f gives a larger projected length or offset. One parameter does not describe the full optics of a real lens. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 为避免倒像而假想放在相机前方的成像平面，离相机中心的距离是 f。真实针孔后的屏幕会倒像；这里不混用这两种约定。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: An imaginary image plane in front of the camera, at distance f from its centre, used to avoid inversion. A screen behind a real pinhole gives an inverted image; the two conventions are not mixed here. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 理想针孔模型中所有投影光线经过的点 O，也是相机坐标的原点。虚像平面在它前方。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
inverse.en: The point O through which all projection rays pass in the ideal pinhole model, and the origin of camera coordinates. The virtual image plane is in front of it. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

inverse.zh: 穿过相机中心、垂直于像平面的参考直线。本游戏以它为 Z 方向，物点的横向偏移和像点的带符号偏移都相对它测量。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
