after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>: big-and-far pictures like small-and-near; working back needs the distance first; colour and count are what a picture settles.

brief.zh: f = 2：调物高 H 和距离 Z，让像高仍是 0.5，箭至少 2 米高。
brief.en: f = 2: set the height H and the distance Z so the image is still 0.5 tall, the arrow at least 2 m.

hint.zh: 物高加倍、距离不变，像会怎样？距离也加倍呢？
hint.en: Double the height and keep the distance: what does the image do? Double the distance too?

why.zh: 只把箭加高：距离不变，像也跟着加倍成 1。要让像不变，距离得和物高一起加倍。
why.en: Only making the arrow taller: at the same distance its image doubles to 1. For the same image the distance must double with the height.

t.zh: 倒过来：已知像点的位置 u，物点在哪？只有像不够，还得假设一个距离 Z。
t.en: The other way: given the image position u, where is the point? The image alone is not enough; a distance Z must be assumed.

brief.zh: 输入像点位置 u、像平面距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
brief.en: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X.

hint.zh: u = fX/Z，把 X 解出来。
hint.en: u = fX/Z: solve it for X.

t.zh: 到这里，每个新值都只看原图的一个位置。可模糊、找边这样的处理，要看一个像素周围的一片：<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>。最常用的一种，是把邻域里的像素各乘一个权重再相加，这组权重叫<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的卷积核。
t.en: So far each new value looks at one position of the original. Blurring or finding edges needs the patch around a pixel: <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>. The commonest kind multiplies each pixel of the neighbourhood by a weight and adds them up; the weights are the kernel of a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：让一组权重沿着一行滑过去，每个位置算一次加权和，结果是什么样？先手算一行，再接成电路：输入一张图和左、中、右三个权重。
t.en: This level asks: sliding three weights along a row and taking the weighted sum at each position, what comes out? First work out a row by hand, then wire it: an image and the left, centre and right weights.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>：一组权重滑过整张图，每个位置算一次加权和。只算三格都在图里的位置，输出比原图窄 2。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>: a set of weights slides over the image, one weighted sum per position. Taking only positions with all three cells inside, the output is 2 narrower.

brief.zh: 权重左 1、中 0、右 −1 滑过这一行：写出三格都在图里的每个位置的加权和。
brief.en: Slide the weights left 1, centre 0, right −1 along this row: write the weighted sum at each position whose three cells are all inside.

hint.zh: 第一个位置以 x = 1 为中心：1 × 左邻 + 0 × 自己 + (−1) × 右邻。
hint.en: The first position is centred on x = 1: 1 × left + 0 × here + (−1) × right.

why.zh: 这是右邻减左邻：权重左 1、右 −1，是左邻减右邻。权重跟着位置走，不要颠倒。
why.en: That is right less left: with the left weight 1 and the right −1 it is left less right. The weights go with their positions.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref>读出图的宽 w 和高 h。只算三格都在图里的位置：输出宽 w − 2，第 x 格以原图的 x + 1 为中心。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref> gives an image's width w and height h. Take only positions with all three cells inside: the output is w − 2 wide, its cell x centred on the original x + 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

hint.zh: 输出的每格要取原图的三个像素：它们的 x 各是多少？
hint.en: Each output cell reads three pixels of the original: what is each one's x?

t.zh: 要一张小一点的图，有两种做法：裁剪是从原图里取一块，每个值都是原图里本来就有的；缩放是把整张图变成别的尺寸，新位置上的值要算出来。
t.en: There are two ways to a smaller picture: cropping takes a part of the original, every value one the original already has; resizing changes the whole picture's size, and the values at the new positions must be worked out.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：裁剪出的图，每个像素来自原图的哪里？先在格子上手裁一块，再接出一块裁剪电路。
t.en: This level asks: where in the original does each pixel of a crop come from? First crop by hand on the grid, then wire a cropping circuit.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、左上角 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h，输出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块
desc.en: Takes an image, the top-left corner x0, y0, and a width w and height h; gives the w × h region from (x0, y0)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>：裁剪只是平移坐标去取原值；缩放要在原图里没有像素的位置上算出新值。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>: a crop only shifts coordinates to read existing values; a resize must work out values where the original has no pixel.

brief.en: Crop the 2 × 2 region (width 2, height 2) starting at (1, 1).

hint.zh: 新图的 (0, 0) 来自原图的哪一格？
hint.en: Which cell of the original does the new (0, 0) come from?

why.zh: 这是从 (0, 0) 起裁的：新图的 (0, 0) 要取原图的 (1, 1)，每个坐标都加上左上角的偏移。
why.en: That crops from (0, 0): the new (0, 0) must read the original (1, 1); every coordinate adds the corner's offset.

t.zh: 一整张新图的每个像素都要算出它在原图的坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>：给定宽和高，给出两张坐标图，x 图每格是自己的 x，y 图每格是自己的 y；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>接上坐标图，就一次取出整张图。
t.en: Every pixel of a whole new image needs its coordinates in the original. New part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>: given a width and a height it gives two coordinate images, each cell of x holding its own x and of y its own y; fed coordinate images, <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads a whole image at once.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
brief.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

hint.zh: 先给新图每格一对自己的坐标，再挪到原图里去。
hint.en: First give each new cell its own coordinates, then move them into the original.

t.zh: 把一个像素和它的邻居平均，图就模糊了。均值滤波每个邻居一样重；高斯滤波让中心最重、越远越轻，模糊得更柔和、更自然。
t.en: Averaging a pixel with its neighbours blurs the picture. A mean filter weighs every neighbour equally; a Gaussian weighs the centre most and the farther ones less, a softer, more natural blur.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个亮点经过高斯模糊，会变成什么样？先手算，再用二维滤波器接一个高斯模糊器：行和列的权重都是 1/4、1/2、1/4。
t.en: This level asks: what does a single bright point become after a Gaussian blur? Work it out by hand, then wire a Gaussian blur from the 2D filter, the row and column weights both 1/4, 1/2, 1/4.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 横竖各滤一遍的模糊图，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image; gives it blurred by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] across and down, 0 outside

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>：一个亮点变成中间亮、四周渐暗的一团。核越大、σ 越大，模糊越强。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>: a bright point becomes a blob, bright in the middle and fading out. The larger the kernel and σ, the stronger the blur.

brief.zh: 这张图只有 (1, 1) 是 16：横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤一遍，图外补 0，写出结果。
brief.en: Only (1, 1) of this image is 16: filter across and down with [1/4, 1/2, 1/4], 0 outside, and write the result.

hint.zh: 先横着滤：16 分到左、中、右三格各是多少？
hint.en: Filter across first: how much of the 16 goes to the left, centre and right?

why.zh: 这是只横着滤了一遍：竖直方向也要滤，亮点向上下扩散，中心只剩 4。
why.en: That filters across only: down must be filtered too, spreading the point up and down and leaving 4 at the centre.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤过的模糊图。
brief.en: Given an image, give it filtered across and down by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4].

hint.zh: <part-ref to="filter2D"></part-ref> 要六个权重。
hint.en: The <part-ref to="filter2D"></part-ref> takes six weights.

solution: f = filter2D(image, q, h, q, q, h, q)
naive: f = filter2D(image, t, t, t, z, o, z)

t.zh: 边是亮度突然变化的地方。右邻减左邻，在平坦处是 0，在边上不是 0：这就是一个找边的核。再竖着用 [1, 2, 1] 平均一下，抗噪声更好，就是 Sobel 核。
t.en: An edge is where brightness changes suddenly. Right less left is 0 on flat ground and not 0 on an edge: an edge-finding kernel. Averaging down the column with [1, 2, 1] resists noise better: that is the Sobel kernel.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：Sobel 的两个响应 gx、gy 在不同方向的边上各是什么？先在一行上手算横向的差，再接一块同时输出 gx 和 gy 的 Sobel 滤波器。
t.en: This level asks: what are Sobel's two responses gx and gy on edges running different ways? First work out the differences across a row by hand, then wire a Sobel filter giving gx and gy together.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出横向响应 gx（右邻减左邻，竖直用 [1, 2, 1] 平均）和纵向响应 gy（下邻减上邻，横向用 [1, 2, 1] 平均）
desc.en: Takes an image; gives the across response gx (right less left, averaged [1, 2, 1] down) and the down response gy (below less above, averaged [1, 2, 1] across)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>：gx 对竖着的边有响应，gy 对横着的边有响应；从暗到亮为正，从亮到暗为负。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>: gx responds to upright edges and gy to level ones; dark to bright is positive, bright to dark negative.

brief.zh: 只看横向：每格算右邻减左邻（图外补 0），写出结果。
brief.en: Across only: at each cell take the right neighbour less the left (0 outside) and write the result.

hint.zh: 从暗到亮的地方是正，从亮到暗呢？平的地方呢？
hint.en: Dark to bright is positive; and bright to dark? And where it is flat?

why.zh: 这是只看变化有多大：响应带符号，从亮到暗的地方右邻比左邻暗，是负的。
why.en: That records only how big the change is: the response is signed, and where it goes bright to dark the right neighbour is darker, so it is negative.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出 gx（横向权重 −1、0、1，竖向 1、2、1）和 gy（横向 1、2、1，竖向 −1、0、1）。
brief.en: Given an image, give gx (across −1, 0, 1; down 1, 2, 1) and gy (across 1, 2, 1; down −1, 0, 1).

hint.zh: 两个响应都是二维滤波器，只是权重不同。
hint.en: Both responses are 2D filters with different weights.

solution: x = filter2D(image, m, z, o, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, m, z, o)
naive: x = filter2D(image, o, z, m, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, m, z, o)

title.en: A picture is a table of numbers

t.zh: 传感器的每个像素记下一个亮度，一张灰度图就是一张 h 行、w 列的数表；彩色图的每格是红、绿、蓝三个数。约定：x 向右数、y 向下数，都从 0 开始，第 y 行第 x 列写作 (x, y)。
t.en: Each sensor pixel records a brightness, so a grey picture is a table of h rows and w columns; in a colour one each cell holds three numbers, red, green and blue. The convention: x counts right and y down, both from 0, and row y, column x is written (x, y).

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个像素在数表的哪里，怎样读出它的值？先在格子上指出坐标、改一个彩色像素，再接一块读相邻两个像素之差的电路。
t.en: This level asks: where in the table is a pixel, and how is its value read? First give a cell's coordinates and change a colour pixel on the grid, then wire a circuit that reads the difference between two neighbouring pixels.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>，按<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>读。
after.en: This is how an <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> is laid out: its shape is h × w (× 3 in colour), read at (x, y) by the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 写出高亮那一格的坐标 (x, y)。
brief.en: Write the coordinates (x, y) of the highlighted cell.

hint.zh: x 是第几列，y 是第几行，都从 0 数起。
hint.en: x is the column and y the row, both counted from 0.

why.zh: 这是先写行、再写列（矩阵的习惯）：图像坐标先写 x（列），再写 y（行），高亮的格子在第 1 行第 2 列，是 (2, 1)。
why.en: That gives the row first, the matrix way: image coordinates give x, the column, first and y, the row, second; the highlighted cell is in row 1, column 2, so (2, 1).

brief.zh: 把 (1, 0) 的像素改成纯红，其他格子不动。
brief.en: Change the pixel at (1, 0) to pure red, leaving every other cell as it is.

hint.zh: 一个彩色像素是三个数，按红、绿、蓝的顺序。
hint.en: A colour pixel is three numbers, in the order red, green, blue.

why.zh: 改的是 (0, 1)：x 和 y 写反了。(1, 0) 是第 0 行第 1 列。
why.en: That changes (0, 1): x and y swapped. (1, 0) is row 0, column 1.

t.zh: 新元件：<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>按坐标读出一个像素，<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数，<part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref>相减。
t.en: New parts: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads the pixel at coordinates, <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number, <part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref> subtracts.

brief.zh: 输入一张灰度图和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
brief.en: Given a grey image and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

hint.zh: 取像素的两个坐标口，哪个是列、哪个是行？
hint.en: Of the lookup's two coordinate inputs, which is the column and which the row?

t.zh: Workshop 2 的一道题：知道物体多高、多远，从照片里量出它占多少像素，反推镜头的焦距。照片里量的是像素，相似三角形要的是传感器上的毫米。
t.en: A Workshop 2 exercise: knowing how tall and how far an object is, measure how many pixels it covers in the photo and work back to the lens's focal length. The photo gives pixels; similar triangles want millimetres on the sensor.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：像素和毫米怎样换算，才能代进相似三角形？传感器高 smm 毫米、spx 像素；物体在图里高 hpx 像素，实际高 H、距离 Z（毫米）。
t.en: This level asks: how are pixels and millimetres converted before the similar triangles? The sensor is smm millimetres and spx pixels high; the object covers hpx pixels and is H tall and Z away, in millimetres.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert pixels to millimetres on the sensor first, then h/f = H/Z; pixels and millimetres never share a proportion.

brief.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出焦距 f（毫米）。
brief.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the focal length f in millimetres.

hint.zh: 一个像素在传感器上有多少毫米？
hint.en: How many millimetres of sensor is one pixel?

t.zh: 最近邻只会照抄：落在两个像素之间的位置，不是取左边就是取右边，离得近一点远一点都一样。放大后的图因此成块。
t.en: Nearest neighbour only copies: a position between two pixels reads the left one or the right one, however near it is to either. That is why enlargements come out blocky.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：位置落在像素之间，值能不能按它离各个像素的远近来算？先在一行上手算，再在 2 × 2 的方格里手算，最后接成电路。位置照旧直接给出，落到图外取最近的边。
t.en: This level asks: can a position between pixels take a value by how near it is to each? Work it out on a row by hand, then inside a 2 × 2 square, then wire it. The positions are given as before; outside the image, the nearest edge.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：四个邻居按横竖两个距离加权平均，比最近邻平滑。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: four neighbours weighted (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V, HV; smoother than nearest neighbour, it softens sharp edges a little.

brief.zh: [0, 4] 在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25 处取值：按到左右两个像素的距离加权，写出每个值。
brief.en: Read [0, 4] at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25, weighting the pixels either side by distance: write each value.

hint.zh: x = 0.25 离 0 有 0.25，离 1 有 0.75：离得近的那边该占几成？
hint.en: x = 0.25 is 0.25 from 0 and 0.75 from 1: what share should the nearer side take?

why.zh: 这是照抄最近的像素：0.25 和 0.75 位置不同，拿到的却是两端的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
why.en: That copies the nearest pixel: 0.25 and 0.75 sit apart yet read the ends. Weighted by distance, 0.25 reads 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

brief.zh: 这张 2 × 2 的图在 x、y 都取 −1/6、0.5、7/6 的 9 个位置取值：写出 3 × 3 的结果。
brief.en: Read this 2 × 2 image at the nine positions where x and y are each −1/6, 0.5 or 7/6: write the 3 × 3 result.

hint.zh: 中间那一行在 y = 0.5，正好在两行中间：先把上下两行各自横着算好，再竖着取中间。
hint.en: The middle row is at y = 0.5, right between the rows: work out the top and bottom rows across first, then take between them.

why.zh: 这是只横着加权、竖直方向照抄最近的一行：中间一行在两行正中，却整个抄了下面一行。竖着也按距离加权，中心是四个邻居的平均 6。
why.en: That weights across only and copies the nearest row: the middle row, right between two, copies the lower. Weighted by distance downwards too, the centre is the average of the four, 6.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
brief.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance.

hint.zh: 先找出左上的邻居：坐标向下取整；位置离它多远，就是右边和下边邻居的权重。
hint.en: First find the top-left neighbour: round the coordinates down; how far the position is from it is the weight of the neighbours right and below.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref>给出平方根。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref> gives the square root.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出每个位置的梯度大小 √(gx² + gy²)。
brief.en: Given an image, give the gradient's size √(gx² + gy²) at each position.

hint.zh: gx、gy 有正有负；直接相加，正负会抵消。
hint.en: gx and gy can be negative; added as they are, they cancel.

value.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>：方向由 gx、gy 定，大小是 √(gx² + gy²)。这台边缘检测器后面还会用到。
value.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>: its direction set by gx and gy, its size √(gx² + gy²). This edge detector is used again later.

t.zh: <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref>：gx 和 gy 合起来是一个箭头，叫梯度，指向亮度增加最快的方向；它的长度说明边有多强，不管边朝哪边。
t.en: An <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref>: gx and gy together make an arrow, the gradient, pointing the way brightness rises fastest; its length says how strong the edge is, whichever way it runs.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样不管方向、只量出边有多强？比如 gx = 4、gy = 0 时它指向右，gx = 0、gy = −4 时指向上（y 向下数）。用 Sobel 接出梯度的大小；新元件开平方。
t.en: This level asks: how is an edge's strength measured, whatever its direction? With gx = 4 and gy = 0 it points right, with gx = 0 and gy = −4 up (y counts down). Wire the gradient's size from the Sobel filter; new part: square root.

value.zh: 梯度：边有多强、朝哪边
value.en: The gradient: how strong, which way

title.en: Width, height and a centre crop

t.zh: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>：NumPy 给出图的形状时先写行数（高）、再写列数（宽）；OpenCV 要尺寸时却先写宽、再写高。Workshop 2 要从图的正中间裁出一块，两种顺序一混，裁出的位置就偏了。
t.en: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>: NumPy gives an image's shape as rows (height) first, then columns (width); OpenCV asks for a size as width first, then height. Workshop 2 crops a region from the very centre, and mixing the two orders puts it off-centre.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：已知形状 (rows, cols)，正中间那一块的左上角在哪？
t.en: This level asks: given the shape (rows, cols), where is the centre region's top-left corner?

after.zh: 形状先高后宽，尺寸先宽后高；<wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref>从余量的一半起。
after.en: A shape is height first, a size width first; a <wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref> starts half the spare room in.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
brief.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

hint.zh: 横向的余量是哪个数减 w？
hint.en: The room left across is which number less w?

solution: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)
naive: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 和行滤波器比，变的是哪个坐标？
hint.en: Compared with the row filter, which coordinate changes?

desc.zh: 输入一张图和上、中、下三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the above, centre and below weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside

value.zh: 同一个<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>，只是邻居换成了上下：方向不同，计算一样。
value.en: The same <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>, the neighbours now above and below: another direction, the same computation.

t.zh: 行滤波器只沿着一行滑。图是二维的，上下的邻居同样有用。
t.en: The row filter slides along rows only. A picture is two-dimensional, and the neighbours above and below matter as much.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：同一个滑动加权和，换成竖直方向该怎么接？接一块列滤波器：输入一张图和上、中、下三个权重，输出和原图一样大，图外补 0。
t.en: This level asks: how is the same sliding weighted sum wired down the columns? Wire a column filter: an image and the above, centre and below weights, an output as large as the image, 0 outside.

value.zh: 竖着也来一遍
value.en: Down the columns too

t.zh: 二维的卷积核是一张 3 × 3 的权重表。很多常用的核正好是一列权重乘一行权重：先横着滤一遍、再竖着滤一遍，和直接用 3 × 3 的核一样。这依赖<wiki-ref to="linear-filter-properties"></wiki-ref>：先后次序可以交换、两次滤波可以合成一次。
t.en: A 2D kernel is a 3 × 3 table of weights. Many common kernels are exactly a column of weights times a row: filtering across and then down equals filtering once with the 3 × 3 kernel. That rests on the <wiki-ref to="linear-filter-properties"></wiki-ref>: the order can be swapped, two filters can be merged into one.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个 3 × 3 的核，什么时候能拆成横、竖两步？先由一行和一列权重写出合成的 3 × 3 核，再用行滤波器和列滤波器接出二维滤波器。
t.en: This level asks: when can a 3 × 3 kernel be split into an across pass and a down pass? First write the 3 × 3 kernel a row and a column of weights make, then wire a 2D filter from the row and column filters.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、一行权重 h1、h2、h3 和一列权重 v1、v2、v3：先横着用行权重滤，再竖着用列权重滤，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image, a row of weights h1, h2, h3 and a column v1, v2, v3: filters across with the row, then down with the column, 0 outside

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>：3 × 3 的核若是一列乘一行，就拆成两次 3 格的滤波，每个像素少算 3 次乘法。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>: a 3 × 3 kernel that is a column times a row splits into two 3-cell passes, three fewer multiplications a pixel.

brief.zh: 行权重 [1, 2, 1]、列权重 [1, 2, 1]：写出合成的 3 × 3 核，第 y 行第 x 列是列权重第 y 个乘行权重第 x 个。
brief.en: Row weights [1, 2, 1], column weights [1, 2, 1]: write the merged 3 × 3 kernel, row y, column x being column weight y times row weight x.

hint.zh: 中心那一格是 2 × 2。
hint.en: The centre cell is 2 × 2.

why.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重：竖直方向也要乘上列权重，第 1 行整行乘 2。
why.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows: the column weights multiply too, doubling row 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、行权重 h1、h2、h3 和列权重 v1、v2、v3：交出先横后竖两次滤波的结果。
brief.en: Given an image, row weights h1, h2, h3 and column weights v1, v2, v3, give the result of filtering across, then down.

hint.zh: 第二次滤波的输入，是第一次的输出。
hint.en: The second pass takes the first pass's output.

t.zh: 彩色图每个像素有三个数。处理彩色图的核也有三层，每个通道一层：三层各自滤过自己的通道，再加起来，得到一张图。
t.en: A colour picture has three numbers a pixel. A kernel for it has three layers too, one per channel: each filters its own channel, and the three are added into one picture.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：三个通道各自模糊、再按权重加起来，结果是什么？新元件取通道，取出每个像素第 0、1、2 个位置（红、绿、蓝）上的数，组成一张灰度图。
t.en: This level asks: blur each channel, then add them up by weights; what comes out? New part: channel takes the number at position 0, 1 or 2 (red, green, blue) of every pixel as a grey image.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>：核有几层就对应几个通道，各层结果相加成一张图。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>: a kernel has a layer per channel, and the layers' results add up to one picture.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>：在元件上设定取第几个位置。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>; set on the part which position it takes.

brief.zh: 输入一张彩色图和权重 wr、wg、wb：把三个通道各自高斯模糊，再按 wr × 红 + wg × 绿 + wb × 蓝 加起来。
brief.en: Given a colour image and the weights wr, wg, wb, Gaussian-blur each channel, then add wr × red + wg × green + wb × blue.

hint.zh: 先把三个通道分开，各自模糊，再乘权重。
hint.en: First take the three channels apart, blur each, then weight them.

t.zh: 缩放时，新图的每个像素对应原图里的一个位置，这个位置一般不是整数：原图在那里没有像素。这一关先不管位置怎么算出来，题目直接给出。
t.en: When resizing, each pixel of the new image corresponds to a position in the original, seldom a whole number: the original has no pixel there. This level does not ask how the positions are worked out; they are given.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：落在像素之间的位置，最简单的取值办法是什么？先手算一行，再接一块电路。离两边一样远时，约定取坐标较大的一边；落到图外，取最近的边。
t.en: This level asks: what is the simplest value for a position between pixels? First work out a row by hand, then wire a circuit. When a position is equally far from two pixels, take the larger coordinate; outside the image, the nearest edge.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：照抄最近的像素，快、边缘硬，放大后成块，新图里只有原图已有的值。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: copy the nearest pixel; fast and hard-edged, blocky when enlarged, with only values the original had.

brief.zh: 这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的像素的值。
brief.en: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the pixel nearest each position.

hint.zh: 0.5 离 0 和 1 一样近；2.2 最近的像素是哪个？
hint.en: 0.5 is as near 0 as 1; which pixel is nearest 2.2?

why.zh: 这是一律向下取整：1.6 离 2 比离 1 近，却取了 1 的值；0.5 离两边一样近，按约定取 1。最近的整数是加 0.5 再向下取整。
why.en: That rounds every position down: 1.6 is nearer 2 than 1 but read 1; 0.5 is equally near both and by the convention reads 1. The nearest whole number is add 0.5, then round down.

t.zh: 位置用两张坐标图给出：x 图每格是要取的横坐标，y 图是纵坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>把数向下取整；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取最近的边。
t.en: The positions come as two coordinate images: each cell of x is the column to read, of y the row. New part: <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds down; <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read the nearest edge outside the image.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
brief.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

hint.zh: 手算时你是怎样从 1.6 得到 2 的？
hint.en: By hand, how did you get from 1.6 to 2?

t.zh: 只算三格都在图里的位置时，输出比原图窄 2：最左和最右的像素缺一个邻居，没法算。很多时候需要输出和原图一样大。
t.en: Taking only positions with all three cells inside, the output is 2 narrower than the original: the leftmost and rightmost pixels lack a neighbour. Often the output must be as large as the original.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图外面没有像素，邻居缺了怎么办？约定在图外补 0。先手算一行，再接一块输出和原图一样宽的行滤波器，以后滤波都用它。
t.en: This level asks: there are no pixels outside the image, so what of the missing neighbours? The convention here pads with 0 outside. Work out a row by hand, then wire a row filter whose output is as wide as the original, the one every later filter uses.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和左、中、右三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the left, centre and right weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>：在图外补 0，输出就和原图一样大；补的值不同，边上的结果也不同。
after.en: These are the <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>: pad with 0 outside and the output is as large as the image; pad differently and the edges differ.

brief.zh: 三个权重都是 1/3（求左中右的平均），图外补 0：写出和原图一样宽的结果。
brief.en: All three weights 1/3 (the average of left, here and right), 0 outside: write the result, as wide as the row.

hint.zh: 最左一格的左邻在图外，算作 0。
hint.en: The leftmost cell's left neighbour is outside and counts as 0.

why.zh: 这是图外取最近的边：题目约定图外补 0，两端只有两个 3 和一个 0，平均是 2。
why.en: That reads the nearest edge outside: here 0 is padded outside, so each end averages two 3s and a 0, giving 2.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取 0。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read 0 outside the image.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：输出和原图一样宽，每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give an output as wide as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 这回输出的第 x 格就以原图的 x 为中心。
hint.en: Now the output's cell x is centred on the original x.

t.zh: 一台理想的针孔相机：场景里一点发出的光，只有穿过小孔的那一条落到像平面上。三维的场景就这样被压成一张二维的图（<wiki-ref to="image-formation-3d-to-2d"></wiki-ref>）。穿过小孔、垂直于像平面的那条线叫光轴：点偏离光轴多远记作 X，它的像偏离光轴多远记作 u。
t.en: An ideal pinhole camera: of all the light a scene point sends out, only the ray through the hole reaches the image plane. That is how a 3D scene is pressed into a 2D picture (<wiki-ref to="image-formation-3d-to-2d"></wiki-ref>). The line through the hole square to the image plane is the optical axis: how far a point is off it is X, how far its image is off it is u.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：点在哪里，它的像就落在哪里？先在相机台上移动一点，让像落进圆圈；再把你找到的关系接成一块电路，以后要投影就直接用它。
t.en: This level asks: where a point is, where does its image land? First move a point on the camera bench until its image lands in the circle; then wire the relation you found into a circuit, to use whenever something must be projected.

desc.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和像平面距离 f，输出像点位置 u
desc.en: Takes a point's sideways position X, its distance Z and the plane distance f; gives the image position u

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>：u = fX/Z。距离加倍，像就缩一半；真相机为了进光够多装上镜头，但成像关系不变。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>: u = fX/Z. Twice as far, half the image; real cameras add a lens for light, but the relation holds.

brief.zh: f = 2，点离小孔 Z = 4：横向移动这一点，让它的像落在 u = 1。
brief.en: f = 2, the point Z = 4 from the hole: move it sideways so its image lands at u = 1.

hint.zh: 顺着画出的光线看：它从点出发，穿过小孔，停在像平面上。像平面离小孔多远，点又离小孔多远？
hint.en: Follow the drawn ray from the point through the hole to the plane. How far is the plane from the hole, and the point?

why.zh: 把点放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：光线穿过小孔后，横向位置按 f/Z = 2/4 缩小了一半。
why.en: With the point at X = 1 the image lands at u = 0.5 only: through the hole, the sideways position shrinks by f/Z = 2/4, to half.

t.zh: 这一步接一块电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去，测试和隐藏测试都对才算对。
t.en: This step wires a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right; it is right when every test and hidden test is.

t.zh: 新元件：<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>。
t.en: New parts: <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

hint.zh: 台子上 Z 加倍时，像离中心近了多少？f 加倍呢？
hint.en: On the bench, how much nearer the centre did the image come when Z doubled? And when f doubled?

t.zh: Workshop 2 里用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，三个数按 B、G、R 存；交给 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示，红蓝就对调了，蓝天变成橙色。另一个坑：照片常用 uint8 存，0 到 255，算出来超出范围会绕回去。
t.en: In Workshop 2 a photo read with OpenCV stores its three numbers as B, G, R; shown by Matplotlib as R, G, B, red and blue trade places and a blue sky turns orange. Another trap: photos are often uint8, 0 to 255, and a result out of range wraps around.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样把颜色换回来？新元件<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图依次当作 R、G、B 合成彩色图。
t.en: This level asks: how are the colours put back? New part: <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images R, G and B of one colour image.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>的差别和<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>的坑：先换好顺序，算之前换成更宽的类型。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref> difference and the <wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref> trap: swap the order before handing over, widen the type before computing.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?

t.zh: 行滤波器让左权重乘左邻、右权重乘右邻，权重和位置一一对应。课上的卷积却规定：先把卷积核左右翻转，再滑过去求加权和。
t.en: The row filter multiplies the left weight by the left neighbour and the right by the right: weights match positions. Convolution as the lecture defines it first flips the kernel left to right, then slides it and sums.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：翻不翻转，结果差在哪？用一行只有一个亮点的图（脉冲）来看：先手算不翻转的结果，再用行滤波器接出真正的卷积。
t.en: This level asks: what does flipping change? Look at a row with a single bright cell (an impulse): work out the unflipped result by hand, then wire true convolution from the row filter.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：不翻转是互相关，脉冲出来是倒过来的核；卷积先翻转，出来就是核本身。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: without the flip it is correlation, and an impulse comes out as the kernel reversed; convolution flips first, and an impulse comes out as the kernel itself.

brief.zh: 不翻转，权重左 1、中 2、右 3 滑过这一行脉冲，图外补 0：写出结果。
brief.en: Without flipping, slide the weights left 1, centre 2, right 3 over this impulse, 0 outside: write the result.

hint.zh: 亮点左边那一格，算加权和时亮点是它的哪个邻居？
hint.en: For the cell left of the bright one, which neighbour is the bright cell?

why.zh: 以为脉冲出来的就是核 [1, 2, 3]：亮点在左边那一格的右邻，乘的是右权重 3。不翻转时，出来的是倒过来的 [3, 2, 1]。
why.en: Expecting the kernel [1, 2, 3] back: for the cell to its left, the bright cell is the right neighbour and meets the right weight 3. Without the flip, out comes [3, 2, 1] reversed.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和卷积核 k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出卷积的结果，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the kernel k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the convolution, 0 outside.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> 不翻转；翻转之后，k1 落到哪一边？
hint.en: The <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> does not flip; flipped, which side does k1 land on?

brief.zh: 传感器高 24 mm、1200 像素：调焦距 f，让竖直视场正好 90°，灯杆顶刚好在画面里。
brief.en: A 24 mm, 1200-pixel-high sensor: set the focal length f so the vertical field of view is exactly 90°, the pole's top just in the frame.

hint.zh: 90° 的视场，一半是 45°：从小孔到画面上沿的那条光线，往上走的和往前走的一样多。
hint.en: Half of 90° is 45°: the ray from the hole to the frame's top edge rises as far as it goes forward.

why.zh: 以为焦距等于传感器高度时视场是 90°：那时半高 12 mm 只有焦距的一半，视场约 53°，杆顶出了画面。焦距要等于半高 12 mm。
why.en: Taking a focal length equal to the sensor's height for 90°: then the half-height, 12 mm, is half the focal length, the view about 53° and the pole's top out of frame. The focal length must equal the half-height, 12 mm.

body.zh: Sobel 核近似计算横向和纵向两个方向的导数：S_x=[[1,0,−1],[2,0,−2],[1,0,−1]]，S_y=[[1,2,1],[0,0,0],[−1,−2,−1]]。平坦区域左右或上下差异小，响应接近 0；边缘附近差异大，响应较大。两张图分别找沿相应方向变化快的位置。常见的误解：以为 S_x 找的是水平方向的边缘线（实际找沿 x 方向变化快处）。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§2 Sobel：找变化快的地方 (slides 29, 30)。
body.en: The Sobel kernels approximate the derivatives in the horizontal and vertical directions: S_x=[[1,0,−1],[2,0,−2],[1,0,−1]], S_y=[[1,2,1],[0,0,0],[−1,−2,−1]]. In flat regions the left–right or up–down differences are small and the response is close to 0; near edges the differences are large and the response is larger. The two output images each find where the change along the corresponding direction is fast. A common mistake: Thinking S_x finds horizontal edge lines (it actually finds where the change along the x direction is fast). Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 Sobel (slides 29, 30).

body.zh: 灰度图像可以看成二维数组；颜色图像通常有三个通道，表示成 height × width × channels 的三维张量。RGB 三通道是相机和人类视觉的工程表示（人眼有三类主要视锥细胞），并非自然界只有三种颜色。使用图像前先检查三件事：形状是 H×W×C 还是 C×H×W，通道顺序是 RGB 还是 BGR，数值范围和数据类型是什么；不同程序库的约定可能不同。常见的误解：以为所有库都按 RGB、H×W×C 存储图像。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§3 数字图像是怎样存储的 (slides 22, 25)。
body.en: A greyscale image can be seen as a 2D array; a colour image usually has three channels and is represented as a 3D tensor of height × width × channels. The three RGB channels are an engineering representation for cameras and human vision (the human eye has three main types of cone cell), not because nature has only three colours. Before using an image, check three things: whether the shape is H×W×C or C×H×W, whether the channel order is RGB or BGR, and what the value range and data type are; different libraries may use different conventions. A common mistake: Thinking every library stores images as RGB, H×W×C. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §3 (slides 22, 25).

body.zh: 沿一条水平扫描线看图像强度：平坦区域变化慢，边缘附近变化快。对强度求导数，就能突出这种变化。常见的误解：以为边缘是亮度高的地方。出处：COMP90086 第 5 讲笔记，§3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 39)。
body.en: Look at the image intensity along a horizontal scan line: in flat regions it changes slowly, and near edges it changes quickly. Taking the derivative of the intensity highlights this change. A common mistake: Thinking edges are where the brightness is high. Source: COMP90086 lecture 5 notes, §3 (slide 39).

title.en: angle of view and focal length

body.zh: 在数字图像中焦距常用像素表示：它只是把物理焦距除以像素尺寸，换成图像坐标单位。例如图像宽 2000 像素、主点在中间、焦距 1000 像素时，左右各约 45°，总视野范围约 90°。常见的误解：把以像素为单位的焦距和以毫米为单位的焦距直接比较或混用。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§2 焦距与视野范围 (slide 15)。
body.en: In digital images the focal length is often expressed in pixels: this divides the physical focal length by the pixel size, converting it into image-coordinate units. For example, if the image is 2000 pixels wide, the principal point is in the middle and the focal length is 1000 pixels, each side spans about 45°, giving a total field of view of about 90°. A common mistake: Directly comparing or mixing up a focal length in pixels with a focal length in millimetres. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §2 (slide 15).

title.zh: 彩色图像滤波（多通道卷积核）

body.zh: RGB 图像除空间维度外还有通道维度，颜色滤波器尺寸可以是 K_h×K_w×3。它同时看同一邻域的 R、G、B，把所有乘积加在一起得到一个输出数值。常见错误是把 height×width×channel 当成普通二维图像，忘记核还要覆盖通道维度。常见的误解：以为彩色滤波得到三个输出值或只对一个通道操作。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§2 彩色图像的滤波核多了一个维度 (slide 31)。
body.en: Besides its spatial dimensions, an RGB image also has a channel dimension, so a colour filter can have size K_h×K_w×3. It looks at R, G and B in the same neighbourhood at once and sums all the products to give a single output value. A common mistake is to treat height×width×channel as an ordinary 2D image and forget that the kernel must also cover the channel dimension. A common mistake: Thinking colour filtering produces three output values, or operates on only one channel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 (slide 31).

body.zh: 二维图像 f(x,y) 的梯度是 ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ。幅度 ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) 表示变化有多强，方向 θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) 表示变化最快的方向。常见的误解：把梯度方向当成边缘的走向。出处：COMP90086 第 5 讲笔记，§3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 40)。
body.en: The gradient of a 2D image f(x,y) is ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ. The magnitude ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) indicates how strong the change is, and the direction θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) indicates the direction of fastest change. A common mistake: Taking the gradient direction to be the direction in which the edge runs. Source: COMP90086 lecture 5 notes, §3 (slide 40).

body.zh: 沿一条水平扫描线看图像强度：平坦区域变化慢，边缘附近变化快。对强度求导数，就能突出这种变化。常见的误解：以为边缘是亮度高的地方。出处：COMP90086 第 5 讲笔记，§3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 39)。
body.en: Look at the image intensity along a horizontal scan line: in flat regions it changes slowly, and near edges it changes quickly. Taking the derivative of the intensity highlights this change. A common mistake: Thinking edges are where the brightness is high. Source: COMP90086 lecture 5 notes, §3 (slide 39).

title.zh: 均值滤波与高斯滤波（模糊）

body.zh: 均值滤波给邻域每个像素相同权重；高斯滤波离中心越近权重越大，形式为 G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²))。σ 控制影响范围，σ 越大模糊越强。模糊核通常归一化使权重和为 1，以免改变整体平均亮度；两种核都减少细节，但权重分配不同，保留的细节也不同。常见的误解：以为高斯模糊和均值模糊效果完全一样，或忘记归一化。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§2 模糊：让变化变慢 (slides 27, 28)。
body.en: A mean filter gives every pixel in the neighbourhood the same weight; a Gaussian filter gives larger weights the closer a pixel is to the centre, in the form G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²)). σ controls the extent of the influence: the larger σ, the stronger the blur. Blur kernels are usually normalised so that the weights sum to 1, so as not to change the overall average brightness; both kernels reduce detail, but they distribute the weights differently, so they preserve different detail. A common mistake: Thinking Gaussian blur and mean blur have exactly the same effect, or forgetting to normalise. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 (slides 27, 28).

title.en: Linear filter properties (commutative, associative, distributive, scalar)

body.zh: 线性滤波满足交换律 f*h=h*f、结合律 f*h₁*h₂=f*(h₁*h₂)、分配律（滤波器可分配到相加的图像上）和标量结合律 k(f*h)=(kf)*h=f*(kh)。这些性质帮助重排计算。理论上可以交换或合并操作，但实际还要考虑图像大小、内存访问、是否需要中间结果和程序库实现。常见的误解：以为数学上可交换就一定更快。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§3 线性滤波的四个代数性质 (slide 37)。
body.en: Linear filtering satisfies commutativity f*h=h*f, associativity f*h₁*h₂=f*(h₁*h₂), distributivity (a filter distributes over images that are added together) and scalar associativity k(f*h)=(kf)*h=f*(kh). These properties help rearrange the computation. In theory operations can be swapped or combined, but in practice you also have to consider image size, memory access, whether intermediate results are needed and the library's implementation. A common mistake: Thinking that being mathematically interchangeable necessarily makes it faster. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §3 (slide 37).

title.zh: 卷积与互相关（是否翻转卷积核）

body.zh: 两者都做“滑动、相乘、相加”，唯一关键区别是卷积先把核旋转 180° 再使用，互相关直接使用。核关于中心对称时两者结果相同；核不对称时方向会改变。手算前要先确定是否翻核。常见的误解：以为翻转只是左右翻，或以为任何核卷积与互相关结果都不同。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 互相关和卷积 (slide 17)。
body.en: Both do ‘slide, multiply, add’; the only key difference is that convolution first rotates the kernel by 180° before using it, whereas cross-correlation uses it directly. When the kernel is symmetric about its centre the two give the same result; when it is not, the direction changes. Before calculating by hand, first decide whether to flip the kernel. A common mistake: Thinking the flip is only a left–right flip, or thinking convolution and cross-correlation give different results for every kernel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1 (slide 17).

title.en: Padding / border handling (constant, wrap, clamp, reflect)

body.zh: 在图像外补像素可使输出与输入同尺寸。Constant/zero 补固定值，简单但可能制造黑边；Wrap 把左接右、上接下，适合 tileable 纹理而不适合普通照片；Clamp/replicate 把边缘像素向外延伸，普通照片通常较自然；Reflect 镜像延伸，常能减少人工边界。没有一种规则永远最好，要看图像是否周期性、任务是否关心边缘及滤波器性质。常见的误解：以为补零总是最好的默认选择。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§4 四种常见边界规则 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45)。
body.en: Padding pixels outside the image lets the output be the same size as the input. Constant/zero fills with a fixed value, which is simple but may create black borders; Wrap joins left to right and top to bottom, which suits tileable textures but not ordinary photos; Clamp/replicate extends the edge pixels outwards, which usually looks more natural for ordinary photos; Reflect extends by mirroring and often reduces artificial borders. No rule is always best; it depends on whether the image is periodic, whether the task cares about the edges and the properties of the filter. A common mistake: Thinking zero padding is always the best default choice. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §4 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45).

title.zh: 线性滤波公式（滑动加权和）
title.en: Linear filtering / convolution formula (sliding weighted sum)

body.zh: 把卷积核放在图像的一个位置，对齐后逐项相乘再相加，写作 g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v)，其中 f 是输入、h 是核权重、g 是输出、(u,v) 是邻域内偏移。式中的 i−u、j−v 表示卷积；按窗口直接对齐相乘的互相关则读作 i+u、j+v。中心权重为 1、其余为 0 时两者都只是复制当前像素。常见的误解：以为公式里的 i−u 与窗口直接对齐相乘是同一件事。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 线性滤波到底在算什么 (slide 9)。
body.en: Place the kernel at one position in the image, align it, multiply element by element and then add up, written as g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v), where f is the input, h the kernel weights, g the output and (u,v) the offset within the neighbourhood. The i−u, j−v in the formula denote convolution; cross-correlation, which multiplies directly with the window aligned, reads i+u, j+v instead. When the centre weight is 1 and all others are 0, both copy the current pixel. A common mistake: Thinking the i−u in the formula is the same thing as multiplying directly with the window aligned. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1 (slide 9).

body.zh: 线性滤波器是局部运算的一种：把邻域中的像素分别乘以权重再相加。这些权重排成的小矩阵叫卷积核或滤波器。它与一般局部运算的区别在于组合方式固定为加权和。常见的误解：把所有局部运算都当成线性滤波。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 线性滤波器。
body.en: A linear filter is one kind of local operation: it multiplies each pixel in the neighbourhood by a weight and then adds them up. The small matrix formed by these weights is called the kernel or filter. What distinguishes it from general local operations is that the way of combining is fixed as a weighted sum. A common mistake: Treating every local operation as linear filtering. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1.

title.zh: 逐像素运算与局部运算（邻域）

body.zh: 逐像素运算的输出位置 (i,j) 只看输入同一位置的像素，例如变亮、变暗或 gamma correction，各位置独立计算。局部运算会看 (i,j) 周围的一个小区域（邻域），模糊、锐化和边缘检测都属于这一类。局部运算改变的是邻居之间的关系，例如葡萄图中加强邻域差异会让轮廓更明显，也可能放大颗粒感。常见的误解：以为 gamma correction 这类亮度调整也需要邻域。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 三种运算：看一个点、看邻居、做加权和 (slides 6, 8)。
body.en: In a pixel operation, the output at position (i,j) looks only at the input pixel at the same position, e.g. brightening, darkening or gamma correction; each position is computed independently. A local operation looks at a small region (neighbourhood) around (i,j); blurring, sharpening and edge detection all belong to this category. Local operations change the relationships between neighbours: for example, in the grapes image, strengthening the differences within a neighbourhood makes the outlines more visible, but may also amplify graininess. A common mistake: Thinking brightness adjustments such as gamma correction also need a neighbourhood. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1 (slides 6, 8).

body.zh: Crop 从原数组取一个子区域，已有像素数值不变；Resize 改变数组尺寸，必须为新位置计算像素数值。直接把 768×512 压成 512×512 会改变宽高比，物体可能变胖或变瘦；若保持比例，目标尺寸应接近 512×341。常见的误解：以为裁剪也要插值，或以为缩放只是“截掉一部分”。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 裁剪与缩放不是一回事 (slide 34)。
body.en: Cropping takes a sub-region of the original array, and the existing pixel values are unchanged; resizing changes the size of the array, so pixel values must be computed for the new positions. Squashing 768×512 straight to 512×512 changes the aspect ratio, so objects may become fatter or thinner; if the proportions are kept, the target size should be about 512×341. A common mistake: Thinking cropping also requires interpolation, or that resizing is just ‘cutting off a part’. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 (slide 34).

title.zh: 图像张量：形状、通道顺序与数据类型
title.en: Image tensor layout, channel order and dtype

body.zh: 灰度图像可以看成二维数组；颜色图像通常有三个通道，表示成 height × width × channels 的三维张量。RGB 三通道是相机和人类视觉的工程表示（人眼有三类主要视锥细胞），并非自然界只有三种颜色。使用图像前先检查三件事：形状是 H×W×C 还是 C×H×W，通道顺序是 RGB 还是 BGR，数值范围和数据类型是什么；不同程序库的约定可能不同。常见的误解：以为所有库都按 RGB、H×W×C 存储图像。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§3 数字图像是怎样存储的 (slides 22, 25)。
body.en: A greyscale image can be seen as a 2D array; a colour image usually has three channels and is represented as a 3D tensor of height × width × channels. The three RGB channels are an engineering representation for cameras and human vision (the human eye has three main types of cone cell), not because nature has only three colours. Before using an image, check three things: whether the shape is H×W×C or C×H×W, whether the channel order is RGB or BGR, and what the value range and data type are; different libraries may use different conventions. A common mistake: Thinking every library stores images as RGB, H×W×C. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §3 (slides 22, 25).

title.zh: 以像素表示的焦距与视野角
title.en: Focal length in pixels and angle of view

body.zh: 在数字图像中焦距常用像素表示：它只是把物理焦距除以像素尺寸，换成图像坐标单位。例如图像宽 2000 像素、主点在中间、焦距 1000 像素时，左右各约 45°，总视野范围约 90°。常见的误解：把以像素为单位的焦距和以毫米为单位的焦距直接比较或混用。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§2 焦距与视野范围 (slide 15)。
body.en: In digital images the focal length is often expressed in pixels: this divides the physical focal length by the pixel size, converting it into image-coordinate units. For example, if the image is 2000 pixels wide, the principal point is in the middle and the focal length is 1000 pixels, each side spans about 45°, giving a total field of view of about 90°. A common mistake: Directly comparing or mixing up a focal length in pixels with a focal length in millimetres. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §2 (slide 15).

title.zh: 正向问题与反向问题：图形学与视觉

body.zh: 计算机图形学已知物体、材质、灯光和相机，向前生成一张图像，是正向问题；计算机视觉已知图像，反过来推测物体、材质、灯光和相机，是反向问题。反问题通常更难，因为不同的三维场景可能产生很相似的二维图像。常见的误解：以为只要图像足够清晰就能唯一还原三维场景；不同三维场景可能产生相似的二维图像。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲笔记，§2 计算机视觉和计算机图形学的方向相反 (slide 8)。
body.en: Computer graphics knows the objects, materials, lighting and camera and works forwards to produce an image: a forward problem. Computer vision knows the image and works backwards to infer the objects, materials, lighting and camera: an inverse problem. The inverse problem is usually harder, because different 3D scenes can produce very similar 2D images. A common mistake: Thinking that as long as the image is clear enough, the 3D scene can be recovered uniquely; different 3D scenes can produce similar 2D images. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1 notes, §2 (slide 8).

title.zh: 视觉任务的输出形式：分类、检测、分割
title.en: Vision task outputs: classification, detection, segmentation

body.zh: 同一张图可以提出不同问题，答案形式也不同：识别／分类回答整张图主要是什么类别（如 dog）；检测回答哪些物体在哪里（类别 + 边界框）；分割回答每个像素属于什么。关键区分是：分类只给一个或少量类别标签，检测还要给位置，分割要把答案细化到像素。常见的误解：以为检测只是“更准的分类”；检测必须同时输出位置（边界框）。也容易以为分类分数高就代表系统理解了场景。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲笔记，§1 先分清几种常见任务 (slide 7)。
body.en: The same image can be asked different questions, and the answers take different forms: recognition/classification answers what category the whole image mainly shows (e.g. dog); detection answers which objects are where (category + bounding box); segmentation answers what each pixel belongs to. The key distinction is that classification gives only one or a few category labels, detection must also give locations, and segmentation refines the answer down to individual pixels. A common mistake: Thinking detection is just ‘more accurate classification’; detection must also output locations (bounding boxes). It is also easy to assume that a high classification score means the system has understood the scene. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1 notes, §1 (slide 7).

title.zh: 成像流程与三维信息丢失
title.en: Image formation pipeline and lost depth

body.zh: 一次拍照可分为：光源 → 表面反射 → 镜头／光学 → 传感器 → 电信号 → 数字值。最重要的困难是现实世界是三维、普通照片只有二维：一个像素通常告诉我们“这里有多亮”，却不能单独告诉我们这个点离相机多远。因此视觉需要相机模型、多视图、深度传感器或学习模型来补回缺失信息。常见的误解：以为知道一个像素的坐标和亮度就能求出对应的三维点。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§1 成像：三维世界怎样变成二维图像 (slide 8)。
body.en: Taking a photo can be broken down into: light source → surface reflection → lens/optics → sensor → electrical signal → digital values. The most important difficulty is that the real world is 3D while an ordinary photo is only 2D: a pixel usually tells us ‘how bright it is here’, but cannot on its own tell us how far that point is from the camera. Vision therefore needs camera models, multiple views, depth sensors or learned models to recover the missing information. A common mistake: Thinking that knowing a pixel's coordinates and brightness is enough to work out the corresponding 3D point. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §1 (slide 8).

why: Polish term access and prediction controls after visual playthrough

body.zh: 理想投影模型中连接物点、相机中心和像点的直线。在虚像平面约定下，三者在同一方向的直线上。 出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slides 11、22–26。
body.en: A straight line joining a scene point, camera centre and image point in the ideal model. With the virtual-plane convention they lie along the same forward direction. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 22–26.

body.zh: 每个采样位置只有一个强度数值的图像。本游戏用数表表示它；数值计算不自动限制在显示亮度范围内。 出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slides 11、22–26。
body.en: An image with one intensity value per sampled location. It is represented by a table here; numerical computation need not stay inside the display intensity range. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 22–26.

body.zh: 以红、绿、蓝三个通道表示颜色。本游戏主线按 R、G、B 排列数值，每个通道示例取 0 到 1；不表示自然光只有这三个波长。 出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slides 11、22–26。
body.en: A colour representation using red, green and blue channels. Main-path examples use R, G, B order and values from 0 to 1; this does not mean natural light has only three wavelengths. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 22–26.

body.zh: 一张存坐标而非亮度的数表。x 图每格记录要读取的列，y 图记录要读取的行；两张一起决定新图每格从原图何处取值。 出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slides 11、22–26。
body.en: A table containing coordinates rather than intensities. Each x cell records a source column, each y cell a source row; together they determine where every output reads from. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 22–26.

body.zh: 把核反向后沿输入滑动，逐项相乘求和。一维反转左、右顺序，二维反转两个方向（旋转 180°）。本游戏的行、列滤波部件直接使用位置权重，需要在接线时安排翻转。 出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 9–17。
body.en: A weighted sum over a sliding input window with the kernel reversed: reverse left/right in 1D, and both axes (180° rotation) in 2D. The row and column filter parts use positional weights directly, so wire the reversal when required. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17.

body.zh: 将窗口中的值与相同位置的核权重相乘再求和，不翻转核。它与卷积的差别在非对称权重上才会显现。 出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 9–17。
body.en: Multiply each window value by the kernel weight at the same position and sum, without flipping the kernel. Asymmetric weights expose its difference from convolution. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17.

body.zh: 将到达平面的光记录为数字读数的器件。在本游戏几何图里，用一段有限宽或高的区域表示它，示例采用均匀取样。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 8。
body.en: The device recording incoming light as digital measurements. The geometric views represent it as a finite width or height, sampled uniformly in these examples. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 8.

ops.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>距离 f，输出像点位置 u
ops.en: Takes a point's sideways position X, its distance Z and the plane distance f; gives the image position u (<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 参照 X=2、Z=4、f=2，像点 u=1。按步骤观察哪一个量变了，输入你预测的 u，再检查光路。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Reference: X=2, Z=4, f=2, image u=1. At each step inspect the changed quantity, enter your predicted u, then check the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 输入像点位置 u、<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
ops.en: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X. (<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 这就是<wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>。光路没变，变的是用什么单位、从哪里计数。将<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>交给已搭好的投影部件，再把结果平移到图像原点，才能与数组里的位置对齐；把这两步混成一次，就容易漏掉负偏移或原点平移。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>. The <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> stays the same; the measurement unit and origin change. Feed the <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> to the projection part, then shift into the image frame. Keeping these steps distinct handles negative offsets and the change of origin.

ops.zh: 输入一张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
ops.en: Given a <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

ops.zh: 一整张新图的每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>都要算出它在原图的坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>：给定宽和高，给出两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>，x 图每格是自己的 x，y 图每格是自己的 y；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>接上坐标图，就一次取出整张图。
ops.en: Every <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> of a whole new image needs its coordinates in the original. New part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>: given a width and a height it gives two coordinate images, each cell of x holding its own x and of y its own y; fed coordinate images, <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads a whole image at once. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 输入一张图和两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> x、y：交出每个位置最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的值。
ops.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> nearest each position. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 位置用两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>给出：x 图每格是要取的横坐标，y 图是纵坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>把数向下取整；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取最近的边。
ops.en: The positions come as two coordinate images: each cell of x is the column to read, of y the row. New part: <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds down; <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read the nearest edge outside the image. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 输入一张图和两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
ops.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 有限大小的<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>只接住部分<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>。固定它的高度，只改变<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>，观察上下两条边界：怎样让<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>正好为 90°？这一关不涉及<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>换算。
ops.en: A finite <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> captures only some rays. Keep its height fixed and change the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>: how can the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> become exactly 90°? No <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> conversion is needed here. (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 24 mm；本实验只看竖直方向。调 f，让全视场为 90°；用上下两条边界<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>核对，不要只看上半角。
ops.en: The <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is 24 mm tall and this experiment uses a vertical slice. Set f for a full field of view of 90°. Check both boundary rays rather than only the upper half-angle. (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 把全高当作半高时，边界<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的夹角不再是 45°。检查后看全角与半角两个读数。
ops.en: Using the full height as the half-height does not give a 45° edge <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>. After checking compare the full and half-angle readings. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 输入一张图和<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的结果，图外补 0。
ops.en: Given an image and the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>, 0 outside.

ops.zh: 这次<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>不只把部件摆在一起：权重决定看哪些<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>，平滑改变进入求变化部件的信号。两张输出让你检查“保留了什么”与“哪里变化强”；这仍是局部处理，不等于识别物体。
ops.en: This <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> composes a real signal path: weights select <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> and smoothing changes what reaches the change detector. The two outputs show what remains and where it changes strongly. These local operations do not recognise objects. (colour channel)

ops.zh: 输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
ops.en: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs. (colour channel)

ops.zh: 先把三个<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>分开，各自模糊，再乘权重。
ops.en: First take the three <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> apart, blur each, then weight them. (colour channel)

ops.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样把颜色换回来？新元件<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次当作 R、G、B 合成彩色图。
ops.en: This level asks: how are the colours put back? New part: <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images R, G and B of one colour image. (<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 固定<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>尺寸，<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>增加使同一场景的投影变大，落在传感器边界内的场景范围变小。比较全角时应同时看两条边界<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>。这里先用物理长度讨论几何；<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>单位的换算在像素相机关卡练习。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 15。
ops.en: For a fixed <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> size, increasing <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> enlarges the scene projection and reduces the region fitting inside the sensor. Compare both boundary rays when considering the full angle. This geometry uses physical lengths; <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>-unit conversion is practised in the pixel-camera level. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 15. (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 图像可按行、列存成数表。<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>的形状是高 × 宽；<wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref> 图是高 × 宽 × 3，每格三个分量。这里讨论数学表示，按 (x,y) 指定列与行。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 22。
ops.en: An image is a table of rows and columns: height × width in greyscale, height × width × 3 in <wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref>. This is a mathematical representation; (x,y) specifies column and row. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 22. (<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 把<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>放在图像的一个位置，对齐后逐项相乘再相加，写作 g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v)，其中 f 是输入、h 是核权重、g 是输出、(u,v) 是邻域内偏移。式中的 i−u、j−v 表示<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>；按窗口直接对齐相乘的<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>则读作 i+u、j+v。中心权重为 1、其余为 0 时两者都只是复制当前<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>。常见的误解：以为公式里的 i−u 与窗口直接对齐相乘是同一件事。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>到底在算什么 (slide 9)。
ops.en: Place the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> at one position in the image, align it, multiply element by element and then add up, written as g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v), where f is the input, h the kernel weights, g the output and (u,v) the offset within the neighbourhood. The i−u, j−v in the formula denote <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>; <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>, which multiplies directly with the window aligned, reads i+u, j+v instead. When the centre weight is 1 and all others are 0, both copy the current <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>. A common mistake: Thinking the i−u in the formula is the same thing as multiplying directly with the window aligned. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1 (slide 9). (<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 两者都做“滑动、相乘、相加”，唯一关键区别是<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>先把核旋转 180° 再使用，<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>直接使用。核关于中心对称时两者结果相同；核不对称时方向会改变。手算前要先确定是否翻核。常见的误解：以为翻转只是左右翻，或以为任何核卷积与互相关结果都不同。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§1 互相关和卷积 (slide 17)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Both do ‘slide, multiply, add’; the only key difference is that <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> first rotates the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> by 180° before using it, whereas <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> uses it directly. When the kernel is symmetric about its centre the two give the same result; when it is not, the direction changes. Before calculating by hand, first decide whether to flip the kernel. A common mistake: Thinking the flip is only a left–right flip, or thinking convolution and cross-correlation give different results for every kernel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §1 (slide 17).

ops.zh: Sobel 用相互垂直的两组权重近似求强度变化。本游戏直接按窗口对齐相乘：g_x 的横向权重为 [−1,0,1]、纵向为 [1,2,1]；g_y 交换两个方向，所以沿坐标正方向从暗到亮为正。数学<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>采用相反的核写法；不能把<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的符号约定与翻转后的核混用。[1,2,1] 的和为 4，本游戏不额外归一化。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 29–30。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Sobel approximates intensity changes with two perpendicular sets of weights. This game aligns weights directly with the window: g_x uses [−1,0,1] across and [1,2,1] down; g_y swaps the directions. Dark to bright along a positive coordinate direction is therefore positive. Mathematical <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> writes the flipped <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>; do not mix conventions. The [1,2,1] weights sum to 4 and are not normalised here. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 29–30. (<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref> 图像除空间维度外还有<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>维度，颜色滤波器尺寸可以是 K_h×K_w×3。它同时看同一邻域的 R、G、B，把所有乘积加在一起得到一个输出数值。常见错误是把 height×width×channel 当成普通二维图像，忘记核还要覆盖颜色通道维度。常见的误解：以为彩色滤波得到三个输出值或只对一个颜色通道操作。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§2 彩色图像的滤波核多了一个维度 (slide 31)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Besides its spatial dimensions, an <wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref> image also has a <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> dimension, so a colour filter can have size K_h×K_w×3. It looks at R, G and B in the same neighbourhood at once and sums all the products to give a single output value. A common mistake is to treat height×width×colour channel as an ordinary 2D image and forget that the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> must also cover the colour channel dimension. A common mistake: Thinking colour filtering produces three output values, or operates on only one colour channel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 (slide 31).

ops.zh: OpenCV 的大小 tuple 是 (width, height)，NumPy 形状却通常写成 (height, width, channels)。所以不能把 NumPy 的形状原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸，否则宽和高会对调。常见的误解：把 image.shape[:2] 直接传给 OpenCV 的缩放函数。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝。 (<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: An OpenCV size tuple is (width, height), whereas a NumPy shape is usually written (height, width, <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>). So you cannot use a NumPy shape as-is as an OpenCV resize size, or the width and height will be swapped. A common mistake: Passing image.shape[:2] straight to OpenCV's resize function. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 ·.

ops.zh: cv2.imread 默认读入 BGR，但 matplotlib.pyplot.imshow 按 <wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref> 显示，所以显示前要用 cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) 转换。这只改变<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>顺序，不改变图像内容或空间尺寸。常见的误解：显示时红蓝颠倒，却以为图片本身坏了；或以为转换会改变图像尺寸。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV 和 Matplotlib 的颜色顺序。
ops.en: cv2.imread reads images as BGR by default, but matplotlib.pyplot.imshow displays them as <wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref>, so convert with cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) before displaying. This changes only the <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> order, not the image content or spatial size. A common mistake: Seeing red and blue swapped on display and thinking the image itself is broken; or thinking the conversion changes the image size. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV Matplotlib.

ops.zh: Workshop 中对 BGR 图像把红色<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>改成蓝色与绿色颜色通道的平均值：R'(x,y) = (G(x,y)+B(x,y))/2。如果原数组是 uint8，要先用较宽或浮点类型做计算，再明确 cast，避免溢出或隐式截断。常见的误解：在 BGR 数组里把第 0 个颜色通道当成红色；或直接用 uint8 相加后再除以 2。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝。
ops.en: In the workshop, the red <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> of a BGR image is replaced by the average of the blue and green colour channel: R'(x,y) = (G(x,y)+B(x,y))/2. If the original array is uint8, first do the calculation in a wider or floating-point type, then cast explicitly, to avoid overflow or implicit truncation. A common mistake: Treating colour channel 0 of a BGR array as red; or adding directly in uint8 and then dividing by 2. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 ·.

ops.zh: 穿过<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>、垂直于<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>的参考直线。本游戏以它为 Z 方向，物点的横向偏移和像点的带符号偏移都相对它测量。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The reference line through the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> perpendicular to the <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>. It is the Z direction here; lateral scene and image offsets are measured relative to it. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22.

ops.zh: 理想针孔模型中所有<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>经过的点 O，也是相机坐标的原点。<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>在它前方。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The point O through which all projection rays pass in the ideal pinhole model, and the origin of camera coordinates. The <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref> is in front of it. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22. (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 从<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>向<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上、下边缘看去，两条边界<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>之间的全角。对居中的传感器，高 S、<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f 时，半角满足 tan(θ/2)=S/(2f)，所以全角为 2 arctan(S/(2f))。水平视场将高度换成宽度。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The full angle between rays from the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> to the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> top and bottom edges. For a centred sensor of height S and <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f, tan(θ/2)=S/(2f), giving θ=2 arctan(S/(2f)). For horizontal field of view use width instead of height. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22. (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 数字图像中的一个采样位置和它记录的数值；<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>记录一个强度值，<wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref> 图记录三个<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>值。像素的索引、物理尺寸和记录值是不同的量。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 22–25。
ops.en: A sampled location in a digital image and the value recorded there: one intensity in greyscale, three <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> values in <wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref>. Its index, physical size and recorded value are different quantities. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 22–25. (<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>的交点。用图像坐标表示为 (c_x,c_y)，不一定在图像中心。本游戏坐标条假设居中；<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>中心索引从 0 到 N−1 时，居中位置为 (N−1)/2，<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>两边界为 −0.5 和 N−0.5。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22。
ops.en: The intersection of the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>, at image coordinates (c_x,c_y); it need not be at the image centre. These strips assume it is centred: with centre indices 0 to N−1, its coordinate is (N−1)/2 and <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> edges are −0.5 and N−0.5. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18, 22. (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 局部滤波使用的一组权重。这里一维窗口按左、中、右或上、中、下标明位置；<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>直接按这些位置使用，数学<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>先翻转方向。 出处：COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17。
ops.en: The weights of a local filter. A 1D window is labelled left/centre/right or above/centre/below here; correlation uses those positions directly, while mathematical <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> flips them first. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17. (<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 理想投影模型中连接物点、<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>和像点的直线。在<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>约定下，三者在同一方向的直线上。 出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slides 11、22–26。
ops.en: A straight line joining a scene point, <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> and image point in the ideal model. With the virtual-plane convention they lie along the same forward direction. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 22–26. (<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 以红、绿、蓝三个<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>表示颜色。本游戏主线按 R、G、B 排列数值，每个颜色通道示例取 0 到 1；不表示自然光只有这三个波长。 出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slides 11、22–26。
ops.en: A colour representation using red, green and blue <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>. Main-path examples use R, G, B order and values from 0 to 1; this does not mean natural light has only three wavelengths. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 22–26.

ops.zh: 把核反向后沿输入滑动，逐项相乘求和。一维反转左、右顺序，二维反转两个方向（旋转 180°）。本游戏的行、列滤波部件直接使用位置权重，需要在接线时安排翻转。 出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 9–17。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: A weighted sum over a sliding input window with the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> reversed: reverse left/right in 1D, and both axes (180° rotation) in 2D. The row and column filter parts use positional weights directly, so wire the reversal when required. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17.

ops.zh: 将窗口中的值与相同位置的核权重相乘再求和，不翻转核。它与<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的差别在非对称权重上才会显现。 出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 9–17。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Multiply each window value by the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> weight at the same position and sum, without flipping the kernel. Asymmetric weights expose its difference from <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17.

learner.zh: 学过编程和中学数学、没有学过计算机视觉的学习者（COMP90086 的学生）
learner.en: Learners who can program and know school mathematics but have not studied computer vision (COMP90086 students)

endpoint.zh: 一章一章造出视觉的机器：相机、卷积器，往后是卷积网络、注意力和全景拼接器；每个部件在后面的章里直接复用。
endpoint.en: Build the machines of vision chapter by chapter: a camera, a convolver, later a convolutional network, attention and a panorama stitcher, each part reused in the chapters after.

scope.zh: 第 1–2 章（讲义第 1–3 讲和第 5 讲的梯度），依据 docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/knowledge-map-1-12.md 的章节方案：相机（投影、像素焦距、数表、裁剪、最近邻、双线性）和卷积器（滑动加权、补边、翻转、可分离、高斯、Sobel、梯度、彩色卷积）。Workshop 内容做成可选专题。
scope.en: Chapters 1–2 (lectures 1–3 and the gradient of lecture 5), after the chapter plan in docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/knowledge-map-1-12.md: the camera (projection, focal length in pixels, the table of numbers, cropping, nearest neighbour, bilinear) and the convolver (sliding weighted sums, padding, flipping, separable, Gaussian, Sobel, the gradient, colour convolution). Workshop content is optional topics.

where.zh: 每关最后一步：把关系接成电路，做出的板成为后面的部件
where.en: The last step of most levels: the relation wired as a circuit, the board a part for later

why.zh: 《图灵完备》式的抽象：造出的部件在后面直接调用，复杂的机器由简单的部件一层层搭起
why.en: Turing Complete's abstraction: parts built are called directly later, complex machines built up from simple parts

where.zh: 动手算：读图、裁剪、取值、卷积核
where.en: Working by hand: reading, cropping, sampling, kernels

why.zh: 先亲手当一回机器，电路才有前因
why.en: Acting as the machine first gives the circuit its reason

where.zh: 针孔相机台：投影、视场
where.en: The pinhole bench: projection, field of view

why.zh: 连续量的关系先预测再检查
why.en: Relations between continuous quantities, predicted, then checked

about.zh: 针孔相机台
about.en: The pinhole camera bench

about.zh: 读写像素格（grid 任务）
about.en: Read and write pixel grids (grid tasks)

about.zh: 图像电路：搭出的板成为部件
about.en: Image circuits: a board built becomes a part

lacks.zh: 它只会把场景拍成数表、按位置取值：不会把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算。
lacks.en: It only pictures a scene as a table and reads values at positions: it cannot combine a pixel with its neighbours.

lacks.zh: 每个输出只是邻域的加权和，权重是人定的：它不会自己学出权重，这是卷积网络存在的理由。
lacks.en: Each output is a weighted sum over a neighbourhood with weights set by hand: it cannot learn them, the reason convolutional networks exist.

about.zh: 针孔相机中，三维点 P=(x,y,z) 投到成像平面上的 (x_i,y_i)，pinhole 到成像平面的距离为 f（焦距）。由相似三角形得 x_i = f·x/z，y_i = f·y/z：同样大小的物体，z 越大投影越小，f 越大投影越大。真实相机还要把世界坐标转成相机坐标，并考虑主点、像素尺寸和镜头畸变，但这个小模型是之后相机几何的基础。
about.en: In a pinhole camera, a 3D point P=(x,y,z) projects to (x_i,y_i) on the image plane, and the distance from the pinhole to the image plane is f (the focal length). By similar triangles, x_i = f·x/z, y_i = f·y/z: for objects of the same size, the larger z, the smaller the projection, and the larger f, the larger the projection. A real camera also has to convert world coordinates into camera coordinates and account for the principal point, pixel size and lens distortion, but this small model is the foundation for the camera geometry that follows.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 针孔相机模型：先学最简单的投影 (slide 11)

wall.zh: 物体距离加倍、焦距不变时，投影大小怎样变？
wall.en: If an object's distance doubles and the focal length stays the same, how does the size of its projection change?

misconception.zh: 以为可以由 (x_i,y_i) 反过来唯一求出 (x,y,z)；一个像素坐标只确定一条视线，深度未知。
misconception.en: Thinking you can recover (x,y,z) uniquely from (x_i,y_i); a pixel coordinate determines only a line of sight, and the depth is unknown.

term.zh: 正向问题与反向问题：图形学与视觉

about.zh: 计算机图形学已知物体、材质、灯光和相机，向前生成一张图像，是正向问题；计算机视觉已知图像，反过来推测物体、材质、灯光和相机，是反向问题。反问题通常更难，因为不同的三维场景可能产生很相似的二维图像。
about.en: Computer graphics knows the objects, materials, lighting and camera and works forwards to produce an image: a forward problem. Computer vision knows the image and works backwards to infer the objects, materials, lighting and camera: an inverse problem. The inverse problem is usually harder, because different 3D scenes can produce very similar 2D images.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/01-introduction.md §2 计算机视觉和计算机图形学的方向相反 (slide 8)

wall.zh: 为什么同一张照片可能对应不同的三维场景？
wall.en: Why can the same photo correspond to different 3D scenes?

misconception.zh: 以为只要图像足够清晰就能唯一还原三维场景；不同三维场景可能产生相似的二维图像。
misconception.en: Thinking that as long as the image is clear enough, the 3D scene can be recovered uniquely; different 3D scenes can produce similar 2D images.

term.en: angle of view and focal length

about.zh: 在数字图像中焦距常用像素表示：它只是把物理焦距除以像素尺寸，换成图像坐标单位。例如图像宽 2000 像素、主点在中间、焦距 1000 像素时，左右各约 45°，总视野范围约 90°。
about.en: In digital images the focal length is often expressed in pixels: this divides the physical focal length by the pixel size, converting it into image-coordinate units. For example, if the image is 2000 pixels wide, the principal point is in the middle and the focal length is 1000 pixels, each side spans about 45°, giving a total field of view of about 90°.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §2 焦距与视野范围 (slide 15)

wall.zh: 为什么只取半高会把全视场弄错？
wall.en: Why does confusing half-height and full height give the wrong full angle?

misconception.zh: 把以像素为单位的焦距和以毫米为单位的焦距直接比较或混用。
misconception.en: Directly comparing or mixing up a focal length in pixels with a focal length in millimetres.

term.zh: 图像张量：形状、通道顺序与数据类型
term.en: Image tensor layout, channel order and dtype

about.zh: 灰度图像可以看成二维数组；颜色图像通常有三个通道，表示成 height × width × channels 的三维张量。RGB 三通道是相机和人类视觉的工程表示（人眼有三类主要视锥细胞），并非自然界只有三种颜色。使用图像前先检查三件事：形状是 H×W×C 还是 C×H×W，通道顺序是 RGB 还是 BGR，数值范围和数据类型是什么；不同程序库的约定可能不同。
about.en: A greyscale image can be seen as a 2D array; a colour image usually has three channels and is represented as a 3D tensor of height × width × channels. The three RGB channels are an engineering representation for cameras and human vision (the human eye has three main types of cone cell), not because nature has only three colours. Before using an image, check three things: whether the shape is H×W×C or C×H×W, whether the channel order is RGB or BGR, and what the value range and data type are; different libraries may use different conventions.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 数字图像是怎样存储的 (slides 22, 25)

wall.zh: 拿到一个形状为 (3, 480, 640) 的数组，它可能是哪种布局？使用前还要检查哪两件事？
wall.en: Given an array of shape (3, 480, 640), what layout might it be? What two other things must you check before using it?

misconception.zh: 以为所有库都按 RGB、H×W×C 存储图像。
misconception.en: Thinking every library stores images as RGB, H×W×C.

about.zh: Crop 从原数组取一个子区域，已有像素数值不变；Resize 改变数组尺寸，必须为新位置计算像素数值。直接把 768×512 压成 512×512 会改变宽高比，物体可能变胖或变瘦；若保持比例，目标尺寸应接近 512×341。
about.en: Cropping takes a sub-region of the original array, and the existing pixel values are unchanged; resizing changes the size of the array, so pixel values must be computed for the new positions. Squashing 768×512 straight to 512×512 changes the aspect ratio, so objects may become fatter or thinner; if the proportions are kept, the target size should be about 512×341.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 裁剪与缩放不是一回事 (slide 34)

wall.zh: 把 768×512 图像缩到 512 并保持比例，另一边应是多少？裁剪和缩放哪个需要计算新像素值？
wall.en: If a 768×512 image is resized to 512 while keeping its proportions, what should the other side be? Which of cropping and resizing requires new pixel values to be computed?

misconception.zh: 以为裁剪也要插值，或以为缩放只是“截掉一部分”。
misconception.en: Thinking cropping also requires interpolation, or that resizing is just ‘cutting off a part’.

about.zh: 最近邻插值对每个新像素，找到原图中最近的像素，直接复制它的值。优点是快、边缘硬；缺点是放大或缩小时容易出现明显的方块感或锯齿。
about.en: For each new pixel, nearest-neighbour interpolation finds the nearest pixel in the original image and copies its value directly. Its advantages are speed and hard edges; its drawback is that enlarging or shrinking easily produces obvious blockiness or jagged edges.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 最近邻插值 (slide 35)

wall.zh: 用最近邻把图像放大 4 倍，为什么会出现方块感？
wall.en: Why does enlarging an image 4 times with nearest neighbour make it look blocky?

misconception.zh: 以为最近邻会产生原图中没有的新数值；它只复制已有值。
misconception.en: Thinking nearest neighbour produces new values not present in the original image; it only copies existing values.

about.zh: 新位置落在四个旧像素之间时，设横向距离为 H、纵向距离为 V，四个权重是 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV；它们加起来等于 1，所以双线性插值本质上是四个邻居的加权平均。它通常比最近邻平滑，但会让非常锐利的边缘稍微软化，老师说它把模糊并入了采样步骤；缩图时仍要根据采样比例检查是否需要额外抗混叠。
about.en: When a new position falls between four old pixels, let the horizontal distance be H and the vertical distance be V; the four weights are (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V and HV. They sum to 1, so bilinear interpolation is essentially a weighted average of the four neighbours. It is usually smoother than nearest neighbour, but slightly softens very sharp edges; the lecturer says it folds blurring into the sampling step. When downsizing, you should still check, based on the sampling ratio, whether extra anti-aliasing is needed.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 双线性插值 (slide 36)

wall.zh: 新像素落在四个旧像素之间时，双线性插值怎样得到它的值？四个权重为什么加起来等于 1？
wall.en: When a new pixel falls between four old pixels, how does bilinear interpolation obtain its value? Why do the four weights sum to 1?

misconception.zh: 把权重配反（让离得远的像素权重更大）；或以为双线性插值不会改变锐利边缘。
misconception.en: Assigning the weights the wrong way round (giving more distant pixels larger weights); or thinking bilinear interpolation does not alter sharp edges.

term.zh: 线性滤波公式（滑动加权和）
term.en: Linear filtering / convolution formula (sliding weighted sum)

about.zh: 把卷积核放在图像的一个位置，对齐后逐项相乘再相加，写作 g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v)，其中 f 是输入、h 是核权重、g 是输出、(u,v) 是邻域内偏移。式中的 i−u、j−v 表示卷积；按窗口直接对齐相乘的互相关则读作 i+u、j+v。中心权重为 1、其余为 0 时两者都只是复制当前像素。
