task.en: Given an image, output change strength at each position. Equal-sized responses pointing in opposite directions must have equal strength.

question.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>已有两个带符号的响应。现在用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>比较不同朝向的变化强度：先在响应表中检验转向和正负是否改变强度，再造一块可复用部件。
question.en: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> provides two signed responses. Use the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> to compare change strength across orientations: first test rotations and sign changes in a response table, then build a reusable part.

chain.zh: 比较等长而朝向不同的响应向量，排除直接相加。
chain.en: Compare equal-length response vectors pointing in different directions, rejecting signed addition.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入一张图：输出每个位置的变化强度。大小相同而方向相反的响应，应得到同样的强度。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given an image, output change strength at each position. Equal-sized responses pointing in opposite directions must have equal strength.

chain.zh: 相同强度的变化可以指向不同方向，两个响应直接相加会相消，无法稳定比较。把响应作为两个互相垂直的分量处理，才可在保留方向信息的同时另取一个非负强度。
chain.en: Equally strong changes can point in different directions. Adding signed responses can cancel them and fails as a stable comparison. Treating them as perpendicular components lets direction remain distinct from nonnegative strength.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

task.zh: 输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各通道模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
task.en: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred channels, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs.

question.zh: 把两条路线装进同一台处理器。先按 wr、wg、wb 选择要观察的颜色组合，用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>减弱细碎变化，再调用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>的强度部件检查剩下的分界。输出处理后的图与它的边缘强度，两者都要通过测试。
question.en: Assemble both routes into one processor. Select a colour mixture with wr, wg and wb, reduce fine variation with <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>, then call the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> strength part to inspect the remaining transitions. Output both the processed image and its edge strength.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各通道模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred channels, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs.

chain.zh: 这次<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>不只把部件摆在一起：权重决定看哪些通道，平滑改变进入求变化部件的信号。两张输出让你检查“保留了什么”与“哪里变化强”；这仍是局部处理，不等于识别物体。
chain.en: This <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> composes a real signal path: weights select channels and smoothing changes what reaches the change detector. The two outputs show what remains and where it changes strongly. These local operations do not recognise objects.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

task.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
task.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

question.zh: Workshop 2 里用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，三个数按 B、G、R 存；交给 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示，红蓝就对调了，蓝天变成橙色。另一个坑：照片常用 uint8 存，0 到 255，算出来超出范围会绕回去。
question.en: In Workshop 2 a photo read with OpenCV stores its three numbers as B, G, R; shown by Matplotlib as R, G, B, red and blue trade places and a blue sky turns orange. Another trap: photos are often uint8, 0 to 255, and a result out of range wraps around.

chain.zh: 换回 RGB：输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
chain.en: Back to RGB: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

chain.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>的差别和<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>的坑：先换好顺序，算之前换成更宽的类型。
chain.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref> difference and the <wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref> trap: swap the order before handing over, widen the type before computing.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

why.zh: 几何与数组路线互不调用对方的部件，像素相机组合时才共同需要。
why.en: Geometry and arrays do not use each other's parts; the pixel-camera join needs both.

why.zh: 核方向与竖直读取是独立问题，二维处理汇合时同时使用。
why.en: Kernel orientation and vertical addressing are independent; the 2D construction joins them.

why.zh: 平滑与变化响应从同一个二维滤波器出发，最终处理器实际调用两边部件。
why.en: Smoothing and change responses share the 2D filter; the finale calls parts from both.

body.zh: Sobel 用相互垂直的两组权重近似求强度变化。本游戏直接按窗口对齐相乘：g_x 的横向权重为 [−1,0,1]、纵向为 [1,2,1]；g_y 交换两个方向，所以沿坐标正方向从暗到亮为正。数学<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>采用相反的核写法；不能把<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的符号约定与翻转后的核混用。[1,2,1] 的和为 4，本游戏不额外归一化。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 29–30。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: Sobel approximates intensity changes with two perpendicular sets of weights. This game aligns weights directly with the window: g_x uses [−1,0,1] across and [1,2,1] down; g_y swaps the directions. Dark to bright along a positive coordinate direction is therefore positive. Mathematical <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> writes the flipped <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>; do not mix conventions. The [1,2,1] weights sum to 4 and are not normalised here. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 29–30. (<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>)

value.zh: 这一支要找变化而不是保留平均值。先比较一行的左右邻居，保留正负，再用<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>同时处理两个方向；使用直接按窗口对齐的权重约定。
value.en: This branch seeks change rather than an average. First compare left and right neighbours, retaining the sign, then use <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> in both directions with weights aligned directly to the window.

value.zh: 输入一张图：交出 gx（横向权重 −1、0、1，竖向 1、2、1）和 gy（横向 1、2、1，竖向 −1、0、1）。
value.en: Given an image, give gx (across −1, 0, 1; down 1, 2, 1) and gy (across 1, 2, 1; down −1, 0, 1).

value: x = filter2D(image, o, z, m, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, m, z, o)
x = filter2D(image, m, z, o, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, m, z, o)

value.zh: 输入一张图、一行权重 h1、h2、h3 和一列权重 v1、v2、v3：先横着用行权重滤，再竖着用列权重滤，图外补 0
value.en: Takes an image, a row of weights h1, h2, h3 and a column v1, v2, v3: filters across with the row, then down with the column, 0 outside

value.zh: 第二次滤波的输入，是第一次的输出。
value.en: The second pass takes the first pass's output.

value.zh: 输入一张图、行权重 h1、h2、h3 和列权重 v1、v2、v3：交出先横后竖两次滤波的结果。
value.en: Given an image, row weights h1, h2, h3 and column weights v1, v2, v3, give the result of filtering across, then down.

why: Provide direct term access for kernel conventions at the filtering join

ops.zh: 输入图像与按书写顺序给出的行、列<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>，输出先横后竖的二维<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>，按<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>约定在图外取零。
ops.en: Given an image and written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pairs for rows and columns, computes 2D <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> across then down, using zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 输入一张图、按书写顺序给出的行、列<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>（h1、h2、h3 与 v1、v2、v3）。输出二维<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的结果，采用零<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>；两组输入不是窗口位置权重。
ops.en: Given an image and written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pairs for rows (h1,h2,h3) and columns (v1,v2,v3), output the 2D <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> using zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>. These inputs are not positional window weights.

ops.zh: 回看<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的方向实验。行、列部件都直接按位置乘权重，怎样让它们服从题目给出的书写<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>？
ops.en: Revisit the orientation experiment in <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>. Both row and column parts multiply positional weights directly; how can they implement the written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pair?

ops.zh: 这一支要找变化而不是保留平均值。先比较一行的左右邻居，保留正负，再用<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>处理两个方向。手算题给窗口位置的权重；电路题沿用二维部件的书写<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>约定，注意核对二者。
ops.en: This branch seeks change rather than an average. First compare left and right neighbours, retaining the sign, then use <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> in both directions. The hand calculation gives positional window weights; the circuit uses the 2D part's written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> convention. Reconcile the two.

ops.zh: 输入一张图，输出 gx、gy。书写的<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>：gx 横向 [1,0,−1]、纵向 [1,2,1]；gy 横向 [1,2,1]、纵向 [1,0,−1]。沿坐标正方向从暗到亮，响应应为正。
ops.en: Given an image, output gx and gy. Written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pairs: gx uses [1,0,−1] across and [1,2,1] down; gy uses [1,2,1] across and [1,0,−1] down. Dark-to-bright along a positive coordinate direction must give a positive response.

value.zh: 输入一张图，输出 gx、gy。书写的核：gx 横向 [1,0,−1]、纵向 [1,2,1]；gy 横向 [1,2,1]、纵向 [1,0,−1]。沿坐标正方向从暗到亮，响应应为正。
value.en: Given an image, output gx and gy. Written kernels: gx uses [1,0,−1] across and [1,2,1] down; gy uses [1,2,1] across and [1,0,−1] down. Dark-to-bright along a positive coordinate direction must give a positive response.

value.zh: 这一支要找变化而不是保留平均值。先比较一行的左右邻居，保留正负，再用<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>处理两个方向。手算题给窗口位置的权重；电路题沿用二维部件的书写核约定，注意核对二者。
value.en: This branch seeks change rather than an average. First compare left and right neighbours, retaining the sign, then use <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> in both directions. The hand calculation gives positional window weights; the circuit uses the 2D part's written-kernel convention. Reconcile the two.

value.zh: 回看<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的方向实验。行、列部件都直接按位置乘权重，怎样让它们服从题目给定的书写顺序？
value.en: Revisit the orientation experiment in <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>. Both row and column parts multiply positional weights directly; how can they implement the given written kernels?

value.zh: 输入一张图、按书写顺序给出的行核 h1、h2、h3 与列核 v1、v2、v3。交出二维<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的结果，图外补零；两组输入不是窗口位置权重。
value.en: Given an image and row kernel h1,h2,h3 and column kernel v1,v2,v3 in written order, output the 2D <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> with zero padding. These inputs are not positional window weights.

value.zh: 输入图像与按书写顺序给出的行、列核，输出先横后竖的二维卷积，图外补零。
value.en: Given an image and written row/column kernels, computes 2D convolution across then down, with zero padding.

why: Keep the equal-scale FOV construction legible across the experimental range

step.why: Keep the equal-scale FOV construction legible across the experimental range

why: Keep the overview grammatical with a singular clickable term label

ops.zh: 一章一章造出视觉的机器。先造一台相机：把场景投影到<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>坐标、在任意位置取值；再造一台卷积器：把邻居加权合起来，搭出模糊器和边缘检测器。每个部件都会在后面直接复用。
ops.en: Build the machines of vision chapter by chapter. First a camera: project a scene into <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> coordinates and read it at any position; then a convolver: weigh neighbours together into a blur and an edge detector. Every part is reused later.

value.zh: 一章一章造出视觉的机器。先造一台相机：把场景投影成<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>、在任意位置取值；再造一台卷积器：把邻居加权合起来，搭出模糊器和边缘检测器。每个部件都会在后面直接复用。
value.en: Build the machines of vision chapter by chapter. First a camera: project a scene into <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> and read it at any position; then a convolver: weigh neighbours together into a blur and an edge detector. Every part is reused later.

why: Improve player-facing motivation, reasoning and synthesis in Vision Lab

ops.zh: 拍摄远处的物体时，物体在照片中的位置和大小由什么决定？先用理想相机研究一个点：图中 O 是<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>，虚线是<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>，f 确定<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>的位置。所有长度使用同一模型单位，虚像为正像。每次只改变 X、Z、f 中的一个，先预测，再与固定参照比较。
ops.en: What determines where a distant object appears in a photograph and how large it looks? Begin with a point in an ideal camera: O is the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>, the dashed line is the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, and f locates the <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>. All lengths share model units and the virtual image is upright. Change one of X, Z and f at a time, predict, then compare with the fixed reference.

ops.zh: 照片中的两个人看起来一样高，他们在现实中一定一样高吗？<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>可以从场景得到图像，但同一图像可能对应不同场景。以 H=1、Z=4、f=2 为参照，构造一支至少高一倍、成像相同的箭，再在额外给定 Z 的条件下倒推位置。
ops.en: If two people appear equally tall in a photograph, must they be equally tall in reality? <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> maps a scene to an image, but one image may correspond to different scenes. Using H=1, Z=4, f=2 as a reference, construct an arrow at least twice as tall with the same image, then infer position when Z is also given.

ops.zh: 相机形成的像要记录在图像中，还需要确定它落在哪个位置。<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>给出相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的偏移，而<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>规定了图像中的位置如何计数。在横向坐标条上，先用<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>换算单位，再以<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>调整原点，最后将两者组合成<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>相机。
ops.en: To record a projected image, a camera must locate it in the image array. <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> gives an offset from the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, while the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> specifies how image positions are counted. On the horizontal strip, convert units using <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>, adjust the origin using the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>, then compose a <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> camera.

ops.zh: 放大一张照片，可以看到它由许多小色点组成。计算机如何找到并修改其中一个点，又如何比较相邻位置？参照<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>和<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>，定位并修改数表中的一格，再计算它与右邻的差。彩色样例按 R、G、B 排列，数值范围为 0 到 1。
ops.en: Magnify a photograph and its small coloured elements become visible. How can a computer locate and change one element, or compare neighbouring positions? Using <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> and the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>, locate and edit a cell, then calculate its difference from its right neighbour. Colour examples use R, G, B order and values from 0 to 1.

ops.zh: 从照片中截取一块区域时，截出的画面怎样对应原图？用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>保留选中的区域，追踪新图各位置在原图中的来源；新图的左上角对应所选区域的起点。
ops.en: When a region is cut from a photograph, how does the result correspond to the original? Use <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> to retain the selected region and trace each position in the new image back to its source. The new top-left corner corresponds to the start of the selected region.

ops.zh: 放大照片时，输出图像需要比原图更多的位置；这些位置不一定落在原有像素中心。题目给出原图中的采样位置，用<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>读取数值，并比较 0.4 和 0.5 附近的结果。本题约定距离相同时取坐标较大的一边，图外取最近边界。
ops.en: Enlarging a photograph requires more output positions, which need not fall on original pixel centres. The task supplies sample positions in the original: use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> to read values and compare positions around 0.4 and 0.5. Ties take the larger coordinate; outside positions use the nearest boundary.

ops.zh: 放大后的照片可能出现明显的阶梯边缘。能否利用周围的像素，让相邻采样位置之间的变化更平滑？在相同采样位置比较<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：先观察一行中靠近两端的位置，再考虑四个角；图外取最近边界。
ops.en: An enlarged photograph can have visibly stepped edges. Can surrounding pixels produce smoother changes between nearby sample positions? Compare <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> with <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref> at the same positions: first observe points near either end of a row, then consider four corners. Outside positions use the nearest boundary.

ops.zh: 拍摄同一场景时，有的镜头能容纳更宽的景物，有的只能拍到局部。有限大小的<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>只接收部分<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>。固定传感器高度，改变<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>并观察两条边界：怎样使<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>恰好为 90°？
ops.en: Different lenses capture different amounts of the same scene. A finite <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> receives only some <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>. Keep its height fixed and change the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> while observing the two boundaries: how can the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> be exactly 90°?

ops.zh: 照片中的噪点可以通过周围像素的信息减弱，但只读取单个位置无法做到这一点。利用<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>，观察窗口移动时<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>如何作用于邻域。本关只计算三个邻居都在图内的位置。
ops.en: Nearby pixels can help reduce noise in a photograph, but reading a single position cannot do this. Use <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> to observe how a <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> acts on a neighbourhood as the window moves. Compute only positions where all three neighbours are inside the image.

ops.zh: 处理照片边缘时，窗口的一部分会落到画面之外。如果仍要保留原图尺寸，应如何处理缺失的邻居？本关采用<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>中的补零规则；比较边缘与内部的相同输入，观察输出是否仍然相同。
ops.en: At a photograph’s edge, part of the processing window falls outside the image. How should missing neighbours be handled if the output is to retain the original size? Use zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>, then compare equal inputs at the edge and in the interior.

ops.zh: 观察一条由暗到亮的边界时，权重的方向会影响变化的符号。用<wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>考察<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：追踪唯一亮点遇到的权重，再让电路符合题目要求的翻转约定。
ops.en: When observing a dark-to-bright boundary, weight orientation affects the sign of the change. Use an <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref> to examine <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: track the weight meeting the single bright sample, then make the circuit obey the requested flip convention.

ops.zh: 图像中的变化既可能沿水平方向出现，也可能沿竖直方向出现。要沿列应用<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>，需要读取哪些邻居？先在窗口中追踪一列，保持 x 不变、改变 y，再将读取方式用于整张图。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Changes in an image can run vertically as well as horizontally. Which neighbours are needed to apply a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> down a column? Track one column in the window, keeping x fixed and varying y, then extend the addressing to the whole image. (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)

ops.zh: 照片中的一个亮点会影响周围多个位置。二维处理能否由横向和纵向两次处理组成？结合已验证的方向约定与行列读取方式，用<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>追踪一个输入对各输出的贡献，再组合已有元件。
ops.en: A bright point in a photograph can influence several nearby positions. Can a two-dimensional operation be composed from horizontal and vertical passes? Using the established orientation and row and column addressing conventions, trace one input’s contributions with <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>, then combine the existing parts.

ops.zh: 照片中的细小亮度变化可能掩盖更大范围的结构。用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>观察平滑的效果：先检查一个亮点对周围的影响，再处理一条明暗分界。本关行、列权重均为 [1/4,1/2,1/4]，图外补零。
ops.en: Fine intensity variation in a photograph can obscure larger structures. Use <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> to examine smoothing: first inspect the effect of one bright point on its surroundings, then process an intensity boundary. Row and column weights are [1/4,1/2,1/4], with zero outside.

ops.zh: 照片中物体的轮廓常伴随亮度变化。怎样区分由暗到亮与由亮到暗的变化，并同时观察两个方向？先比较一行的相邻值，再用<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>处理图像。手算题给出窗口位置的权重；电路题采用二维元件的书写<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>约定，注意核对两种顺序。
ops.en: Object outlines in a photograph often coincide with intensity changes. How can dark-to-bright and bright-to-dark changes be distinguished in both directions? First compare neighbouring values in a row, then process the image with <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>. The hand calculation gives positional window weights; the circuit uses the 2D part’s written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> convention. Reconcile the two orders.

ops.zh: 照片中的边缘可能朝向不同方向，如何比较它们的变化强度？<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>给出两个带符号的方向响应。利用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>，先比较响应表中不同方向和符号的变化，再构建可复用的强度元件。
ops.en: Edges in a photograph can point in different directions. How can their change strengths be compared? <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> provides two signed directional responses. Using the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>, compare directions and signs in the response table, then build a reusable strength part.

ops.zh: 分析彩色照片时，关注不同颜色可能突出不同的结构；细碎变化又可能影响边缘的观察。组合已有元件，按 wr、wg、wb 选择颜色权重，用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>平滑图像，再用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>的强度元件分析变化。输出处理后的图像和对应的边缘强度。
ops.en: In a colour photograph, different colour mixtures can reveal different structures, while fine variation can affect edge analysis. Combine the existing parts: choose colour weights wr, wg and wb, smooth the image with <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>, and use the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> strength part to analyse change. Output the processed image and its edge strength.

ops.zh: 图像中的数值与位置共同决定了读到的内容。<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>使定位和比较邻近<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>成为可能；坐标顺序不一致则可能读到或修改错误的位置。
ops.en: Image values and positions together determine what is read. The <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> makes it possible to locate and compare neighbouring <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>; inconsistent coordinate order can select or change the wrong position.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>保留选定区域的原有数值，只改变区域的位置和坐标范围；它不会像缩放那样重新确定输出的采样位置。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> retains the selected region’s original values while changing its position and coordinate range. Unlike resizing, it does not establish new sampling positions.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>使用最近位置的值。采样位置连续移动时，所选邻居可能突然切换，因此放大结果可能出现阶梯；坐标正确本身并不保证平滑。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> uses the value at the nearest position. As the sampling position moves continuously, the selected neighbour can change abruptly, producing steps in an enlargement. Correct coordinates alone do not ensure smoothness.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>根据横向和纵向距离在邻近值之间过渡，可以减轻阶梯感；但它不能恢复原图未记录的细节，平滑不等于增加真实信息。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref> transitions between neighbouring values according to horizontal and vertical distances, reducing stepping. It cannot recover detail absent from the original: smoothness does not add measured information.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的区别涉及权重的方向。对称权重可能掩盖方向差异，而不对称权重能帮助检查约定；数值相近的结果不一定表示使用了相同运算。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> differ in weight orientation. Symmetric weights can hide that difference; asymmetric weights help check the convention. Similar-looking results do not necessarily imply the same operation.

ops.zh: 横向与纵向<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>使用相同的计算结构，区别在于邻居的位置。使用非方形图和不对称内容，有助于发现坐标方向混淆。
ops.en: Horizontal and vertical <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> share the same computational structure but address different neighbours. Non-square images with asymmetric content help expose confusion between coordinate directions.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>中，横向与纵向的权重共同决定二维邻域中各位置的贡献。只有满足可分解条件的<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>才能这样处理，并非任意二维核都适用。
ops.en: In a <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>, horizontal and vertical weights jointly determine each position’s contribution to the two-dimensional neighbourhood. This applies only to separable <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>, not every two-dimensional kernel.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>减弱细小变化，也会使锐利边界变得模糊。内部常值区域可以保持亮度，但补零边界的邻域条件不同，因此边缘可能变暗。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> reduces fine variation but also blurs sharp boundaries. Constant interior regions can retain their intensity, while zero-padded boundaries have different neighbourhoods and may darken.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>的带符号响应反映亮度变化的方向；平坦区域即使很亮也可能没有响应。图像边界的补零则可能产生额外响应。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: Signed <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> responses indicate the direction of intensity change. A bright flat region can have zero response, while zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> can create extra responses at image boundaries.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>用两个方向的响应描述局部变化：方向与非负强度是不同的信息。直接相加可能使正负响应相消，不能稳定地比较变化强度。
ops.en: The <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> describes local change using two directional responses: direction and nonnegative strength convey different information. Direct addition can cancel signed responses and does not reliably compare strengths.

ops.zh: 不同工具的颜色通道顺序可能不同，交换顺序前需要确认输入和输出的约定（<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>）。整数类型的取值范围也会影响计算结果（<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>）；计算前应选择足以容纳结果的类型。
ops.en: Tools may use different channel orders, so check input and output conventions before rearranging them (<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>). Integer ranges also affect computed results (<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>); choose a type that can hold the result before computing.

ops.zh: 已知物体的实际高度和距离，并测得它在照片中占据的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>数，能否估计镜头的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>？照片给出的是像素数，而<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>关系需要<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的实际长度。
ops.en: If an object’s height and distance are known and its size in the photograph is measured in <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>, can the lens’s <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> be estimated? The photograph gives a pixel count, while <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> requires a physical length on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 从照片中心裁取区域时，需要准确确定宽、高和起点。不同工具对尺寸的排列约定可能不同：<wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>说明了 NumPy 图像形状与 OpenCV 尺寸的顺序。若混淆两者，裁剪区域可能偏离中心。
ops.en: A centre crop requires the width, height and starting position to be identified correctly. Tools may order dimensions differently: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref> describes the conventions for NumPy image shapes and OpenCV sizes. Confusing them can move the crop away from the centre.

ops.zh: 一张照片在不同工具中显示时，蓝天可能变成橙色：原因可能是颜色通道的排列顺序不同。Workshop 2 中，OpenCV 读入的顺序为 B、G、R，而 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示。图像计算还需要留意数据类型：uint8 的范围为 0 到 255，超出范围的运算结果可能发生回绕。
ops.en: A photograph can display an orange sky in another tool because its colour channels are ordered differently. In Workshop 2, OpenCV reads B, G, R while Matplotlib displays R, G, B. Image calculations also depend on data type: uint8 ranges from 0 to 255, and arithmetic results outside that range can wrap around.

ops.zh: 怎样恢复照片的颜色？<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>将三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次作为 R、G、B 通道合成彩色图。
ops.en: How can the photograph’s colours be restored? <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> combines three <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> as the R, G and B channels of a colour image.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>将投影位置与图像坐标联系起来：光路不变，变化的是单位和原点。区分<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>的单位换算与坐标原点的平移，有助于正确表示负偏移。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
ops.en: A <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> relates projected positions to image coordinates: the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> is unchanged, while the units and origin differ. Distinguishing the unit conversion for <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> from the shift of origin helps represent negative offsets correctly.

value.zh: 这就是<wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>。光路没变，变的是用什么单位、从哪里计数。将<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>交给已搭好的投影部件，再把结果平移到图像原点，才能与数组里的位置对齐；把这两步混成一次，就容易漏掉负偏移或原点平移。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
value.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>. The <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> stays the same; the measurement unit and origin change. Feed the <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> to the projection part, then shift into the image frame. Keeping these steps distinct handles negative offsets and the change of origin.

value.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样把颜色换回来？新元件<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次当作 R、G、B 合成彩色图。
value.en: This level asks: how are the colours put back? New part: <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images R, G and B of one colour image. (<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>)

value.zh: Workshop 2 里用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，三个数按 B、G、R 存；交给 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示，红蓝就对调了，蓝天变成橙色。另一个坑：照片常用 uint8 存，0 到 255，算出来超出范围会绕回去。
value.en: In Workshop 2 a photo read with OpenCV stores its three numbers as B, G, R; shown by Matplotlib as R, G, B, red and blue trade places and a blue sky turns orange. Another trap: photos are often uint8, 0 to 255, and a result out of range wraps around.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>：NumPy 给出图的形状时先写行数（高）、再写列数（宽）；OpenCV 要尺寸时却先写宽、再写高。Workshop 2 要从图的正中间裁出一块，两种顺序一混，裁出的位置就偏了。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>: NumPy gives an image's shape as rows (height) first, then columns (width); OpenCV asks for a size as width first, then height. Workshop 2 crops a region from the very centre, and mixing the two orders puts it off-centre.

value.zh: Workshop 2 的一道题：知道物体多高、多远，从照片里量出它占多少<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>，反推镜头的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>。照片里量的是像素，<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>要的是<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的毫米。
value.en: A Workshop 2 exercise: knowing how tall and how far an object is, measure the span in <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> units in the photo and work back to the lens's <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>. The photo gives pixel counts; <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> want millimetres on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>的差别和<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>的坑：先换好顺序，算之前换成更宽的类型。
value.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref> difference and the <wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref> trap: swap the order before handing over, widen the type before computing.

value.zh: 相同强度的变化可以指向不同方向，两个响应直接相加会相消，无法稳定比较。把响应作为两个互相垂直的分量处理，才可在保留方向信息的同时另取一个非负强度。
value.en: Equally strong changes can point in different directions. Adding signed responses can cancel them and fails as a stable comparison. Treating them as perpendicular components lets direction remain distinct from nonnegative strength.

value.zh: 同一条分界从暗到亮与从亮到暗，响应的符号相反；把符号丢掉，就不能判断增亮方向。平坦区域即使很亮也可以没有响应，图像边界的补零却可能制造额外响应。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
value.en: Reversing a step from dark-to-bright to bright-to-dark reverses the response sign. Losing it loses the brightening direction. A bright flat region can have zero response, while zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> can create extra responses at image boundaries.

value.zh: 亮点传播到邻居，分界也随之变缓；减弱细碎变化的同时，定位锐利边界的能力也会损失。内部常值区域可保持亮度，但补零造成的边界不满足相同邻域条件。
value.en: The bright sample spreads and the step becomes gentler. Reducing fine variation also sacrifices sharp boundary localisation. Constant interior regions can keep their intensity; zero-padded boundaries do not have the same neighbourhood conditions.

value.zh: 横向结果成为纵向输入时，两次权重会相乘，而不是相加。这个贡献路径解释了为何能合成二维权重；它只覆盖可分解的核，不能据此把任意二维核都拆开。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
value.en: When the horizontal result becomes the vertical input, the two weights multiply rather than add. That contribution path explains the combined 2D weights. It covers separable <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>, not every possible 2D kernel.

value.zh: 横、竖处理的代数结构一致，差别落在“读哪个邻居”。用非方形图与不对称内容测试，才能让误把 y 改成 x 的接法显出差异。
value.en: Horizontal and vertical operations share an algebraic structure; the addressed neighbours differ. Non-square images with asymmetric content expose a circuit that changes x where y was intended.

value.zh: 亮点把权重方向暴露出来；对称权重会掩盖这个错误，所以还要用不对称权重检查。下一步处理二维方向时，应先确定窗口位置的约定，而不靠输出“看起来差不多”。
value.en: The bright sample exposes weight orientation. Symmetric weights hide this error, so asymmetric tests matter. Before processing two directions, establish positional conventions rather than accepting outputs that look similar.

value.zh: 横向与纵向分别考虑距离，可以在四个邻居之间连续过渡。这减少了阶梯感，却不会补回原图未记录的细节；平滑的结果不等于更多真实信息。
value.en: Considering horizontal and vertical distances separately gives a continuous transition between four neighbours. It reduces stepping without recovering detail absent from the original; a smoother result does not contain more measured information.

value.zh: 位置只移动一点，读到的值却可能突然改变；这种不连续来自所选邻居的切换。取样规则决定了新图的结构，坐标正确并不保证放大后平滑。
value.en: A tiny position change can cause a sudden value change when the selected neighbour switches. The sampling rule determines the new image structure; correct coordinates alone do not ensure a smooth enlargement.

value.zh: 裁出的数值没有重新估计，变化的是读取位置。沿同一偏移追踪四个角，可以检验<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>电路是否保留了整块区域，而不只碰巧取对一格。
value.en: The values were not re-estimated; their read positions changed. Track the same offset at all four corners to check that the <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> circuit preserves a whole region rather than one lucky cell.

value.zh: 同一张数表换一个读取位置，得到的值就可能不同；图像运算首先要保证“取到了哪里”。邻居差把这种定位用于比较，为后面的局部处理打下基础。
value.en: Reading another position can change the value obtained from the same table. Before computing, establish where the input comes from. Neighbour differences use that positioning to make a comparison, ready for local processing.

value.zh: 把两条路线装进同一台处理器。先按 wr、wg、wb 选择要观察的颜色组合，用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>减弱细碎变化，再调用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>的强度部件检查剩下的分界。输出处理后的图与它的边缘强度，两者都要通过测试。
value.en: Assemble both routes into one processor. Select a colour mixture with wr, wg and wb, reduce fine variation with <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>, then call the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> strength part to inspect the remaining transitions. Output both the processed image and its edge strength.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>已有两个带符号的响应。现在用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>比较不同朝向的变化强度：先在响应表中检验转向和正负是否改变强度，再造一块可复用部件。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> provides two signed responses. Use the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> to compare change strength across orientations: first test rotations and sign changes in a response table, then build a reusable part.

value.zh: 这一支要找变化而不是保留平均值。先比较一行的左右邻居，保留正负，再用<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>处理两个方向。手算题给窗口位置的权重；电路题沿用二维部件的书写<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>约定，注意核对二者。
value.en: This branch seeks change rather than an average. First compare left and right neighbours, retaining the sign, then use <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> in both directions. The hand calculation gives positional window weights; the circuit uses the 2D part's written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> convention. Reconcile the two.

value.zh: 这一支用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>处理细碎变化。先检查一个亮点向周围传播的结果，再用同样的部件处理一条明暗分界；本关给定行、列权重 [1/4,1/2,1/4]，图外补零。
value.en: This branch uses <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> for fine-scale variation. Check how one bright sample spreads, then apply the same parts to an intensity step. Row and column weights are [1/4,1/2,1/4], with zero outside.

value.zh: 两条路线在这里汇合：方向约定已经核对，也能分别读行与列。用<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>思考两次处理如何组合；先追踪一个输入位置到各输出位置的贡献，再组合已搭好的部件。
value.en: The routes meet here: orientation is checked and both rows and columns can be addressed. Use <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> to reason about composition. Track one input contribution across output positions before combining the built parts.

value.zh: 这条必修路线把<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>转向上下，不依赖核方向路线。先在窗口里追踪一列：保持 x 不动，只改变 y，再把刚验证的读取方式推广到整张图。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
value.en: This required route turns <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> vertically, independently of the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>-orientation route. Track one column in the window: keep x fixed, vary y, then extend the checked addressing to the image.

value.zh: 这条必修路线研究权重的方向，不必等待列处理。用<wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>检查<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：沿窗口追踪唯一亮点分别遇到哪个权重，再让电路符合题目要求的翻转约定。
value.en: This required route studies weight orientation without waiting for column processing. Use an <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref> to inspect <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: track which weight meets the single bright sample, then make the circuit obey the requested flip convention.

value.zh: 相邻处理要继续组合，不能每次都悄悄缩小画面。本关选用<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>中的补零规则，保留所有中心位置；比较边缘和中间同样的输入，看看输出是否还相同。
value.en: To compose local operations, the frame must not silently shrink each time. Use zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> and retain every centre position. Compare equal inputs at the edge and in the interior: do their outputs stay equal?

value.zh: 已经会按坐标读取，现在要让一个输出同时依赖周围的值。打开<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>和<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>，用窗口逐格跟踪<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>。本关只算三个邻居都在图内的位置。
value.en: Coordinate lookup is ready; now one output must depend on surrounding values. Open <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>, then follow the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> with the movable window. Only positions with three neighbours inside the image are used.

value.zh: 有限大小的<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>只接住部分<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>。固定它的高度，只改变<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>，观察上下两条边界：怎样让<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>正好为 90°？这一关不涉及<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>换算。
value.en: A finite <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> captures only some rays. Keep its height fixed and change the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>: how can the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> become exactly 90°? No <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> conversion is needed here. (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)

value.zh: 保持与<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>相同的采样位置，改用<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>。先看一行上靠左、靠右两点怎样变化，再把这个做法用于四个角；图外仍取最近边界。
value.en: Keep the same sample positions but use <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>. First compare points near either end of a row, then extend that reasoning to four corners. Outside positions still use the nearest boundary. (<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>)

value.zh: 改过输出尺寸后，题目直接给出原图中的采样位置。用<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>完成这次读取，比较 0.4 和 0.5 附近的结果。本题约定距离相同时取坐标较大的一边，图外取最近边界。
value.en: After changing output size, the task supplies sample positions in the original. Use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> and compare positions around 0.4 and 0.5. Ties take the larger coordinate and positions outside use the nearest boundary.

value.zh: 现在只保留画面的一部分，用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>完成。先把选中的区域搬进小图，再追踪新图的每一格来自原图哪里；新图左上角不再对应原图左上角。
value.en: Keep only part of the image using <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>. Move the selected region into a smaller image, then track where each new cell comes from. The two top-left corners no longer coincide.

value.zh: 这条路线从数表开始，不需要先会相机几何。通过<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>查看表示约定：指出位置、改变一格，再让电路读取右邻和当前位置的差。彩色样例约定按 R、G、B 排列，数值在 0 到 1。
value.en: This route starts from tables and needs no camera geometry. Open <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> and the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> for the representation: locate a cell, change one cell, then wire the difference between it and its right neighbour. Colour examples use R, G, B order with values from 0 to 1.

value.zh: 两条路线在这里汇合：<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>给出相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的偏移，<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>让你能在数表中定位。先在横向坐标条上做两步：按<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>换单位，再用<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>换原点；最后接成<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>相机。
value.en: The routes meet here: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> gives an offset from the axis, while the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> locates cells in the table. On the horizontal strip, first convert units using <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>, then move the origin using the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>; finally compose a <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> camera. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>能从场景得到图像，但反过来是否唯一？保留 H=1、Z=4、f=2 的参照，让一支至少高一倍的箭拍出相同的像。之后只在额外给定 Z 的条件下倒推位置。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> maps a scene to an image. Is the reverse unique? Keep the H=1, Z=4, f=2 reference and construct an arrow at least twice as tall with the same image. Then invert a point position only when Z is supplied.

value.zh: 先造相机的投影部件。图中 O 是<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>，虚线标出<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>，f 指向<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>。本实验所有长度共用模型单位，采用正像的虚像平面。固定参照一直保留：每次只改变 X、Z、f 中的一个，先预测，再检查。
value.en: Build the projection part of the camera. O marks the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>, the dashed line the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, and f locates the <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>. All lengths share model units and the virtual image is upright. Keep the reference in view: change one of X, Z and f at a time, predict, then check.

why: Replace trivial onboarding and numeric bench gates with circuit reasoning; retain tangible inverse and framing experiments with competing constraints.

t.zh: 同一盏灯，为什么换了距离或相机设置，照片中的位置就变了？展开测试中的拍摄场景，比较只改变 X、Z 或 f 的案例，再搭出适用于所有案例的投影电路。O 是<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>；测量屏采用正像的<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>，所有长度共用模型单位。
t.en: Why does the same light appear at a different position when its distance or the camera setting changes? Inspect the camera scenes in the tests, compare cases that change only X, Z or f, then build a projection circuit that works across them. O is the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>; the measurement screen uses an upright <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>, with one length unit throughout.

t.zh: 测试中的像点都由<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>经过 O 得到。观察改变位置、距离与像平面距离分别怎样影响结果；需要时打开<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>查看比例关系。用乘法和除法搭出同一个关系，不必逐个预测数字。
t.en: Each test image point lies on a <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> through O. Compare how position, depth and plane distance change it; open <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> if you need the proportional relation. Build one rule with multiplication and division.

value.zh: 同一条<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>经过 O，使两段距离受<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>约束。<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>把这个比例推广到不同的位置与深度；场景和图像的坐标不能直接当作同一个量。
value.en: A shared <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> through O constrains the distances through <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>. <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> applies that proportion across positions and depths; scene and image coordinates are not interchangeable.

value.zh: 读出图像中的变化
value.en: Read changes in an image

t.zh: 图像里的亮暗变化藏在不同位置的数值之间。按照<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>在<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>中读取两个样本，先搭出比较器，再让它自动寻找右邻。样例都是<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>；正负差值也必须保留。
t.en: Changes in an image lie between values at different positions. Read two samples in the <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> using the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>, build a comparator, then make it find the right neighbour automatically. Samples are <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> values; retain the sign of each difference.

brief.zh: 输入一张图与 A、B 两点的坐标：输出 B 的像素值减去 A 的像素值。坐标先写列 x，再写行 y；编号从 0 开始。
brief.en: Given an image and coordinates for A and B, output the pixel value at B minus the value at A. Coordinates give column x before row y, indexed from 0.

hint.zh: 分别检查两个取值是否来自正确的位置，再检查差值的正负。行与列写反可能仍得到一个数，但不能通过所有图像的测试。
hint.en: Check the two addressed values before checking the sign of their difference. Swapping row and column can still produce a number, but fails across the images.

t.zh: 比较器已经能读取任意两点。现在只给一个位置，另一点始终在它右侧：保留同一行，找出应当怎样从 x 得到另一个列坐标，再把寻址和比较组合起来。
t.en: The comparator can read any two points. Now only one position is supplied, and the other is always its right neighbour. Keep the row, work out the second column from x, then combine addressing and comparison.

t.zh: 相机几何与读图路线在这里汇合。投影先给出相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的带符号偏移；图像中的列坐标却从另一处起算。题目直接提供已按<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>换过单位的<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px，接着用<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x 表示光轴在图中的位置，组成能处理不同相机的坐标电路。
t.en: The geometry and image-reading routes meet here. Projection gives a signed offset from the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, while image columns use a different origin. The supplied <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px already incorporates the <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref> conversion. Use the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x to account for where the axis meets the image, building a coordinate circuit for different cameras.

t.zh: X 与 Z 使用同一长度单位，f_px 已经以像素表示。测试中的 X=0 应落在 c_x；X<0 只表示在光轴的一侧，不等于落在画面之外。比较这些案例，决定怎样平移投影结果。
t.en: X and Z use one length unit, and f_px is already in pixels. X=0 must land at c_x; X<0 means one side of the axis, not necessarily outside the image. Compare these cases to decide how the projected offset should be shifted.

t.zh: 想把远处的灯塔拍大，拉近焦距却可能裁掉塔顶；附近的路灯还会闯入画面。用<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>和相机高度共同调整取景：灯塔必须完整、像高至少 16 mm，而路灯要完全在画面之外。这里研究竖直<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，传感器高 24 mm，场景使用统一的模型毫米。
t.en: Making the distant lighthouse larger can crop its top, while a nearby lamp intrudes into the photograph. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> and camera height together: keep the entire lighthouse at an image height of at least 16 mm, with the lamp wholly outside the frame. This is a vertical <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> experiment with a 24 mm sensor and consistent model millimetres.

after.zh: 放大投影会缩小<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，改变相机高度则平移物体相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的位置。这两个调整相互约束：画面中的主体要足够大，也必须完整；不能把“有一部分被裁掉”当作“完全不在画面里”。<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>描述固定画幅与焦距之间的取舍。
after.en: Enlarging the projection narrows the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>, while changing camera height shifts objects relative to the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>. The controls constrain each other: the subject must be large enough yet complete. Partial cropping is not complete exclusion. <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> describes the fixed-sensor trade-off.

brief.zh: 完整拍下灯塔，像高至少 16 mm；附近的路灯必须完全出画。调焦距 f 和相机高度，再检查照片。
brief.en: Keep the lighthouse complete, with image height at least 16 mm. Exclude the nearby lamp entirely. Adjust f and camera height, then check the photograph.

hint.zh: 先让灯塔达到要求的大小，再观察是哪一端超出传感器。移动相机高度会同时改变灯塔与路灯的位置；它们的距离不同，移动幅度也不同。
hint.en: First make the lighthouse large enough, then inspect which end exceeds the sensor. Camera height moves both lighthouse and lamp in the image, by different amounts because their depths differ.

why.zh: 只放大而不调整取景中心，会裁掉灯塔顶部。
why.en: Zooming without adjusting the view centre crops the top of the lighthouse.

why.zh: 灯塔完整，但较近的路灯仍有一部分入画；不能只检查主体。
why.en: The lighthouse fits, but part of the nearer lamp remains visible; checking only the subject is insufficient.

learner.zh: 学过编程和中学数学、没有学过计算机视觉的学习者（COMP90086 的学生）
learner.en: Learners who can program and know school mathematics but have not studied computer vision (COMP90086 students)

endpoint.zh: 一章一章造出视觉的机器：相机、卷积器，往后是卷积网络、注意力和全景拼接器；每个部件在后面的章里直接复用。
endpoint.en: Build the machines of vision chapter by chapter: a camera, a convolver, later a convolutional network, attention and a panorama stitcher, each part reused in the chapters after.

scope.zh: 第 1–2 章（讲义第 1–3 讲和第 5 讲的梯度），依据 docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/knowledge-map-1-12.md 的章节方案：相机（投影、像素焦距、数表、裁剪、最近邻、双线性）和卷积器（滑动加权、补边、翻转、可分离、高斯、Sobel、梯度、彩色卷积）。Workshop 内容做成可选专题。
scope.en: Chapters 1–2 (lectures 1–3 and the gradient of lecture 5), after the chapter plan in docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/knowledge-map-1-12.md: the camera (projection, focal length in pixels, the table of numbers, cropping, nearest neighbour, bilinear) and the convolver (sliding weighted sums, padding, flipping, separable, Gaussian, Sobel, the gradient, colour convolution). Workshop content is optional topics.

where.zh: 每关最后一步：把关系接成电路，做出的板成为后面的部件
where.en: The last step of most levels: the relation wired as a circuit, the board a part for later

why.zh: 《图灵完备》式的抽象：造出的部件在后面直接调用，复杂的机器由简单的部件一层层搭起
why.en: Turing Complete's abstraction: parts built are called directly later, complex machines built up from simple parts

where.zh: 动手算：读图、裁剪、取值、卷积核
where.en: Working by hand: reading, cropping, sampling, kernels

why.zh: 先亲手当一回机器，电路才有前因
why.en: Acting as the machine first gives the circuit its reason

where.zh: 针孔相机台：投影、视场
where.en: The pinhole bench: projection, field of view

why.zh: 连续量的关系先预测再检查
why.en: Relations between continuous quantities, predicted, then checked

about.zh: 针孔相机台
about.en: The pinhole camera bench

about.zh: 读写像素格（grid 任务）
about.en: Read and write pixel grids (grid tasks)

about.zh: 图像电路：搭出的板成为部件
about.en: Image circuits: a board built becomes a part

lacks.zh: 它只会把场景拍成数表、按位置取值：不会把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算。
lacks.en: It only pictures a scene as a table and reads values at positions: it cannot combine a pixel with its neighbours.

lacks.zh: 每个输出只是邻域的加权和，权重是人定的：它不会自己学出权重，这是卷积网络存在的理由。
lacks.en: Each output is a weighted sum over a neighbourhood with weights set by hand: it cannot learn them, the reason convolutional networks exist.

about.zh: 针孔相机中，三维点 P=(x,y,z) 投到成像平面上的 (x_i,y_i)，pinhole 到成像平面的距离为 f（焦距）。由相似三角形得 x_i = f·x/z，y_i = f·y/z：同样大小的物体，z 越大投影越小，f 越大投影越大。真实相机还要把世界坐标转成相机坐标，并考虑主点、像素尺寸和镜头畸变，但这个小模型是之后相机几何的基础。
about.en: In a pinhole camera, a 3D point P=(x,y,z) projects to (x_i,y_i) on the image plane, and the distance from the pinhole to the image plane is f (the focal length). By similar triangles, x_i = f·x/z, y_i = f·y/z: for objects of the same size, the larger z, the smaller the projection, and the larger f, the larger the projection. A real camera also has to convert world coordinates into camera coordinates and account for the principal point, pixel size and lens distortion, but this small model is the foundation for the camera geometry that follows.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 针孔相机模型：先学最简单的投影 (slide 11)

wall.zh: 物体距离加倍、焦距不变时，投影大小怎样变？
wall.en: If an object's distance doubles and the focal length stays the same, how does the size of its projection change?

misconception.zh: 以为可以由 (x_i,y_i) 反过来唯一求出 (x,y,z)；一个像素坐标只确定一条视线，深度未知。
misconception.en: Thinking you can recover (x,y,z) uniquely from (x_i,y_i); a pixel coordinate determines only a line of sight, and the depth is unknown.

term.zh: 正向问题与反向问题：图形学与视觉

about.zh: 计算机图形学已知物体、材质、灯光和相机，向前生成一张图像，是正向问题；计算机视觉已知图像，反过来推测物体、材质、灯光和相机，是反向问题。反问题通常更难，因为不同的三维场景可能产生很相似的二维图像。
about.en: Computer graphics knows the objects, materials, lighting and camera and works forwards to produce an image: a forward problem. Computer vision knows the image and works backwards to infer the objects, materials, lighting and camera: an inverse problem. The inverse problem is usually harder, because different 3D scenes can produce very similar 2D images.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/01-introduction.md §2 计算机视觉和计算机图形学的方向相反 (slide 8)

wall.zh: 为什么同一张照片可能对应不同的三维场景？
wall.en: Why can the same photo correspond to different 3D scenes?

misconception.zh: 以为只要图像足够清晰就能唯一还原三维场景；不同三维场景可能产生相似的二维图像。
misconception.en: Thinking that as long as the image is clear enough, the 3D scene can be recovered uniquely; different 3D scenes can produce similar 2D images.

term.en: angle of view and focal length

about.zh: 在数字图像中焦距常用像素表示：它只是把物理焦距除以像素尺寸，换成图像坐标单位。例如图像宽 2000 像素、主点在中间、焦距 1000 像素时，左右各约 45°，总视野范围约 90°。
about.en: In digital images the focal length is often expressed in pixels: this divides the physical focal length by the pixel size, converting it into image-coordinate units. For example, if the image is 2000 pixels wide, the principal point is in the middle and the focal length is 1000 pixels, each side spans about 45°, giving a total field of view of about 90°.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §2 焦距与视野范围 (slide 15)

wall.zh: 怎样把主体拍大而不裁掉它，并排除不同距离的干扰物？
wall.en: How can a subject be made large without cropping it while excluding a distracting object at a different depth?

misconception.zh: 把以像素为单位的焦距和以毫米为单位的焦距直接比较或混用。
misconception.en: Directly comparing or mixing up a focal length in pixels with a focal length in millimetres.

term.zh: 图像张量：形状、通道顺序与数据类型
term.en: Image tensor layout, channel order and dtype

about.zh: 灰度图像可以看成二维数组；颜色图像通常有三个通道，表示成 height × width × channels 的三维张量。RGB 三通道是相机和人类视觉的工程表示（人眼有三类主要视锥细胞），并非自然界只有三种颜色。使用图像前先检查三件事：形状是 H×W×C 还是 C×H×W，通道顺序是 RGB 还是 BGR，数值范围和数据类型是什么；不同程序库的约定可能不同。
about.en: A greyscale image can be seen as a 2D array; a colour image usually has three channels and is represented as a 3D tensor of height × width × channels. The three RGB channels are an engineering representation for cameras and human vision (the human eye has three main types of cone cell), not because nature has only three colours. Before using an image, check three things: whether the shape is H×W×C or C×H×W, whether the channel order is RGB or BGR, and what the value range and data type are; different libraries may use different conventions.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 数字图像是怎样存储的 (slides 22, 25)

wall.zh: 拿到一个形状为 (3, 480, 640) 的数组，它可能是哪种布局？使用前还要检查哪两件事？
wall.en: Given an array of shape (3, 480, 640), what layout might it be? What two other things must you check before using it?

misconception.zh: 以为所有库都按 RGB、H×W×C 存储图像。
misconception.en: Thinking every library stores images as RGB, H×W×C.

about.zh: Crop 从原数组取一个子区域，已有像素数值不变；Resize 改变数组尺寸，必须为新位置计算像素数值。直接把 768×512 压成 512×512 会改变宽高比，物体可能变胖或变瘦；若保持比例，目标尺寸应接近 512×341。
about.en: Cropping takes a sub-region of the original array, and the existing pixel values are unchanged; resizing changes the size of the array, so pixel values must be computed for the new positions. Squashing 768×512 straight to 512×512 changes the aspect ratio, so objects may become fatter or thinner; if the proportions are kept, the target size should be about 512×341.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 裁剪与缩放不是一回事 (slide 34)

wall.zh: 把 768×512 图像缩到 512 并保持比例，另一边应是多少？裁剪和缩放哪个需要计算新像素值？
wall.en: If a 768×512 image is resized to 512 while keeping its proportions, what should the other side be? Which of cropping and resizing requires new pixel values to be computed?

misconception.zh: 以为裁剪也要插值，或以为缩放只是“截掉一部分”。
misconception.en: Thinking cropping also requires interpolation, or that resizing is just ‘cutting off a part’.

about.zh: 最近邻插值对每个新像素，找到原图中最近的像素，直接复制它的值。优点是快、边缘硬；缺点是放大或缩小时容易出现明显的方块感或锯齿。
about.en: For each new pixel, nearest-neighbour interpolation finds the nearest pixel in the original image and copies its value directly. Its advantages are speed and hard edges; its drawback is that enlarging or shrinking easily produces obvious blockiness or jagged edges.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 最近邻插值 (slide 35)

wall.zh: 用最近邻把图像放大 4 倍，为什么会出现方块感？
wall.en: Why does enlarging an image 4 times with nearest neighbour make it look blocky?

misconception.zh: 以为最近邻会产生原图中没有的新数值；它只复制已有值。
misconception.en: Thinking nearest neighbour produces new values not present in the original image; it only copies existing values.

about.zh: 新位置落在四个旧像素之间时，设横向距离为 H、纵向距离为 V，四个权重是 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV；它们加起来等于 1，所以双线性插值本质上是四个邻居的加权平均。它通常比最近邻平滑，但会让非常锐利的边缘稍微软化，老师说它把模糊并入了采样步骤；缩图时仍要根据采样比例检查是否需要额外抗混叠。
about.en: When a new position falls between four old pixels, let the horizontal distance be H and the vertical distance be V; the four weights are (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V and HV. They sum to 1, so bilinear interpolation is essentially a weighted average of the four neighbours. It is usually smoother than nearest neighbour, but slightly softens very sharp edges; the lecturer says it folds blurring into the sampling step. When downsizing, you should still check, based on the sampling ratio, whether extra anti-aliasing is needed.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 双线性插值 (slide 36)

wall.zh: 新像素落在四个旧像素之间时，双线性插值怎样得到它的值？四个权重为什么加起来等于 1？
wall.en: When a new pixel falls between four old pixels, how does bilinear interpolation obtain its value? Why do the four weights sum to 1?

misconception.zh: 把权重配反（让离得远的像素权重更大）；或以为双线性插值不会改变锐利边缘。
misconception.en: Assigning the weights the wrong way round (giving more distant pixels larger weights); or thinking bilinear interpolation does not alter sharp edges.

term.zh: 线性滤波公式（滑动加权和）
term.en: Linear filtering / convolution formula (sliding weighted sum)

about.zh: 把卷积核放在图像的一个位置，对齐后逐项相乘再相加，写作 g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v)，其中 f 是输入、h 是核权重、g 是输出、(u,v) 是邻域内偏移。式中的 i−u、j−v 表示卷积；按窗口直接对齐相乘的互相关则读作 i+u、j+v。中心权重为 1、其余为 0 时两者都只是复制当前像素。
about.en: Place the kernel at one position in the image, align it, multiply element by element and then add up, written as g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v), where f is the input, h the kernel weights, g the output and (u,v) the offset within the neighbourhood. The i−u, j−v in the formula denote convolution; cross-correlation, which multiplies directly with the window aligned, reads i+u, j+v instead. When the centre weight is 1 and all others are 0, both copy the current pixel.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §1 线性滤波到底在算什么 (slide 9)

wall.zh: g(i,j)=Σh(u,v)f(i−u,j−v) 中的负号意味着核被怎样使用？
wall.en: What does the minus sign in g(i,j)=Σh(u,v)f(i−u,j−v) imply about how the kernel is used?

misconception.zh: 以为公式里的 i−u 与窗口直接对齐相乘是同一件事。
misconception.en: Thinking the i−u in the formula is the same thing as multiplying directly with the window aligned.

term.en: Padding / border handling (constant, wrap, clamp, reflect)

about.zh: 在图像外补像素可使输出与输入同尺寸。Constant/zero 补固定值，简单但可能制造黑边；Wrap 把左接右、上接下，适合 tileable 纹理而不适合普通照片；Clamp/replicate 把边缘像素向外延伸，普通照片通常较自然；Reflect 镜像延伸，常能减少人工边界。没有一种规则永远最好，要看图像是否周期性、任务是否关心边缘及滤波器性质。
about.en: Padding pixels outside the image lets the output be the same size as the input. Constant/zero fills with a fixed value, which is simple but may create black borders; Wrap joins left to right and top to bottom, which suits tileable textures but not ordinary photos; Clamp/replicate extends the edge pixels outwards, which usually looks more natural for ordinary photos; Reflect extends by mirroring and often reduces artificial borders. No rule is always best; it depends on whether the image is periodic, whether the task cares about the edges and the properties of the filter.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §4 四种常见边界规则 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45)

wall.zh: 普通照片做模糊时，zero 补边可能产生什么伪影？
wall.en: When blurring an ordinary photo, what artefact might zero padding produce?

misconception.zh: 以为补零总是最好的默认选择。
misconception.en: Thinking zero padding is always the best default choice.

term.zh: 卷积与互相关（是否翻转卷积核）

about.zh: 两者都做“滑动、相乘、相加”，唯一关键区别是卷积先把核旋转 180° 再使用，互相关直接使用。核关于中心对称时两者结果相同；核不对称时方向会改变。手算前要先确定是否翻核。
about.en: Both do ‘slide, multiply, add’; the only key difference is that convolution first rotates the kernel by 180° before using it, whereas cross-correlation uses it directly. When the kernel is symmetric about its centre the two give the same result; when it is not, the direction changes. Before calculating by hand, first decide whether to flip the kernel.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §1 互相关和卷积 (slide 17)

wall.zh: 同一个非对称核，卷积与互相关为什么会给出不同结果？
wall.en: Why do convolution and cross-correlation give different results for the same asymmetric kernel?

misconception.zh: 以为翻转只是左右翻，或以为任何核卷积与互相关结果都不同。
misconception.en: Thinking the flip is only a left–right flip, or thinking convolution and cross-correlation give different results for every kernel.

about.zh: 若二维核可写成一个列向量与一个行向量的外积，就叫可分离，此时可先对每一行做一维滤波，再对每一列做一维滤波。k×k 核每像素约需 k² 次乘法，拆开后约需 2k 次，k 大时差别明显。高斯核常常接近或可以构造成可分离核。
about.en: If a 2D kernel can be written as the outer product of a column vector and a row vector, it is called separable; you can then first apply a 1D filter to each row and then a 1D filter to each column. A k×k kernel needs about k² multiplications per pixel; split up, it needs about 2k, and the difference is significant when k is large. Gaussian kernels are often close to separable or can be constructed to be separable.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §3 可分离滤波：把二维计算拆成两次一维计算 (slides 39, 40)

wall.zh: 为什么可分离的二维核能用两次一维计算完成？
wall.en: Why can a separable 2D kernel be computed with two 1D passes?

misconception.zh: 以为任何二维核都能拆成两个一维核。
misconception.en: Thinking any 2D kernel can be split into two 1D kernels.

term.zh: 均值滤波与高斯滤波（模糊）

about.zh: 均值滤波给邻域每个像素相同权重；高斯滤波离中心越近权重越大，形式为 G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²))。σ 控制影响范围，σ 越大模糊越强。模糊核通常归一化使权重和为 1，以免改变整体平均亮度；两种核都减少细节，但权重分配不同，保留的细节也不同。
about.en: A mean filter gives every pixel in the neighbourhood the same weight; a Gaussian filter gives larger weights the closer a pixel is to the centre, in the form G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²)). σ controls the extent of the influence: the larger σ, the stronger the blur. Blur kernels are usually normalised so that the weights sum to 1, so as not to change the overall average brightness; both kernels reduce detail, but they distribute the weights differently, so they preserve different detail.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 模糊：让变化变慢 (slides 27, 28)

wall.zh: 为什么模糊核的权重和要为 1？σ 增大会怎样？
wall.en: Why should the weights of a blur kernel sum to 1? What happens as σ increases?

misconception.zh: 以为高斯模糊和均值模糊效果完全一样，或忘记归一化。
misconception.en: Thinking Gaussian blur and mean blur have exactly the same effect, or forgetting to normalise.

about.zh: Sobel 核近似计算横向和纵向两个方向的导数：S_x=[[1,0,−1],[2,0,−2],[1,0,−1]]，S_y=[[1,2,1],[0,0,0],[−1,−2,−1]]。平坦区域左右或上下差异小，响应接近 0；边缘附近差异大，响应较大。两张图分别找沿相应方向变化快的位置。
about.en: The Sobel kernels approximate the derivatives in the horizontal and vertical directions: S_x=[[1,0,−1],[2,0,−2],[1,0,−1]], S_y=[[1,2,1],[0,0,0],[−1,−2,−1]]. In flat regions the left–right or up–down differences are small and the response is close to 0; near edges the differences are large and the response is larger. The two output images each find where the change along the corresponding direction is fast.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 Sobel：找变化快的地方 (slides 29, 30)

wall.zh: S_x 在平坦区域与竖直边缘处响应分别是多少？
wall.en: What is the response of S_x in a flat region and at a vertical edge, respectively?

misconception.zh: 以为 S_x 找的是水平方向的边缘线（实际找沿 x 方向变化快处）。
misconception.en: Thinking S_x finds horizontal edge lines (it actually finds where the change along the x direction is fast).

about.zh: 二维图像 f(x,y) 的梯度是 ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ。幅度 ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) 表示变化有多强，方向 θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) 表示变化最快的方向。
about.en: The gradient of a 2D image f(x,y) is ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ. The magnitude ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) indicates how strong the change is, and the direction θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) indicates the direction of fastest change.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/05-image-formation-ii.md §3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 40)

wall.zh: 给定 ∂f/∂x=3、∂f/∂y=4，梯度幅度是多少？
wall.en: Given ∂f/∂x=3 and ∂f/∂y=4, what is the gradient magnitude?

misconception.zh: 把梯度方向当成边缘的走向。
misconception.en: Taking the gradient direction to be the direction in which the edge runs.

term.zh: 彩色图像滤波（多通道卷积核）

about.zh: RGB 图像除空间维度外还有通道维度，颜色滤波器尺寸可以是 K_h×K_w×3。它同时看同一邻域的 R、G、B，把所有乘积加在一起得到一个输出数值。常见错误是把 height×width×channel 当成普通二维图像，忘记核还要覆盖通道维度。
about.en: Besides its spatial dimensions, an RGB image also has a channel dimension, so a colour filter can have size K_h×K_w×3. It looks at R, G and B in the same neighbourhood at once and sums all the products to give a single output value. A common mistake is to treat height×width×channel as an ordinary 2D image and forget that the kernel must also cover the channel dimension.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 彩色图像的滤波核多了一个维度 (slide 31)

wall.zh: 一个 3×3×3 核作用于 RGB 图像一个位置，输出几个数？
wall.en: When a 3×3×3 kernel is applied to an RGB image at one position, how many numbers does it output?

misconception.zh: 以为彩色滤波得到三个输出值或只对一个通道操作。
misconception.en: Thinking colour filtering produces three output values, or operates on only one channel.

term.zh: 像素换算成传感器毫米再求焦距
term.en: Converting pixels to sensor millimetres to find focal length

about.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图像中高 100 像素，所以它在传感器上高 h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm。物体实际高 h_o = 120 mm、距离 z = 600 mm，由相似三角形 h_i/f = h_o/z 得 f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm。重点是先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，不能直接把像素和毫米放进同一个比例式。
about.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels, and the object is 100 pixels high in the image, so its height on the sensor is h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm. The object's real height is h_o = 120 mm and its distance is z = 600 mm, so by similar triangles h_i/f = h_o/z, giving f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm. The key point is to convert pixels into millimetres on the sensor first; you cannot put pixels and millimetres directly into the same proportion.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · 用传感器尺寸求焦距

wall.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图中占 100 像素，实高 120 mm、距离 600 mm，焦距是多少毫米？
wall.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels; an object occupies 100 pixels in the image, is 120 mm tall in reality and is 600 mm away. What is the focal length in millimetres?

misconception.zh: 直接把 100 像素当作 h_i 代入，得到单位混乱的 f = 100×600/120 = 500。
misconception.en: Substituting the 100 pixels directly as h_i, giving f = 100×600/120 = 500 with muddled units.

term.zh: OpenCV 尺寸 (width, height) 与 NumPy 形状 (height, width, channels)
term.en: OpenCV (width, height) vs NumPy (height, width, channels)

about.zh: OpenCV 的大小 tuple 是 (width, height)，NumPy 形状却通常写成 (height, width, channels)。所以不能把 NumPy 的形状原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸，否则宽和高会对调。
about.en: An OpenCV size tuple is (width, height), whereas a NumPy shape is usually written (height, width, channels). So you cannot use a NumPy shape as-is as an OpenCV resize size, or the width and height will be swapped.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝

wall.zh: 为什么 NumPy 的形状不能原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸？
wall.en: Why can a NumPy shape not be used as-is as an OpenCV resize size?

misconception.zh: 把 image.shape[:2] 直接传给 OpenCV 的缩放函数。
misconception.en: Passing image.shape[:2] straight to OpenCV's resize function.

term.zh: OpenCV 的 BGR 与 Matplotlib 的 RGB

about.zh: cv2.imread 默认读入 BGR，但 matplotlib.pyplot.imshow 按 RGB 显示，所以显示前要用 cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) 转换。这只改变通道顺序，不改变图像内容或空间尺寸。
about.en: cv2.imread reads images as BGR by default, but matplotlib.pyplot.imshow displays them as RGB, so convert with cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) before displaying. This changes only the channel order, not the image content or spatial size.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV 和 Matplotlib 的颜色顺序

wall.zh: 用 cv2.imread 读图后直接 plt.imshow，红色物体会显示成什么颜色？为什么？
wall.en: If you read an image with cv2.imread and pass it straight to plt.imshow, what colour will a red object appear? Why?

misconception.zh: 显示时红蓝颠倒，却以为图片本身坏了；或以为转换会改变图像尺寸。
misconception.en: Seeing red and blue swapped on display and thinking the image itself is broken; or thinking the conversion changes the image size.

about.zh: 把投影偏移转换成像素并平移原点。
about.en: Convert projected offset into pixels and translate its origin.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 and §2 (slides 11, 15, 18)

wall.zh: 为什么负投影偏移仍可以对应正的列坐标？
wall.en: Why can a negative projected offset have a positive column coordinate?

misconception.zh: 将像素偏移直接当作图像列坐标。
misconception.en: Treating signed pixel offset as an image column.

about.zh: 逐个值相乘
about.en: Multiply value by value

why.zh: 投影要乘焦距，乘法接不出来
why.en: Projection multiplies by the focal length

about.zh: 逐个值相除
about.en: Divide value by value

why.zh: 投影要除以距离
why.en: Projection divides by the distance

about.zh: 逐个值相加
about.en: Add value by value

why.zh: 基本算术
why.en: Basic arithmetic

about.zh: 固定的数
about.en: A fixed number

why.zh: 其余元件造不出一个固定的数
why.en: No other part makes a fixed number

about.zh: 逐个值相减
about.en: Subtract value by value

why.zh: 差值是滤波和坐标里最常见的运算
why.en: Differences are the commonest operation in filters and coordinates

about.zh: 按坐标取像素
about.en: Read a pixel at coordinates

why.zh: 其余元件都在原位置上算，取不到别处的值
why.en: Every other part computes in place

about.zh: 给定宽高的两张坐标图
about.en: The two coordinate images of a size

why.zh: 没有元件能从两个数造出一整张图
why.en: No part makes a whole image from two numbers

about.zh: 向下取整
about.en: Round down

why.zh: 算术只给出连续的数，取像素要整数
why.en: Arithmetic gives continuous numbers; lookup needs whole ones

about.zh: 图的宽和高
about.en: An image's width and height

why.zh: 电路只拿到图时读不出它的尺寸
why.en: A circuit given only the image cannot read its size

about.zh: 平方根
about.en: Square root

why.zh: 梯度的大小要开平方，算术接不出来
why.en: The gradient's size needs a square root

about.zh: 取出彩色像素第 c 个位置的灰度图
about.en: The grey image of position c of each colour pixel

why.zh: 逐个值的算术拆不开一个像素的三个数
why.en: Value-by-value arithmetic cannot take a pixel's three numbers apart

about.zh: 三张灰度图合成彩色图
about.en: Three grey images made one colour image

why.zh: 没有元件能从灰度图造出彩色图
why.en: No other part makes a colour image from grey ones

about.zh: 投影：X、Z、f → u
about.en: Projection: X, Z, f → u

about.zh: 裁剪：从 (x0, y0) 起取 w × h
about.en: Crop: w × h from (x0, y0)

about.zh: 行滤波器：左中右三个权重的滑动加权和
about.en: Row filter: a sliding weighted sum of left, centre, right

about.zh: 列滤波器：上中下三个权重的滑动加权和
about.en: Column filter: a sliding weighted sum of above, centre, below

about.zh: 二维卷积：按书写核先横后竖，图外补零
about.en: 2D convolution: written kernels across then down, zero padding

about.zh: 高斯模糊
about.en: Gaussian blur

about.zh: Sobel：gx、gy
about.en: Sobel: gx, gy

about.zh: 用 Sobel 响应计算边缘强度
about.en: Compute edge strength from Sobel responses

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

why.zh: 从一台理想的针孔相机起步。
why.en: Starting from an ideal pinhole camera.

task.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
task.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

question.zh: 同一盏灯，为什么换了距离或相机设置，照片中的位置就变了？展开测试中的拍摄场景，比较只改变 X、Z 或 f 的案例，再搭出适用于所有案例的投影电路。O 是<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>；测量屏采用正像的<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>，所有长度共用模型单位。
question.en: Why does the same light appear at a different position when its distance or the camera setting changes? Inspect the camera scenes in the tests, compare cases that change only X, Z or f, then build a projection circuit that works across them. O is the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>; the measurement screen uses an upright <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>, with one length unit throughout.

chain.zh: 比较独立改变位置、深度和像平面距离的拍摄案例。
chain.en: Compare camera cases with independently varied position, depth and plane distance.

chain.zh: 用两个运算部件搭出覆盖所有案例的投影。
chain.en: Build projection across all cases with two arithmetic parts.

naive.zh: 把点放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：光线穿过小孔后，横向位置按 f/Z = 2/4 缩小了一半。
naive.en: With the point at X = 1 the image lands at u = 0.5 only: through the hole, the sideways position shrinks by f/Z = 2/4, to half.

task.zh: 输入像点位置 u、像平面距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
task.en: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X.

question.zh: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>能从场景得到图像，但反过来是否唯一？保留 H=1、Z=4、f=2 的参照，让一支至少高一倍的箭拍出相同的像。之后只在额外给定 Z 的条件下倒推位置。
question.en: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> maps a scene to an image. Is the reverse unique? Keep the H=1, Z=4, f=2 reference and construct an arrow at least twice as tall with the same image. Then invert a point position only when Z is supplied.

chain.zh: 另造一个场景：调 H 和 Z：像高仍为 0.5，但 H 至少为 2。所有长度共用模型单位；对照参照图再检查。
chain.en: Another scene: Adjust H and Z: keep image height 0.5 with H at least 2. All lengths share model units. Compare with the reference, then check.

chain.zh: 倒推：输入像点位置 u、像平面距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
chain.en: Work back: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X.

naive.zh: 只把箭加高：距离不变，像也跟着加倍成 1。要让像不变，距离得和物高一起加倍。
naive.en: Only making the arrow taller: at the same distance its image doubles to 1. For the same image the distance must double with the height.

task.zh: 输入一张灰度图和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
task.en: Given a grey image and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

question.zh: 图像里的亮暗变化藏在不同位置的数值之间。按照<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>在<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>中读取两个样本，先搭出比较器，再让它自动寻找右邻。样例都是<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>；正负差值也必须保留。
question.en: Changes in an image lie between values at different positions. Read two samples in the <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> using the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>, build a comparator, then make it find the right neighbour automatically. Samples are <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> values; retain the sign of each difference.

chain.zh: 比较任意两点的像素值，处理坐标顺序与差值正负。
chain.en: Compare arbitrary image samples, handling coordinate order and signed differences.

chain.zh: 在同一比较器上增加自动右邻寻址。
chain.en: Extend comparison with automatic right-neighbour addressing.

naive.zh: 这是先写行、再写列（矩阵的习惯）：图像坐标先写 x（列），再写 y（行），高亮的格子在第 1 行第 2 列，是 (2, 1)。
naive.en: That gives the row first, the matrix way: image coordinates give x, the column, first and y, the row, second; the highlighted cell is in row 1, column 2, so (2, 1).

task.zh: 输入 X、Z、像素焦距 f_px 和主点 c_x：交出像点的像素横坐标 u。
task.en: Given X, Z, the focal length in pixels f_px and the principal point c_x, give the image's pixel column u.

question.zh: 相机几何与读图路线在这里汇合。投影先给出相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的带符号偏移；图像中的列坐标却从另一处起算。题目直接提供已按<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>换过单位的<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px，接着用<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x 表示光轴在图中的位置，组成能处理不同相机的坐标电路。
question.en: The geometry and image-reading routes meet here. Projection gives a signed offset from the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, while image columns use a different origin. The supplied <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px already incorporates the <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref> conversion. Use the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x to account for where the axis meets the image, building a coordinate circuit for different cameras.

chain.zh: 以像素焦距计算带符号偏移，再按给定主点平移。
chain.en: Use focal length in pixels for the signed offset, then translate by the supplied principal point.

chain.zh: 用零位置、负位置和不同主点检验组合后的相机。
chain.en: Check the composed camera at zero and negative positions with different principal points.

naive.zh: 以为焦距等于传感器高度时视场是 90°：那时半高 12 mm 只有焦距的一半，视场约 53°，杆顶出了画面。焦距要等于半高 12 mm。
naive.en: Taking a focal length equal to the sensor's height for 90°: then the half-height, 12 mm, is half the focal length, the view about 53° and the pole's top out of frame. The focal length must equal the half-height, 12 mm.

task.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
task.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

question.zh: 现在只保留画面的一部分，用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>完成。先把选中的区域搬进小图，再追踪新图的每一格来自原图哪里；新图左上角不再对应原图左上角。
question.en: Keep only part of the image using <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>. Move the selected region into a smaller image, then track where each new cell comes from. The two top-left corners no longer coincide.

chain.zh: 手裁：从 (1, 1) 起裁出 2 × 2 的一块（宽 2、高 2）。
chain.en: By hand: Crop the 2 × 2 region (width 2, height 2) starting at (1, 1).

chain.zh: 裁剪电路：输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
chain.en: Crop circuit: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

naive.zh: 这是从 (0, 0) 起裁的：新图的 (0, 0) 要取原图的 (1, 1)，每个坐标都加上左上角的偏移。
naive.en: That crops from (0, 0): the new (0, 0) must read the original (1, 1); every coordinate adds the corner's offset.

task.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
task.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

question.zh: 改过输出尺寸后，题目直接给出原图中的采样位置。用<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>完成这次读取，比较 0.4 和 0.5 附近的结果。本题约定距离相同时取坐标较大的一边，图外取最近边界。
question.en: After changing output size, the task supplies sample positions in the original. Use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> and compare positions around 0.4 and 0.5. Ties take the larger coordinate and positions outside use the nearest boundary.

chain.zh: 手算：这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的像素的值。
chain.en: By hand: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the pixel nearest each position.

chain.zh: 接成电路：输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
chain.en: Wire it: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

naive.zh: 这是一律向下取整：1.6 离 2 比离 1 近，却取了 1 的值；0.5 离两边一样近，按约定取 1。最近的整数是加 0.5 再向下取整。
naive.en: That rounds every position down: 1.6 is nearer 2 than 1 but read 1; 0.5 is equally near both and by the convention reads 1. The nearest whole number is add 0.5, then round down.

task.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
task.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance.

question.zh: 保持与最近邻相同的采样位置，改用<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>。先看一行上靠左、靠右两点怎样变化，再把这个做法用于四个角；图外仍取最近边界。
question.en: Keep the same sample positions but use <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>. First compare points near either end of a row, then extend that reasoning to four corners. Outside positions still use the nearest boundary.

chain.zh: 一行：[0, 4] 在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25 处取值：按到左右两个像素的距离加权，写出每个值。
chain.en: A row: Read [0, 4] at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25, weighting the pixels either side by distance: write each value.

chain.zh: 四个邻居：这张 2 × 2 的图在 x、y 都取 −1/6、0.5、7/6 的 9 个位置取值：写出 3 × 3 的结果。
chain.en: Four neighbours: Read this 2 × 2 image at the nine positions where x and y are each −1/6, 0.5 or 7/6: write the 3 × 3 result.

chain.zh: 接成电路：输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
chain.en: Wire it: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance.

naive.zh: 这是照抄最近的像素：0.25 和 0.75 位置不同，拿到的却是两端的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
naive.en: That copies the nearest pixel: 0.25 and 0.75 sit apart yet read the ends. Weighted by distance, 0.25 reads 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

task.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出焦距 f（毫米）。
task.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the focal length f in millimetres.

question.zh: Workshop 2 的一道题：知道物体多高、多远，从照片里量出它占多少像素，反推镜头的焦距。照片里量的是像素，相似三角形要的是传感器上的毫米。
question.en: A Workshop 2 exercise: knowing how tall and how far an object is, measure how many pixels it covers in the photo and work back to the lens's focal length. The photo gives pixels; similar triangles want millimetres on the sensor.
