value.en: The offset d is no longer supplied. Instead you receive point position X, depth Z and f_px. X and Z still share a length unit. With <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px, <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> returns a signed pixel offset. Use the origin distinction you just established to express it as an image column.

why: State the prerequisite weighted-sum operation before the first filter task, without giving its circuit.

value.zh: 图示用一行独立样例演示<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>：窗口每次收进左邻、中心、右邻三个读数。<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>给这三个位置各配一个权重。每个读数乘以对应的权重，三项乘积相加得到一个输出。观察窗口移动时哪些数变、哪些数不变；<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的每个输出对应一个窗口。本任务只取三个邻居都在图内的位置。
value.en: This independent row illustrates <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>: each window collects a left, centre and right reading. The <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> assigns a weight to each position. Multiply each reading by its positional weight and add the three products for one output. Move the window and observe what changes and what stays fixed; each <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> output corresponds to one window. This task uses only windows wholly inside the image.

value.zh: 图示用一行独立样例演示<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>：窗口每次收进左邻、中心、右邻三个读数。<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>给这三个位置各配一个权重。观察窗口移动时哪些数变、哪些数不变；<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的每个输出对应一个窗口。本任务只取三个邻居都在图内的位置。
value.en: This independent row illustrates <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>: each window collects a left, centre and right reading. The <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> assigns a weight to each position. Move the window and observe what changes and what stays fixed; each <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> output corresponds to one window. This task uses only windows wholly inside the image.

why: Keep the lab promise accurate and distinguish array locations from intensity readings in natural bilingual copy.

value.zh: 欢迎来到视觉实验室。你要为一座灯塔搭建成像与图像处理系统：先让相机把场景变成照片，再让机器读取、重采样和处理照片。这里没有现成的整机；你亲手做出的关键模块会封装成工具，用来组装更完整的机器。
value.en: Welcome to Vision Lab. Build a camera and image processor for a lighthouse: turn the scene into a photograph, then teach the machine to read, resample and process it. Key modules you build become reusable tools for assembling the larger machine.

value.zh: 相机已经能确定光落在哪里；接下来，处理器需要读出照片中的明暗。照片在电路里以<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>传递，而非一个数。本阶段只处理<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>。先按<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>找到某格，再读出其中的数值；位置和读数是不同的信息。
value.en: The camera can locate incoming light. The processor now needs the photograph’s intensity values. A photograph travels through the circuit as an <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>, rather than one number. This stage uses a <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>. Locate a cell using the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>, then read the value it contains. A position and a reading are different information.

value.zh: 相机已经能确定光落在哪里；接下来，处理器需要读出照片中的明暗。照片在电路里以<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>传递，而非一个数。先按<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>找到某格，再读取它的<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>数值；位置和读数是不同的信息。
value.en: The camera can locate incoming light. The processor now needs the photograph’s intensity values. A photograph travels through the circuit as an <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>, rather than one number. Locate a cell using the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>, then read its <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> value. A position and a reading are different information.

value.zh: 欢迎来到视觉实验室。你要为一座灯塔搭建成像与图像处理系统：先让相机把场景变成照片，再让机器读取、重采样和处理照片。这里没有现成的整机；每次通过测试的电路，都会成为你能继续使用的工具。
value.en: Welcome to Vision Lab. Build a camera and image processor for a lighthouse: turn the scene into a photograph, then teach the machine to read, resample and process it. Each circuit you make and test becomes a tool you can reuse.

why: Represent sample positions A and B as two-output coordinate inputs instead of four separate scalar inputs.

brief.zh: 输入一张图与 A、B 两点的坐标：输出 B 的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>值减去 A 的值。坐标先写列 x，再写行 y；编号从 0 开始。
brief.en: Given an image and coordinates for A and B, output the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> value at B minus the value at A. Coordinates give column x before row y, indexed from 0.

hint.zh: 分别检查两个取值是否来自正确的位置，再检查差值的正负。行与列写反可能仍得到一个数，但不能通过所有图像的测试。
hint.en: Check the two addressed values before checking the sign of their difference. Swapping row and column can still produce a number, but fails across the images.

value.zh: A、B 各是一个输入元件，x、y 输出口分别给出列与行，数值随测试变化。测试给出这两个位置，但明暗变化要比较它们的读数。<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>有图、x、y 三个输入口；输出的是所选格的值。先分别观察读数，再判断从 A 走到 B 是变亮、变暗还是不变。<part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref>保留差值的正负。
value.en: A and B are each one input part: their x and y outputs give column and row, changing with the test. Tests supply these positions, but intensity change compares their readings. <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> takes an image, x and y; its output is the selected value. Inspect both readings, then decide whether going from A to B is brighter, darker or unchanged. <part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref> preserves the sign of a difference.

step.why: Represent sample positions A and B as two-output coordinate inputs instead of four separate scalar inputs.

value.zh: 测试给出 A、B 的位置，但明暗变化要比较它们的读数。<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>有图、x、y 三个输入口；输出的是所选格的值。先分别观察读数，再判断从 A 走到 B 是变亮、变暗还是不变。<part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref>保留差值的正负。
value.en: Tests give positions A and B, but intensity change compares their readings. <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> takes an image, x and y; its output is the selected value. Inspect both readings, then decide whether going from A to B is brighter, darker or unchanged. <part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref> preserves the sign of a difference.

brief.zh: 输入一张图与 A、B 两点的坐标：输出 B 的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>值减去 A 的值。坐标先写列 x，再写行 y；编号从 0 开始。
brief.en: Given an image and coordinates for A and B, output the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> value at B minus the value at A. Coordinates give column x before row y, indexed from 0.

hint.zh: 分别检查两个取值是否来自正确的位置，再检查差值的正负。行与列写反可能仍得到一个数，但不能通过所有图像的测试。
hint.en: Check the two addressed values before checking the sign of their difference. Swapping row and column can still produce a number, but fails across the images.

why: Keep the two coordinate inputs adjacent so A and B share a phone row.

step.why: Keep the two coordinate inputs adjacent so A and B share a phone row.

why: Keep component descriptions plain text, with terminology written directly instead of embedded reference chips.

ops.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和虚像平面距离 f，输出像点位置 u。
ops.en: Given a point's sideways position X, depth Z and virtual image plane distance f, outputs the image position u.

ops.zh: 输入图像与按书写顺序给出的行核、列核，先横后竖计算二维卷积；图外补零。
ops.en: Given an image and row and column kernels in written order, computes 2D convolution across rows then columns, with zero padding.

ops.zh: 输入图像，输出每个位置的 Sobel 梯度幅度；图外补零。
ops.en: Given an image, outputs the Sobel gradient magnitude at each position, with zero padding.

value.zh: 输入一张图，使用已搭好的 <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> 部件输出每个位置的梯度幅度；图外补零。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
value.en: Given an image, uses the built <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> part to output gradient magnitude at each position, with zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 输入图像与按书写顺序给出的行、列<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>，输出先横后竖的二维<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>，按<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>约定在图外取零。
value.en: Given an image and written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pairs for rows and columns, computes 2D <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> across then down, using zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>距离 f，输出像点位置 u
value.en: Takes a point's sideways position X, its distance Z and the plane distance f; gives the image position u (<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>)

why: Scaffold nearest-neighbour assembly with observable sampling boundaries and a single-coordinate circuit before two-axis image sampling.

t.zh: 摄影实验室已经能裁出照片的一块，但放大时还会遇到原图两个像素之间的位置。题目直接给出原图中的取样位置，这次只决定从哪个已有像素读取数值。先移动示例中的取样位置，观察<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>在什么位置换到另一个像素。本关约定：像素中心位于整数坐标，中点取较大的坐标，图外读取最近边界。
t.en: The lab can crop a photograph, but enlargement also requests positions between original pixels. Sample positions in the original are supplied; your job is to decide which existing pixel to read. Move the sample position in the example and observe where <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> switches pixels. Pixel centres have integer coordinates; midpoint ties take the larger coordinate, and outside positions read the nearest boundary.

value.zh: 按距离取值
value.en: Read by distance

value.zh: 这是一律向下取整，分界在整数处；最近位置的分界在相邻整数的中点。比较 0.4、0.5 和 1.6，再检查超出图像范围时读到了哪一格。
value.en: That always rounds down, switching at integers. Nearest selection switches at integer midpoints. Compare 0.4, 0.5 and 1.6, then check which pixel is read outside the image.

t.zh: 按距离选出了像素，还需要让电路算出它的整数坐标。先只处理一个取样位置，不读取图，也不处理图像边界。新元件<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>会在取样位置跨过整数时切换输出；观察它与最近整数坐标的切换位置有什么差别，再用算术元件弥合这个差别。
t.en: After selecting a pixel by distance, a circuit must compute its integer coordinate. Start with one sample position, without reading an image or handling its boundaries. The new <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> switches output when the position crosses an integer. Compare its switching locations with those of the nearest integer, then use arithmetic parts to bridge that difference.

brief.zh: 输入取样位置 x，输出距离它最近的整数坐标；中点取较大的整数。这里不限制图像范围，负坐标也要保留。
brief.en: Given sample position x, output its nearest integer coordinate; a midpoint tie takes the larger integer. There is no image boundary in this task: retain negative coordinates.

hint.zh: 移动示例中的取样位置，比较整数处和相邻整数中点处：两种规则分别在哪里切换？
hint.en: Move the example position across integers and their midpoints. Where does each rule switch?

hint.zh: 只向下取整会总选较小的整数。需要调整的是所有切换位置，而不是只给某个测试的输出加 1；尝试常数和算术元件，并同时检查正、负坐标。
hint.en: Flooring alone always selects the smaller integer. Adjust all switching locations, rather than adding 1 to the output of one test. Try a constant and arithmetic parts, checking both positive and negative coordinates.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>按距离选取整数坐标，分界位于相邻整数的中点；负坐标也遵循同一规则。是否超出图像范围是另一件事，不能在对齐位置时提前丢掉负坐标。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> chooses integer coordinates by distance, with boundaries at integer midpoints. Negative coordinates follow the same rule. Being outside an image is a separate issue; aligning a position must not discard negative coordinates.

value.zh: 两路坐标取样
value.en: Sample with two axes

t.zh: 一个位置已经能对齐到最近整数。现在把相同的处理分别应用到两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>：x 图保存每格要读取的列坐标，y 图保存行坐标。算术元件会逐格处理；两张坐标图必须同样大小，结果也采用这个大小，不要求与原图相同。
t.en: One position can now be aligned to its nearest integer. Apply the same processing independently to the two <wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> inputs: x stores the column to read at each cell, and y stores the row. Arithmetic parts act cell by cell. The coordinate images must share a size, which also becomes the result size; it need not match the source.

t.zh: 对齐后的坐标交给<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>读取原图。如果坐标在图外，本关要求使用最近边界；在这个元件的详情中将“出界”设为“最近的边”。可以先查看两路中间坐标，再查看读取结果，分清错误发生在哪一步。
t.en: Feed the aligned coordinates to <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> to read the source. This task uses the nearest boundary for outside coordinates: in the part details, set Outside to Nearest edge. Inspect both intermediate coordinate results before the sampled output to locate an error.

value.zh: 输入原图和两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> x、y，按<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>读取每格的值：中点取较大坐标，图外取最近边界。
value.en: Given a source and the <wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> inputs x and y, use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> to read each value: midpoint ties take the larger coordinate; outside positions use the nearest boundary.

value.zh: 先只检查 x 路的整数坐标，再检查 y 路；每格应遵循单个位置任务中的同一规则。原图的亮度不参与坐标计算。
value.en: Inspect integer coordinates on the x path first, then y. Each cell follows the same rule as the single-position task. Source intensities do not participate in coordinate calculations.

value.zh: 位置正确但出界测试失败时，检查取像素元件的“出界”设置；本关要求读取最近的边。
value.en: If positions are correct but outside tests fail, inspect the Lookup part's Outside setting. This task reads the nearest edge.

value.zh: 摄影实验室已经能裁出照片的一块，但放大时还会遇到原图两个像素之间的位置。题目直接给出原图中的取样位置，这次只决定从哪个已有像素读取数值。先移动示例中的取样位置，观察<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>在什么位置换到另一个像素。本关约定：像素中心位于整数坐标，中点取较大的坐标，图外读取最近边界。
value.en: The lab can crop a photograph, but enlargement also requests positions between original pixels. Sample positions in the original are supplied; your job is to decide which existing pixel to read. Move the sample position in the example and observe where <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> switches pixels. Pixel centres have integer coordinates; midpoint ties take the larger coordinate, and outside positions read the nearest boundary.

value.zh: 根据距离、中点约定和边界规则读取一行数值。
value.en: Read a row by distance, midpoint convention and boundary rule.

value.zh: 把一个连续取样位置对齐到最近整数，比较中点切换与向下取整的整数切换；检查正负位置。
value.en: Align one continuous sample position to its nearest integer; compare midpoint switches with flooring at integers and check both signs.

value.zh: 把单位置处理逐格应用于 x、y 坐标图，再用最近边界读取原图。
value.en: Apply the single-position mapping cell by cell to x and y coordinate images, then read the source with nearest boundaries.

value.zh: 这是一律向下取整，分界在整数处；最近位置的分界在相邻整数的中点。比较 0.4、0.5 和 1.6，再检查超出图像范围时读到了哪一格。
value.en: That always rounds down, switching at integers. Nearest selection switches at integer midpoints. Compare 0.4, 0.5 and 1.6, then check which pixel is read outside the image.

step.why: Scaffold nearest-neighbour assembly with observable sampling boundaries and a single-coordinate circuit before two-axis image sampling.

value.zh: 这是一律向下取整：1.6 离 2 比离 1 近，却取了 1 的值；0.5 离两边一样近，按约定取 1。最近的整数是加 0.5 再向下取整。
value.en: That rounds every position down: 1.6 is nearer 2 than 1 but read 1; 0.5 is equally near both and by the convention reads 1. The nearest whole number is add 0.5, then round down.

value.zh: 手算：这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的像素的值。
value.en: By hand: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the pixel nearest each position.

value.zh: 接成电路：输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
value.en: Wire it: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

value.zh: 改过输出尺寸后，题目直接给出原图中的采样位置。用<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>完成这次读取，比较 0.4 和 0.5 附近的结果。本题约定距离相同时取坐标较大的一边，图外取最近边界。
value.en: After changing output size, the task supplies sample positions in the original. Use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> and compare positions around 0.4 and 0.5. Ties take the larger coordinate and positions outside use the nearest boundary.

value.zh: 手算时你是怎样从 1.6 得到 2 的？
value.en: By hand, how did you get from 1.6 to 2?

value.zh: 输入一张图和两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> x、y：交出每个位置最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的值。
value.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> nearest each position. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

t.zh: 位置用两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>给出：x 图每格是要取的横坐标，y 图是纵坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>把数向下取整；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取最近的边。
t.en: The positions come as two coordinate images: each cell of x is the column to read, of y the row. New part: <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds down; <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read the nearest edge outside the image. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

value.zh: 接成电路
value.en: Wire it

value.zh: 这是一律向下取整：1.6 离 2 比离 1 近，却取了 1 的值；0.5 离两边一样近，按约定取 1。最近的整数是加 0.5 再向下取整。
value.en: That rounds every position down: 1.6 is nearer 2 than 1 but read 1; 0.5 is equally near both and by the convention reads 1. The nearest whole number is add 0.5, then round down.

value.zh: 手算
value.en: By hand

t.zh: 放大照片时，输出图像需要比原图更多的位置；这些位置不一定落在原有像素中心。题目给出原图中的采样位置，用<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>读取数值，并比较 0.4 和 0.5 附近的结果。本题约定距离相同时取坐标较大的一边，图外取最近边界。
t.en: Enlarging a photograph requires more output positions, which need not fall on original pixel centres. The task supplies sample positions in the original: use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> to read values and compare positions around 0.4 and 0.5. Ties take the larger coordinate; outside positions use the nearest boundary.

why: Show automatic arithmetic and spatial evidence in numeric workbenches, with transferable results instead of hand calculation.

ops.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重，遗漏了竖直方向的贡献：中间一行的列权重为 0，另一行的列权重为 −1，因而会出现零值和符号翻转。
ops.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows and omits the vertical contribution: the middle row has column weight 0 and another row has weight −1, producing zeros and a sign reversal.

value.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重：竖直方向也要乘上列权重，第 1 行整行乘 2。
value.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows: the column weights multiply too, doubling row 1.

why: Read row weights from the displayed source table instead of duplicating them in calculator metadata.
Rebuild trial around computer-vision theory and visual problem solving; supply technical arithmetic and wiring

t.zh: 你负责摄影实验室的相机与图像处理器。先预测场景会落在照片的哪里，再让处理器裁剪、放大和提取变化。每关解决一个视觉问题，计算与重复接线由工具协助。这里先研究：物体位置、距离和焦距分别怎样改变投影？
t.en: You are building a camera and image processor for a photography lab. First locate a scene in its photograph, then crop, enlarge and measure changes. Each level solves a visual problem, with arithmetic and repeated wiring supported. Begin by relating position, depth and focal length to projection.

t.zh: 先接通相机的定位模块。图中的发光标记与<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> O 确定一条<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>。X 量离轴位置，Z 量到相机的距离，f 量 O 到<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>的距离；u 是屏上的位置。正方向一致，所有长度共用单位。只改变一个量的拍摄案例，能帮助你找出它们的关系。
t.en: Begin with the camera’s positioning module. The light marker and <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> O define a <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>. X measures displacement from the axis, Z distance to the camera, f distance from O to the <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>, and u position on that screen. Positive directions agree and lengths share one unit. Compare cases changing one quantity at a time.

t.zh: 可随时查看相似三角形和投影关系：u = f × X / Z。重点是各量的作用和单位，不需要猜算术技巧。比较只改变一个量的测试，再组成适用于全部场景的关系。 <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The projection relation u = f × X / Z is available for reference. Focus on each quantity and its unit. Compare cases changing one quantity at a time, then compose one relationship for every scene. <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>

desc.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和虚像平面距离 f，输出像点位置 u。
desc.en: Given a point's sideways position X, depth Z and virtual image plane distance f, outputs the image position u.

after.zh: 同一条<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>经过 O，使两段距离受<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>约束。<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>把这个比例推广到不同的位置与深度；场景和图像的坐标不能直接当作同一个量。
after.en: A shared <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> through O constrains the distances through <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>. <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> applies that proportion across positions and depths; scene and image coordinates are not interchangeable.

t.zh: 输入元件显示当前测试给定的数，输出元件收取你的结果。从元件栏放入<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>或<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>，从输出口连接到输入口。手机上依次点两个接口；电脑上拖线。点“运行”会检查整块电路，失败时可切换测试、检查数值并改线。需要比例关系时可查看<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Input parts show the current test’s given values; output parts collect your result. Place <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> or <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref> from the tray and connect output ports to input ports. On a phone tap the two ports; on a computer drag a wire. Run checks the circuit. Switch tests and inspect values to debug it. For proportions, consult <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

hint.zh: 先决定 X 在同一深度下怎样缩放，再比较 Z 和 f 各改变哪一段距离。
hint.en: First decide how X is scaled at one depth, then compare which distance changes with Z and f.

hint.zh: 回看<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>的比例关系；需要的是能随三个输入一起变化的关系，而不是固定倍数。
hint.en: Revisit the proportion in <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>; the scale must respond to all three inputs rather than stay fixed.

t.zh: 照片里一样高的物体，现实中一定一样高吗？以 H=1、Z=4、f=2 为参照，另造一个明显更高、照片却相同的场景。这里改变真实场景，不改变相机或显示比例。 <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Must equally tall image objects have equal real heights? Starting from H=1, Z=4, f=2, construct a visibly taller scene with the same photograph. Change the scene while keeping the camera and display scale fixed. <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 两个不同场景得到同样的观测，因此单凭这个像不能在它们之间做选择。这是<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>的困难：假设 Z 后算出的是条件下的位置，不是从图像恢复出的真实深度。这个实验也不能证明颜色或物体总数一定能确定。
after.en: Two different scenes give the same observation, so that image cannot distinguish them. This is the difficulty of the <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>: supplying Z gives a conditional position, not depth recovered from the image. This experiment does not establish unique colour or object count either.

brief.zh: 调 H 和 Z：像高仍为 0.5，但 H 至少为 2。所有长度共用模型单位；对照参照图再检查。
brief.en: Adjust H and Z: keep image height 0.5 with H at least 2. All lengths share model units. Compare with the reference, then check.

hint.zh: 物高加倍、距离不变，像会怎样？距离也加倍呢？
hint.en: Double the height and keep the distance: what does the image do? Double the distance too?

why.zh: 只把灯塔加高：距离不变，像也跟着加倍成 1。要让像不变，距离得和物高一起加倍。
why.en: Only making the lighthouse taller: at the same distance its image doubles to 1. For the same image the distance must double with the height.

t.zh: 照片是按行列排列的读数。这里 x 是列、y 是行，左上角为 (0,0)，每个整数位置指一个像素中心；位置与该格的亮度是不同信息。先看示例，再把已知的投影接到照片的列号。 <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A photograph contains readings arranged in rows and columns. Here x is the column, y the row, the top-left is (0,0), and integer positions mark pixel centres. A location and its intensity are different information. Inspect the example, then relate projection to image columns. <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>

t.zh: <part-ref to="project"></part-ref>能确定像的位置，<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>则从图像原点数列号。要让两者对上，先区分单位，再区分原点。同一段距离可以用毫米量，也可以数跨过几个<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>；本关直接提供换算好的<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px，不需要另算换算系数。
t.en: <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> locates the image, while the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> counts columns from the image origin. Connecting them requires distinguishing units, then origins. One distance can be measured in millimetres or in <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref> steps. This task supplies the converted <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px; no extra conversion factor is needed.

t.zh: 照片中的列从 0 向右增加，光轴却不一定穿过第 0 列。它穿过的列由<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x 给出。图示的两种位置距光轴同样远，却落在不同列。先只处理已给出的带符号偏移 d，弄清它与列号的关系，再把相机计算接进来。
t.en: Image columns increase rightwards from 0, but the axis need not pass through column 0. Its intersection is given by <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x. The two illustrated positions are equally far from the axis but occupy different columns. First handle a supplied signed offset d, then connect the camera calculation.

t.zh: 投影和输出结构已预接，可以自由修改。公式与像素单位换算均可查阅；需要决定的是偏移应当相对哪个原点使用。
t.en: Projection and output plumbing are preconnected and editable. Formulas and pixel conversion are available; decide which origin the displacement is relative to.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>将投影位置与图像坐标联系起来：光路不变，变化的是单位和原点。区分<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>的单位换算与坐标原点的平移，有助于正确表示负偏移。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
after.en: A <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> relates projected positions to image coordinates: the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> is unchanged, while the units and origin differ. Distinguishing the unit conversion for <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> from the shift of origin helps represent negative offsets correctly.

t.zh: 现在不再直接给偏移 d，而是给物点 X、深度 Z 和 f_px。X、Z 使用相同长度单位，两者的比例不带长度单位；f_px 是<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>，因此<part-ref to="project"></part-ref>的输出已是带符号的像素偏移。沿用刚才区分原点的方法，把这个结果表示成图像列号。
t.en: The offset d is no longer supplied. Instead you receive point position X, depth Z and f_px. X and Z share a length unit, so their ratio has no length unit. With <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px, <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> returns a signed pixel offset. Use the origin distinction you just established to express it as an image column.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px 和<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x：交出像点的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>横坐标 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z, the <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px and the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x, give the image's <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> column u.

hint.zh: 检查投影元件给的是相对光轴的偏移，还是从图像原点数的列号。用 X=0 的测试定位参照原点，再检查负 X。
hint.en: Check whether projection gives an axis-relative offset or an image-origin column. Use X=0 to locate the reference origin, then inspect negative X.

t.zh: 从照片中截取一块区域时，截出的画面怎样对应原图？用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>保留选中的区域，追踪新图各位置在原图中的来源；新图的左上角对应所选区域的起点。
t.en: When a region is cut from a photograph, how does the result correspond to the original? Use <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> to retain the selected region and trace each position in the new image back to its source. The new top-left corner corresponds to the start of the selected region.

t.zh: 处理器已生成输出坐标并接好图像读取。你只需建立这些输出位置与原图所选区域的对应关系；循环和逐像素读取不需要实现。裁剪后每格仍应是原来那个像素的值。
t.en: The processor already generates output coordinates and reads the source. Establish their correspondence to the selected source region; loops and per-pixel indexing are supplied. Every cropped value must remain an original sample.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、左上角 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h，输出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块
desc.en: Takes an image, the top-left corner x0, y0, and a width w and height h; gives the w × h region from (x0, y0)

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>保留选定区域的原有数值，只改变区域的位置和坐标范围；它不会像缩放那样重新确定输出的采样位置。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> retains the selected region’s original values while changing its position and coordinate range. Unlike resizing, it does not establish new sampling positions.

t.zh: 一整张新图的每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>都要算出它在原图的坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>：给定宽和高，给出两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>，x 图每格是自己的 x，y 图每格是自己的 y；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>接上坐标图，就一次取出整张图。
t.en: Every <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> of a whole new image needs its coordinates in the original. New part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>: given a width and a height it gives two coordinate images, each cell of x holding its own x and of y its own y; fed coordinate images, <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads a whole image at once. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

brief.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
brief.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

hint.zh: 先给新图每格一对自己的坐标，再挪到原图里去。
hint.en: First give each new cell its own coordinates, then move them into the original.

t.zh: 图像不一定记录亮度，也可能记录每个位置属于哪个区域。放大一张区域图时，编号之间的平均值通常没有类别含义。比较原有读数与距离混合的差别，再为处理器设置采样方式和图外假设。 <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>
t.en: An image can record region membership rather than brightness. An average between two region identifiers generally has no class meaning. Compare copying with distance-based mixing, then configure the sampler and outside assumption. <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>保持原有样本，适合不能混合的离散标签；选择取值规则必须考虑数值代表什么。图外延续边缘是一种假设，并不是对图外内容的新观测。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> preserves original samples, which suits discrete labels that must not mix. Interpolation depends on what the values mean. Extending an edge is an assumption, not a new observation.

brief.zh: 这张图的每个值是一个区域编号。按给定位置生成新的区域图：每格必须来自最近的原有区域；图外延续边缘区域，不能创造编号或混合类别。
brief.en: Each value identifies a region. Build a new region map at the supplied positions: use the closest original region and extend edge regions outside, without inventing labels or mixing classes.

hint.zh: 检查分界附近是否出现原图没有的编号，再检查图外位置。距离、权重和中点取较大坐标的约定都由采样元件处理。
hint.en: Inspect whether a boundary invents labels absent from the source, then inspect outside positions. The sampler supplies distances, weights and midpoint ties toward the larger coordinate.

showcase.zh: 必须根据离散标签的含义配置取值与图外假设；默认采样器在分界或图外测试失败。
showcase.en: Configure interpolation and outside assumptions from discrete-label meaning; the default starter fails boundary or fractional cases.

title.zh: 平滑放大，保留信息边界

t.zh: 照片亮度与区域编号需要不同的处理。双线性会按距离在四个邻居之间过渡；权重和计算自动完成，你决定它应该作用于哪种材料、哪张源图。 <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Intensities and identifiers need different treatment. Bilinear interpolation transitions between four neighbours by distance. Arithmetic is supplied; decide which material and source image it should act on. <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>能减轻阶梯感，但平滑过渡不代表恢复了原图没有记录的细节。处理顺序还决定坐标相对哪张图解释；同一对数字放在不同参照系里会读到不同内容。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref> can reduce stepping, but a smooth transition does not restore unmeasured detail. The processing order also determines which image the coordinates refer to.

brief.zh: 同一组采样位置用于亮度照片和区域编号。照片需要随位置连续过渡，区域图必须保留最近的原有编号。组成两路读图器；图外均延续边缘。
brief.en: Use the same positions for intensities and region identifiers. Intensities should transition continuously, while identifiers must retain the closest original class. Build both reading paths, extending their edges outside.

brief.zh: 先选取指定区域，再在区域内部的 x、y 位置生成平滑放大图。输出原样裁剪的区域与放大图。给出的采样坐标相对于裁剪后的区域，不是原照片。
brief.en: Select the requested region, then produce a smooth enlargement at x,y within that region. Output the unchanged crop and the enlargement. Sampling positions are relative to the crop, not the original photograph.

solution: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)
naive: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)
starter: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)

t.zh: 把已构建的裁剪器用于一个完整处理任务。两张输出可以帮助定位：区域错了，还是在正确区域里取值错了？ <part-ref to="crop"></part-ref>
t.en: Use your crop in a complete processing task. Two outputs distinguish selecting the wrong region from sampling the correct region incorrectly. <part-ref to="crop"></part-ref>

t.zh: 想把远处的灯塔拍大，拉近焦距却可能裁掉塔顶；附近悬挂的灯泡还会闯入画面。用<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>和相机高度共同调整取景：灯塔必须完整、像高至少 16 mm，而灯泡要完全在画面之外。这里研究竖直<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 24 mm，场景使用统一的模型毫米。
t.en: Making the distant lighthouse larger can crop its top, while a nearby hanging bulb intrudes into the photograph. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> and camera height together: keep the entire lighthouse at an image height of at least 16 mm, with the bulb wholly outside the frame. This is a vertical <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> experiment with a 24 mm <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and consistent model millimetres.

after.zh: 放大投影会缩小<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，改变相机高度则平移物体相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的位置。这两个调整相互约束：画面中的主体要足够大，也必须完整；不能把“有一部分被裁掉”当作“完全不在画面里”。<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>描述固定<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>画幅与<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>之间的取舍。
after.en: Enlarging the projection narrows the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>, while changing camera height shifts objects relative to the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>. The controls constrain each other: the subject must be large enough yet complete. Partial cropping is not complete exclusion. <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> describes the trade-off between a fixed <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 完整拍下灯塔，像高至少 16 mm；附近悬挂的灯泡必须完全出画。调<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f 和相机高度，再检查照片。
brief.en: Keep the lighthouse complete, with image height at least 16 mm. Exclude the nearby hanging bulb entirely. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f and camera height, then check the photograph.

hint.zh: 先让灯塔达到要求的大小，再观察是哪一端超出<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>。移动相机高度会同时改变灯塔与灯泡的位置；它们的距离不同，移动幅度也不同。
hint.en: First make the lighthouse large enough, then inspect which end exceeds the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>. Camera height moves both lighthouse and bulb in the image, by different amounts because their depths differ.

why.zh: 只放大而不调整取景中心，会裁掉灯塔顶部。
why.en: Zooming without adjusting the view centre crops the top of the lighthouse.

why.zh: 灯塔完整，但较近的灯泡仍有一部分入画；不能只检查主体。
why.en: The lighthouse fits, but part of the nearer bulb remains visible; checking only the subject is insufficient.

t.zh: 已知物体的实际高度和距离，并测得它在照片中占据的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>数，能否估计镜头的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>？照片给出的是像素数，而<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>关系需要<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的实际长度。
t.en: If an object’s height and distance are known and its size in the photograph is measured in <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>, can the lens’s <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> be estimated? The photograph gives a pixel count, while <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> requires a physical length on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>和毫米怎样换算，才能代进<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>？<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 smm 毫米、spx 像素；物体在图里高 hpx 像素，实际高 H、距离 Z（毫米）。
t.en: This level asks: how are <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> and millimetres converted before the <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>? The <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is smm millimetres and spx samples high; the object covers hpx samples and is H tall and Z away, in millimetres.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>换成<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> to millimetres on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> first, then h/f = H/Z; pixel counts and millimetres never share a proportion.

brief.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f（毫米）。
brief.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f in millimetres.

hint.zh: 一个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>在<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上有多少毫米？
hint.en: How many millimetres of <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is one <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>?

title.en: Width, height and a centre crop

t.zh: 从照片中心裁取区域时，需要准确确定宽、高和起点。不同工具对尺寸的排列约定可能不同：<wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>说明了 NumPy 图像形状与 OpenCV 尺寸的顺序。若混淆两者，裁剪区域可能偏离中心。
t.en: A centre crop requires the width, height and starting position to be identified correctly. Tools may order dimensions differently: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref> describes the conventions for NumPy image shapes and OpenCV sizes. Confusing them can move the crop away from the centre.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：已知形状 (rows, cols)，正中间那一块的左上角在哪？
t.en: This level asks: given the shape (rows, cols), where is the centre region's top-left corner?

after.zh: 形状先高后宽，尺寸先宽后高；<wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref>从余量的一半起。
after.en: A shape is height first, a size width first; a <wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref> starts half the spare room in.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
brief.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

hint.zh: 横向的余量是哪个数减 w？
hint.en: The room left across is which number less w?

solution: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)
naive: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)

t.zh: 一张照片在不同工具中显示时，蓝天可能变成橙色：原因可能是颜色通道的排列顺序不同。Workshop 2 中，OpenCV 读入的顺序为 B、G、R，而 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示。图像计算还需要留意数据类型：uint8 的范围为 0 到 255，超出范围的运算结果可能发生回绕。
t.en: A photograph can display an orange sky in another tool because its colour channels are ordered differently. In Workshop 2, OpenCV reads B, G, R while Matplotlib displays R, G, B. Image calculations also depend on data type: uint8 ranges from 0 to 255, and arithmetic results outside that range can wrap around.

t.zh: 怎样恢复照片的颜色？<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>将三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次作为 R、G、B 通道合成彩色图。
t.en: How can the photograph’s colours be restored? <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> combines three <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> as the R, G and B channels of a colour image.

after.zh: 不同工具的颜色通道顺序可能不同，交换顺序前需要确认输入和输出的约定（<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>）。整数类型的取值范围也会影响计算结果（<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>）；计算前应选择足以容纳结果的类型。
after.en: Tools may use different channel orders, so check input and output conventions before rearranging them (<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>). Integer ranges also affect computed results (<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>); choose a type that can hold the result before computing.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?

t.zh: 相机图像出现细碎亮暗变化，可能掩盖较大结构。先尝试邻域平均：这既会减弱噪声，也会损失细节。工具替你移动窗口并计算，任务是控制权重怎样影响图像。 <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Fine intensity fluctuations can obscure larger structure. Neighbourhood averaging can suppress noise but also lose detail. The tool moves the window and computes; you control how its weights affect the image. <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 局部平滑通过邻居组合减弱快速变化；权重和控制恒定区域的亮度。边缘效果还取决于未观测位置的假设。 <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Local smoothing combines neighbours to weaken rapid changes; the weight sum controls constant intensity. Boundary effects also depend on assumptions about unobserved positions. <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 让细碎变化减弱，同时保持恒定区域内部的亮度。调整三个位置权重：两侧同等贡献，中心的贡献是每侧的两倍。图外暂按 0；观察所有测试，权重和由系统计算。
brief.en: Reduce rapid variation while retaining constant interior intensity. Set three positional weights: equal side contributions, and a centre contribution twice each side. For now assume zero outside; inspect all cases and the computed weight sum.

hint.zh: 孤立亮点能显示每个权重的作用；恒定区域能检验总增益。权重比已给出，不需要从目标数字猜高斯公式。
hint.en: An isolated bright sample exposes individual weights; a constant region tests total gain. The ratio is supplied, so no Gaussian-formula guessing is required.

brief.zh: 这次照片外侧假设延续边缘读数。保持相同平均规则，让恒定图在边缘也保持亮度，避免人为黑框。检查变化发生在什么位置。
brief.en: Now assume the image continues with its edge readings. Keep the same averaging rule and preserve constants at the boundary too, avoiding an artificial dark frame. Inspect where the change occurs.

step.zh: 边缘读数来自哪种假设

t.zh: 相同的权重在图像内部工作正常，边缘却可能变暗。缺少的邻居没有被相机观测到：补 0 和延续边缘代表不同的假设。把已有电路用于新条件，检查边缘和内部的差别。 <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The same weights can work inside an image while darkening its edges. Missing neighbours were not observed: zero padding and extending the edge make different assumptions. Adapt your circuit and compare the boundary with the interior. <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>

desc.zh: 按 [1/4,1/2,1/4] 横向平均，图外延续边缘读数。
desc.en: Average across using [1/4,1/2,1/4], extending edge readings outside.

showcase.zh: 三项权重和边界假设必须同时解释亮点、常量与快速变化，默认元件不能通过。
showcase.en: Weights and boundary assumptions must explain impulses, constants and rapid variation together; the default operator cannot pass.

t.zh: 只参考左右邻居，可能完全看不到上下方向的变化。把已有平滑器扩展到二维，观察两种条纹和孤立亮点。 <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="rowSmooth"></part-ref>
t.en: A filter looking only left and right can miss variation above and below. Extend your smoother to two dimensions and inspect both stripe orientations and an isolated point. <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="rowSmooth"></part-ref>

t.zh: 横向再纵向的有效权重可以自动相乘显示。这个例子说明可分离结构为何节省计算，并不表示任意二维核都能拆开。
t.en: The effective weights of the two passes can be displayed by multiplying them. This explains the computational benefit of a separable structure; arbitrary 2D kernels do not necessarily factor.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>利用二维核的外积结构分两次完成同一运算；边界假设必须一致。这里得到的<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>降低快速变化，也会扩散分界，不能把平滑当作无损去噪。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> uses an outer-product structure to perform the same operation in two passes with consistent boundaries. <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> reduces rapid variation but also spreads boundaries; denoising is not lossless.

brief.zh: 横向平滑对所有方向都够用吗？保持同样的平均规则，同时减弱横向与纵向的细碎变化。复用横向平滑器，组合另一个方向的处理；图外延续边缘。
brief.en: Does smoothing across handle every direction? Retain the same averaging rule while reducing fine variation along both axes. Reuse the row smoother and compose the other direction, extending edges outside.

hint.zh: 对比横条纹和竖条纹：哪一种沿着当前处理方向没有变化？方向正确后，孤立亮点应向两个方向扩散。
hint.en: Compare horizontal and vertical stripes: which is constant along the current processing direction? With both axes covered, an isolated bright sample should spread in two directions.

desc.zh: 横向与纵向各按 [1/4,1/2,1/4] 平均，图外延续边缘。
desc.en: Average across and down with [1/4,1/2,1/4], extending edge readings.

title.zh: 对称核掩盖的方向差别

t.zh: 对称平滑核翻转后不变，容易让人忽略约定。准备研究有方向的变化之前，先用不对称的核和孤立亮点检查：书写顺序如何影响响应方向？ <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Reversing a symmetric smoothing kernel changes nothing, which can hide the convention. Before studying directional changes, use an asymmetric kernel and an impulse to inspect how written order affects response direction. <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的差别在核的方向约定；对称核无法暴露差别。不对称测试可用于检查后续方向响应，核翻转本身无需手工接线。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> differ in kernel orientation. Symmetric kernels conceal the difference; asymmetric probes expose it. Kernel reversal itself needs no manual wiring.

brief.zh: 同一输入要交出两路结果：一路复用二维平滑器；另一路按书写核做数学卷积，图外补 0。用孤立亮点确认方向，核翻转由工具处理。
brief.en: Produce two paths from the same input: reuse your 2D smoother, and apply the written kernel as mathematical convolution with zero outside. Use an impulse to check direction; the operator handles reversal.

title.zh: 分界在哪里，向哪边变化

t.zh: 平滑能减弱变化，但我们还需要知道分界在哪里。比较两种朝向与正反明暗的分界，构建横向、纵向响应，再处理垂直方向的细碎变化。 <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Smoothing suppresses change, but we also need its location. Compare orientations and contrast reversals, construct horizontal and vertical responses, then reduce fine variation perpendicular to each. <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>在变化方向上做差分，在垂直方向上做平滑；响应符号区分明暗变化方向，不能直接作为非负强度。图像分界只是亮度证据，不等同于物体轮廓或类别。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> differentiates along the change direction and smooths perpendicularly. Its sign records contrast direction and is not a nonnegative strength. Intensity boundaries alone do not establish object identity or shape.

brief.zh: 给出两个带符号的变化图：gx 比较右邻与左邻，gy 比较下邻与上邻。位置权重 [-1,0,1] 已给出，决定两路应沿哪个方向工作；图外延续边缘。
brief.en: Produce two signed changes: gx compares right with left, and gy below with above. Positional weights [-1,0,1] are supplied. Decide the axis of each path, extending edge readings.

brief.zh: 保留方向差分，并减弱垂直方向的细碎变化。分别组合差分 [-1,0,1] 与平滑 [1,2,1]。这是 Sobel 的位置权重约定，幅值不归一化；无需猜系数。
brief.en: Retain directional differences while reducing fine variation perpendicular to them. Compose differences [-1,0,1] with smoothing [1,2,1]. These are Sobel positional weights with unnormalised amplitude; coefficients are supplied.

step.zh: 保留方向，抑制横向干扰

t.zh: 单纯差分容易响应细碎变化。Sobel 将一个方向的差分与垂直方向的平滑结合。请根据两路信号的含义选择平滑方向；元件已给定两种权重。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Raw differences also respond to fine fluctuations. Sobel combines a difference along one axis with smoothing perpendicular to it. Choose the smoothing axis from each signal meaning; both weight patterns are provided. <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>

desc.zh: 按 Sobel 位置权重计算 gx 与 gy，图外延续边缘。
desc.en: Compute gx and gy with Sobel positional weights, extending edge readings.

title.zh: 方向不同，怎样比较强度

t.zh: 横向和纵向响应是互相垂直的分量。用 sqrt(gx²+gy²) 衡量长度可保留强度与方向的区别。公式直接提供；你决定怎样将两路响应组成有效的测量。 <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Horizontal and vertical responses are perpendicular components. The supplied length relation sqrt(gx²+gy²) separates strength from direction. Decide how the two responses form this measurement. <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>同时包含方向和强度。向量长度对符号和坐标旋转保持一致，而分量直接相加可能相消；非负边缘强度仍不是物体识别。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> has both direction and strength. Its length is consistent under sign reversal and coordinate rotation, whereas signed addition can cancel. Edge strength is still not object recognition.

brief.zh: 将已有的 gx、gy 合成非负变化强度。反转明暗或旋转分界不应因分量正负相消而失去响应。向量长度工具已提供平方和与开根号。
brief.en: Combine gx and gy into a nonnegative change strength. Reversing contrast or rotating a boundary must not cancel signed components. Vector length supplies squares, sum and square root.

desc.zh: 将自己构建的 Sobel 两路响应作为垂直分量，输出非负长度。
desc.en: Compute the nonnegative length of the two perpendicular Sobel responses you built.

title.zh: 让分界测量看见正确的信号
title.en: Measure boundaries in the intended signal

t.zh: 现在将相机读数变成可解释的视觉测量。颜色组合工具处理通道算术；你构建的平滑器与强度器决定处理流程。比较平滑后的图与变化强度，检查细碎变化是否先进入了非线性的强度计算。 <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="blur"></part-ref> <part-ref to="edgeStrength"></part-ref>
t.en: Turn camera readings into an interpretable visual measurement. Colour mixing supplies channel arithmetic; your smoother and strength module determine the processing path. Compare the processed image and its strength, checking when fine variation enters the nonlinear magnitude operation. <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="blur"></part-ref> <part-ref to="edgeStrength"></part-ref>

after.zh: 处理顺序决定测量的对象。线性颜色组合与逐通道线性平滑可交换，但求长度是非线性的，先求强度再平滑通常不等价。整条流程建立的是局部亮度证据，并不识别物体。 <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>
after.en: The signal path determines what is measured. Linear colour mixing commutes with channelwise linear smoothing, but magnitude is nonlinear: measuring strength before smoothing is generally different. The pipeline produces local intensity evidence, not object recognition. <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 照片中的细碎纹理会干扰分界测量。按 wr、wg、wb 观察颜色组合，输出平滑后的图 out，以及该图的变化强度 mag。组合自己构建的工具；用两张输出判断信号在哪一步改变。
brief.en: Fine texture interferes with boundary measurements. Observe the colour mixture specified by wr,wg,wb, and output its smoothed image out and that image's change strength mag. Compose your tools and inspect both outputs to locate signal changes.

title.zh: 照片：观测、位置与重采样

question.zh: 图像说明了什么，又怎样改变图像而不混淆信息？
question.en: What does an image establish, and how can we transform it without confusing its information?

title.zh: 邻域：平滑、方向与视觉测量

question.zh: 怎样利用邻居压低干扰、保留变化，并理解处理的代价？
question.en: How can neighbours reduce nuisance, retain changes and expose the cost of processing?

value.zh: 从成像关系与深度歧义出发，构建有意义的图像位置变换与重采样，再组合可解释的去噪和边缘测量流程。技术计算由工具提供。
value.en: Relate imaging to depth ambiguity, construct meaningful position transforms and resampling, then compose interpretable smoothing and edge measurements. Tools supply implementation arithmetic.

learner.zh: 学过编程和中学数学、没有学过计算机视觉的学习者（COMP90086 的学生）
learner.en: Learners who can program and know school mathematics but have not studied computer vision (COMP90086 students)

endpoint.zh: 从成像关系与深度歧义出发，构建有意义的图像位置变换与重采样，再组合可解释的去噪和边缘测量流程。技术计算由工具提供。
endpoint.en: Relate imaging to depth ambiguity, construct meaningful position transforms and resampling, then compose interpretable smoothing and edge measurements. Tools supply implementation arithmetic.

scope.zh: 前两章试做：讲义第 1–3 讲与第 5 讲的梯度。考核视觉关系、材料含义、边界假设与处理顺序；不考索引、取整、循环、通道拆装或重复接线。
scope.en: The two-chapter trial covers lectures 1–3 and lecture 5 gradients. Assess visual relations, material meanings, boundary assumptions and processing order; indexing, rounding, loops, channel plumbing and repeated wiring are supplied.

where.zh: 构建视觉处理关系与流程
where.en: Construct visual relationships and processing paths

why.zh: 元件提供计算，玩家决定信息如何转换与组合
why.en: Tools compute; learners decide how information is transformed and composed

where.zh: 构造具有相同照片的不同场景；可选构图
where.en: Construct different scenes with the same photograph; optional framing

why.zh: 亲手构造证据，理解反问题的不唯一性
why.en: Construct evidence of inverse ambiguity

about.zh: 针孔相机台
about.en: The pinhole camera bench

about.zh: 读写像素格（grid 任务）
about.en: Read and write pixel grids (grid tasks)

about.zh: 图像电路：搭出的板成为部件
about.en: Image circuits: a board built becomes a part

lacks.zh: 它只会把场景拍成数表、按位置取值：不会把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算。
lacks.en: It only pictures a scene as a table and reads values at positions: it cannot combine a pixel with its neighbours.

lacks.zh: 每个输出只是邻域的加权和，权重是人定的：它不会自己学出权重，这是卷积网络存在的理由。
lacks.en: Each output is a weighted sum over a neighbourhood with weights set by hand: it cannot learn them, the reason convolutional networks exist.

about.zh: 针孔相机中，三维点 P=(x,y,z) 投到成像平面上的 (x_i,y_i)，pinhole 到成像平面的距离为 f（焦距）。由相似三角形得 x_i = f·x/z，y_i = f·y/z：同样大小的物体，z 越大投影越小，f 越大投影越大。真实相机还要把世界坐标转成相机坐标，并考虑主点、像素尺寸和镜头畸变，但这个小模型是之后相机几何的基础。
about.en: In a pinhole camera, a 3D point P=(x,y,z) projects to (x_i,y_i) on the image plane, and the distance from the pinhole to the image plane is f (the focal length). By similar triangles, x_i = f·x/z, y_i = f·y/z: for objects of the same size, the larger z, the smaller the projection, and the larger f, the larger the projection. A real camera also has to convert world coordinates into camera coordinates and account for the principal point, pixel size and lens distortion, but this small model is the foundation for the camera geometry that follows.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 针孔相机模型：先学最简单的投影 (slide 11)

wall.zh: 物体距离加倍、焦距不变时，投影大小怎样变？
wall.en: If an object's distance doubles and the focal length stays the same, how does the size of its projection change?

misconception.zh: 以为可以由 (x_i,y_i) 反过来唯一求出 (x,y,z)；一个像素坐标只确定一条视线，深度未知。
misconception.en: Thinking you can recover (x,y,z) uniquely from (x_i,y_i); a pixel coordinate determines only a line of sight, and the depth is unknown.

term.zh: 正向问题与反向问题：图形学与视觉

about.zh: 计算机图形学已知物体、材质、灯光和相机，向前生成一张图像，是正向问题；计算机视觉已知图像，反过来推测物体、材质、灯光和相机，是反向问题。反问题通常更难，因为不同的三维场景可能产生很相似的二维图像。
about.en: Computer graphics knows the objects, materials, lighting and camera and works forwards to produce an image: a forward problem. Computer vision knows the image and works backwards to infer the objects, materials, lighting and camera: an inverse problem. The inverse problem is usually harder, because different 3D scenes can produce very similar 2D images.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/01-introduction.md §2 计算机视觉和计算机图形学的方向相反 (slide 8)

wall.zh: 为什么同一张照片可能对应不同的三维场景？
wall.en: Why can the same photo correspond to different 3D scenes?

misconception.zh: 以为只要图像足够清晰就能唯一还原三维场景；不同三维场景可能产生相似的二维图像。
misconception.en: Thinking that as long as the image is clear enough, the 3D scene can be recovered uniquely; different 3D scenes can produce similar 2D images.

term.en: angle of view and focal length

about.zh: 在数字图像中焦距常用像素表示：它只是把物理焦距除以像素尺寸，换成图像坐标单位。例如图像宽 2000 像素、主点在中间、焦距 1000 像素时，左右各约 45°，总视野范围约 90°。
about.en: In digital images the focal length is often expressed in pixels: this divides the physical focal length by the pixel size, converting it into image-coordinate units. For example, if the image is 2000 pixels wide, the principal point is in the middle and the focal length is 1000 pixels, each side spans about 45°, giving a total field of view of about 90°.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §2 焦距与视野范围 (slide 15)

wall.zh: 怎样把主体拍大而不裁掉它，并排除不同距离的干扰物？
wall.en: How can a subject be made large without cropping it while excluding a distracting object at a different depth?

misconception.zh: 把以像素为单位的焦距和以毫米为单位的焦距直接比较或混用。
misconception.en: Directly comparing or mixing up a focal length in pixels with a focal length in millimetres.

about.zh: 灰度图按行、列存储亮度样本；坐标指定位置，取样得到该位置的值。
about.en: A greyscale image stores intensity samples by row and column; coordinates specify a position, and sampling returns its value.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 数字图像是怎样存储的 (slides 22, 25)

wall.zh: 位置与明暗读数怎样分别表示，才能比较两个位置？
wall.en: How do positions differ from readings when comparing two image locations?

misconception.zh: 把坐标当作读数，或把行列顺序颠倒。
misconception.en: Confusing coordinates with readings, or swapping row and column order.

about.zh: Crop 从原数组取一个子区域，已有像素数值不变；Resize 改变数组尺寸，必须为新位置计算像素数值。直接把 768×512 压成 512×512 会改变宽高比，物体可能变胖或变瘦；若保持比例，目标尺寸应接近 512×341。
about.en: Cropping takes a sub-region of the original array, and the existing pixel values are unchanged; resizing changes the size of the array, so pixel values must be computed for the new positions. Squashing 768×512 straight to 512×512 changes the aspect ratio, so objects may become fatter or thinner; if the proportions are kept, the target size should be about 512×341.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 裁剪与缩放不是一回事 (slide 34)

wall.zh: 把 768×512 图像缩到 512 并保持比例，另一边应是多少？裁剪和缩放哪个需要计算新像素值？
wall.en: If a 768×512 image is resized to 512 while keeping its proportions, what should the other side be? Which of cropping and resizing requires new pixel values to be computed?

misconception.zh: 以为裁剪也要插值，或以为缩放只是“截掉一部分”。
misconception.en: Thinking cropping also requires interpolation, or that resizing is just ‘cutting off a part’.

about.zh: 最近邻插值对每个新像素，找到原图中最近的像素，直接复制它的值。优点是快、边缘硬；缺点是放大或缩小时容易出现明显的方块感或锯齿。
about.en: For each new pixel, nearest-neighbour interpolation finds the nearest pixel in the original image and copies its value directly. Its advantages are speed and hard edges; its drawback is that enlarging or shrinking easily produces obvious blockiness or jagged edges.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 最近邻插值 (slide 35)

wall.zh: 用最近邻把图像放大 4 倍，为什么会出现方块感？
wall.en: Why does enlarging an image 4 times with nearest neighbour make it look blocky?

misconception.zh: 以为最近邻会产生原图中没有的新数值；它只复制已有值。
misconception.en: Thinking nearest neighbour produces new values not present in the original image; it only copies existing values.

about.zh: 新位置落在四个旧像素之间时，设横向距离为 H、纵向距离为 V，四个权重是 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV；它们加起来等于 1，所以双线性插值本质上是四个邻居的加权平均。它通常比最近邻平滑，但会让非常锐利的边缘稍微软化，老师说它把模糊并入了采样步骤；缩图时仍要根据采样比例检查是否需要额外抗混叠。
about.en: When a new position falls between four old pixels, let the horizontal distance be H and the vertical distance be V; the four weights are (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V and HV. They sum to 1, so bilinear interpolation is essentially a weighted average of the four neighbours. It is usually smoother than nearest neighbour, but slightly softens very sharp edges; the lecturer says it folds blurring into the sampling step. When downsizing, you should still check, based on the sampling ratio, whether extra anti-aliasing is needed.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 双线性插值 (slide 36)

wall.zh: 新像素落在四个旧像素之间时，双线性插值怎样得到它的值？四个权重为什么加起来等于 1？
wall.en: When a new pixel falls between four old pixels, how does bilinear interpolation obtain its value? Why do the four weights sum to 1?

misconception.zh: 把权重配反（让离得远的像素权重更大）；或以为双线性插值不会改变锐利边缘。
misconception.en: Assigning the weights the wrong way round (giving more distant pixels larger weights); or thinking bilinear interpolation does not alter sharp edges.

term.zh: 卷积与互相关（是否翻转卷积核）

about.zh: 两者都做“滑动、相乘、相加”，唯一关键区别是卷积先把核旋转 180° 再使用，互相关直接使用。核关于中心对称时两者结果相同；核不对称时方向会改变。手算前要先确定是否翻核。
about.en: Both do ‘slide, multiply, add’; the only key difference is that convolution first rotates the kernel by 180° before using it, whereas cross-correlation uses it directly. When the kernel is symmetric about its centre the two give the same result; when it is not, the direction changes. Before calculating by hand, first decide whether to flip the kernel.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §1 互相关和卷积 (slide 17)

wall.zh: 同一个非对称核，卷积与互相关为什么会给出不同结果？
wall.en: Why do convolution and cross-correlation give different results for the same asymmetric kernel?

misconception.zh: 以为翻转只是左右翻，或以为任何核卷积与互相关结果都不同。
misconception.en: Thinking the flip is only a left–right flip, or thinking convolution and cross-correlation give different results for every kernel.

about.zh: 若二维核可写成一个列向量与一个行向量的外积，就叫可分离，此时可先对每一行做一维滤波，再对每一列做一维滤波。k×k 核每像素约需 k² 次乘法，拆开后约需 2k 次，k 大时差别明显。高斯核常常接近或可以构造成可分离核。
about.en: If a 2D kernel can be written as the outer product of a column vector and a row vector, it is called separable; you can then first apply a 1D filter to each row and then a 1D filter to each column. A k×k kernel needs about k² multiplications per pixel; split up, it needs about 2k, and the difference is significant when k is large. Gaussian kernels are often close to separable or can be constructed to be separable.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §3 可分离滤波：把二维计算拆成两次一维计算 (slides 39, 40)

wall.zh: 为什么可分离的二维核能用两次一维计算完成？
wall.en: Why can a separable 2D kernel be computed with two 1D passes?

misconception.zh: 以为任何二维核都能拆成两个一维核。
misconception.en: Thinking any 2D kernel can be split into two 1D kernels.

term.zh: 均值滤波与高斯滤波（模糊）

about.zh: 均值滤波给邻域每个像素相同权重；高斯滤波离中心越近权重越大，形式为 G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²))。σ 控制影响范围，σ 越大模糊越强。模糊核通常归一化使权重和为 1，以免改变整体平均亮度；两种核都减少细节，但权重分配不同，保留的细节也不同。
about.en: A mean filter gives every pixel in the neighbourhood the same weight; a Gaussian filter gives larger weights the closer a pixel is to the centre, in the form G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²)). σ controls the extent of the influence: the larger σ, the stronger the blur. Blur kernels are usually normalised so that the weights sum to 1, so as not to change the overall average brightness; both kernels reduce detail, but they distribute the weights differently, so they preserve different detail.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 模糊：让变化变慢 (slides 27, 28)

wall.zh: 为什么模糊核的权重和要为 1？σ 增大会怎样？
wall.en: Why should the weights of a blur kernel sum to 1? What happens as σ increases?

misconception.zh: 以为高斯模糊和均值模糊效果完全一样，或忘记归一化。
misconception.en: Thinking Gaussian blur and mean blur have exactly the same effect, or forgetting to normalise.

about.zh: Sobel 核近似计算横向和纵向两个方向的导数：S_x=[[1,0,−1],[2,0,−2],[1,0,−1]]，S_y=[[1,2,1],[0,0,0],[−1,−2,−1]]。平坦区域左右或上下差异小，响应接近 0；边缘附近差异大，响应较大。两张图分别找沿相应方向变化快的位置。
about.en: The Sobel kernels approximate the derivatives in the horizontal and vertical directions: S_x=[[1,0,−1],[2,0,−2],[1,0,−1]], S_y=[[1,2,1],[0,0,0],[−1,−2,−1]]. In flat regions the left–right or up–down differences are small and the response is close to 0; near edges the differences are large and the response is larger. The two output images each find where the change along the corresponding direction is fast.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 Sobel：找变化快的地方 (slides 29, 30)

wall.zh: S_x 在平坦区域与竖直边缘处响应分别是多少？
wall.en: What is the response of S_x in a flat region and at a vertical edge, respectively?

misconception.zh: 以为 S_x 找的是水平方向的边缘线（实际找沿 x 方向变化快处）。
misconception.en: Thinking S_x finds horizontal edge lines (it actually finds where the change along the x direction is fast).

about.zh: 二维图像 f(x,y) 的梯度是 ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ。幅度 ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) 表示变化有多强，方向 θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) 表示变化最快的方向。
about.en: The gradient of a 2D image f(x,y) is ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ. The magnitude ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) indicates how strong the change is, and the direction θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) indicates the direction of fastest change.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/05-image-formation-ii.md §3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 40)

wall.zh: 给定 ∂f/∂x=3、∂f/∂y=4，梯度幅度是多少？
wall.en: Given ∂f/∂x=3 and ∂f/∂y=4, what is the gradient magnitude?

misconception.zh: 把梯度方向当成边缘的走向。
misconception.en: Taking the gradient direction to be the direction in which the edge runs.

term.zh: 彩色图像滤波（多通道卷积核）

about.zh: RGB 图像除空间维度外还有通道维度，颜色滤波器尺寸可以是 K_h×K_w×3。它同时看同一邻域的 R、G、B，把所有乘积加在一起得到一个输出数值。常见错误是把 height×width×channel 当成普通二维图像，忘记核还要覆盖通道维度。
about.en: Besides its spatial dimensions, an RGB image also has a channel dimension, so a colour filter can have size K_h×K_w×3. It looks at R, G and B in the same neighbourhood at once and sums all the products to give a single output value. A common mistake is to treat height×width×channel as an ordinary 2D image and forget that the kernel must also cover the channel dimension.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 彩色图像的滤波核多了一个维度 (slide 31)

wall.zh: 一个 3×3×3 核作用于 RGB 图像一个位置，输出几个数？
wall.en: When a 3×3×3 kernel is applied to an RGB image at one position, how many numbers does it output?

misconception.zh: 以为彩色滤波得到三个输出值或只对一个通道操作。
misconception.en: Thinking colour filtering produces three output values, or operates on only one channel.

term.zh: 像素换算成传感器毫米再求焦距
term.en: Converting pixels to sensor millimetres to find focal length

about.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图像中高 100 像素，所以它在传感器上高 h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm。物体实际高 h_o = 120 mm、距离 z = 600 mm，由相似三角形 h_i/f = h_o/z 得 f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm。重点是先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，不能直接把像素和毫米放进同一个比例式。
about.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels, and the object is 100 pixels high in the image, so its height on the sensor is h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm. The object's real height is h_o = 120 mm and its distance is z = 600 mm, so by similar triangles h_i/f = h_o/z, giving f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm. The key point is to convert pixels into millimetres on the sensor first; you cannot put pixels and millimetres directly into the same proportion.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · 用传感器尺寸求焦距

wall.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图中占 100 像素，实高 120 mm、距离 600 mm，焦距是多少毫米？
wall.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels; an object occupies 100 pixels in the image, is 120 mm tall in reality and is 600 mm away. What is the focal length in millimetres?

misconception.zh: 直接把 100 像素当作 h_i 代入，得到单位混乱的 f = 100×600/120 = 500。
misconception.en: Substituting the 100 pixels directly as h_i, giving f = 100×600/120 = 500 with muddled units.

term.zh: OpenCV 尺寸 (width, height) 与 NumPy 形状 (height, width, channels)
term.en: OpenCV (width, height) vs NumPy (height, width, channels)

about.zh: OpenCV 的大小 tuple 是 (width, height)，NumPy 形状却通常写成 (height, width, channels)。所以不能把 NumPy 的形状原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸，否则宽和高会对调。
about.en: An OpenCV size tuple is (width, height), whereas a NumPy shape is usually written (height, width, channels). So you cannot use a NumPy shape as-is as an OpenCV resize size, or the width and height will be swapped.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝

wall.zh: 为什么 NumPy 的形状不能原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸？
wall.en: Why can a NumPy shape not be used as-is as an OpenCV resize size?

misconception.zh: 把 image.shape[:2] 直接传给 OpenCV 的缩放函数。
misconception.en: Passing image.shape[:2] straight to OpenCV's resize function.

term.zh: OpenCV 的 BGR 与 Matplotlib 的 RGB

about.zh: cv2.imread 默认读入 BGR，但 matplotlib.pyplot.imshow 按 RGB 显示，所以显示前要用 cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) 转换。这只改变通道顺序，不改变图像内容或空间尺寸。
about.en: cv2.imread reads images as BGR by default, but matplotlib.pyplot.imshow displays them as RGB, so convert with cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) before displaying. This changes only the channel order, not the image content or spatial size.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV 和 Matplotlib 的颜色顺序

wall.zh: 用 cv2.imread 读图后直接 plt.imshow，红色物体会显示成什么颜色？为什么？
wall.en: If you read an image with cv2.imread and pass it straight to plt.imshow, what colour will a red object appear? Why?

misconception.zh: 显示时红蓝颠倒，却以为图片本身坏了；或以为转换会改变图像尺寸。
misconception.en: Seeing red and blue swapped on display and thinking the image itself is broken; or thinking the conversion changes the image size.

about.zh: 把投影偏移转换成像素并平移原点。
about.en: Convert projected offset into pixels and translate its origin.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 and §2 (slides 11, 15, 18)

wall.zh: 为什么负投影偏移仍可以对应正的列坐标？
wall.en: Why can a negative projected offset have a positive column coordinate?

misconception.zh: 将像素偏移直接当作图像列坐标。
misconception.en: Treating signed pixel offset as an image column.

about.en: Compute the nonnegative length of the two perpendicular Sobel responses you built.

title.zh: 照片：观测、位置与重采样

question.zh: 图像说明了什么，又怎样改变图像而不混淆信息？
question.en: What does an image establish, and how can we transform it without confusing its information?

why.zh: 从一台理想的针孔相机起步。
why.en: Starting from an ideal pinhole camera.

task.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
task.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

question.zh: 你负责摄影实验室的相机与图像处理器。先预测场景会落在照片的哪里，再让处理器裁剪、放大和提取变化。每关解决一个视觉问题，计算与重复接线由工具协助。这里先研究：物体位置、距离和焦距分别怎样改变投影？
question.en: You are building a camera and image processor for a photography lab. First locate a scene in its photograph, then crop, enlarge and measure changes. Each level solves a visual problem, with arithmetic and repeated wiring supported. Begin by relating position, depth and focal length to projection.

chain.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
chain.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

chain.zh: 同一条<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>经过 O，使两段距离受<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>约束。<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>把这个比例推广到不同的位置与深度；场景和图像的坐标不能直接当作同一个量。
chain.en: A shared <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> through O constrains the distances through <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>. <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> applies that proportion across positions and depths; scene and image coordinates are not interchangeable.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

task.zh: 调 H 和 Z：像高仍为 0.5，但 H 至少为 2。所有长度共用模型单位；对照参照图再检查。
task.en: Adjust H and Z: keep image height 0.5 with H at least 2. All lengths share model units. Compare with the reference, then check.

question.zh: 照片里一样高的物体，现实中一定一样高吗？以 H=1、Z=4、f=2 为参照，另造一个明显更高、照片却相同的场景。这里改变真实场景，不改变相机或显示比例。 <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>
question.en: Must equally tall image objects have equal real heights? Starting from H=1, Z=4, f=2, construct a visibly taller scene with the same photograph. Change the scene while keeping the camera and display scale fixed. <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 调 H 和 Z：像高仍为 0.5，但 H 至少为 2。所有长度共用模型单位；对照参照图再检查。
chain.en: Adjust H and Z: keep image height 0.5 with H at least 2. All lengths share model units. Compare with the reference, then check.

chain.zh: 两个不同场景得到同样的观测，因此单凭这个像不能在它们之间做选择。这是<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>的困难：假设 Z 后算出的是条件下的位置，不是从图像恢复出的真实深度。这个实验也不能证明颜色或物体总数一定能确定。
chain.en: Two different scenes give the same observation, so that image cannot distinguish them. This is the difficulty of the <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>: supplying Z gives a conditional position, not depth recovered from the image. This experiment does not establish unique colour or object count either.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

task.zh: 输入 X、Z、<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px 和<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x：交出像点的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>横坐标 u。
task.en: Given X, Z, the <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px and the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x, give the image's <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> column u.

question.zh: 照片是按行列排列的读数。这里 x 是列、y 是行，左上角为 (0,0)，每个整数位置指一个像素中心；位置与该格的亮度是不同信息。先看示例，再把已知的投影接到照片的列号。 <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>
question.en: A photograph contains readings arranged in rows and columns. Here x is the column, y the row, the top-left is (0,0), and integer positions mark pixel centres. A location and its intensity are different information. Inspect the example, then relate projection to image columns. <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 输入 X、Z、<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px 和<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x：交出像点的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>横坐标 u。
chain.en: Given X, Z, the <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px and the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x, give the image's <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> column u.

chain.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>将投影位置与图像坐标联系起来：光路不变，变化的是单位和原点。区分<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>的单位换算与坐标原点的平移，有助于正确表示负偏移。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
chain.en: A <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> relates projected positions to image coordinates: the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> is unchanged, while the units and origin differ. Distinguishing the unit conversion for <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> from the shift of origin helps represent negative offsets correctly.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

task.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
task.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

question.zh: 从照片中截取一块区域时，截出的画面怎样对应原图？用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>保留选中的区域，追踪新图各位置在原图中的来源；新图的左上角对应所选区域的起点。
question.en: When a region is cut from a photograph, how does the result correspond to the original? Use <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> to retain the selected region and trace each position in the new image back to its source. The new top-left corner corresponds to the start of the selected region.

chain.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
chain.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

chain.zh: <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>保留选定区域的原有数值，只改变区域的位置和坐标范围；它不会像缩放那样重新确定输出的采样位置。
chain.en: <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> retains the selected region’s original values while changing its position and coordinate range. Unlike resizing, it does not establish new sampling positions.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

task.zh: 这张图的每个值是一个区域编号。按给定位置生成新的区域图：每格必须来自最近的原有区域；图外延续边缘区域，不能创造编号或混合类别。
task.en: Each value identifies a region. Build a new region map at the supplied positions: use the closest original region and extend edge regions outside, without inventing labels or mixing classes.

question.zh: 图像不一定记录亮度，也可能记录每个位置属于哪个区域。放大一张区域图时，编号之间的平均值通常没有类别含义。比较原有读数与距离混合的差别，再为处理器设置采样方式和图外假设。 <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>
question.en: An image can record region membership rather than brightness. An average between two region identifiers generally has no class meaning. Compare copying with distance-based mixing, then configure the sampler and outside assumption. <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 这张图的每个值是一个区域编号。按给定位置生成新的区域图：每格必须来自最近的原有区域；图外延续边缘区域，不能创造编号或混合类别。
chain.en: Each value identifies a region. Build a new region map at the supplied positions: use the closest original region and extend edge regions outside, without inventing labels or mixing classes.

chain.zh: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>保持原有样本，适合不能混合的离散标签；选择取值规则必须考虑数值代表什么。图外延续边缘是一种假设，并不是对图外内容的新观测。
chain.en: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> preserves original samples, which suits discrete labels that must not mix. Interpolation depends on what the values mean. Extending an edge is an assumption, not a new observation.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

title.zh: 平滑放大，保留信息边界

task.zh: 先选取指定区域，再在区域内部的 x、y 位置生成平滑放大图。输出原样裁剪的区域与放大图。给出的采样坐标相对于裁剪后的区域，不是原照片。
task.en: Select the requested region, then produce a smooth enlargement at x,y within that region. Output the unchanged crop and the enlargement. Sampling positions are relative to the crop, not the original photograph.

question.zh: 照片亮度与区域编号需要不同的处理。双线性会按距离在四个邻居之间过渡；权重和计算自动完成，你决定它应该作用于哪种材料、哪张源图。 <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>
question.en: Intensities and identifiers need different treatment. Bilinear interpolation transitions between four neighbours by distance. Arithmetic is supplied; decide which material and source image it should act on. <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 同一组采样位置用于亮度照片和区域编号。照片需要随位置连续过渡，区域图必须保留最近的原有编号。组成两路读图器；图外均延续边缘。
chain.en: Use the same positions for intensities and region identifiers. Intensities should transition continuously, while identifiers must retain the closest original class. Build both reading paths, extending their edges outside.

chain.zh: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>能减轻阶梯感，但平滑过渡不代表恢复了原图没有记录的细节。处理顺序还决定坐标相对哪张图解释；同一对数字放在不同参照系里会读到不同内容。
chain.en: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref> can reduce stepping, but a smooth transition does not restore unmeasured detail. The processing order also determines which image the coordinates refer to.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

task.zh: 完整拍下灯塔，像高至少 16 mm；附近悬挂的灯泡必须完全出画。调<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f 和相机高度，再检查照片。
task.en: Keep the lighthouse complete, with image height at least 16 mm. Exclude the nearby hanging bulb entirely. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f and camera height, then check the photograph.

question.zh: 想把远处的灯塔拍大，拉近焦距却可能裁掉塔顶；附近悬挂的灯泡还会闯入画面。用<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>和相机高度共同调整取景：灯塔必须完整、像高至少 16 mm，而灯泡要完全在画面之外。这里研究竖直<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 24 mm，场景使用统一的模型毫米。
question.en: Making the distant lighthouse larger can crop its top, while a nearby hanging bulb intrudes into the photograph. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> and camera height together: keep the entire lighthouse at an image height of at least 16 mm, with the bulb wholly outside the frame. This is a vertical <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> experiment with a 24 mm <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and consistent model millimetres.

chain.zh: 完整拍下灯塔，像高至少 16 mm；附近悬挂的灯泡必须完全出画。调<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f 和相机高度，再检查照片。
chain.en: Keep the lighthouse complete, with image height at least 16 mm. Exclude the nearby hanging bulb entirely. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f and camera height, then check the photograph.

chain.zh: 放大投影会缩小<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，改变相机高度则平移物体相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的位置。这两个调整相互约束：画面中的主体要足够大，也必须完整；不能把“有一部分被裁掉”当作“完全不在画面里”。<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>描述固定<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>画幅与<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>之间的取舍。
chain.en: Enlarging the projection narrows the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>, while changing camera height shifts objects relative to the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>. The controls constrain each other: the subject must be large enough yet complete. Partial cropping is not complete exclusion. <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> describes the trade-off between a fixed <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

task.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f（毫米）。
task.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f in millimetres.

question.zh: 已知物体的实际高度和距离，并测得它在照片中占据的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>数，能否估计镜头的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>？照片给出的是像素数，而<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>关系需要<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的实际长度。
question.en: If an object’s height and distance are known and its size in the photograph is measured in <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>, can the lens’s <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> be estimated? The photograph gives a pixel count, while <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> requires a physical length on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>.

chain.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f（毫米）。
chain.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f in millimetres.

chain.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>换成<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
chain.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> to millimetres on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> first, then h/f = H/Z; pixel counts and millimetres never share a proportion.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

title.en: Width, height and a centre crop

task.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
task.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.
