question.zh: 从照片中心裁取区域时，需要准确确定宽、高和起点。不同工具对尺寸的排列约定可能不同：<wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>说明了 NumPy 图像形状与 OpenCV 尺寸的顺序。若混淆两者，裁剪区域可能偏离中心。
question.en: A centre crop requires the width, height and starting position to be identified correctly. Tools may order dimensions differently: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref> describes the conventions for NumPy image shapes and OpenCV sizes. Confusing them can move the crop away from the centre.

chain.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
chain.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

chain.zh: 形状先高后宽，尺寸先宽后高；<wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref>从余量的一半起。
chain.en: A shape is height first, a size width first; a <wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref> starts half the spare room in.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

title.zh: 邻域：平滑、方向与视觉测量

question.zh: 怎样利用邻居压低干扰、保留变化，并理解处理的代价？
question.en: How can neighbours reduce nuisance, retain changes and expose the cost of processing?

why.zh: 相机只会按位置取值，不会把邻居合起来算。
why.en: The camera only reads values at positions and cannot combine neighbours.

task.zh: 这次照片外侧假设延续边缘读数。保持相同平均规则，让恒定图在边缘也保持亮度，避免人为黑框。检查变化发生在什么位置。
task.en: Now assume the image continues with its edge readings. Keep the same averaging rule and preserve constants at the boundary too, avoiding an artificial dark frame. Inspect where the change occurs.

question.zh: 相机图像出现细碎亮暗变化，可能掩盖较大结构。先尝试邻域平均：这既会减弱噪声，也会损失细节。工具替你移动窗口并计算，任务是控制权重怎样影响图像。 <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>
question.en: Fine intensity fluctuations can obscure larger structure. Neighbourhood averaging can suppress noise but also lose detail. The tool moves the window and computes; you control how its weights affect the image. <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 让细碎变化减弱，同时保持恒定区域内部的亮度。调整三个位置权重：两侧同等贡献，中心的贡献是每侧的两倍。图外暂按 0；观察所有测试，权重和由系统计算。
chain.en: Reduce rapid variation while retaining constant interior intensity. Set three positional weights: equal side contributions, and a centre contribution twice each side. For now assume zero outside; inspect all cases and the computed weight sum.

chain.zh: 局部平滑通过邻居组合减弱快速变化；权重和控制恒定区域的亮度。边缘效果还取决于未观测位置的假设。 <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Local smoothing combines neighbours to weaken rapid changes; the weight sum controls constant intensity. Boundary effects also depend on assumptions about unobserved positions. <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

showcase.zh: 配置三项位置权重和边界假设，须同时解释亮点、常量、快速变化与图像边界；放置默认元件无法通过。
showcase.en: Configure weights and boundary assumptions across impulse, constant, rapid variation and boundary cases; placing the default operator cannot pass.

task.zh: 横向平滑对所有方向都够用吗？保持同样的平均规则，同时减弱横向与纵向的细碎变化。复用横向平滑器，组合另一个方向的处理；图外延续边缘。
task.en: Does smoothing across handle every direction? Retain the same averaging rule while reducing fine variation along both axes. Reuse the row smoother and compose the other direction, extending edges outside.

question.zh: 只参考左右邻居，可能完全看不到上下方向的变化。把已有平滑器扩展到二维，观察两种条纹和孤立亮点。 <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="rowSmooth"></part-ref>
question.en: A filter looking only left and right can miss variation above and below. Extend your smoother to two dimensions and inspect both stripe orientations and an isolated point. <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="rowSmooth"></part-ref>

chain.zh: 横向平滑对所有方向都够用吗？保持同样的平均规则，同时减弱横向与纵向的细碎变化。复用横向平滑器，组合另一个方向的处理；图外延续边缘。
chain.en: Does smoothing across handle every direction? Retain the same averaging rule while reducing fine variation along both axes. Reuse the row smoother and compose the other direction, extending edges outside.

chain.zh: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>利用二维核的外积结构分两次完成同一运算；边界假设必须一致。这里得到的<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>降低快速变化，也会扩散分界，不能把平滑当作无损去噪。
chain.en: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> uses an outer-product structure to perform the same operation in two passes with consistent boundaries. <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> reduces rapid variation but also spreads boundaries; denoising is not lossless.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

title.zh: 对称核掩盖的方向差别
对称核掩盖的方向差别

task.zh: 同一输入要交出两路结果：一路复用二维平滑器；另一路按书写核做数学卷积，图外补 0。用孤立亮点确认方向，核翻转由工具处理。
task.en: Produce two paths from the same input: reuse your 2D smoother, and apply the written kernel as mathematical convolution with zero outside. Use an impulse to check direction; the operator handles reversal.

question.zh: 对称平滑核翻转后不变，容易让人忽略约定。准备研究有方向的变化之前，先用不对称的核和孤立亮点检查：书写顺序如何影响响应方向？ <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>
question.en: Reversing a symmetric smoothing kernel changes nothing, which can hide the convention. Before studying directional changes, use an asymmetric kernel and an impulse to inspect how written order affects response direction. <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 同一输入要交出两路结果：一路复用二维平滑器；另一路按书写核做数学卷积，图外补 0。用孤立亮点确认方向，核翻转由工具处理。
chain.en: Produce two paths from the same input: reuse your 2D smoother, and apply the written kernel as mathematical convolution with zero outside. Use an impulse to check direction; the operator handles reversal.

chain.zh: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的差别在核的方向约定；对称核无法暴露差别。不对称测试可用于检查后续方向响应，核翻转本身无需手工接线。
chain.en: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> differ in kernel orientation. Symmetric kernels conceal the difference; asymmetric probes expose it. Kernel reversal itself needs no manual wiring.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

title.zh: 分界在哪里，向哪边变化
分界在哪里，向哪边变化

task.zh: 保留方向差分，并减弱垂直方向的细碎变化。分别组合差分 [-1,0,1] 与平滑 [1,2,1]。这是 Sobel 的位置权重约定，幅值不归一化；无需猜系数。
task.en: Retain directional differences while reducing fine variation perpendicular to them. Compose differences [-1,0,1] with smoothing [1,2,1]. These are Sobel positional weights with unnormalised amplitude; coefficients are supplied.

question.zh: 平滑能减弱变化，但我们还需要知道分界在哪里。比较两种朝向与正反明暗的分界，构建横向、纵向响应，再处理垂直方向的细碎变化。 <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>
question.en: Smoothing suppresses change, but we also need its location. Compare orientations and contrast reversals, construct horizontal and vertical responses, then reduce fine variation perpendicular to each. <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 给出两个带符号的变化图：gx 比较右邻与左邻，gy 比较下邻与上邻。位置权重 [-1,0,1] 已给出，决定两路应沿哪个方向工作；图外延续边缘。
chain.en: Produce two signed changes: gx compares right with left, and gy below with above. Positional weights [-1,0,1] are supplied. Decide the axis of each path, extending edge readings.

chain.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>在变化方向上做差分，在垂直方向上做平滑；响应符号区分明暗变化方向，不能直接作为非负强度。图像分界只是亮度证据，不等同于物体轮廓或类别。
chain.en: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> differentiates along the change direction and smooths perpendicularly. Its sign records contrast direction and is not a nonnegative strength. Intensity boundaries alone do not establish object identity or shape.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

title.zh: 方向不同，怎样比较强度
方向不同，怎样比较强度

task.zh: 将已有的 gx、gy 合成非负变化强度。反转明暗或旋转分界不应因分量正负相消而失去响应。向量长度工具已提供平方和与开根号。
task.en: Combine gx and gy into a nonnegative change strength. Reversing contrast or rotating a boundary must not cancel signed components. Vector length supplies squares, sum and square root.

question.zh: 横向和纵向响应是互相垂直的分量。用 sqrt(gx²+gy²) 衡量长度可保留强度与方向的区别。公式直接提供；你决定怎样将两路响应组成有效的测量。 <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>
question.en: Horizontal and vertical responses are perpendicular components. The supplied length relation sqrt(gx²+gy²) separates strength from direction. Decide how the two responses form this measurement. <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 将已有的 gx、gy 合成非负变化强度。反转明暗或旋转分界不应因分量正负相消而失去响应。向量长度工具已提供平方和与开根号。
chain.en: Combine gx and gy into a nonnegative change strength. Reversing contrast or rotating a boundary must not cancel signed components. Vector length supplies squares, sum and square root.

chain.zh: <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>同时包含方向和强度。向量长度对符号和坐标旋转保持一致，而分量直接相加可能相消；非负边缘强度仍不是物体识别。
chain.en: <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> has both direction and strength. Its length is consistent under sign reversal and coordinate rotation, whereas signed addition can cancel. Edge strength is still not object recognition.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

title.zh: 让分界测量看见正确的信号
title.en: Measure boundaries in the intended signal

title.zh: 让分界测量看见正确的信号
title.en: Measure boundaries in the intended signal

task.zh: 照片中的细碎纹理会干扰分界测量。按 wr、wg、wb 观察颜色组合，输出平滑后的图 out，以及该图的变化强度 mag。组合自己构建的工具；用两张输出判断信号在哪一步改变。
task.en: Fine texture interferes with boundary measurements. Observe the colour mixture specified by wr,wg,wb, and output its smoothed image out and that image's change strength mag. Compose your tools and inspect both outputs to locate signal changes.

question.zh: 现在将相机读数变成可解释的视觉测量。颜色组合工具处理通道算术；你构建的平滑器与强度器决定处理流程。比较平滑后的图与变化强度，检查细碎变化是否先进入了非线性的强度计算。 <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="blur"></part-ref> <part-ref to="edgeStrength"></part-ref>
question.en: Turn camera readings into an interpretable visual measurement. Colour mixing supplies channel arithmetic; your smoother and strength module determine the processing path. Compare the processed image and its strength, checking when fine variation enters the nonlinear magnitude operation. <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="blur"></part-ref> <part-ref to="edgeStrength"></part-ref>

chain.zh: 照片中的细碎纹理会干扰分界测量。按 wr、wg、wb 观察颜色组合，输出平滑后的图 out，以及该图的变化强度 mag。组合自己构建的工具；用两张输出判断信号在哪一步改变。
chain.en: Fine texture interferes with boundary measurements. Observe the colour mixture specified by wr,wg,wb, and output its smoothed image out and that image's change strength mag. Compose your tools and inspect both outputs to locate signal changes.

chain.zh: 处理顺序决定测量的对象。线性颜色组合与逐通道线性平滑可交换，但求长度是非线性的，先求强度再平滑通常不等价。整条流程建立的是局部亮度证据，并不识别物体。 <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The signal path determines what is measured. Linear colour mixing commutes with channelwise linear smoothing, but magnitude is nonlinear: measuring strength before smoothing is generally different. The pipeline produces local intensity evidence, not object recognition. <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

task.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
task.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

question.zh: 一张照片在不同工具中显示时，蓝天可能变成橙色：原因可能是颜色通道的排列顺序不同。Workshop 2 中，OpenCV 读入的顺序为 B、G、R，而 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示。图像计算还需要留意数据类型：uint8 的范围为 0 到 255，超出范围的运算结果可能发生回绕。
question.en: A photograph can display an orange sky in another tool because its colour channels are ordered differently. In Workshop 2, OpenCV reads B, G, R while Matplotlib displays R, G, B. Image calculations also depend on data type: uint8 ranges from 0 to 255, and arithmetic results outside that range can wrap around.

chain.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
chain.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

chain.zh: 不同工具的颜色通道顺序可能不同，交换顺序前需要确认输入和输出的约定（<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>）。整数类型的取值范围也会影响计算结果（<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>）；计算前应选择足以容纳结果的类型。
chain.en: Tools may use different channel orders, so check input and output conventions before rearranging them (<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>). Integer ranges also affect computed results (<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>); choose a type that can hold the result before computing.

naive.zh: 检查关卡中的特征错解：它必须在改变结构、符号或边界的测试中失败。
naive.en: The characteristic wrong method must fail a changed structural, sign or boundary case.

why.zh: 共享相机引入之后，场景歧义与图像变换是两个独立的必修问题；下一章同时建立在图像处理能力与观测局限上。
why.en: After the shared camera opening, scene ambiguity and image transformation are independent required questions. The next chapter uses both processing abilities and limits of observation.

about.zh: 提供语义采样、邻域、书写核、向量长度和颜色组合工具，以及可编辑预接电路
about.en: Supply semantic sampling, neighbourhoods, kernels, vector length, colour mixture and editable starter circuits

body.zh: 图像可按行、列存成数表。<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>的形状是高 × 宽；<wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref> 图是高 × 宽 × 3，每格三个分量。这里讨论数学表示，按 (x,y) 指定列与行。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 22。
body.en: An image is a table of rows and columns: height × width in greyscale, height × width × 3 in <wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref>. This is a mathematical representation; (x,y) specifies column and row. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 22. (<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>)

body.zh: <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>通常从左上角开始：x 向右增加，y 向下增加，并且通常从 0 开始编号。这和数学课上 y 轴向上的笛卡尔坐标不一样。常见的误解：以为 y 轴向上增大；或以为数组下标先写 x 再写 y。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§3 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>坐标、数据类型和文件格式 (slide 26)。
body.en: Image arrays usually start from the top-left corner: x increases to the right, y increases downwards, and numbering usually starts from 0. This differs from the Cartesian coordinates of maths lessons, where the y-axis points upwards. A common mistake: Thinking y increases upwards; or thinking array indices are written with x first and then y. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §3 (slide 26). (<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>) (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

body.zh: 在图像外补<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>可使输出与输入同尺寸。Constant/zero 补固定值，简单但可能制造黑边；Wrap 把左接右、上接下，适合 tileable 纹理而不适合普通照片；Clamp/replicate 把边缘像素向外延伸，普通照片通常较自然；Reflect 镜像延伸，常能减少人工边界。没有一种规则永远最好，要看图像是否周期性、任务是否关心边缘及滤波器性质。常见的误解：以为补零总是最好的默认选择。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§4 四种常见边界规则 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45)。
body.en: Padding <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> outside the image lets the output be the same size as the input. Constant/zero fills with a fixed value, which is simple but may create black borders; Wrap joins left to right and top to bottom, which suits tileable textures but not ordinary photos; Clamp/replicate extends the edge pixel outwards, which usually looks more natural for ordinary photos; Reflect extends by mirroring and often reduces artificial borders. No rule is always best; it depends on whether the image is periodic, whether the task cares about the edges and the properties of the filter. A common mistake: Thinking zero padding is always the best default choice. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §4 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45).

body.zh: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>满足交换律 f*h=h*f、结合律 f*h₁*h₂=f*(h₁*h₂)、分配律（滤波器可分配到相加的图像上）和标量结合律 k(f*h)=(kf)*h=f*(kh)。这些性质帮助重排计算。理论上可以交换或合并操作，但实际还要考虑图像大小、内存访问、是否需要中间结果和程序库实现。常见的误解：以为数学上可交换就一定更快。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§3 线性滤波的四个代数性质 (slide 37)。
body.en: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> satisfies commutativity f*h=h*f, associativity f*h₁*h₂=f*(h₁*h₂), distributivity (a filter distributes over images that are added together) and scalar associativity k(f*h)=(kf)*h=f*(kh). These properties help rearrange the computation. In theory operations can be swapped or combined, but in practice you also have to consider image size, memory access, whether intermediate results are needed and the library's implementation. A common mistake: Thinking that being mathematically interchangeable necessarily makes it faster. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §3 (slide 37).

body.zh: 若二维核可写成一个列向量与一个行向量的外积，就叫可分离，此时可先对每一行做一维滤波，再对每一列做一维滤波。k×k 核每<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>约需 k² 次乘法，拆开后约需 2k 次，k 大时差别明显。高斯核常常接近或可以构造成可分离核。常见的误解：以为任何二维核都能拆成两个一维核。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§3 可分离滤波：把二维计算拆成两次一维计算 (slides 39, 40)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: If a 2D <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> can be written as the outer product of a column vector and a row vector, it is called separable; you can then first apply a 1D filter to each row and then a 1D filter to each column. A k×k kernel needs about k² multiplications per <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>; split up, it needs about 2k, and the difference is significant when k is large. Gaussian kernels are often close to separable or can be constructed to be separable. A common mistake: Thinking any 2D kernel can be split into two 1D kernels. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §3 (slides 39, 40).

body.zh: 均值滤波给邻域每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>相同权重；高斯滤波离中心越近权重越大，形式为 G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²))。σ 控制影响范围，σ 越大模糊越强。模糊核通常归一化使权重和为 1，以免改变整体平均亮度；两种核都减少细节，但权重分配不同，保留的细节也不同。常见的误解：以为高斯模糊和均值模糊效果完全一样，或忘记归一化。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§2 模糊：让变化变慢 (slides 27, 28)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: A mean filter gives every <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> in the neighbourhood the same weight; a Gaussian filter gives larger weights the closer a pixel is to the centre, in the form G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²)). σ controls the extent of the influence: the larger σ, the stronger the blur. A blur <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> is usually normalised so that the weights sum to 1, so as not to change the overall average brightness; both kernels reduce detail, but they distribute the weights differently, so they preserve different detail. A common mistake: Thinking Gaussian blur and mean blur have exactly the same effect, or forgetting to normalise. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 (slides 27, 28).

body.zh: 二维图像 f(x,y) 的梯度是 ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ。幅度 ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) 表示变化有多强，方向 θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) 表示变化最快的方向。常见的误解：把梯度方向当成边缘的走向。出处：COMP90086 第 5 讲笔记，§3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 40)。
body.en: The gradient of a 2D image f(x,y) is ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ. The magnitude ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) indicates how strong the change is, and the direction θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) indicates the direction of fastest change. A common mistake: Taking the gradient direction to be the direction in which the edge runs. Source: COMP90086 lecture 5 notes, §3 (slide 40).

body.zh: 把核反向后沿输入滑动，逐项相乘求和。一维反转左、右顺序，二维反转两个方向（旋转 180°）。本游戏的行、列滤波部件直接使用位置权重，需要在接线时安排翻转。 出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 9–17。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: A weighted sum over a sliding input window with the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> reversed: reverse left/right in 1D, and both axes (180° rotation) in 2D. The row and column filter parts use positional weights directly, so wire the reversal when required. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17.

body.zh: 将窗口中的值与相同位置的核权重相乘再求和，不翻转核。它与<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的差别在非对称权重上才会显现。 出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 9–17。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: Multiply each window value by the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> weight at the same position and sum, without flipping the kernel. Asymmetric weights expose its difference from <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17.

step.why: Rebuild trial around computer-vision theory and visual problem solving; supply technical arithmetic and wiring

t.zh: 处理照片边缘时，窗口的一部分会落到画面之外。如果仍要保留原图尺寸，应如何处理缺失的邻居？本关采用<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>中的补零规则；比较边缘与内部的相同输入，观察输出是否仍然相同。
t.en: At a photograph’s edge, part of the processing window falls outside the image. How should missing neighbours be handled if the output is to retain the original size? Use zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>, then compare equal inputs at the edge and in the interior.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和左、中、右三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the left, centre and right weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside

after.zh: 尺寸保住了，边界却加入了人为假设：补零会在边缘引入与内部不同的邻居。输出两端变暗不能直接当成场景中的真实边缘，后面找变化时也必须记得这一点。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
after.en: The size is preserved, but an artificial boundary assumption was added. Zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> introduces neighbours unlike the interior. Darkened ends need not be real scene boundaries; remember this when detecting changes.

brief.zh: 三个权重都是 1/3（求左中右的平均），图外补 0：写出和原图一样宽的结果。
brief.en: All three weights 1/3 (the average of left, here and right), 0 outside: write the result, as wide as the row.

hint.zh: 最左一格的左邻在图外，算作 0。
hint.en: The leftmost cell's left neighbour is outside and counts as 0.

why.zh: 这是图外取最近的边：题目约定图外补 0，两端只有两个 3 和一个 0，平均是 2。
why.en: That reads the nearest edge outside: here 0 is padded outside, so each end averages two 3s and a 0, giving 2.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取 0。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read 0 outside the image.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：输出和原图一样宽，每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give an output as wide as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 这回输出的第 x 格就以原图的 x 为中心。
hint.en: Now the output's cell x is centred on the original x.

title.zh: 照片：观测、位置与重采样

question.zh: 图像说明了什么，又怎样改变图像而不混淆信息？
question.en: What does an image establish, and how can we transform it without confusing its information?

title.zh: 邻域：平滑、方向与视觉测量

question.zh: 怎样利用邻居压低干扰、保留变化，并理解处理的代价？
question.en: How can neighbours reduce nuisance, retain changes and expose the cost of processing?

t.zh: 相机已经能确定光落在哪里；接下来，处理器需要读出照片中的明暗。照片在电路里以<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>传递，而非一个数。本阶段只处理<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>。先按<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>找到某格，再读出其中的数值；位置和读数是不同的信息。
t.en: The camera can locate incoming light. The processor now needs the photograph’s intensity values. A photograph travels through the circuit as an <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>, rather than one number. This stage uses a <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>. Locate a cell using the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>, then read the value it contains. A position and a reading are different information.

t.zh: A、B 各是一个输入元件，x、y 输出口分别给出列与行，数值随测试变化。测试给出这两个位置，但明暗变化要比较它们的读数。<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>有图、x、y 三个输入口；输出的是所选格的值。先分别观察读数，再判断从 A 走到 B 是变亮、变暗还是不变。<part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref>保留差值的正负。
t.en: A and B are each one input part: their x and y outputs give column and row, changing with the test. Tests supply these positions, but intensity change compares their readings. <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> takes an image, x and y; its output is the selected value. Inspect both readings, then decide whether going from A to B is brighter, darker or unchanged. <part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref> preserves the sign of a difference.

after.zh: 图像中的数值与位置共同决定了读到的内容。<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>使定位和比较邻近<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>成为可能；坐标顺序不一致则可能读到或修改错误的位置。
after.en: Image values and positions together determine what is read. The <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> makes it possible to locate and compare neighbouring <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>; inconsistent coordinate order can select or change the wrong position.

brief.zh: 输入一张图与 A、B 两点的坐标：输出 B 的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>值减去 A 的值。坐标先写列 x，再写行 y；编号从 0 开始。
brief.en: Given an image and coordinates for A and B, output the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> value at B minus the value at A. Coordinates give column x before row y, indexed from 0.

hint.zh: 分别检查两个取值是否来自正确的位置，再检查差值的正负。行与列写反可能仍得到一个数，但不能通过所有图像的测试。
hint.en: Check the two addressed values before checking the sign of their difference. Swapping row and column can still produce a number, but fails across the images.

t.zh: 比较器已经能读取任意两点。现在只给一个位置，另一点始终在它右侧：保留同一行，找出应当怎样从 x 得到另一个列坐标，再把寻址和比较组合起来。
t.en: The comparator can read any two points. Now only one position is supplied, and the other is always its right neighbour. Keep the row, work out the second column from x, then combine addressing and comparison.

brief.zh: 输入一张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
brief.en: Given a <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

hint.zh: 取<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的两个坐标口，哪个是列、哪个是行？
hint.en: Of the lookup's two coordinate inputs, which is the column and which the row? (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

title.zh: 照片：观测、位置与重采样

question.zh: 图像说明了什么，又怎样改变图像而不混淆信息？
question.en: What does an image establish, and how can we transform it without confusing its information?

title.zh: 邻域：平滑、方向与视觉测量

question.zh: 怎样利用邻居压低干扰、保留变化，并理解处理的代价？
question.en: How can neighbours reduce nuisance, retain changes and expose the cost of processing?

t.zh: 照片中的一个亮点会影响周围多个位置。二维处理能否由横向和纵向两次处理组成？结合已验证的方向约定与行列读取方式，用<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>追踪一个输入对各输出的贡献，再组合已有元件。
t.en: A bright point in a photograph can influence several nearby positions. Can a two-dimensional operation be composed from horizontal and vertical passes? Using the established orientation and row and column addressing conventions, trace one input’s contributions with <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>, then combine the existing parts.

desc.zh: 输入图像与按书写顺序给出的行核、列核，先横后竖计算二维卷积；图外补零。
desc.en: Given an image and row and column kernels in written order, computes 2D convolution across rows then columns, with zero padding.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>中，横向与纵向的权重共同决定二维邻域中各位置的贡献。只有满足可分解条件的<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>才能这样处理，并非任意二维核都适用。
after.en: In a <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>, horizontal and vertical weights jointly determine each position’s contribution to the two-dimensional neighbourhood. This applies only to separable <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>, not every two-dimensional kernel.

brief.zh: 行权重 [1,2,1]、列权重 [1,0,−1]。追踪每个行权重经由列处理的贡献，写出组合后的 3×3 权重表。
brief.en: Row weights [1,2,1], column weights [1,0,−1]. Track each horizontal contribution through the column pass and fill the combined 3×3 weights.

hint.zh: 先跟踪中心行：列权重是 0 时，已有的横向结果还贡献多少？再比较上、下两行。
hint.en: Track the centre row first: what survives a column weight of 0? Then compare the upper and lower rows.

why.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重，遗漏了竖直方向的贡献：中间一行的列权重为 0，另一行的列权重为 −1，因而会出现零值和符号翻转。
why.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows and omits the vertical contribution: the middle row has column weight 0 and another row has weight −1, producing zeros and a sign reversal.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、按书写顺序给出的行、列<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>（h1、h2、h3 与 v1、v2、v3）。输出二维<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的结果，采用零<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>；两组输入不是窗口位置权重。
brief.en: Given an image and written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pairs for rows (h1,h2,h3) and columns (v1,v2,v3), output the 2D <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> using zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>. These inputs are not positional window weights.

hint.zh: 回看<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的方向实验。行、列部件都直接按位置乘权重，怎样让它们服从题目给出的书写<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>？
hint.en: Revisit the orientation experiment in <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>. Both row and column parts multiply positional weights directly; how can they implement the written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pair?

title.zh: 照片：观测、位置与重采样

question.zh: 图像说明了什么，又怎样改变图像而不混淆信息？
question.en: What does an image establish, and how can we transform it without confusing its information?

title.zh: 邻域：平滑、方向与视觉测量

question.zh: 怎样利用邻居压低干扰、保留变化，并理解处理的代价？
question.en: How can neighbours reduce nuisance, retain changes and expose the cost of processing?

t.zh: 图像中的变化既可能沿水平方向出现，也可能沿竖直方向出现。要沿列应用<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>，需要读取哪些邻居？先在窗口中追踪一列，保持 x 不变、改变 y，再将读取方式用于整张图。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
t.en: Changes in an image can run vertically as well as horizontally. Which neighbours are needed to apply a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> down a column? Track one column in the window, keeping x fixed and varying y, then extend the addressing to the whole image. (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)

desc.zh: 输入一张图和上、中、下三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the above, centre and below weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside

after.zh: 横向与纵向<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>使用相同的计算结构，区别在于邻居的位置。使用非方形图和不对称内容，有助于发现坐标方向混淆。
after.en: Horizontal and vertical <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> share the same computational structure but address different neighbours. Non-square images with asymmetric content help expose confusion between coordinate directions.

brief.zh: 使用上、中、下权重 [1,0,−1]，图外补零，写出每格结果。窗口可左右选择列、上下移动中心。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
brief.en: Use above/centre/below weights [1,0,−1] with zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>. Write every result. Choose a column and move its centre vertically.

hint.zh: 比较同一列上、下的值；不能横向取邻居。
hint.en: Compare above and below in the same column, not horizontal neighbours.

why.zh: 这组数把每一对上下差都当成了 0。固定一列上下移动窗口，检查相邻数值并不相等的位置。
why.en: These values treat every above–below difference as zero. Keep one column fixed and move the window vertically to inspect unequal neighbours.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 和行滤波器比，变的是哪个坐标？
hint.en: Compared with the row filter, which coordinate changes?

title.zh: 照片：观测、位置与重采样

question.zh: 图像说明了什么，又怎样改变图像而不混淆信息？
question.en: What does an image establish, and how can we transform it without confusing its information?

title.zh: 邻域：平滑、方向与视觉测量

question.zh: 怎样利用邻居压低干扰、保留变化，并理解处理的代价？
question.en: How can neighbours reduce nuisance, retain changes and expose the cost of processing?

body.zh: 将窗口中的值与相同位置的核权重相乘再求和，不翻转核。它与<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的差别在非对称权重上才会显现。 出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 9–17。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: Multiply each window value by the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> weight at the same position and sum, without flipping the kernel. Asymmetric weights expose its difference from <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17.

body.zh: 把核反向后沿输入滑动，逐项相乘求和。一维反转左、右顺序，二维反转两个方向（旋转 180°）。本游戏的行、列滤波部件直接使用位置权重，需要在接线时安排翻转。 出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲，slides 9–17。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: A weighted sum over a sliding input window with the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> reversed: reverse left/right in 1D, and both axes (180° rotation) in 2D. The row and column filter parts use positional weights directly, so wire the reversal when required. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 3, slides 9–17.

body.zh: 二维图像 f(x,y) 的梯度是 ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ。幅度 ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) 表示变化有多强，方向 θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) 表示变化最快的方向。常见的误解：把梯度方向当成边缘的走向。出处：COMP90086 第 5 讲笔记，§3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 40)。
body.en: The gradient of a 2D image f(x,y) is ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ. The magnitude ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) indicates how strong the change is, and the direction θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) indicates the direction of fastest change. A common mistake: Taking the gradient direction to be the direction in which the edge runs. Source: COMP90086 lecture 5 notes, §3 (slide 40).

body.zh: 均值滤波给邻域每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>相同权重；高斯滤波离中心越近权重越大，形式为 G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²))。σ 控制影响范围，σ 越大模糊越强。模糊核通常归一化使权重和为 1，以免改变整体平均亮度；两种核都减少细节，但权重分配不同，保留的细节也不同。常见的误解：以为高斯模糊和均值模糊效果完全一样，或忘记归一化。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§2 模糊：让变化变慢 (slides 27, 28)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: A mean filter gives every <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> in the neighbourhood the same weight; a Gaussian filter gives larger weights the closer a pixel is to the centre, in the form G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²)). σ controls the extent of the influence: the larger σ, the stronger the blur. A blur <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> is usually normalised so that the weights sum to 1, so as not to change the overall average brightness; both kernels reduce detail, but they distribute the weights differently, so they preserve different detail. A common mistake: Thinking Gaussian blur and mean blur have exactly the same effect, or forgetting to normalise. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 (slides 27, 28).

body.zh: 若二维核可写成一个列向量与一个行向量的外积，就叫可分离，此时可先对每一行做一维滤波，再对每一列做一维滤波。k×k 核每<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>约需 k² 次乘法，拆开后约需 2k 次，k 大时差别明显。高斯核常常接近或可以构造成可分离核。常见的误解：以为任何二维核都能拆成两个一维核。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§3 可分离滤波：把二维计算拆成两次一维计算 (slides 39, 40)。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
body.en: If a 2D <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> can be written as the outer product of a column vector and a row vector, it is called separable; you can then first apply a 1D filter to each row and then a 1D filter to each column. A k×k kernel needs about k² multiplications per <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>; split up, it needs about 2k, and the difference is significant when k is large. Gaussian kernels are often close to separable or can be constructed to be separable. A common mistake: Thinking any 2D kernel can be split into two 1D kernels. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §3 (slides 39, 40).

body.zh: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>满足交换律 f*h=h*f、结合律 f*h₁*h₂=f*(h₁*h₂)、分配律（滤波器可分配到相加的图像上）和标量结合律 k(f*h)=(kf)*h=f*(kh)。这些性质帮助重排计算。理论上可以交换或合并操作，但实际还要考虑图像大小、内存访问、是否需要中间结果和程序库实现。常见的误解：以为数学上可交换就一定更快。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§3 线性滤波的四个代数性质 (slide 37)。
body.en: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> satisfies commutativity f*h=h*f, associativity f*h₁*h₂=f*(h₁*h₂), distributivity (a filter distributes over images that are added together) and scalar associativity k(f*h)=(kf)*h=f*(kh). These properties help rearrange the computation. In theory operations can be swapped or combined, but in practice you also have to consider image size, memory access, whether intermediate results are needed and the library's implementation. A common mistake: Thinking that being mathematically interchangeable necessarily makes it faster. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §3 (slide 37).

body.zh: 在图像外补<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>可使输出与输入同尺寸。Constant/zero 补固定值，简单但可能制造黑边；Wrap 把左接右、上接下，适合 tileable 纹理而不适合普通照片；Clamp/replicate 把边缘像素向外延伸，普通照片通常较自然；Reflect 镜像延伸，常能减少人工边界。没有一种规则永远最好，要看图像是否周期性、任务是否关心边缘及滤波器性质。常见的误解：以为补零总是最好的默认选择。出处：COMP90086 第 3 讲笔记，§4 四种常见边界规则 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45)。
body.en: Padding <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> outside the image lets the output be the same size as the input. Constant/zero fills with a fixed value, which is simple but may create black borders; Wrap joins left to right and top to bottom, which suits tileable textures but not ordinary photos; Clamp/replicate extends the edge pixel outwards, which usually looks more natural for ordinary photos; Reflect extends by mirroring and often reduces artificial borders. No rule is always best; it depends on whether the image is periodic, whether the task cares about the edges and the properties of the filter. A common mistake: Thinking zero padding is always the best default choice. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §4 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45).

body.zh: <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>通常从左上角开始：x 向右增加，y 向下增加，并且通常从 0 开始编号。这和数学课上 y 轴向上的笛卡尔坐标不一样。常见的误解：以为 y 轴向上增大；或以为数组下标先写 x 再写 y。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§3 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>坐标、数据类型和文件格式 (slide 26)。
body.en: Image arrays usually start from the top-left corner: x increases to the right, y increases downwards, and numbering usually starts from 0. This differs from the Cartesian coordinates of maths lessons, where the y-axis points upwards. A common mistake: Thinking y increases upwards; or thinking array indices are written with x first and then y. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §3 (slide 26). (<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>) (<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>)

body.zh: 图像可按行、列存成数表。<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>的形状是高 × 宽；<wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref> 图是高 × 宽 × 3，每格三个分量。这里讨论数学表示，按 (x,y) 指定列与行。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，slide 22。
body.en: An image is a table of rows and columns: height × width in greyscale, height × width × 3 in <wiki-ref to="rgb"></wiki-ref>. This is a mathematical representation; (x,y) specifies column and row. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slide 22. (<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>)

learner.zh: 学过编程和中学数学、没有学过计算机视觉的学习者（COMP90086 的学生）
learner.en: Learners who can program and know school mathematics but have not studied computer vision (COMP90086 students)

endpoint.zh: 一章一章造出视觉的机器：相机、卷积器，往后是卷积网络、注意力和全景拼接器；每个部件在后面的章里直接复用。
endpoint.en: Build the machines of vision chapter by chapter: a camera, a convolver, later a convolutional network, attention and a panorama stitcher, each part reused in the chapters after.

scope.zh: 第 1–2 章（讲义第 1–3 讲和第 5 讲的梯度），依据 docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/knowledge-map-1-12.md 的章节方案：相机（投影、像素焦距、数表、裁剪、最近邻、双线性）和卷积器（滑动加权、补边、翻转、可分离、高斯、Sobel、梯度、彩色卷积）。Workshop 内容做成可选专题。
scope.en: Chapters 1–2 (lectures 1–3 and the gradient of lecture 5), after the chapter plan in docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/vision-game-specs/knowledge-map-1-12.md: the camera (projection, focal length in pixels, the table of numbers, cropping, nearest neighbour, bilinear) and the convolver (sliding weighted sums, padding, flipping, separable, Gaussian, Sobel, the gradient, colour convolution). Workshop content is optional topics.

where.zh: 每关最后一步：把关系接成电路，做出的板成为后面的部件
where.en: The last step of most levels: the relation wired as a circuit, the board a part for later

why.zh: 《图灵完备》式的抽象：造出的部件在后面直接调用，复杂的机器由简单的部件一层层搭起
why.en: Turing Complete's abstraction: parts built are called directly later, complex machines built up from simple parts

where.zh: 动手算：读图、裁剪、取值、卷积核
where.en: Working by hand: reading, cropping, sampling, kernels

why.zh: 先亲手当一回机器，电路才有前因
why.en: Acting as the machine first gives the circuit its reason

where.zh: 针孔相机台：投影、视场
where.en: The pinhole bench: projection, field of view

why.zh: 连续量的关系先预测再检查
why.en: Relations between continuous quantities, predicted, then checked

about.zh: 针孔相机台
about.en: The pinhole camera bench

about.zh: 读写像素格（grid 任务）
about.en: Read and write pixel grids (grid tasks)

about.zh: 图像电路：搭出的板成为部件
about.en: Image circuits: a board built becomes a part

lacks.zh: 它只会把场景拍成数表、按位置取值：不会把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算。
lacks.en: It only pictures a scene as a table and reads values at positions: it cannot combine a pixel with its neighbours.

lacks.zh: 每个输出只是邻域的加权和，权重是人定的：它不会自己学出权重，这是卷积网络存在的理由。
lacks.en: Each output is a weighted sum over a neighbourhood with weights set by hand: it cannot learn them, the reason convolutional networks exist.

about.zh: 针孔相机中，三维点 P=(x,y,z) 投到成像平面上的 (x_i,y_i)，pinhole 到成像平面的距离为 f（焦距）。由相似三角形得 x_i = f·x/z，y_i = f·y/z：同样大小的物体，z 越大投影越小，f 越大投影越大。真实相机还要把世界坐标转成相机坐标，并考虑主点、像素尺寸和镜头畸变，但这个小模型是之后相机几何的基础。
about.en: In a pinhole camera, a 3D point P=(x,y,z) projects to (x_i,y_i) on the image plane, and the distance from the pinhole to the image plane is f (the focal length). By similar triangles, x_i = f·x/z, y_i = f·y/z: for objects of the same size, the larger z, the smaller the projection, and the larger f, the larger the projection. A real camera also has to convert world coordinates into camera coordinates and account for the principal point, pixel size and lens distortion, but this small model is the foundation for the camera geometry that follows.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 针孔相机模型：先学最简单的投影 (slide 11)

wall.zh: 物体距离加倍、焦距不变时，投影大小怎样变？
wall.en: If an object's distance doubles and the focal length stays the same, how does the size of its projection change?

misconception.zh: 以为可以由 (x_i,y_i) 反过来唯一求出 (x,y,z)；一个像素坐标只确定一条视线，深度未知。
misconception.en: Thinking you can recover (x,y,z) uniquely from (x_i,y_i); a pixel coordinate determines only a line of sight, and the depth is unknown.

term.zh: 正向问题与反向问题：图形学与视觉

about.zh: 计算机图形学已知物体、材质、灯光和相机，向前生成一张图像，是正向问题；计算机视觉已知图像，反过来推测物体、材质、灯光和相机，是反向问题。反问题通常更难，因为不同的三维场景可能产生很相似的二维图像。
about.en: Computer graphics knows the objects, materials, lighting and camera and works forwards to produce an image: a forward problem. Computer vision knows the image and works backwards to infer the objects, materials, lighting and camera: an inverse problem. The inverse problem is usually harder, because different 3D scenes can produce very similar 2D images.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/01-introduction.md §2 计算机视觉和计算机图形学的方向相反 (slide 8)

wall.zh: 为什么同一张照片可能对应不同的三维场景？
wall.en: Why can the same photo correspond to different 3D scenes?

misconception.zh: 以为只要图像足够清晰就能唯一还原三维场景；不同三维场景可能产生相似的二维图像。
misconception.en: Thinking that as long as the image is clear enough, the 3D scene can be recovered uniquely; different 3D scenes can produce similar 2D images.

term.en: angle of view and focal length

about.zh: 在数字图像中焦距常用像素表示：它只是把物理焦距除以像素尺寸，换成图像坐标单位。例如图像宽 2000 像素、主点在中间、焦距 1000 像素时，左右各约 45°，总视野范围约 90°。
about.en: In digital images the focal length is often expressed in pixels: this divides the physical focal length by the pixel size, converting it into image-coordinate units. For example, if the image is 2000 pixels wide, the principal point is in the middle and the focal length is 1000 pixels, each side spans about 45°, giving a total field of view of about 90°.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §2 焦距与视野范围 (slide 15)

wall.zh: 怎样把主体拍大而不裁掉它，并排除不同距离的干扰物？
wall.en: How can a subject be made large without cropping it while excluding a distracting object at a different depth?

misconception.zh: 把以像素为单位的焦距和以毫米为单位的焦距直接比较或混用。
misconception.en: Directly comparing or mixing up a focal length in pixels with a focal length in millimetres.

about.zh: 灰度图按行、列存储亮度样本；坐标指定位置，取样得到该位置的值。
about.en: A greyscale image stores intensity samples by row and column; coordinates specify a position, and sampling returns its value.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §3 数字图像是怎样存储的 (slides 22, 25)

wall.zh: 位置与明暗读数怎样分别表示，才能比较两个位置？
wall.en: How do positions differ from readings when comparing two image locations?

misconception.zh: 把坐标当作读数，或把行列顺序颠倒。
misconception.en: Confusing coordinates with readings, or swapping row and column order.

about.zh: Crop 从原数组取一个子区域，已有像素数值不变；Resize 改变数组尺寸，必须为新位置计算像素数值。直接把 768×512 压成 512×512 会改变宽高比，物体可能变胖或变瘦；若保持比例，目标尺寸应接近 512×341。
about.en: Cropping takes a sub-region of the original array, and the existing pixel values are unchanged; resizing changes the size of the array, so pixel values must be computed for the new positions. Squashing 768×512 straight to 512×512 changes the aspect ratio, so objects may become fatter or thinner; if the proportions are kept, the target size should be about 512×341.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 裁剪与缩放不是一回事 (slide 34)

wall.zh: 把 768×512 图像缩到 512 并保持比例，另一边应是多少？裁剪和缩放哪个需要计算新像素值？
wall.en: If a 768×512 image is resized to 512 while keeping its proportions, what should the other side be? Which of cropping and resizing requires new pixel values to be computed?

misconception.zh: 以为裁剪也要插值，或以为缩放只是“截掉一部分”。
misconception.en: Thinking cropping also requires interpolation, or that resizing is just ‘cutting off a part’.

about.zh: 最近邻插值对每个新像素，找到原图中最近的像素，直接复制它的值。优点是快、边缘硬；缺点是放大或缩小时容易出现明显的方块感或锯齿。
about.en: For each new pixel, nearest-neighbour interpolation finds the nearest pixel in the original image and copies its value directly. Its advantages are speed and hard edges; its drawback is that enlarging or shrinking easily produces obvious blockiness or jagged edges.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 最近邻插值 (slide 35)

wall.zh: 用最近邻把图像放大 4 倍，为什么会出现方块感？
wall.en: Why does enlarging an image 4 times with nearest neighbour make it look blocky?

misconception.zh: 以为最近邻会产生原图中没有的新数值；它只复制已有值。
misconception.en: Thinking nearest neighbour produces new values not present in the original image; it only copies existing values.

about.zh: 新位置落在四个旧像素之间时，设横向距离为 H、纵向距离为 V，四个权重是 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV；它们加起来等于 1，所以双线性插值本质上是四个邻居的加权平均。它通常比最近邻平滑，但会让非常锐利的边缘稍微软化，老师说它把模糊并入了采样步骤；缩图时仍要根据采样比例检查是否需要额外抗混叠。
about.en: When a new position falls between four old pixels, let the horizontal distance be H and the vertical distance be V; the four weights are (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V and HV. They sum to 1, so bilinear interpolation is essentially a weighted average of the four neighbours. It is usually smoother than nearest neighbour, but slightly softens very sharp edges; the lecturer says it folds blurring into the sampling step. When downsizing, you should still check, based on the sampling ratio, whether extra anti-aliasing is needed.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 双线性插值 (slide 36)

wall.zh: 新像素落在四个旧像素之间时，双线性插值怎样得到它的值？四个权重为什么加起来等于 1？
wall.en: When a new pixel falls between four old pixels, how does bilinear interpolation obtain its value? Why do the four weights sum to 1?

misconception.zh: 把权重配反（让离得远的像素权重更大）；或以为双线性插值不会改变锐利边缘。
misconception.en: Assigning the weights the wrong way round (giving more distant pixels larger weights); or thinking bilinear interpolation does not alter sharp edges.

term.zh: 线性滤波公式（滑动加权和）
term.en: Linear filtering / convolution formula (sliding weighted sum)

about.zh: 把卷积核放在图像的一个位置，对齐后逐项相乘再相加，写作 g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v)，其中 f 是输入、h 是核权重、g 是输出、(u,v) 是邻域内偏移。式中的 i−u、j−v 表示卷积；按窗口直接对齐相乘的互相关则读作 i+u、j+v。中心权重为 1、其余为 0 时两者都只是复制当前像素。
about.en: Place the kernel at one position in the image, align it, multiply element by element and then add up, written as g(i,j)=Σ_{u,v} h(u,v) f(i−u,j−v), where f is the input, h the kernel weights, g the output and (u,v) the offset within the neighbourhood. The i−u, j−v in the formula denote convolution; cross-correlation, which multiplies directly with the window aligned, reads i+u, j+v instead. When the centre weight is 1 and all others are 0, both copy the current pixel.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §1 线性滤波到底在算什么 (slide 9)

wall.zh: g(i,j)=Σh(u,v)f(i−u,j−v) 中的负号意味着核被怎样使用？
wall.en: What does the minus sign in g(i,j)=Σh(u,v)f(i−u,j−v) imply about how the kernel is used?

misconception.zh: 以为公式里的 i−u 与窗口直接对齐相乘是同一件事。
misconception.en: Thinking the i−u in the formula is the same thing as multiplying directly with the window aligned.

term.en: Padding / border handling (constant, wrap, clamp, reflect)

about.zh: 在图像外补像素可使输出与输入同尺寸。Constant/zero 补固定值，简单但可能制造黑边；Wrap 把左接右、上接下，适合 tileable 纹理而不适合普通照片；Clamp/replicate 把边缘像素向外延伸，普通照片通常较自然；Reflect 镜像延伸，常能减少人工边界。没有一种规则永远最好，要看图像是否周期性、任务是否关心边缘及滤波器性质。
about.en: Padding pixels outside the image lets the output be the same size as the input. Constant/zero fills with a fixed value, which is simple but may create black borders; Wrap joins left to right and top to bottom, which suits tileable textures but not ordinary photos; Clamp/replicate extends the edge pixels outwards, which usually looks more natural for ordinary photos; Reflect extends by mirroring and often reduces artificial borders. No rule is always best; it depends on whether the image is periodic, whether the task cares about the edges and the properties of the filter.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §4 四种常见边界规则 (slides 42, 43, 44, 45)

wall.zh: 普通照片做模糊时，zero 补边可能产生什么伪影？
wall.en: When blurring an ordinary photo, what artefact might zero padding produce?

misconception.zh: 以为补零总是最好的默认选择。
misconception.en: Thinking zero padding is always the best default choice.

term.zh: 卷积与互相关（是否翻转卷积核）

about.zh: 两者都做“滑动、相乘、相加”，唯一关键区别是卷积先把核旋转 180° 再使用，互相关直接使用。核关于中心对称时两者结果相同；核不对称时方向会改变。手算前要先确定是否翻核。
about.en: Both do ‘slide, multiply, add’; the only key difference is that convolution first rotates the kernel by 180° before using it, whereas cross-correlation uses it directly. When the kernel is symmetric about its centre the two give the same result; when it is not, the direction changes. Before calculating by hand, first decide whether to flip the kernel.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §1 互相关和卷积 (slide 17)

wall.zh: 同一个非对称核，卷积与互相关为什么会给出不同结果？
wall.en: Why do convolution and cross-correlation give different results for the same asymmetric kernel?

misconception.zh: 以为翻转只是左右翻，或以为任何核卷积与互相关结果都不同。
misconception.en: Thinking the flip is only a left–right flip, or thinking convolution and cross-correlation give different results for every kernel.

about.zh: 若二维核可写成一个列向量与一个行向量的外积，就叫可分离，此时可先对每一行做一维滤波，再对每一列做一维滤波。k×k 核每像素约需 k² 次乘法，拆开后约需 2k 次，k 大时差别明显。高斯核常常接近或可以构造成可分离核。
about.en: If a 2D kernel can be written as the outer product of a column vector and a row vector, it is called separable; you can then first apply a 1D filter to each row and then a 1D filter to each column. A k×k kernel needs about k² multiplications per pixel; split up, it needs about 2k, and the difference is significant when k is large. Gaussian kernels are often close to separable or can be constructed to be separable.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §3 可分离滤波：把二维计算拆成两次一维计算 (slides 39, 40)

wall.zh: 为什么可分离的二维核能用两次一维计算完成？
wall.en: Why can a separable 2D kernel be computed with two 1D passes?

misconception.zh: 以为任何二维核都能拆成两个一维核。
misconception.en: Thinking any 2D kernel can be split into two 1D kernels.

term.zh: 均值滤波与高斯滤波（模糊）

about.zh: 均值滤波给邻域每个像素相同权重；高斯滤波离中心越近权重越大，形式为 G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²))。σ 控制影响范围，σ 越大模糊越强。模糊核通常归一化使权重和为 1，以免改变整体平均亮度；两种核都减少细节，但权重分配不同，保留的细节也不同。
about.en: A mean filter gives every pixel in the neighbourhood the same weight; a Gaussian filter gives larger weights the closer a pixel is to the centre, in the form G_σ(x,y)=1/(2πσ²)·exp(−(x²+y²)/(2σ²)). σ controls the extent of the influence: the larger σ, the stronger the blur. Blur kernels are usually normalised so that the weights sum to 1, so as not to change the overall average brightness; both kernels reduce detail, but they distribute the weights differently, so they preserve different detail.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 模糊：让变化变慢 (slides 27, 28)

wall.zh: 为什么模糊核的权重和要为 1？σ 增大会怎样？
wall.en: Why should the weights of a blur kernel sum to 1? What happens as σ increases?

misconception.zh: 以为高斯模糊和均值模糊效果完全一样，或忘记归一化。
misconception.en: Thinking Gaussian blur and mean blur have exactly the same effect, or forgetting to normalise.

about.zh: Sobel 核近似计算横向和纵向两个方向的导数：S_x=[[1,0,−1],[2,0,−2],[1,0,−1]]，S_y=[[1,2,1],[0,0,0],[−1,−2,−1]]。平坦区域左右或上下差异小，响应接近 0；边缘附近差异大，响应较大。两张图分别找沿相应方向变化快的位置。
about.en: The Sobel kernels approximate the derivatives in the horizontal and vertical directions: S_x=[[1,0,−1],[2,0,−2],[1,0,−1]], S_y=[[1,2,1],[0,0,0],[−1,−2,−1]]. In flat regions the left–right or up–down differences are small and the response is close to 0; near edges the differences are large and the response is larger. The two output images each find where the change along the corresponding direction is fast.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 Sobel：找变化快的地方 (slides 29, 30)

wall.zh: S_x 在平坦区域与竖直边缘处响应分别是多少？
wall.en: What is the response of S_x in a flat region and at a vertical edge, respectively?

misconception.zh: 以为 S_x 找的是水平方向的边缘线（实际找沿 x 方向变化快处）。
misconception.en: Thinking S_x finds horizontal edge lines (it actually finds where the change along the x direction is fast).

about.zh: 二维图像 f(x,y) 的梯度是 ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ。幅度 ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) 表示变化有多强，方向 θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) 表示变化最快的方向。
about.en: The gradient of a 2D image f(x,y) is ∇f=[∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y]ᵀ. The magnitude ‖∇f‖=√((∂f/∂x)²+(∂f/∂y)²) indicates how strong the change is, and the direction θ=atan2(∂f/∂y, ∂f/∂x) indicates the direction of fastest change.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/05-image-formation-ii.md §3 梯度：把“变化快”写成数字 (slide 40)

wall.zh: 给定 ∂f/∂x=3、∂f/∂y=4，梯度幅度是多少？
wall.en: Given ∂f/∂x=3 and ∂f/∂y=4, what is the gradient magnitude?

misconception.zh: 把梯度方向当成边缘的走向。
misconception.en: Taking the gradient direction to be the direction in which the edge runs.

term.zh: 彩色图像滤波（多通道卷积核）

about.zh: RGB 图像除空间维度外还有通道维度，颜色滤波器尺寸可以是 K_h×K_w×3。它同时看同一邻域的 R、G、B，把所有乘积加在一起得到一个输出数值。常见错误是把 height×width×channel 当成普通二维图像，忘记核还要覆盖通道维度。
about.en: Besides its spatial dimensions, an RGB image also has a channel dimension, so a colour filter can have size K_h×K_w×3. It looks at R, G and B in the same neighbourhood at once and sums all the products to give a single output value. A common mistake is to treat height×width×channel as an ordinary 2D image and forget that the kernel must also cover the channel dimension.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md §2 彩色图像的滤波核多了一个维度 (slide 31)

wall.zh: 一个 3×3×3 核作用于 RGB 图像一个位置，输出几个数？
wall.en: When a 3×3×3 kernel is applied to an RGB image at one position, how many numbers does it output?

misconception.zh: 以为彩色滤波得到三个输出值或只对一个通道操作。
misconception.en: Thinking colour filtering produces three output values, or operates on only one channel.

term.zh: 像素换算成传感器毫米再求焦距
term.en: Converting pixels to sensor millimetres to find focal length

about.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图像中高 100 像素，所以它在传感器上高 h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm。物体实际高 h_o = 120 mm、距离 z = 600 mm，由相似三角形 h_i/f = h_o/z 得 f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm。重点是先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，不能直接把像素和毫米放进同一个比例式。
about.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels, and the object is 100 pixels high in the image, so its height on the sensor is h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm. The object's real height is h_o = 120 mm and its distance is z = 600 mm, so by similar triangles h_i/f = h_o/z, giving f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm. The key point is to convert pixels into millimetres on the sensor first; you cannot put pixels and millimetres directly into the same proportion.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · 用传感器尺寸求焦距

wall.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图中占 100 像素，实高 120 mm、距离 600 mm，焦距是多少毫米？
wall.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels; an object occupies 100 pixels in the image, is 120 mm tall in reality and is 600 mm away. What is the focal length in millimetres?

misconception.zh: 直接把 100 像素当作 h_i 代入，得到单位混乱的 f = 100×600/120 = 500。
misconception.en: Substituting the 100 pixels directly as h_i, giving f = 100×600/120 = 500 with muddled units.

term.zh: OpenCV 尺寸 (width, height) 与 NumPy 形状 (height, width, channels)
term.en: OpenCV (width, height) vs NumPy (height, width, channels)

about.zh: OpenCV 的大小 tuple 是 (width, height)，NumPy 形状却通常写成 (height, width, channels)。所以不能把 NumPy 的形状原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸，否则宽和高会对调。
about.en: An OpenCV size tuple is (width, height), whereas a NumPy shape is usually written (height, width, channels). So you cannot use a NumPy shape as-is as an OpenCV resize size, or the width and height will be swapped.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝

wall.zh: 为什么 NumPy 的形状不能原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸？
wall.en: Why can a NumPy shape not be used as-is as an OpenCV resize size?

misconception.zh: 把 image.shape[:2] 直接传给 OpenCV 的缩放函数。
misconception.en: Passing image.shape[:2] straight to OpenCV's resize function.

term.zh: OpenCV 的 BGR 与 Matplotlib 的 RGB

about.zh: cv2.imread 默认读入 BGR，但 matplotlib.pyplot.imshow 按 RGB 显示，所以显示前要用 cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) 转换。这只改变通道顺序，不改变图像内容或空间尺寸。
about.en: cv2.imread reads images as BGR by default, but matplotlib.pyplot.imshow displays them as RGB, so convert with cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) before displaying. This changes only the channel order, not the image content or spatial size.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV 和 Matplotlib 的颜色顺序

wall.zh: 用 cv2.imread 读图后直接 plt.imshow，红色物体会显示成什么颜色？为什么？
wall.en: If you read an image with cv2.imread and pass it straight to plt.imshow, what colour will a red object appear? Why?

misconception.zh: 显示时红蓝颠倒，却以为图片本身坏了；或以为转换会改变图像尺寸。
misconception.en: Seeing red and blue swapped on display and thinking the image itself is broken; or thinking the conversion changes the image size.

about.zh: 把投影偏移转换成像素并平移原点。
about.en: Convert projected offset into pixels and translate its origin.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md §1 and §2 (slides 11, 15, 18)

wall.zh: 为什么负投影偏移仍可以对应正的列坐标？
wall.en: Why can a negative projected offset have a positive column coordinate?

misconception.zh: 将像素偏移直接当作图像列坐标。
misconception.en: Treating signed pixel offset as an image column.

about.zh: 逐个值相乘
about.en: Multiply value by value

why.zh: 投影要乘焦距，乘法接不出来
why.en: Projection multiplies by the focal length

about.zh: 逐个值相除
about.en: Divide value by value

why.zh: 投影要除以距离
why.en: Projection divides by the distance

about.zh: 逐个值相加
about.en: Add value by value

why.zh: 基本算术
why.en: Basic arithmetic

about.zh: 固定的数
about.en: A fixed number

why.zh: 其余元件造不出一个固定的数
why.en: No other part makes a fixed number

about.zh: 逐个值相减
about.en: Subtract value by value

why.zh: 差值是滤波和坐标里最常见的运算
why.en: Differences are the commonest operation in filters and coordinates

about.zh: 按坐标取像素
about.en: Read a pixel at coordinates

why.zh: 其余元件都在原位置上算，取不到别处的值
why.en: Every other part computes in place

about.zh: 给定宽高的两张坐标图
about.en: The two coordinate images of a size

why.zh: 没有元件能从两个数造出一整张图
why.en: No part makes a whole image from two numbers

about.zh: 向下取整
about.en: Round down

why.zh: 算术只给出连续的数，取像素要整数
why.en: Arithmetic gives continuous numbers; lookup needs whole ones

about.zh: 图的宽和高
about.en: An image's width and height

why.zh: 电路只拿到图时读不出它的尺寸
why.en: A circuit given only the image cannot read its size

about.zh: 平方根
about.en: Square root

why.zh: 梯度的大小要开平方，算术接不出来
why.en: The gradient's size needs a square root

about.zh: 取出彩色像素第 c 个位置的灰度图
about.en: The grey image of position c of each colour pixel

why.zh: 逐个值的算术拆不开一个像素的三个数
why.en: Value-by-value arithmetic cannot take a pixel's three numbers apart

about.zh: 三张灰度图合成彩色图
about.en: Three grey images made one colour image

why.zh: 没有元件能从灰度图造出彩色图
why.en: No other part makes a colour image from grey ones

about.zh: 投影：X、Z、f → u
about.en: Projection: X, Z, f → u

about.zh: 裁剪：从 (x0, y0) 起取 w × h
about.en: Crop: w × h from (x0, y0)

about.zh: 行滤波器：左中右三个权重的滑动加权和
about.en: Row filter: a sliding weighted sum of left, centre, right

about.zh: 列滤波器：上中下三个权重的滑动加权和
about.en: Column filter: a sliding weighted sum of above, centre, below

about.zh: 二维卷积：按书写核先横后竖，图外补零
about.en: 2D convolution: written kernels across then down, zero padding

about.zh: 高斯模糊
about.en: Gaussian blur

about.zh: Sobel：gx、gy
about.en: Sobel: gx, gy

about.zh: 用 Sobel 响应计算边缘强度
about.en: Compute edge strength from Sobel responses

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

why.zh: 从一台理想的针孔相机起步。
why.en: Starting from an ideal pinhole camera.

task.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
task.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

question.zh: 欢迎来到视觉实验室。你要为一座灯塔搭建成像与图像处理系统：先让相机把场景变成照片，再让机器读取、重采样和处理照片。这里没有现成的整机；每次通过测试的电路，都会成为你能继续使用的工具。
question.en: Welcome to Vision Lab. Build a camera and image processor for a lighthouse: turn the scene into a photograph, then teach the machine to read, resample and process it. Each circuit you make and test becomes a tool you can reuse.

chain.zh: 比较独立改变位置、深度和像平面距离的拍摄案例。
chain.en: Compare camera cases with independently varied position, depth and plane distance.

chain.zh: 用两个运算部件搭出覆盖所有案例的投影。
chain.en: Build projection across all cases with two arithmetic parts.

naive.zh: 把点放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：光线穿过小孔后，横向位置按 f/Z = 2/4 缩小了一半。
naive.en: With the point at X = 1 the image lands at u = 0.5 only: through the hole, the sideways position shrinks by f/Z = 2/4, to half.

task.zh: 输入一张灰度图和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
task.en: Given a grey image and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

question.zh: 相机已经能确定光落在哪里；接下来，处理器需要读出照片中的明暗。照片在电路里以<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>传递，而非一个数。先按<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>找到某格，再读取它的<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>数值；位置和读数是不同的信息。
question.en: The camera can locate incoming light. The processor now needs the photograph’s intensity values. A photograph travels through the circuit as an <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>, rather than one number. Locate a cell using the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>, then read its <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> value. A position and a reading are different information.

chain.zh: 比较任意两点的像素值，处理坐标顺序与差值正负。
chain.en: Compare arbitrary image samples, handling coordinate order and signed differences.

chain.zh: 在同一比较器上增加自动右邻寻址。
chain.en: Extend comparison with automatic right-neighbour addressing.

naive.zh: 位置读对了，差值方向却反了。
naive.en: Reading the right positions but reversing the difference.

task.zh: 输入 X、Z、像素焦距 f_px 和主点 c_x：交出像点的像素横坐标 u。
task.en: Given X, Z, the focal length in pixels f_px and the principal point c_x, give the image's pixel column u.

question.zh: <part-ref to="project"></part-ref>能确定像的位置，<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>则从图像原点数列号。要让两者对上，先区分单位，再区分原点。同一段距离可以用毫米量，也可以数跨过几个<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>；本关直接提供换算好的<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px，不需要另算换算系数。
question.en: <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> locates the image, while the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> counts columns from the image origin. Connecting them requires distinguishing units, then origins. One distance can be measured in millimetres or in <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref> steps. This task supplies the converted <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px; no extra conversion factor is needed.

chain.zh: 用独立配图区分物理距离与像素计量，不要求手抄换算。
chain.en: Distinguish physical distance and pixel measurement in an independent figure, without a transcription gate.

chain.zh: 先在正、负和零偏移中建立图像原点与光轴原点的关系。
chain.en: Establish image-origin versus axis-origin coordinates for positive, negative and zero offsets.

chain.zh: 组合已建立的原点变换与投影模块，在不同相机参数下检验。
chain.en: Compose the origin transformation with projection and test different camera parameters.

naive.zh: 把相对光轴的偏移当作列号，漏掉图像原点的差别。
naive.en: Mistaking the axis-relative offset for a column, omitting the image-origin distinction.

task.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
task.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

question.zh: 现在只保留画面的一部分，用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>完成。先把选中的区域搬进小图，再追踪新图的每一格来自原图哪里；新图左上角不再对应原图左上角。
question.en: Keep only part of the image using <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>. Move the selected region into a smaller image, then track where each new cell comes from. The two top-left corners no longer coincide.

chain.zh: 把点采样推广为坐标图：输出每个位置都寻址到原图的正确区域。
chain.en: Generalise point sampling to coordinate images, addressing the source region for every output position.

chain.zh: 把区域起点与新图局部坐标组合，检查不同裁剪尺寸与非零起点。
chain.en: Combine the region origin with local output coordinates, checking varied sizes and nonzero origins.

naive.zh: 这是从 (0, 0) 起裁的：新图的 (0, 0) 要取原图的 (1, 1)，每个坐标都加上左上角的偏移。
naive.en: That crops from (0, 0): the new (0, 0) must read the original (1, 1); every coordinate adds the corner's offset.

task.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
task.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

question.zh: 摄影实验室已经能裁出照片的一块，但放大时还会遇到原图两个像素之间的位置。题目直接给出原图中的取样位置，这次只决定从哪个已有像素读取数值。先移动示例中的取样位置，观察<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>在什么位置换到另一个像素。本关约定：像素中心位于整数坐标，中点取较大的坐标，图外读取最近边界。
question.en: The lab can crop a photograph, but enlargement also requests positions between original pixels. Sample positions in the original are supplied; your job is to decide which existing pixel to read. Move the sample position in the example and observe where <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> switches pixels. Pixel centres have integer coordinates; midpoint ties take the larger coordinate, and outside positions read the nearest boundary.

chain.zh: 根据距离、中点约定和边界规则读取一行数值。
chain.en: Read a row by distance, midpoint convention and boundary rule.

chain.zh: 把一个连续取样位置对齐到最近整数，比较中点切换与向下取整的整数切换；检查正负位置。
chain.en: Align one continuous sample position to its nearest integer; compare midpoint switches with flooring at integers and check both signs.

chain.zh: 把单位置处理逐格应用于 x、y 坐标图，再用最近边界读取原图。
chain.en: Apply the single-position mapping cell by cell to x and y coordinate images, then read the source with nearest boundaries.

naive.zh: 这是一律向下取整，分界在整数处；最近位置的分界在相邻整数的中点。比较 0.4、0.5 和 1.6，再检查超出图像范围时读到了哪一格。
naive.en: That always rounds down, switching at integers. Nearest selection switches at integer midpoints. Compare 0.4, 0.5 and 1.6, then check which pixel is read outside the image.

task.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
task.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance.

question.zh: 保持与最近邻相同的采样位置，改用<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>。先看一行上靠左、靠右两点怎样变化，再把这个做法用于四个角；图外仍取最近边界。
question.en: Keep the same sample positions but use <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>. First compare points near either end of a row, then extend that reasoning to four corners. Outside positions still use the nearest boundary.

chain.zh: 一行：[0, 4] 在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25 处取值：按到左右两个像素的距离加权，写出每个值。
chain.en: A row: Read [0, 4] at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25, weighting the pixels either side by distance: write each value.

chain.zh: 四个邻居：这张 2 × 2 的图在 x、y 都取 −1/6、0.5、7/6 的 9 个位置取值：写出 3 × 3 的结果。
chain.en: Four neighbours: Read this 2 × 2 image at the nine positions where x and y are each −1/6, 0.5 or 7/6: write the 3 × 3 result.

chain.zh: 接成电路：输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
chain.en: Wire it: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance.

naive.zh: 这是照抄最近的像素：0.25 和 0.75 位置不同，拿到的却是两端的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
naive.en: That copies the nearest pixel: 0.25 and 0.75 sit apart yet read the ends. Weighted by distance, 0.25 reads 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

task.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出焦距 f（毫米）。
task.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the focal length f in millimetres.

question.zh: Workshop 2 的一道题：知道物体多高、多远，从照片里量出它占多少像素，反推镜头的焦距。照片里量的是像素，相似三角形要的是传感器上的毫米。
question.en: A Workshop 2 exercise: knowing how tall and how far an object is, measure how many pixels it covers in the photo and work back to the lens's focal length. The photo gives pixels; similar triangles want millimetres on the sensor.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出焦距 f（毫米）。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the focal length f in millimetres.

chain.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
chain.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert pixels to millimetres on the sensor first, then h/f = H/Z; pixels and millimetres never share a proportion.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

title.en: Width, height and a centre crop

task.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
task.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

question.zh: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>：NumPy 给出图的形状时先写行数（高）、再写列数（宽）；OpenCV 要尺寸时却先写宽、再写高。Workshop 2 要从图的正中间裁出一块，两种顺序一混，裁出的位置就偏了。
question.en: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>: NumPy gives an image's shape as rows (height) first, then columns (width); OpenCV asks for a size as width first, then height. Workshop 2 crops a region from the very centre, and mixing the two orders puts it off-centre.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

chain.zh: 形状先高后宽，尺寸先宽后高；<wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref>从余量的一半起。
chain.en: A shape is height first, a size width first; a <wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref> starts half the spare room in.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

title.en: Optional: framing and field of view

task.zh: 传感器高 24 mm；本实验只看竖直方向。调 f，让全视场为 90°；用上下两条边界光线核对，不要只看上半角。
task.en: The sensor is 24 mm tall and this experiment uses a vertical slice. Set f for a full field of view of 90°. Check both boundary rays rather than only the upper half-angle.

question.zh: 想把远处的灯塔拍大，拉近焦距却可能裁掉塔顶；附近悬挂的灯泡还会闯入画面。用<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>和相机高度共同调整取景：灯塔必须完整、像高至少 16 mm，而灯泡要完全在画面之外。这里研究竖直<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 24 mm，场景使用统一的模型毫米。
question.en: Making the distant lighthouse larger can crop its top, while a nearby hanging bulb intrudes into the photograph. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> and camera height together: keep the entire lighthouse at an image height of at least 16 mm, with the bulb wholly outside the frame. This is a vertical <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> experiment with a 24 mm <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and consistent model millimetres.

chain.zh: 放大灯塔，同时移动相机高度以保留完整主体并排除近处灯泡。
chain.en: Enlarge the lighthouse while moving camera height to retain the whole subject and exclude the nearer bulb.

chain.zh: 在照片与等比例视场测量中核对完整入画和部分可见的区别。
chain.en: Inspect the photograph and field measurement to distinguish complete framing from partial visibility.

naive.zh: 只把箭加高：距离不变，像也跟着加倍成 1。要让像不变，距离得和物高一起加倍。
naive.en: Only making the arrow taller: at the same distance its image doubles to 1. For the same image the distance must double with the height.

title.zh: 可选：一张照片的多种解释

task.zh: 输入像点位置 u、像平面距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
task.en: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X.

question.zh: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>能从场景得到图像，但反过来是否唯一？保留 H=1、Z=4、f=2 的参照，让一座至少高一倍的标定灯塔拍出相同的像。之后只在额外给定 Z 的条件下倒推位置。
question.en: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> maps a scene to an image. Is the reverse unique? Keep the H=1, Z=4, f=2 reference and construct a calibration lighthouse at least twice as tall with the same image. Then invert a point position only when Z is supplied.

chain.zh: 另造一个场景：调 H 和 Z：像高仍为 0.5，但 H 至少为 2。所有长度共用模型单位；对照参照图再检查。
chain.en: Another scene: Adjust H and Z: keep image height 0.5 with H at least 2. All lengths share model units. Compare with the reference, then check.

chain.zh: 倒推：输入像点位置 u、像平面距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
chain.en: Work back: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X.

naive.zh: 只把箭加高：距离不变，像也跟着加倍成 1。要让像不变，距离得和物高一起加倍。
naive.en: Only making the arrow taller: at the same distance its image doubles to 1. For the same image the distance must double with the height.

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

why.zh: 相机只会按位置取值，不会把邻居合起来算。
why.en: The camera only reads values at positions and cannot combine neighbours.

task.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
task.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

question.zh: 已经会按坐标读取，现在要让一个输出同时依赖周围的值。打开<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>和<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>，用窗口逐格跟踪<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>。本关只算三个邻居都在图内的位置。
question.en: Coordinate lookup is ready; now one output must depend on surrounding values. Open <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>, then follow the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> with the movable window. Only positions with three neighbours inside the image are used.

chain.zh: 手算：权重左 1、中 0、右 −1 滑过这一行：写出三格都在图里的每个位置的加权和。
chain.en: By hand: Slide the weights left 1, centre 0, right −1 along this row: write the weighted sum at each position whose three cells are all inside.

chain.zh: 接成电路：输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
chain.en: Wire it: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

naive.zh: 这是右邻减左邻：权重左 1、右 −1，是左邻减右邻。权重跟着位置走，不要颠倒。
naive.en: That is right less left: with the left weight 1 and the right −1 it is left less right. The weights go with their positions.

task.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：输出和原图一样宽，每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0。
task.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give an output as wide as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside.

question.zh: 相邻处理要继续组合，不能每次都悄悄缩小画面。本关选用<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>中的补零规则，保留所有中心位置；比较边缘和中间同样的输入，看看输出是否还相同。
question.en: To compose local operations, the frame must not silently shrink each time. Use zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> and retain every centre position. Compare equal inputs at the edge and in the interior: do their outputs stay equal?

chain.zh: 手算：三个权重都是 1/3（求左中右的平均），图外补 0：写出和原图一样宽的结果。
chain.en: By hand: All three weights 1/3 (the average of left, here and right), 0 outside: write the result, as wide as the row.

chain.zh: 行滤波器：输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：输出和原图一样宽，每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0。
chain.en: Row filter: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give an output as wide as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside.

naive.zh: 这是图外取最近的边：题目约定图外补 0，两端只有两个 3 和一个 0，平均是 2。
naive.en: That reads the nearest edge outside: here 0 is padded outside, so each end averages two 3s and a 0, giving 2.

task.zh: 输入一张图和卷积核 k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出卷积的结果，图外补 0。
task.en: Given an image and the kernel k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the convolution, 0 outside.

question.zh: 这条必修路线研究权重的方向，不必等待列处理。用<wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>检查<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：沿窗口追踪唯一亮点分别遇到哪个权重，再让电路符合题目要求的翻转约定。
question.en: This required route studies weight orientation without waiting for column processing. Use an <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref> to inspect <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: track which weight meets the single bright sample, then make the circuit obey the requested flip convention.

chain.zh: 脉冲：不翻转，权重左 1、中 2、右 3 滑过这一行脉冲，图外补 0：写出结果。
chain.en: An impulse: Without flipping, slide the weights left 1, centre 2, right 3 over this impulse, 0 outside: write the result.

chain.zh: 真正的卷积：输入一张图和卷积核 k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出卷积的结果，图外补 0。
chain.en: True convolution: Given an image and the kernel k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the convolution, 0 outside.

naive.zh: 以为脉冲出来的就是核 [1, 2, 3]：亮点在左边那一格的右邻，乘的是右权重 3。不翻转时，出来的是倒过来的 [3, 2, 1]。
naive.en: Expecting the kernel [1, 2, 3] back: for the cell to its left, the bright cell is the right neighbour and meets the right weight 3. Without the flip, out comes [3, 2, 1] reversed.

task.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
task.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

question.zh: 这条必修路线把<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>转向上下，不依赖核方向路线。先在窗口里追踪一列：保持 x 不动，只改变 y，再把刚验证的读取方式推广到整张图。
question.en: This required route turns <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> vertically, independently of the kernel-orientation route. Track one column in the window: keep x fixed, vary y, then extend the checked addressing to the image.

chain.zh: 在可移动窗口里保持 x 不变，沿 y 追踪三个邻居。
chain.en: Keep x fixed and track three y-neighbours in the movable window.

chain.zh: 接出列滤波器：输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
chain.en: Wire the column filter: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

chain.zh: 横、竖处理的代数结构一致，差别落在“读哪个邻居”。用非方形图与不对称内容测试，才能让误把 y 改成 x 的接法显出差异。
chain.en: Horizontal and vertical operations share an algebraic structure; the addressed neighbours differ. Non-square images with asymmetric content expose a circuit that changes x where y was intended.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

facet.zh: 同一个滑动加权和，邻居换成上下：方向不同，计算一样
facet.en: The same sliding weighted sum with the neighbours above and below: another direction, the same computation

task.zh: 由行、列部件实现书写核的二维卷积。
task.en: Build 2D convolution of written kernels from row and column parts.

question.zh: 两条路线在这里汇合：方向约定已经核对，也能分别读行与列。用<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>思考两次处理如何组合；先追踪一个输入位置到各输出位置的贡献，再组合已搭好的部件。
question.en: The routes meet here: orientation is checked and both rows and columns can be addressed. Use <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> to reason about composition. Track one input contribution across output positions before combining the built parts.

chain.zh: 合成的核：行权重 [1,2,1]、列权重 [1,0,−1]。追踪每个行权重经由列处理的贡献，写出组合后的 3×3 权重表。
chain.en: The merged kernel: Row weights [1,2,1], column weights [1,0,−1]. Track each horizontal contribution through the column pass and fill the combined 3×3 weights.

chain.zh: 二维滤波器：输入一张图、行权重 h1、h2、h3 和列权重 v1、v2、v3：交出先横后竖两次滤波的结果。
chain.en: 2D filter: Given an image, row weights h1, h2, h3 and column weights v1, v2, v3, give the result of filtering across, then down.

chain.zh: 让两个位置权重部件共同执行书写核的翻转，用双向不对称核检验。
chain.en: Make both positional parts reverse the written kernels; check asymmetry in both axes.

naive.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重：竖直方向也要乘上列权重，第 1 行整行乘 2。
naive.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows: the column weights multiply too, doubling row 1.

task.zh: 输入一张图：交出横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤过的模糊图。
task.en: Given an image, give it filtered across and down by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4].

question.zh: 细碎亮暗变化会掩盖图像中的大结构。利用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>的目标光斑，为已有的二维滤波器选择权重：单个亮点应向四周对称扩散，恒定区域的亮度则应保持不变。观察测试中的亮点、明暗分界与常量图，再搭出同一块平滑器。
question.en: Fine intensity variation can hide larger structure. Choose weights for the existing 2D filter using the target <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> point spread: an isolated bright sample spreads symmetrically, while a constant interior keeps its brightness. Inspect the bright-point, step and constant-image tests, then build one smoother.

chain.zh: 从目标光斑推断对称权重，再用常量图约束总增益。
chain.en: Infer symmetric weights from the target point spread, then constrain the total gain with a constant image.

chain.zh: 用常量区域约束总增益，检查相同权重对阶跃与边界的影响。
chain.en: Constrain total gain on a constant interior, then check steps and boundaries with the same weights.

naive.zh: 这是只横着滤了一遍：竖直方向也要滤，亮点向上下扩散，中心只剩 4。
naive.en: That filters across only: down must be filtered too, spreading the point up and down and leaving 4 at the centre.

task.zh: 由书写核构造正向增亮为正的 gx、gy。
task.en: Construct gx and gy from written kernels, positive for positive-direction brightening.

question.zh: 轮廓附近的亮度变化有强弱，也有方向。让<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>同时给出横向与竖向的带符号响应；变化方向要敏感，垂直方向的细碎变化则要减弱。比较测试中的两种明暗分界，用已经搭好的二维滤波器实现这两个角色。
question.en: Intensity transitions around an outline have both strength and direction.
