Build the two signed <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> responses: remain sensitive along the direction of change while reducing fine variation across it. Compare the horizontal and vertical step tests and use the built 2D filter for both roles.

chain.zh: 从两种阶跃目标分辨方向，组合差分与垂直方向的平滑。
chain.en: Distinguish directions using two step targets, combining differences with perpendicular smoothing.

chain.zh: 用已有二维部件构造两路响应，检验核翻转与响应正负。
chain.en: Construct both responses with the existing 2D part, checking kernel reversal and response signs.

naive.zh: 这是只看变化有多大：响应带符号，从亮到暗的地方右邻比左邻暗，是负的。
naive.en: That records only how big the change is: the response is signed, and where it goes bright to dark the right neighbour is darker, so it is negative.

title.en: The gradient: how strong, which way

task.zh: 输入一张图：输出每个位置的变化强度。大小相同而方向相反的响应，应得到同样的强度。
task.en: Given an image, output change strength at each position. Equal-sized responses pointing in opposite directions must have equal strength.

question.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>已有两个带符号的响应。现在用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>比较不同朝向的变化强度：先在响应表中检验转向和正负是否改变强度，再造一块可复用部件。
question.en: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> provides two signed responses. Use the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> to compare change strength across orientations: first test rotations and sign changes in a response table, then build a reusable part.

chain.zh: 比较等长而朝向不同的响应向量，排除直接相加。
chain.en: Compare equal-length response vectors pointing in different directions, rejecting signed addition.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入一张图：输出每个位置的变化强度。大小相同而方向相反的响应，应得到同样的强度。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given an image, output change strength at each position. Equal-sized responses pointing in opposite directions must have equal strength.

chain.zh: 相同强度的变化可以指向不同方向，两个响应直接相加会相消，无法稳定比较。把响应作为两个互相垂直的分量处理，才可在保留方向信息的同时另取一个非负强度。
chain.en: Equally strong changes can point in different directions. Adding signed responses can cancel them and fails as a stable comparison. Treating them as perpendicular components lets direction remain distinct from nonnegative strength.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

task.zh: 输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各通道模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
task.en: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred channels, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs.

question.zh: 把两条路线装进同一台处理器。先按 wr、wg、wb 选择要观察的颜色组合，用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>减弱细碎变化，再调用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>的强度部件检查剩下的分界。输出处理后的图与它的边缘强度，两者都要通过测试。
question.en: Assemble both routes into one processor. Select a colour mixture with wr, wg and wb, reduce fine variation with <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>, then call the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> strength part to inspect the remaining transitions. Output both the processed image and its edge strength.

chain.zh: 观察与操作：输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各通道模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
chain.en: Observe and act: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred channels, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs.

chain.zh: 这次<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>不只把部件摆在一起：权重决定看哪些通道，平滑改变进入求变化部件的信号。两张输出让你检查“保留了什么”与“哪里变化强”；这仍是局部处理，不等于识别物体。
chain.en: This <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> composes a real signal path: weights select channels and smoothing changes what reaches the change detector. The two outputs show what remains and where it changes strongly. These local operations do not recognise objects.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

task.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
task.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

question.zh: Workshop 2 里用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，三个数按 B、G、R 存；交给 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示，红蓝就对调了，蓝天变成橙色。另一个坑：照片常用 uint8 存，0 到 255，算出来超出范围会绕回去。
question.en: In Workshop 2 a photo read with OpenCV stores its three numbers as B, G, R; shown by Matplotlib as R, G, B, red and blue trade places and a blue sky turns orange. Another trap: photos are often uint8, 0 to 255, and a result out of range wraps around.

chain.zh: 换回 RGB：输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
chain.en: Back to RGB: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

chain.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>的差别和<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>的坑：先换好顺序，算之前换成更宽的类型。
chain.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref> difference and the <wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref> trap: swap the order before handing over, widen the type before computing.

naive.zh: 参考解之外的直觉做法，见关卡的 naive 板。
naive.en: The intuitive board beside the reference; see the level's naive board.

why.zh: 核方向与竖直读取是独立问题，二维处理汇合时同时使用。
why.en: Kernel orientation and vertical addressing are independent; the 2D construction joins them.

why.zh: 平滑与变化响应从同一个二维滤波器出发，最终处理器实际调用两边部件。
why.en: Smoothing and change responses share the 2D filter; the finale calls parts from both.

value.zh: 一章一章造出视觉的机器。先造一台相机：把场景投影到<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>坐标、在任意位置取值；再造一台卷积器：把邻居加权合起来，搭出模糊器和边缘检测器。每个部件都会在后面直接复用。
value.en: Build the machines of vision chapter by chapter. First a camera: project a scene into <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> coordinates and read it at any position; then a convolver: weigh neighbours together into a blur and an edge detector. Every part is reused later.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

title.en: Optional: framing and field of view

title.zh: 可选：一张照片的多种解释

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 分析彩色照片时，关注不同颜色可能突出不同的结构；细碎变化又可能影响边缘的观察。组合已有元件，按 wr、wg、wb 选择颜色权重，用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>平滑图像，再用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>的强度元件分析变化。输出处理后的图像和对应的边缘强度。
t.en: In a colour photograph, different colour mixtures can reveal different structures, while fine variation can affect edge analysis. Combine the existing parts: choose colour weights wr, wg and wb, smooth the image with <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>, and use the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> strength part to analyse change. Output the processed image and its edge strength.

after.zh: 这次<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>不只把部件摆在一起：权重决定看哪些<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>，平滑改变进入求变化部件的信号。两张输出让你检查“保留了什么”与“哪里变化强”；这仍是局部处理，不等于识别物体。
after.en: This <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> composes a real signal path: weights select <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> and smoothing changes what reaches the change detector. The two outputs show what remains and where it changes strongly. These local operations do not recognise objects. (colour channel)

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>：在元件上设定取第几个位置。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>; set on the part which position it takes.

brief.zh: 输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
brief.en: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs. (colour channel)

hint.zh: 先把三个<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>分开，各自模糊，再乘权重。
hint.en: First take the three <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> apart, blur each, then weight them. (colour channel)

title.en: The gradient: how strong, which way

t.zh: 照片中的边缘可能朝向不同方向，如何比较它们的变化强度？<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>给出两个带符号的方向响应。利用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>，先比较响应表中不同方向和符号的变化，再构建可复用的强度元件。
t.en: Edges in a photograph can point in different directions. How can their change strengths be compared? <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> provides two signed directional responses. Using the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>, compare directions and signs in the response table, then build a reusable strength part.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>用两个方向的响应描述局部变化：方向与非负强度是不同的信息。直接相加可能使正负响应相消，不能稳定地比较变化强度。
after.en: The <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> describes local change using two directional responses: direction and nonnegative strength convey different information. Direct addition can cancel signed responses and does not reliably compare strengths.

desc.zh: 输入图像，输出每个位置的 Sobel 梯度幅度；图外补零。
desc.en: Given an image, outputs the Sobel gradient magnitude at each position, with zero padding.

brief.zh: 这两行分别是三个位置的 gx 和 gy。填出这三个位置的梯度幅度；把每一列视作同一位置的一对响应。
brief.en: These rows give gx and gy at three positions. Fill the three gradient magnitudes, pairing responses within each column.

hint.zh: 把每一列看作一个箭头；转向和翻转不改变箭头长度。
hint.en: Treat each column as an arrow; rotation or reversal does not change its length.

why.zh: 直接把两行带符号的响应相加，会因方向不同得到不同甚至为负的值。三个箭头只是转了方向，比较长度时不能让它们互相抵消。
why.en: Adding the signed rows gives different values, including negative ones, depending on direction. These arrows differ only in direction; measuring length must not let their components cancel.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref>给出平方根。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref> gives the square root.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：输出每个位置的变化强度。大小相同而方向相反的响应，应得到同样的强度。
brief.en: Given an image, output change strength at each position. Equal-sized responses pointing in opposite directions must have equal strength.

hint.zh: gx、gy 有正有负；直接相加，正负会抵消。
hint.en: gx and gy can be negative; added as they are, they cancel.

t.zh: 轮廓附近的亮度变化有强弱，也有方向。让<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>同时给出横向与竖向的带符号响应；变化方向要敏感，垂直方向的细碎变化则要减弱。比较测试中的两种明暗分界，用已经搭好的二维滤波器实现这两个角色。
t.en: Intensity transitions around an outline have both strength and direction. Build the two signed <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> responses: remain sensitive along the direction of change while reducing fine variation across it. Compare the horizontal and vertical step tests and use the built 2D filter for both roles.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出横向响应 gx（右邻减左邻，竖直用 [1, 2, 1] 平均）和纵向响应 gy（下邻减上邻，横向用 [1, 2, 1] 平均）
desc.en: Takes an image; gives the across response gx (right less left, averaged [1, 2, 1] down) and the down response gy (below less above, averaged [1, 2, 1] across)

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>的带符号响应反映亮度变化的方向；平坦区域即使很亮也可能没有响应。图像边界的补零则可能产生额外响应。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
after.en: Signed <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> responses indicate the direction of intensity change. A bright flat region can have zero response, while zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> can create extra responses at image boundaries.

brief.zh: 输出横向响应 gx 和竖向响应 gy，使它们与测试的目标图一致。沿坐标正方向从暗到亮应为正；每一路还要抑制垂直方向的细碎变化。
brief.en: Output gx and gy matching the target images. Dark-to-bright along a positive coordinate direction gives a positive response; each branch also suppresses fine changes across its perpendicular direction.

hint.zh: 先看两种明暗分界：哪一路应有响应，哪一路应为零？分别调用<part-ref to="filter2D"></part-ref>。
hint.en: Compare the two step directions: which branch responds and which stays zero? Use <part-ref to="filter2D"></part-ref> for each.

hint.zh: 变化方向用反对称差分，垂直方向用对称加权。<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>按书写顺序提供，检查翻转后响应的正负。
hint.en: Use an antisymmetric difference along the change and symmetric weighting across it. <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> entries are supplied in written order; check the sign after reversal.

solution: x = filter2D(image, o, z, m, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, o, z, m)
naive: x = filter2D(image, m, z, o, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, m, z, o)

t.zh: 观察一条由暗到亮的边界时，权重的方向会影响变化的符号。用<wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>考察<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：追踪唯一亮点遇到的权重，再让电路符合题目要求的翻转约定。
t.en: When observing a dark-to-bright boundary, weight orientation affects the sign of the change. Use an <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref> to examine <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: track the weight meeting the single bright sample, then make the circuit obey the requested flip convention.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的区别涉及权重的方向。对称权重可能掩盖方向差异，而不对称权重能帮助检查约定；数值相近的结果不一定表示使用了相同运算。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> differ in weight orientation. Symmetric weights can hide that difference; asymmetric weights help check the convention. Similar-looking results do not necessarily imply the same operation.

brief.zh: 不翻转，权重左 1、中 2、右 3 滑过这一行脉冲，图外补 0：写出结果。
brief.en: Without flipping, slide the weights left 1, centre 2, right 3 over this impulse, 0 outside: write the result.

hint.zh: 亮点左边那一格，算加权和时亮点是它的哪个邻居？
hint.en: For the cell left of the bright one, which neighbour is the bright cell?

why.zh: 以为脉冲出来的就是核 [1, 2, 3]：亮点在左边那一格的右邻，乘的是右权重 3。不翻转时，出来的是倒过来的 [3, 2, 1]。 (<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>)
why.en: Expecting the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> [1, 2, 3] back: for the cell to its left, the bright cell is the right neighbour and meets the right weight 3. Without the flip, out comes [3, 2, 1] reversed.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的结果，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>, 0 outside.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> 不翻转；翻转之后，k1 落到哪一边？
hint.en: The <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> does not flip; flipped, which side does k1 land on?

t.zh: 细碎亮暗变化会掩盖图像中的大结构。利用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>的目标光斑，为已有的二维滤波器选择权重：单个亮点应向四周对称扩散，恒定区域的亮度则应保持不变。观察测试中的亮点、明暗分界与常量图，再搭出同一块平滑器。
t.en: Fine intensity variation can hide larger structure. Choose weights for the existing 2D filter using the target <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> point spread: an isolated bright sample spreads symmetrically, while a constant interior keeps its brightness. Inspect the bright-point, step and constant-image tests, then build one smoother.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 横竖各滤一遍的模糊图，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image; gives it blurred by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] across and down, 0 outside

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>减弱细小变化，也会使锐利边界变得模糊。内部常值区域可以保持亮度，但补零边界的邻域条件不同，因此边缘可能变暗。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> reduces fine variation but also blurs sharp boundaries. Constant interior regions can retain their intensity, while zero-padded boundaries have different neighbourhoods and may darken.

brief.zh: 把输入图像平滑成测试中的目标图：孤立亮点形成对称的 3×3 光斑，内部恒定区域保持亮度，图外补零。根据目标选择行、列权重。
brief.en: Smooth the input into the target images: an isolated bright sample forms a symmetric 3×3 spread, constant interiors keep their brightness, and samples outside are zero. Choose the row and column weights from these targets.

hint.zh: 先比较亮点测试中中心、边中点与角点的响应比例，再用常量图检查两次加权后的总量。
hint.en: Compare the centre, edge-middle and corner responses to the impulse, then check the overall gain on the constant image.

hint.zh: 行与列都采用对称权重；若每一方向的权重和为 1，中间权重应是单侧权重的两倍。
hint.en: Use symmetric weights on each axis. With unit gain on each pass, its centre weight is twice either side weight.

solution: f = filter2D(image, q, h, q, q, h, q)
naive: f = filter2D(image, t, t, t, z, o, z)

t.zh: 灯塔的照片已经能够定位、裁剪和重新取样，但处理器还不能利用邻近信息来改变画面。现在给实验室加上局部处理模块：同一套运算，改变权重便可用于柔化细碎变化或突出明暗交界。先让窗口沿照片移动，再把这项运算推广到整张图。
t.en: The lighthouse photograph can now be located, cropped and resampled, but the processor cannot yet use nearby information to change it. Add a local-processing module: different weights let the same operation soften small variations or emphasise intensity transitions. Start with a moving window, then extend the operation to the whole image.

t.zh: 图示用一行独立样例演示<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>：窗口每次收进左邻、中心、右邻三个读数。<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>给这三个位置各配一个权重。每个读数乘以对应的权重，三项乘积相加得到一个输出。观察窗口移动时哪些数变、哪些数不变；<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的每个输出对应一个窗口。本任务只取三个邻居都在图内的位置。
t.en: This independent row illustrates <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>: each window collects a left, centre and right reading. The <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> assigns a weight to each position. Multiply each reading by its positional weight and add the three products for one output. Move the window and observe what changes and what stays fixed; each <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> output corresponds to one window. This task uses only windows wholly inside the image.

after.zh: 窗口平移时，权重的位置保持固定，读到的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>随位置改变。边缘缺邻居，所以当前输出更窄；<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>的运算与“在哪些位置计算”是两个不同决定。
after.en: The window moves while weight positions stay fixed and sampled <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> values change. Missing edge neighbours make this output narrower: the <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref> and the choice of output positions are separate decisions.

brief.zh: 权重左 1、中 0、右 −1 滑过这一行：写出三格都在图里的每个位置的加权和。
brief.en: Slide the weights left 1, centre 0, right −1 along this row: write the weighted sum at each position whose three cells are all inside.

hint.zh: 第一个位置以 x = 1 为中心：1 × 左邻 + 0 × 自己 + (−1) × 右邻。
hint.en: The first position is centred on x = 1: 1 × left + 0 × here + (−1) × right.

why.zh: 这是右邻减左邻：权重左 1、右 −1，是左邻减右邻。权重跟着位置走，不要颠倒。
why.en: That is right less left: with the left weight 1 and the right −1 it is left less right. The weights go with their positions.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref>读出图的宽 w 和高 h。只算三格都在图里的位置：输出宽 w − 2，第 x 格以原图的 x + 1 为中心。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref> gives an image's width w and height h. Take only positions with all three cells inside: the output is w − 2 wide, its cell x centred on the original x + 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

hint.zh: 输出的每格要取原图的三个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>：它们的 x 各是多少？
hint.en: Each output cell reads three <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> of the original: what is each one's x?

t.zh: 一张照片在不同工具中显示时，蓝天可能变成橙色：原因可能是颜色通道的排列顺序不同。Workshop 2 中，OpenCV 读入的顺序为 B、G、R，而 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示。图像计算还需要留意数据类型：uint8 的范围为 0 到 255，超出范围的运算结果可能发生回绕。
t.en: A photograph can display an orange sky in another tool because its colour channels are ordered differently. In Workshop 2, OpenCV reads B, G, R while Matplotlib displays R, G, B. Image calculations also depend on data type: uint8 ranges from 0 to 255, and arithmetic results outside that range can wrap around.

t.zh: 怎样恢复照片的颜色？<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>将三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次作为 R、G、B 通道合成彩色图。
t.en: How can the photograph’s colours be restored? <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> combines three <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> as the R, G and B channels of a colour image.

after.zh: 不同工具的颜色通道顺序可能不同，交换顺序前需要确认输入和输出的约定（<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>）。整数类型的取值范围也会影响计算结果（<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>）；计算前应选择足以容纳结果的类型。
after.en: Tools may use different channel orders, so check input and output conventions before rearranging them (<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>). Integer ranges also affect computed results (<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>); choose a type that can hold the result before computing.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?

title.en: Width, height and a centre crop

t.zh: 从照片中心裁取区域时，需要准确确定宽、高和起点。不同工具对尺寸的排列约定可能不同：<wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>说明了 NumPy 图像形状与 OpenCV 尺寸的顺序。若混淆两者，裁剪区域可能偏离中心。
t.en: A centre crop requires the width, height and starting position to be identified correctly. Tools may order dimensions differently: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref> describes the conventions for NumPy image shapes and OpenCV sizes. Confusing them can move the crop away from the centre.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：已知形状 (rows, cols)，正中间那一块的左上角在哪？
t.en: This level asks: given the shape (rows, cols), where is the centre region's top-left corner?

after.zh: 形状先高后宽，尺寸先宽后高；<wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref>从余量的一半起。
after.en: A shape is height first, a size width first; a <wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref> starts half the spare room in.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
brief.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

hint.zh: 横向的余量是哪个数减 w？
hint.en: The room left across is which number less w?

solution: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)
naive: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)

t.zh: 已知物体的实际高度和距离，并测得它在照片中占据的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>数，能否估计镜头的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>？照片给出的是像素数，而<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>关系需要<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的实际长度。
t.en: If an object’s height and distance are known and its size in the photograph is measured in <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>, can the lens’s <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> be estimated? The photograph gives a pixel count, while <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> requires a physical length on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>和毫米怎样换算，才能代进<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>？<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 smm 毫米、spx 像素；物体在图里高 hpx 像素，实际高 H、距离 Z（毫米）。
t.en: This level asks: how are <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> and millimetres converted before the <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>? The <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is smm millimetres and spx samples high; the object covers hpx samples and is H tall and Z away, in millimetres.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>换成<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> to millimetres on the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> first, then h/f = H/Z; pixel counts and millimetres never share a proportion.

brief.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f（毫米）。
brief.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f in millimetres.

hint.zh: 一个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>在<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>上有多少毫米？
hint.en: How many millimetres of <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> is one <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>?

t.zh: 想把远处的灯塔拍大，拉近焦距却可能裁掉塔顶；附近悬挂的灯泡还会闯入画面。用<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>和相机高度共同调整取景：灯塔必须完整、像高至少 16 mm，而灯泡要完全在画面之外。这里研究竖直<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>高 24 mm，场景使用统一的模型毫米。
t.en: Making the distant lighthouse larger can crop its top, while a nearby hanging bulb intrudes into the photograph. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> and camera height together: keep the entire lighthouse at an image height of at least 16 mm, with the bulb wholly outside the frame. This is a vertical <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref> experiment with a 24 mm <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and consistent model millimetres.

after.zh: 放大投影会缩小<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，改变相机高度则平移物体相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的位置。这两个调整相互约束：画面中的主体要足够大，也必须完整；不能把“有一部分被裁掉”当作“完全不在画面里”。<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>描述固定<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>画幅与<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>之间的取舍。
after.en: Enlarging the projection narrows the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>, while changing camera height shifts objects relative to the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>. The controls constrain each other: the subject must be large enough yet complete. Partial cropping is not complete exclusion. <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> describes the trade-off between a fixed <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 完整拍下灯塔，像高至少 16 mm；附近悬挂的灯泡必须完全出画。调<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f 和相机高度，再检查照片。
brief.en: Keep the lighthouse complete, with image height at least 16 mm. Exclude the nearby hanging bulb entirely. Adjust <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> f and camera height, then check the photograph.

hint.zh: 先让灯塔达到要求的大小，再观察是哪一端超出<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>。移动相机高度会同时改变灯塔与灯泡的位置；它们的距离不同，移动幅度也不同。
hint.en: First make the lighthouse large enough, then inspect which end exceeds the <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>. Camera height moves both lighthouse and bulb in the image, by different amounts because their depths differ.

why.zh: 只放大而不调整取景中心，会裁掉灯塔顶部。
why.en: Zooming without adjusting the view centre crops the top of the lighthouse.

why.zh: 灯塔完整，但较近的灯泡仍有一部分入画；不能只检查主体。
why.en: The lighthouse fits, but part of the nearer bulb remains visible; checking only the subject is insufficient.

t.zh: 放大后的照片可能出现明显的阶梯边缘。能否利用周围的像素，让相邻采样位置之间的变化更平滑？在相同采样位置比较<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：先观察一行中靠近两端的位置，再考虑四个角；图外取最近边界。
t.en: An enlarged photograph can have visibly stepped edges. Can surrounding pixels produce smoother changes between nearby sample positions? Compare <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> with <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref> at the same positions: first observe points near either end of a row, then consider four corners. Outside positions use the nearest boundary.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>根据横向和纵向距离在邻近值之间过渡，可以减轻阶梯感；但它不能恢复原图未记录的细节，平滑不等于增加真实信息。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref> transitions between neighbouring values according to horizontal and vertical distances, reducing stepping. It cannot recover detail absent from the original: smoothness does not add measured information.

brief.zh: [0, 4] 在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25 处取值：按到左右两个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的距离加权，写出每个值。
brief.en: Read [0, 4] at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25, weighting the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> on each side by distance: write each value.

hint.zh: x = 0.25 离 0 有 0.25，离 1 有 0.75：离得近的那边该占几成？
hint.en: x = 0.25 is 0.25 from 0 and 0.75 from 1: what share should the nearer side take?

why.zh: 这是照抄最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>：0.25 和 0.75 位置不同，拿到的却是两端的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
why.en: That copies the nearest <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>: 0.25 and 0.75 sit apart yet read the ends. Weighted by distance, 0.25 reads 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

brief.zh: 这张 2 × 2 的图在 x、y 都取 −1/6、0.5、7/6 的 9 个位置取值：写出 3 × 3 的结果。
brief.en: Read this 2 × 2 image at the nine positions where x and y are each −1/6, 0.5 or 7/6: write the 3 × 3 result.

hint.zh: 中间那一行在 y = 0.5，正好在两行中间：先把上下两行各自横着算好，再竖着取中间。
hint.en: The middle row is at y = 0.5, right between the rows: work out the top and bottom rows across first, then take between them.

why.zh: 这是只横着加权、竖直方向照抄最近的一行：中间一行在两行正中，却整个抄了下面一行。竖着也按距离加权，中心是四个邻居的平均 6。
why.en: That weights across only and copies the nearest row: the middle row, right between two, copies the lower. Weighted by distance downwards too, the centre is the average of the four, 6.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
brief.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

hint.zh: 先找出左上的邻居：坐标向下取整；位置离它多远，就是右边和下边邻居的权重。
hint.en: First find the top-left neighbour: round the coordinates down; how far the position is from it is the weight of the neighbours right and below.

t.zh: 摄影实验室已经能裁出照片的一块，但放大时还会遇到原图两个像素之间的位置。题目直接给出原图中的取样位置，这次只决定从哪个已有像素读取数值。先移动示例中的取样位置，观察<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>在什么位置换到另一个像素。本关约定：像素中心位于整数坐标，中点取较大的坐标，图外读取最近边界。
t.en: The lab can crop a photograph, but enlargement also requests positions between original pixels. Sample positions in the original are supplied; your job is to decide which existing pixel to read. Move the sample position in the example and observe where <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> switches pixels. Pixel centres have integer coordinates; midpoint ties take the larger coordinate, and outside positions read the nearest boundary.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>使用最近位置的值。采样位置连续移动时，所选邻居可能突然切换，因此放大结果可能出现阶梯；坐标正确本身并不保证平滑。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> uses the value at the nearest position. As the sampling position moves continuously, the selected neighbour can change abruptly, producing steps in an enlargement. Correct coordinates alone do not ensure smoothness.

brief.zh: 这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的值。
brief.en: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> nearest each position.

hint.zh: 0.5 离 0 和 1 一样近；2.2 最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>是哪个？
hint.en: 0.5 is as near 0 as 1; which <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> is nearest 2.2?

why.zh: 这是一律向下取整，分界在整数处；最近位置的分界在相邻整数的中点。比较 0.4、0.5 和 1.6，再检查超出图像范围时读到了哪一格。
why.en: That always rounds down, switching at integers. Nearest selection switches at integer midpoints. Compare 0.4, 0.5 and 1.6, then check which pixel is read outside the image.

t.zh: 按距离选出了像素，还需要让电路算出它的整数坐标。先只处理一个取样位置，不读取图，也不处理图像边界。新元件<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>会在取样位置跨过整数时切换输出；观察它与最近整数坐标的切换位置有什么差别，再用算术元件弥合这个差别。
t.en: After selecting a pixel by distance, a circuit must compute its integer coordinate. Start with one sample position, without reading an image or handling its boundaries. The new <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> switches output when the position crosses an integer. Compare its switching locations with those of the nearest integer, then use arithmetic parts to bridge that difference.

brief.zh: 输入取样位置 x，输出距离它最近的整数坐标；中点取较大的整数。这里不限制图像范围，负坐标也要保留。
brief.en: Given sample position x, output its nearest integer coordinate; a midpoint tie takes the larger integer. There is no image boundary in this task: retain negative coordinates.

hint.zh: 移动示例中的取样位置，比较整数处和相邻整数中点处：两种规则分别在哪里切换？
hint.en: Move the example position across integers and their midpoints. Where does each rule switch?

hint.zh: 只向下取整会总选较小的整数。需要调整的是所有切换位置，而不是只给某个测试的输出加 1；尝试常数和算术元件，并同时检查正、负坐标。
hint.en: Flooring alone always selects the smaller integer. Adjust all switching locations, rather than adding 1 to the output of one test. Try a constant and arithmetic parts, checking both positive and negative coordinates.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>按距离选取整数坐标，分界位于相邻整数的中点；负坐标也遵循同一规则。是否超出图像范围是另一件事，不能在对齐位置时提前丢掉负坐标。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> chooses integer coordinates by distance, with boundaries at integer midpoints. Negative coordinates follow the same rule. Being outside an image is a separate issue; aligning a position must not discard negative coordinates.

t.zh: 一个位置已经能对齐到最近整数。现在把相同的处理分别应用到两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>：x 图保存每格要读取的列坐标，y 图保存行坐标。算术元件会逐格处理；两张坐标图必须同样大小，结果也采用这个大小，不要求与原图相同。
t.en: One position can now be aligned to its nearest integer. Apply the same processing independently to the two <wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> inputs: x stores the column to read at each cell, and y stores the row. Arithmetic parts act cell by cell. The coordinate images must share a size, which also becomes the result size; it need not match the source.

t.zh: 对齐后的坐标交给<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>读取原图。如果坐标在图外，本关要求使用最近边界；在这个元件的详情中将“出界”设为“最近的边”。可以先查看两路中间坐标，再查看读取结果，分清错误发生在哪一步。
t.en: Feed the aligned coordinates to <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> to read the source. This task uses the nearest boundary for outside coordinates: in the part details, set Outside to Nearest edge. Inspect both intermediate coordinate results before the sampled output to locate an error.

brief.zh: 输入原图和两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> x、y，按<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>读取每格的值：中点取较大坐标，图外取最近边界。
brief.en: Given a source and the <wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> inputs x and y, use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> to read each value: midpoint ties take the larger coordinate; outside positions use the nearest boundary.

hint.zh: 先只检查 x 路的整数坐标，再检查 y 路；每格应遵循单个位置任务中的同一规则。原图的亮度不参与坐标计算。
hint.en: Inspect integer coordinates on the x path first, then y. Each cell follows the same rule as the single-position task. Source intensities do not participate in coordinate calculations.

hint.zh: 位置正确但出界测试失败时，检查取像素元件的“出界”设置；本关要求读取最近的边。
hint.en: If positions are correct but outside tests fail, inspect the Lookup part's Outside setting. This task reads the nearest edge.

t.zh: 从照片中截取一块区域时，截出的画面怎样对应原图？用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>保留选中的区域，追踪新图各位置在原图中的来源；新图的左上角对应所选区域的起点。
t.en: When a region is cut from a photograph, how does the result correspond to the original? Use <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> to retain the selected region and trace each position in the new image back to its source. The new top-left corner corresponds to the start of the selected region.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、左上角 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h，输出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块
desc.en: Takes an image, the top-left corner x0, y0, and a width w and height h; gives the w × h region from (x0, y0)

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>保留选定区域的原有数值，只改变区域的位置和坐标范围；它不会像缩放那样重新确定输出的采样位置。
after.en: <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> retains the selected region’s original values while changing its position and coordinate range. Unlike resizing, it does not establish new sampling positions.

t.zh: 一整张新图的每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>都要算出它在原图的坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>：给定宽和高，给出两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>，x 图每格是自己的 x，y 图每格是自己的 y；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>接上坐标图，就一次取出整张图。
t.en: Every <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> of a whole new image needs its coordinates in the original. New part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>: given a width and a height it gives two coordinate images, each cell of x holding its own x and of y its own y; fed coordinate images, <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads a whole image at once. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

brief.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
brief.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

hint.zh: 先给新图每格一对自己的坐标，再挪到原图里去。
hint.en: First give each new cell its own coordinates, then move them into the original.

t.zh: <part-ref to="project"></part-ref>能确定像的位置，<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>则从图像原点数列号。要让两者对上，先区分单位，再区分原点。同一段距离可以用毫米量，也可以数跨过几个<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>；本关直接提供换算好的<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px，不需要另算换算系数。
t.en: <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> locates the image, while the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> counts columns from the image origin. Connecting them requires distinguishing units, then origins. One distance can be measured in millimetres or in <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref> steps. This task supplies the converted <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px; no extra conversion factor is needed.

t.zh: 照片中的列从 0 向右增加，光轴却不一定穿过第 0 列。它穿过的列由<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x 给出。图示的两种位置距光轴同样远，却落在不同列。先只处理已给出的带符号偏移 d，弄清它与列号的关系，再把相机计算接进来。
t.en: Image columns increase rightwards from 0, but the axis need not pass through column 0. Its intersection is given by <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x. The two illustrated positions are equally far from the axis but occupy different columns. First handle a supplied signed offset d, then connect the camera calculation.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>将投影位置与图像坐标联系起来：光路不变，变化的是单位和原点。区分<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>的单位换算与坐标原点的平移，有助于正确表示负偏移。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
after.en: A <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> relates projected positions to image coordinates: the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> is unchanged, while the units and origin differ. Distinguishing the unit conversion for <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> from the shift of origin helps represent negative offsets correctly.

brief.zh: 已知以<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>为单位的带符号偏移 d，以及<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>列号 c_x：输出像点列号 u。
brief.en: Given signed offset d in <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> units and <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> column c_x, output the image column u.

hint.zh: 先看 d = 0 的测试：落点应与光轴同列。再看正、负偏移，它们应朝哪个方向改变列号？
hint.en: Start with d = 0: the point is in the same column as the axis. In which direction should positive and negative offsets change that column?

after.zh: 同样的偏移可以落在不同列，取决于光轴穿过哪一列。负偏移表示朝列号减小的方向移动，不等于一定在图外。接下来由相机提供这个偏移。
after.en: The same offset can land in different columns depending on where the axis intersects the image. A negative offset moves towards smaller columns; it need not be outside the image. Next let the camera provide the offset.

t.zh: 现在不再直接给偏移 d，而是给物点 X、深度 Z 和 f_px。X、Z 使用相同长度单位，两者的比例不带长度单位；f_px 是<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>，因此<part-ref to="project"></part-ref>的输出已是带符号的像素偏移。沿用刚才区分原点的方法，把这个结果表示成图像列号。
t.en: The offset d is no longer supplied. Instead you receive point position X, depth Z and f_px. X and Z share a length unit, so their ratio has no length unit. With <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px, <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> returns a signed pixel offset. Use the origin distinction you just established to express it as an image column.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px 和<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x：交出像点的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>横坐标 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z, the <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px and the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x, give the image's <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> column u.

hint.zh: 先只接带符号的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>偏移，检查 X=0 与 X<0 两种情况，再决定图像原点要怎样平移。
hint.en: First wire only the signed <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> offset. Check X=0 and X<0, then decide how the image origin shifts it.

t.zh: 照片中的两个人看起来一样高，他们在现实中一定一样高吗？<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>可以从场景得到图像，但同一图像可能对应不同场景。以 H=1、Z=4、f=2 为参照，构造一座至少高一倍、成像相同的标定灯塔，再在额外给定 Z 的条件下倒推位置。
t.en: If two people appear equally tall in a photograph, must they be equally tall in reality? <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> maps a scene to an image, but one image may correspond to different scenes. Using H=1, Z=4, f=2 as a reference, construct a calibration lighthouse at least twice as tall with the same image, then infer position when Z is also given.

after.zh: 两个不同场景得到同样的观测，因此单凭这个像不能在它们之间做选择。这是<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>的困难：假设 Z 后算出的是条件下的位置，不是从图像恢复出的真实深度。这个实验也不能证明颜色或物体总数一定能确定。
after.en: Two different scenes give the same observation, so that image cannot distinguish them. This is the difficulty of the <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>: supplying Z gives a conditional position, not depth recovered from the image. This experiment does not establish unique colour or object count either.

brief.zh: 调 H 和 Z：像高仍为 0.5，但 H 至少为 2。所有长度共用模型单位；对照参照图再检查。
brief.en: Adjust H and Z: keep image height 0.5 with H at least 2. All lengths share model units. Compare with the reference, then check.

hint.zh: 物高加倍、距离不变，像会怎样？距离也加倍呢？
hint.en: Double the height and keep the distance: what does the image do? Double the distance too?

why.zh: 只把灯塔加高：距离不变，像也跟着加倍成 1。要让像不变，距离得和物高一起加倍。
why.en: Only making the lighthouse taller: at the same distance its image doubles to 1. For the same image the distance must double with the height.

t.zh: 倒过来：已知像点的位置 u，物点在哪？只有像不够，还得假设一个距离 Z。
t.en: The other way: given the image position u, where is the point? The image alone is not enough; a distance Z must be assumed.

brief.zh: 输入像点位置 u、<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>距离 f 和假设的距离 Z：交出物点的横向位置 X。
brief.en: Given the image position u, the plane distance f and an assumed distance Z, give the point's sideways position X. (<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>)

hint.zh: 对比两个测试：像点相同，假设的 Z 不同，X 应怎样变化？哪一步能撤销已做过的投影缩放？
hint.en: Compare the two tests: the image point stays fixed but the assumed Z changes. How should X change, and how can the projection scale be undone?

t.zh: 欢迎来到视觉实验室。你要为一座灯塔搭建成像与图像处理系统：先让相机把场景变成照片，再让机器读取、重采样和处理照片。这里没有现成的整机；你亲手做出的关键模块会封装成工具，用来组装更完整的机器。
t.en: Welcome to Vision Lab. Build a camera and image processor for a lighthouse: turn the scene into a photograph, then teach the machine to read, resample and process it. Key modules you build become reusable tools for assembling the larger machine.

t.zh: 先接通相机的定位模块。图中的发光标记与<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> O 确定一条<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>。X 量离轴位置，Z 量到相机的距离，f 量 O 到<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>的距离；u 是屏上的位置。正方向一致，所有长度共用单位。只改变一个量的拍摄案例，能帮助你找出它们的关系。
t.en: Begin with the camera’s positioning module. The light marker and <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref> O define a <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>. X measures displacement from the axis, Z distance to the camera, f distance from O to the <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>, and u position on that screen. Positive directions agree and lengths share one unit. Compare cases changing one quantity at a time.

desc.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和虚像平面距离 f，输出像点位置 u。
desc.en: Given a point's sideways position X, depth Z and virtual image plane distance f, outputs the image position u.

after.zh: 同一条<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>经过 O，使两段距离受<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>约束。<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>把这个比例推广到不同的位置与深度；场景和图像的坐标不能直接当作同一个量。
after.en: A shared <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> through O constrains the distances through <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>. <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> applies that proportion across positions and depths; scene and image coordinates are not interchangeable.

t.zh: 输入元件显示当前测试给定的数，输出元件收取你的结果。从元件栏放入<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>或<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>，从输出口连接到输入口。手机上依次点两个接口；电脑上拖线。点“运行”会检查整块电路，失败时可切换测试、检查数值并改线。需要比例关系时可查看<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Input parts show the current test’s given values; output parts collect your result. Place <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> or <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref> from the tray and connect output ports to input ports. On a phone tap the two ports; on a computer drag a wire. Run checks the circuit. Switch tests and inspect values to debug it. For proportions, consult <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

hint.zh: 先决定 X 在同一深度下怎样缩放，再比较 Z 和 f 各改变哪一段距离。
hint.en: First decide how X is scaled at one depth, then compare which distance changes with Z and f.

hint.zh: 回看<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>的比例关系；需要的是能随三个输入一起变化的关系，而不是固定倍数。
hint.en: Revisit the proportion in <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>; the scale must respond to all three inputs rather than stay fixed.

why: Explain characteristic conceptual mistakes from their observed outputs

value.zh: 对称平滑核不能暴露约定差别。观察孤立亮点与不对称书写核，数学卷积会反转核的方向。
value.en: Symmetric smoothing hides the convention. Inspect the impulse and asymmetric written kernel: mathematical convolution reverses the kernel orientation.

value.zh: 混合区域编号会创造没有定义的类别；检查分界位置的读数是否来自原有样本。
value.en: Mixing identifiers invents undefined classes; inspect whether boundary readings are original samples.

value.zh: 先求强度会把细碎变化变成非负响应，之后平滑通常无法得到先平滑信号再测量的结果。
value.en: Magnitude first turns fine variations into nonnegative responses. Smoothing them is generally different from measuring a smoothed signal.

value.zh: 带符号分量相加可能相消。强度需要衡量两个垂直分量的长度。
value.en: Signed components can cancel. Strength measures the length of the two perpendicular components.

value.zh: 两种材料不能使用同一种判断：亮度允许中间过渡，区域编号必须保留原有类别。
value.en: The materials have different meanings: intensities allow intermediate transitions, while identifiers must retain original classes.

value.zh: 取值用到了原照片的参照系。这里的坐标相对于裁剪区域，同样的数字在原照片中指向别的位置。
value.en: Sampling used the original photograph as reference. These coordinates are local to the crop and point elsewhere in the original.

value.zh: 两路读到了相同方向的变化。沿 x 的响应与沿 y 的响应需要检查不同的邻居。
value.en: Both paths measure the same direction. Changes along x and y require different neighbours.

value.zh: 平滑沿着差分方向进行，削弱的不是要求抑制的垂直干扰。检查每路差分与平滑的轴是否互相垂直。
value.en: Smoothing follows the differentiation axis rather than the perpendicular nuisance. Inspect whether the two axes are perpendicular in each path.

value.zh: 两次都沿相同方向处理，另一方向的条纹没有被平均。比较横向和纵向图案。
value.en: Both passes work along the same axis, leaving the other stripe orientation unaveraged. Compare horizontal and vertical patterns.

value.zh: 权重和超过 1 会放大恒定区域的亮度。对照常量图与权重和，而不是只看亮点形状。
value.en: A weight sum above 1 amplifies constant intensity. Inspect the constant case and gain, not only the impulse shape.

value.zh: 黑框来自未观测邻居被补成 0。内部平均规则可以保持不变，需要检查图外假设。
value.en: The dark frame comes from filling unobserved neighbours with zero. Keep the averaging rule and inspect the outside assumption.

why: Show discrete region identifiers as visible colours rather than clipped numeric intensities

ops.zh: 这张图用不同颜色标记区域编号。按给定位置生成新的区域图：每格必须保留最近的原有区域颜色；图外延续边缘区域，不能混出新的类别颜色。
ops.en: Colours identify regions. Build a new map at the supplied positions, retaining the closest original region colour and extending edge regions outside, without inventing mixed class colours.

step.why: Show discrete region identifiers as visible colours rather than clipped numeric intensities

value.zh: 这张图的每个值是一个区域编号。按给定位置生成新的区域图：每格必须来自最近的原有区域；图外延续边缘区域，不能创造编号或混合类别。
value.en: Each value identifies a region. Build a new region map at the supplied positions: use the closest original region and extend edge regions outside, without inventing labels or mixing classes.

why: Keep synthesis concise and terminology reachable before use

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>由位置与深度的比例决定；焦距改变成像尺度。照片只记录投影，通常不能唯一确定原场景。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> depends on position relative to depth; focal length changes image scale. The image generally does not uniquely determine its scene.

ops.zh: 不同场景可产生相同照片，这是<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>的歧义。假设距离后能计算位置，不代表从照片恢复了真实深度。
ops.en: Different scenes can produce one image: the ambiguity of an <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>. Assuming a distance permits a position calculation, not recovery of true depth.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>改变单位和原点，不改变光路。光轴左侧的负偏移仍可对应有效列号。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> changes units and origin, not the light path. A negative offset from the optical axis can still correspond to a valid column.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>保留原样本，适合离散标签。延续边缘是一种图外假设，不是新观测。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> retains original samples and suits discrete labels. Extending edges is an outside assumption, not new evidence.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>减轻阶梯感，但不会恢复未记录的细节。采样位置必须相对正确的源图解释。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref> reduces stepping but cannot restore unmeasured detail. Sampling positions must refer to the intended source image.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>同时涉及传感器范围与焦距。构图须兼顾完整主体、成像大小与干扰物；局部裁掉不等于完全排除。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> depends on sensor extent and focal length. Framing balances subject coverage, image size and distractions; partial cropping is not complete exclusion.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的权重和控制恒定区域亮度；平均会减弱快速变化。<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>还决定边缘是否出现人工变化。
ops.en: The weight sum of a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> controls constant intensity; averaging weakens rapid variation. <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> also determines artificial boundary changes.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>利用外积结构减少计算，边界假设须一致。<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>也会扩散分界，平滑并非无损去噪。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> exploits an outer product with consistent boundaries. <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> also spreads boundaries: smoothing is not lossless denoising.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的方向约定不同；对称权重会掩盖差别，不对称探针才能暴露它。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> use different orientations. Symmetric weights conceal the difference; asymmetric probes expose it.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>沿变化方向差分、沿垂直方向平滑。正负记录变化方向；亮度分界不等同于物体轮廓或类别。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> differentiates along change and smooths perpendicularly. Sign records contrast direction; an intensity boundary does not establish an object or its class.

ops.zh: 处理顺序决定测量对象。先求非负强度再平滑，通常不等价于先平滑再测量；<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>仍是局部证据。
ops.en: Processing order determines the measured signal. Smoothing magnitude is generally different from measuring a smoothed signal; <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> still supplies local evidence.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>是工具的约定差别；<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>是数值表示的限制，需与视觉模型区分。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref> concerns a tool convention; <wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref> concerns numeric representation. Distinguish both from the visual model.

ops.zh: 你负责摄影实验室的相机与图像处理器。先预测场景会落在照片的哪里，再让处理器裁剪、放大和提取变化。每关解决一个视觉问题，计算与重复接线由工具协助。这里先研究：物体位置、距离和焦距分别怎样改变投影？ <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: You are building a camera and image processor for a photography lab. First locate a scene in its photograph, then crop, enlarge and measure changes. Each level solves a visual problem, with arithmetic and repeated wiring supported. Begin by relating position, depth and focal length to projection. <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 照片是按行列排列的读数。这里 x 是列、y 是行，左上角为 (0,0)，每个整数位置指一个像素中心；位置与该格的亮度是不同信息。先看示例，再把已知的投影接到照片的列号。 <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: A photograph contains readings arranged in rows and columns. Here x is the column, y the row, the top-left is (0,0), and integer positions mark pixel centres. A location and its intensity are different information. Inspect the example, then relate projection to image columns. <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 照片中的列从 0 向右增加，光轴却不一定穿过第 0 列。它穿过的列由<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x 给出。图示的两种位置距光轴同样远，却落在不同列。先只处理已给出的带符号偏移 d，弄清它与列号的关系，再把相机计算接进来。 <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: Image columns increase rightwards from 0, but the axis need not pass through column 0. Its intersection is given by <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x. The two illustrated positions are equally far from the axis but occupy different columns. First handle a supplied signed offset d, then connect the camera calculation. <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 投影和输出结构已预接，可以自由修改。公式与像素单位换算均可查阅；需要决定的是偏移应当相对哪个原点使用。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: Projection and output plumbing are preconnected and editable. Formulas and pixel conversion are available; decide which origin the displacement is relative to. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 检查投影元件给的是相对光轴的偏移，还是从图像原点数的列号。用 X=0 的测试定位参照原点，再检查负 X。 <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: Check whether projection gives an axis-relative offset or an image-origin column. Use X=0 to locate the reference origin, then inspect negative X. <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 现在不再直接给偏移 d，而是给物点 X、深度 Z 和 f_px。X、Z 使用相同长度单位，两者的比例不带长度单位；f_px 是<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>，因此<part-ref to="project"></part-ref>的输出已是带符号的像素偏移。沿用刚才区分原点的方法，把这个结果表示成图像列号。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: The offset d is no longer supplied. Instead you receive point position X, depth Z and f_px. X and Z share a length unit, so their ratio has no length unit. With <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px, <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> returns a signed pixel offset. Use the origin distinction you just established to express it as an image column. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 处理器已生成输出坐标并接好图像读取。你只需建立这些输出位置与原图所选区域的对应关系；循环和逐像素读取不需要实现。裁剪后每格仍应是原来那个像素的值。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: The processor already generates output coordinates and reads the source. Establish their correspondence to the selected source region; loops and per-pixel indexing are supplied. Every cropped value must remain an original sample. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 对称平滑核翻转后不变，容易让人忽略约定。准备研究有方向的变化之前，先用不对称的核和孤立亮点检查：书写顺序如何影响响应方向？ <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: Reversing a symmetric smoothing kernel changes nothing, which can hide the convention. Before studying directional changes, use an asymmetric kernel and an impulse to inspect how written order affects response direction. <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 同一输入要交出两路结果：一路复用二维平滑器；另一路按书写核做数学卷积，图外补 0。用孤立亮点确认方向，核翻转由工具处理。 <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: Produce two paths from the same input: reuse your 2D smoother, and apply the written kernel as mathematical convolution with zero outside. Use an impulse to check direction; the operator handles reversal. <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 横向再纵向的有效权重可以自动相乘显示。这个例子说明可分离结构为何节省计算，并不表示任意二维核都能拆开。 <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: The effective weights of the two passes can be displayed by multiplying them. This explains the computational benefit of a separable structure; arbitrary 2D kernels do not necessarily factor. <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 保留方向差分，并减弱垂直方向的细碎变化。分别组合差分 [-1,0,1] 与平滑 [1,2,1]。这是 Sobel 的位置权重约定，幅值不归一化；无需猜系数。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: Retain directional differences while reducing fine variation perpendicular to them. Compose differences [-1,0,1] with smoothing [1,2,1]. These are Sobel positional weights with unnormalised amplitude; coefficients are supplied. <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 现在将相机读数变成可解释的视觉测量。颜色组合工具处理通道算术；你构建的平滑器与强度器决定处理流程。比较平滑后的图与变化强度，检查细碎变化是否先进入了非线性的强度计算。 <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="blur"></part-ref> <part-ref to="edgeStrength"></part-ref> <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: Turn camera readings into an interpretable visual measurement. Colour mixing supplies channel arithmetic; your smoother and strength module determine the processing path. Compare the processed image and its strength, checking when fine variation enters the nonlinear magnitude operation. <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="blur"></part-ref> <part-ref to="edgeStrength"></part-ref> <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 一张照片在不同工具中显示时，蓝天可能变成橙色：原因可能是颜色通道的排列顺序不同。Workshop 2 中，OpenCV 读入的顺序为 B、G、R，而 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示。图像计算还需要留意数据类型：uint8 的范围为 0 到 255，超出范围的运算结果可能发生回绕。 <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: A photograph can display an orange sky in another tool because its colour channels are ordered differently. In Workshop 2, OpenCV reads B, G, R while Matplotlib displays R, G, B. Image calculations also depend on data type: uint8 ranges from 0 to 255, and arithmetic results outside that range can wrap around. <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 怎样恢复照片的颜色？<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>将三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次作为 R、G、B 通道合成彩色图。 <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: How can the photograph’s colours be restored? <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> combines three <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> as the R, G and B channels of a colour image. <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>

ops.zh: 对称权重掩盖了方向差别。观察孤立亮点与不对称权重，目标规则会反转相邻位置的贡献。
ops.en: Symmetric weights hide the direction difference. Inspect the impulse and asymmetric weights: the target convention reverses the neighbouring contributions.

value.zh: 对称平滑核不能暴露约定差别。观察孤立亮点与不对称书写核，数学卷积会反转核的方向。
value.en: Symmetric smoothing hides the convention. Inspect the impulse and asymmetric written kernel: mathematical convolution reverses the kernel orientation.

value.zh: 怎样恢复照片的颜色？<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>将三张<wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref>依次作为 R、G、B 通道合成彩色图。
value.en: How can the photograph’s colours be restored? <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> combines three <wiki-ref to="greyscale-image"></wiki-ref> as the R, G and B channels of a colour image.

Image calculations also depend on data type: uint8 ranges from 0 to 255, and arithmetic results outside that range can wrap around.

Compare the processed image and its strength, checking when fine variation enters the nonlinear magnitude operation. <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> <part-ref to="blur"></part-ref> <part-ref to="edgeStrength"></part-ref>

value.en: Reversing a symmetric smoothing kernel changes nothing, which can hide the convention. Before studying directional changes, use an asymmetric kernel and an impulse to inspect how written order affects response direction. <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="impulse"></wiki-ref>

value.en: The processor already generates output coordinates and reads the source. Establish their correspondence to the selected source region; loops and per-pixel indexing are supplied. Every cropped value must remain an original sample.

value.zh: 现在不再直接给偏移 d，而是给物点 X、深度 Z 和 f_px。X、Z 使用相同长度单位，两者的比例不带长度单位；f_px 是<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>，因此<part-ref to="project"></part-ref>的输出已是带符号的像素偏移。沿用刚才区分原点的方法，把这个结果表示成图像列号。
value.en: The offset d is no longer supplied. Instead you receive point position X, depth Z and f_px. X and Z share a length unit, so their ratio has no length unit. With <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px, <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> returns a signed pixel offset. Use the origin distinction you just established to express it as an image column.

value.zh: 检查投影元件给的是相对光轴的偏移，还是从图像原点数的列号。用 X=0 的测试定位参照原点，再检查负 X。
value.en: Check whether projection gives an axis-relative offset or an image-origin column. Use X=0 to locate the reference origin, then inspect negative X.

value.zh: 投影和输出结构已预接，可以自由修改。公式与像素单位换算均可查阅；需要决定的是偏移应当相对哪个原点使用。
value.en: Projection and output plumbing are preconnected and editable. Formulas and pixel conversion are available; decide which origin the displacement is relative to.

value.zh: 照片中的列从 0 向右增加，光轴却不一定穿过第 0 列。它穿过的列由<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x 给出。图示的两种位置距光轴同样远，却落在不同列。先只处理已给出的带符号偏移 d，弄清它与列号的关系，再把相机计算接进来。
value.en: Image columns increase rightwards from 0, but the axis need not pass through column 0. Its intersection is given by <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x. The two illustrated positions are equally far from the axis but occupy different columns. First handle a supplied signed offset d, then connect the camera calculation.

value.zh: 照片是按行列排列的读数。这里 x 是列、y 是行，左上角为 (0,0)，每个整数位置指一个像素中心；位置与该格的亮度是不同信息。先看示例，再把已知的投影接到照片的列号。 <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A photograph contains readings arranged in rows and columns. Here x is the column, y the row, the top-left is (0,0), and integer positions mark pixel centres. A location and its intensity are different information. Inspect the example, then relate projection to image columns. <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 你负责摄影实验室的相机与图像处理器。先预测场景会落在照片的哪里，再让处理器裁剪、放大和提取变化。每关解决一个视觉问题，计算与重复接线由工具协助。这里先研究：物体位置、距离和焦距分别怎样改变投影？
value.en: You are building a camera and image processor for a photography lab. First locate a scene in its photograph, then crop, enlarge and measure changes. Each level solves a visual problem, with arithmetic and repeated wiring supported. Begin by relating position, depth and focal length to projection.

value.zh: 不同工具的颜色通道顺序可能不同，交换顺序前需要确认输入和输出的约定（<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>）。整数类型的取值范围也会影响计算结果（<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>）；计算前应选择足以容纳结果的类型。
value.en: Tools may use different channel orders, so check input and output conventions before rearranging them (<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>). Integer ranges also affect computed results (<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>); choose a type that can hold the result before computing.

value.zh: 处理顺序决定测量的对象。线性颜色组合与逐通道线性平滑可交换，但求长度是非线性的，先求强度再平滑通常不等价。整条流程建立的是局部亮度证据，并不识别物体。 <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The signal path determines what is measured. Linear colour mixing commutes with channelwise linear smoothing, but magnitude is nonlinear: measuring strength before smoothing is generally different. The pipeline produces local intensity evidence, not object recognition. <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>在变化方向上做差分，在垂直方向上做平滑；响应符号区分明暗变化方向，不能直接作为非负强度。图像分界只是亮度证据，不等同于物体轮廓或类别。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> differentiates along the change direction and smooths perpendicularly. Its sign records contrast direction and is not a nonnegative strength. Intensity boundaries alone do not establish object identity or shape.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的差别在核的方向约定；对称核无法暴露差别。不对称测试可用于检查后续方向响应，核翻转本身无需手工接线。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> differ in kernel orientation. Symmetric kernels conceal the difference; asymmetric probes expose it. Kernel reversal itself needs no manual wiring.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>利用二维核的外积结构分两次完成同一运算；边界假设必须一致。这里得到的<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>降低快速变化，也会扩散分界，不能把平滑当作无损去噪。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref> uses an outer-product structure to perform the same operation in two passes with consistent boundaries. <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref> reduces rapid variation but also spreads boundaries; denoising is not lossless.

value.zh: 局部平滑通过邻居组合减弱快速变化；权重和控制恒定区域的亮度。边缘效果还取决于未观测位置的假设。 <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Local smoothing combines neighbours to weaken rapid changes; the weight sum controls constant intensity. Boundary effects also depend on assumptions about unobserved positions. <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 放大投影会缩小<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>，改变相机高度则平移物体相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的位置。这两个调整相互约束：画面中的主体要足够大，也必须完整；不能把“有一部分被裁掉”当作“完全不在画面里”。<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>描述固定<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>画幅与<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>之间的取舍。
value.en: Enlarging the projection narrows the <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>, while changing camera height shifts objects relative to the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>. The controls constrain each other: the subject must be large enough yet complete. Partial cropping is not complete exclusion. <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> describes the trade-off between a fixed <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>能减轻阶梯感，但平滑过渡不代表恢复了原图没有记录的细节。处理顺序还决定坐标相对哪张图解释；同一对数字放在不同参照系里会读到不同内容。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref> can reduce stepping, but a smooth transition does not restore unmeasured detail. The processing order also determines which image the coordinates refer to.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>保持原有样本，适合不能混合的离散标签；选择取值规则必须考虑数值代表什么。图外延续边缘是一种假设，并不是对图外内容的新观测。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> preserves original samples, which suits discrete labels that must not mix. Interpolation depends on what the values mean. Extending an edge is an assumption, not a new observation.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>将投影位置与图像坐标联系起来：光路不变，变化的是单位和原点。区分<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>的单位换算与坐标原点的平移，有助于正确表示负偏移。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
value.en: A <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> relates projected positions to image coordinates: the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> is unchanged, while the units and origin differ. Distinguishing the unit conversion for <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> from the shift of origin helps represent negative offsets correctly.

value.zh: 两个不同场景得到同样的观测，因此单凭这个像不能在它们之间做选择。这是<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>的困难：假设 Z 后算出的是条件下的位置，不是从图像恢复出的真实深度。这个实验也不能证明颜色或物体总数一定能确定。
value.en: Two different scenes give the same observation, so that image cannot distinguish them. This is the difficulty of the <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>: supplying Z gives a conditional position, not depth recovered from the image. This experiment does not establish unique colour or object count either.

value.zh: 同一条<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>经过 O，使两段距离受<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>约束。<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>把这个比例推广到不同的位置与深度；场景和图像的坐标不能直接当作同一个量。
value.en: A shared <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> through O constrains the distances through <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>. <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> applies that proportion across positions and depths; scene and image coordinates are not interchangeable.

why: Tighten conclusions without losing principles or references

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>由位置与深度的比例决定，<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>改变尺度；照片通常不能唯一确定场景。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> depends on position relative to depth; <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref> changes scale. An image generally does not uniquely establish its scene.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>改变单位和原点，不改变光路。<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>左侧的偏移仍可对应有效列号。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> changes units and origin, not the light path. An offset left of the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref> can still correspond to a valid column.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>同时涉及<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>。构图须兼顾主体、大小与干扰；部分裁掉不等于完全排除。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> depends on <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>. Balance subject coverage, size and distractions; partial cropping is not exclusion.

ops.zh: 不同场景可产生相同照片，这是<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>的歧义。假设距离后计算位置，不等于恢复真实深度。
ops.en: Different scenes can produce one image: the ambiguity of an <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>. Assuming a distance permits a position calculation, not recovery of true depth.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的权重和控制恒定亮度；平均减弱快速变化。<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>还影响边缘。
ops.en: The weight sum of a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> controls constant intensity; averaging weakens rapid variation. <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> also affects boundaries.

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>方向约定不同；对称权重掩盖差别，不对称探针可暴露它。
ops.en: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> use different orientations. Symmetric weights conceal the difference; asymmetric probes expose it.

ops.zh: 同一输入交出两路结果：复用二维平滑器；按书写核做<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>，图外补 0。用亮点确认方向，工具处理翻转。 <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>
ops.en: Produce two paths: your 2D smoother and <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> with the written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> and zero outside. Use an impulse to check direction; reversal is supplied.

ops.zh: 保留方向差分，并抑制垂直方向干扰。组合 [-1,0,1] 与 [1,2,1]，幅值不归一化；<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>系数已提供。
ops.en: Retain directional differences and suppress perpendicular nuisance. Compose [-1,0,1] with [1,2,1] without normalising amplitude; <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> coefficients are supplied.

body.zh: <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>与成像平面的交点，用图像坐标表示为 (c_x,c_y)，不一定在图像中心。<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>中心从 0 开始编号；若 N 格的图恰好居中，中心坐标才是 (N−1)/2。相对光轴的偏移为零，图像坐标则是主点坐标。出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2，slides 11、15、18。 <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>
body.en: The intersection of the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref> with the image plane, at image coordinates (c_x,c_y); it need not be at the image centre. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> centres are indexed from 0; only a centred N-cell image has centre coordinate (N−1)/2. Zero axis-relative displacement corresponds to the principal-point coordinate. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18. <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>与成像平面的交点，用图像坐标表示为 (c_x,c_y)，不一定在图像中心。<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>中心从 0 开始编号；若 N 格的图恰好居中，中心坐标才是 (N−1)/2。相对光轴的偏移为零，图像坐标则是主点坐标。出处：COMP90086 Lecture 2，slides 11、15、18。
body.en: The intersection of the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref> with the image plane, at image coordinates (c_x,c_y); it need not be at the image centre. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> centres are indexed from 0; only a centred N-cell image has centre coordinate (N−1)/2. Zero axis-relative displacement corresponds to the principal-point coordinate. Source: COMP90086 Lecture 2, slides 11, 15, 18.

value.zh: 保留方向差分，并减弱垂直方向的细碎变化。分别组合差分 [-1,0,1] 与平滑 [1,2,1]。这是 Sobel 的位置权重约定，幅值不归一化；无需猜系数。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Retain directional differences while reducing fine variation perpendicular to them. Compose differences [-1,0,1] with smoothing [1,2,1]. These are Sobel positional weights with unnormalised amplitude; coefficients are supplied. <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 同一输入要交出两路结果：一路复用二维平滑器；另一路按书写核做数学卷积，图外补 0。用孤立亮点确认方向，核翻转由工具处理。 <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Produce two paths from the same input: reuse your 2D smoother, and apply the written kernel as mathematical convolution with zero outside. Use an impulse to check direction; the operator handles reversal. <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>与<wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的方向约定不同；对称权重会掩盖差别，不对称探针才能暴露它。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> use different orientations. Symmetric weights conceal the difference; asymmetric probes expose it.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的权重和控制恒定区域亮度；平均会减弱快速变化。<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>还决定边缘是否出现人工变化。
value.en: The weight sum of a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref> controls constant intensity; averaging weakens rapid variation. <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref> also determines artificial boundary changes.

value.zh: 不同场景可产生相同照片，这是<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>的歧义。假设距离后能计算位置，不代表从照片恢复了真实深度。
value.en: Different scenes can produce one image: the ambiguity of an <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>. Assuming a distance permits a position calculation, not recovery of true depth.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>同时涉及传感器范围与焦距。构图须兼顾完整主体、成像大小与干扰物；局部裁掉不等于完全排除。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> depends on sensor extent and focal length. Framing balances subject coverage, image size and distractions; partial cropping is not complete exclusion.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>改变单位和原点，不改变光路。光轴左侧的负偏移仍可对应有效列号。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> changes units and origin, not the light path. A negative offset from the optical axis can still correspond to a valid column.

value.zh: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>由位置与深度的比例决定；焦距改变成像尺度。照片只记录投影，通常不能唯一确定原场景。
value.en: <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> depends on position relative to depth; focal length changes image scale. The image generally does not uniquely determine its scene.

why: Supply normalisation arithmetic while retaining the gain decision

ops.zh: 孤立亮点显示权重比例，恒定图检验总增益。可以输入比例 1、2、1，再点“使权重和为 1”；系统计算小数，无需手算。
ops.en: An impulse exposes weight ratios; a constant image tests gain. Enter ratios 1,2,1 and use Make weights sum to 1; the tool computes the decimals.

value.zh: 孤立亮点能显示每个权重的作用；恒定区域能检验总增益。权重比已给出，不需要从目标数字猜高斯公式。
value.en: An isolated bright sample exposes individual weights; a constant region tests total gain. The ratio is supplied, so no Gaussian-formula guessing is required.

why: Connect image ambiguity to the assumptions behind smoothing

t.zh: 细碎变化可能是噪声，也可能是真实纹理；单凭照片不能唯一分辨。本实验假设这些小尺度变化是干扰，目标是平滑，并不声称还原真实场景。<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Fine variation may be noise or real texture; the photograph alone cannot uniquely distinguish them. Here we assume small-scale variation is nuisance. Smoothing does not establish recovery of the actual scene. <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>

why: Keep final synthesis within the shared reading budget

ops.zh: <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>和<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>共同决定<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>。构图需兼顾主体与干扰，部分裁掉并非完全排除。

value.en: <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="cross-correlation"></wiki-ref> use different orientations. Symmetric weights conceal the difference; asymmetric probes expose it.

value.en: <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> depends on <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref> and <wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>. Balance subject coverage, size and distractions; partial cropping is not exclusion.

ops.en: <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> constrains subject size and coverage. Partially cropping a distraction does not exclude it completely.
