value.en: Neighbourhood processing combines locations. Position, sign and total weight affect direction, response and constant gain. Not every rule should be normalised. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

t.zh: 横向加权器只能看一条线。二维平均还需要另一条轴的邻居；自己的三点加权器已开放空间轴设置。你决定两次处理怎样连接，对比亮点的十字和矩形响应。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The line sees one axis. A 2D average also needs the other; your weighted-line part exposes an axis setting. Decide how to connect two passes by comparing cross and square impulse responses. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 权重的位置、符号与总和分别影响方向、响应与增益。负权重和非单位增益也有用途。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Weight positions, signs and sum affect direction, response and gain. Negative weights and non-unit gain can be useful. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

why: Keep the introductory impulse fully visible as a 3x3 matrix on phones; rectangular transfer cases remain

step.why: Keep the introductory impulse fully visible as a 3x3 matrix on phones; rectangular transfer cases remain

why: Introduce components and enum configurations only in the task that needs them; scaffold unfamiliar representations before combined machines

value.zh: 邻域读数必须先按给定权重形成贡献；直接汇总会把核中应被忽略的位置也算进去。
value.en: Samples must first receive their supplied weights; summing raw readings counts neighbours the kernel excludes.

t.zh: 每一行现在是一处输出的全部贡献。逐行汇总先把它们相加，得到一列；还原形状再按原图的行序排回宽高。两个工具只处理重复计算与排布，你决定哪些量应被汇合。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Each row now contains all contributions to one output. Sum rows into one column, then restore original dimensions in row order. The services handle repeated arithmetic and arrangement; decide which quantities belong in the sum. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 每个原位置展开为一行，输出各邻居的带权贡献，暂不合并。行内位置按权重表逐行对应，图外读数取 0。
brief.en: For each original location, output one row of weighted neighbour contributions without combining them. Within a row, match written kernel order; read zero outside.

naiveWhy.zh: 展开只收集读数，不施加权重。中心为 0 的核仍可能让周围位置产生贡献。
naiveWhy.en: Unfolding collects samples without applying weights. A zero centre weight does not remove contributions from neighbours.

t.zh: 三点加权已经把位置与权重分开。现在邻域可以有多行：展开工具为每个输出位置保留一行读数，并给出一一对应的权重；先检查每一路的贡献，再汇合结果。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The line separated sample positions from weights. A neighbourhood can now have several rows: unfolding gives one sample row per output location and matching weights. Inspect contributions before combining them. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 展开只收集读数，不施加权重。中心为 0 的核仍可能让周围位置产生贡献。
hint.en: Unfolding collects samples without applying weights. A zero centre weight does not remove contributions from neighbours.

t.zh: 强度测量已经能合并两方向，但差分仍会响应细碎干扰。现在引入垂直于求导方向的平滑，让方向分量先更稳定，再送入已验证的长度测量。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The strength measurement combines both directions, but raw derivatives still respond to fine nuisance. Stabilise each derivative by smoothing perpendicular to its direction before the verified length measurement. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 保留差分器给出的两个带符号分量，并输出它们作为垂直方向分量时的长度。长度只表示变化有多强，不能被正负抵消。
brief.en: Retain both signed derivative components and output their length as perpendicular components. Strength measures change size without cancellation.

naiveWhy.zh: 同时看两个方向都有变化的位置，以及符号相反的位置。保留分量是为了区分方向，长度负责合并强度。
naiveWhy.en: Inspect locations changing in both directions and with opposite signs. Components retain direction; length combines strength.

t.zh: 差分器分别测出横向和纵向变化。两分量有正负号，直接相加会互相抵消；向量长度元件自动计算平方和与平方根。先建立强度测量，再处理干扰。 <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The derivative measures horizontal and vertical change separately. Signed components can cancel in a sum; the length component supplies the squared sum and square root. Establish strength before suppressing nuisance. <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 同时看两个方向都有变化的位置，以及符号相反的位置。保留分量是为了区分方向，长度负责合并强度。
hint.en: Inspect locations changing in both directions and with opposite signs. Components retain direction; length combines strength.

t.zh: 逐频率探测已经通过。现在把每行的三路系数分别还原为原图宽高，保持同一行、同一频率的实部、虚部和幅度对应。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The frequency scan works. Restore each of its three coefficient channels to the original dimensions, retaining correspondence between real, imaginary and magnitude values at each row/frequency. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 对每行的每个离散频率运行已有探针，按原行次序、再按 k 从 0 开始的次序输出一列幅度，暂不恢复为频谱图。
brief.en: Run the earned probe at every frequency of each row. Output one magnitude column ordered by source row, then k from zero; do not yet restore a spectrum image.

naiveWhy.zh: 检查每行恒定的频率索引与行内变化的位置表。原行读数保持不变，改变的是探测频率。
naiveWhy.en: Distinguish the row-constant frequency index from positions varying within a row. Source readings repeat unchanged; probe frequency varies.

t.zh: 单频探针已经能测给定的 k。展开遍历把原行重复 N 次，并让 k 在重复行间变化；每行内的位置仍随列变化。两种刻度含义不同，先让探针逐频率工作。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The probe measures a supplied k. Expansion repeats each source row N times and changes k between repetitions; sample position still varies within each row. These indices have different meanings. First run the probe across frequencies. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 检查每行恒定的频率索引与行内变化的位置表。原行读数保持不变，改变的是探测频率。
hint.en: Distinguish the row-constant frequency index from positions varying within a row. Source readings repeat unchanged; probe frequency varies.

t.zh: 系数缩放已能保留方向。现在把它接在两台频谱仪之后：从一张图取得目标幅度，从另一张图保留相位关系，再交给已验证的重建器。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Coefficient rescaling now retains direction. Apply it after two spectrum analysers: take desired magnitudes from one image, preserve phase relationships from the other, and use the earned synthesiser. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 把每对频率系数缩放到给定长度，保持实部与虚部的比例和符号。两分量同为 0 时仍输出 0；用给定下限保护除数。
brief.en: Rescale each coefficient pair to the supplied length while retaining its component ratio and signs. A zero pair stays zero; use the supplied floor to protect division.

naiveWhy.zh: 长度由向量长度元件计算。比例取决于目标长度与当前长度；把两个分量一起改变，观察负号是否保留。
naiveWhy.en: The length component supplies current magnitude. Scaling depends on desired versus current length; change both components together and inspect retained signs.

t.zh: 频率系数的两分量共同确定长度与方向。同一个正比例同时作用于实部和虚部，会改变长度而保留方向；零系数没有可保留的方向。先在系数表上验证，再交换图像的幅度和相位。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A coefficient pair determines length and direction together. One positive scale changes length while retaining direction; a zero pair has no direction to preserve. Verify coefficient rescaling before exchanging image magnitudes and phases. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 长度由向量长度元件计算。比例取决于目标长度与当前长度；把两个分量一起改变，观察负号是否保留。
hint.en: The length component supplies current magnitude. Scaling depends on desired versus current length; change both components together and inspect retained signs.

t.zh: 列方向处理已经能往返保持形状。现在让同一台机器沿两方向连续工作，使横向和纵向都成为频率刻度，而不是只把逐行结果换一个摆放方向。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The column transform now preserves interface shape. Compose both directions so horizontal and vertical coordinates both become frequency indices, rather than merely rearranging a row spectrum. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 只分析列方向的频率：让逐行复数频谱仪处理原图的每列，再把输出恢复为原来的宽高。保留两分量及幅度，横向此时仍代表原来的列。
brief.en: Analyse column frequencies only: use the row complex analyser on each original column, then restore the original dimensions. Retain both components and magnitude; columns still identify original spatial columns.

naiveWhy.zh: 横向仍应保留原图各列的对应。只在机器入口交换，会让结果接口的宽高仍是交换后的形状。
naiveWhy.en: The output must retain correspondence with original spatial columns. Swapping only at the input leaves dimensions reversed at the interface.

t.zh: 逐行机器不能直接把一列当作一行。行列互换会交换宽高并把 (x,y) 放到 (y,x)，数值不变；复数两分量必须一起交换。用非方形图追踪进入机器和返回接口时的形状。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A row machine cannot directly consume columns. Transpose swaps dimensions and moves (x,y) to (y,x) without changing values; both complex components must move together. Track rectangular shapes into the machine and back to the interface. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 横向仍应保留原图各列的对应。只在机器入口交换，会让结果接口的宽高仍是交换后的形状。
hint.en: The output must retain correspondence with original spatial columns. Swapping only at the input leaves dimensions reversed at the interface.

t.zh: 波形使用每行的归一化位置 x/N；行内位置元件直接给出这张刻度表。投影采用平均乘积而不是总和，使同一周期的读数数量改变时，系数不随行长成倍放大。逐行汇总在这里新增“平均”。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The wave uses normalised positions x/N, supplied by the row-position component. Projection uses mean products rather than sums so changing the number of samples does not multiply coefficient scale. Row reduction now introduces mean. <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 三点加权已经把位置与权重分开。现在邻域可以有多行：展开工具为每个输出位置保留一行读数，并给出一一对应的权重；先检查每一路的贡献，再汇合结果。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The line separated sample positions from weights. A neighbourhood can now have several rows: unfolding gives one sample row per output location and matching weights. Inspect contributions before combining them. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 三点加权能处理一条线，但斜向和其他形状需要更一般的邻域。工具把重复取样展开为表，你把刚才学会的加权关系扩展到整张权重表。工具不会替你加权求和。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A line cannot express every diagonal or local pattern. A helper unfolds repeated sampling into tables. Extend the weighted relation to the entire table; the helper does not calculate a weighted sum. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 每行是一处输出的邻域。先检查读数与权重的对应，再决定如何把一行变成一个结果。
value.en: Each row is one output neighbourhood. Inspect sample/weight correspondence, then decide how to reduce the row.

value.zh: 同一局部处理器能表达平滑、差分和方向响应；变化的是位置权重，不是重新发明一套接线。书写顺序直接对应邻域时是互相关。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
value.en: One local processor can express smoothing, differences and directional responses through its weights. Written weights directly matched to the neighbourhood implement correlation. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 差分器分别测出横向和纵向变化。两分量有正负号，直接相加会互相抵消；向量长度元件自动计算平方和与平方根。先建立强度测量，再处理干扰。 <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The derivative measures horizontal and vertical change separately. Signed components can cancel in a sum; the length component supplies the squared sum and square root. Establish strength before suppressing nuisance. <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 单纯差分也会响应细碎干扰。三点加权器可以沿另一条轴汇合读数；将它接到双轴差分器，再把两种方向统一到强度测量。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Raw differences also respond to fine nuisance. Use the weighted-line part along the other axis, then combine both directional responses into a strength measurement. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 把求导轴和去干扰轴分开考虑。长度元件已经提供平方、相加和开方，不要求你手算。
value.en: Separate the derivative axis from the smoothing axis. Vector length supplies squaring, addition and square root.

value.zh: Sobel 将差分与垂直方向平滑组合。强度由两个分量共同决定，直接相加会让相反符号抵消；强边缘也不等于已经识别出物体。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Sobel combines differentiation with perpendicular smoothing. Strength uses both components; direct addition can cancel signs. Strong responses do not establish recognised objects. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 单频探针已经能测给定的 k。展开遍历把原行重复 N 次，并让 k 在重复行间变化；每行内的位置仍随列变化。两种刻度含义不同，先让探针逐频率工作。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The probe measures a supplied k. Expansion repeats each source row N times and changes k between repetitions; sample position still varies within each row. These indices have different meanings. First run the probe across frequencies. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 单频探针已经可靠。现在由工具展开重复工作，让同一个部件扫描所有离散频率；你负责把读数、频率和输出形状对应起来。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The single-frequency probe works. Expand repeated execution to every discrete frequency using the same part, while keeping observations, frequencies and output shape correctly associated. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 先检查展开表中哪一路每行恒定、哪一路随列变化。k=0 的系数应当等于原行平均值。
value.en: Inspect which table varies by row and which by column. The k=0 coefficient equals the original row mean.

value.zh: 频谱是同一信号的另一种表示。这里零频率在索引 0，k 与 N−k 构成正负频率对，不把未移中心的数组误读为所有索引都代表更高频率。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A spectrum is another representation of the signal. DC is at index 0; k and N−k pair positive and negative frequencies. Increasing unshifted indices do not always mean increasing frequency. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 频率系数的两分量共同确定长度与方向。同一个正比例同时作用于实部和虚部，会改变长度而保留方向；零系数没有可保留的方向。先在系数表上验证，再交换图像的幅度和相位。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A coefficient pair determines length and direction together. One positive scale changes length while retaining direction; a zero pair has no direction to preserve. Verify coefficient rescaling before exchanging image magnitudes and phases. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 重建器可以检验“频率有多少”是否足够。现在交换两张图的幅度来源和相位来源，检查空间结构跟随哪一部分。只在非零系数上讨论相位，零系数的方向没有意义。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Use the synthesiser to test whether frequency amounts alone suffice. Mix magnitude and phase sources and inspect spatial structure. Phase is meaningful for nonzero coefficients; zero coefficients have no direction. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 同一比例缩放实部和虚部会改变长度而保持方向。先比较平移前后的同一形状。
value.en: Scaling both components equally changes length but preserves direction. Start by comparing a shape with its translation.

value.zh: 频谱幅度记录贡献大小，相位记录各频率的排列关系。丢失相位不是单纯降低清晰度，可能得到完全不同的空间结构。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Magnitude records contribution size; phase records frequency arrangement. Losing phase can change spatial structure, not merely sharpness. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 逐行机器不能直接把一列当作一行。行列互换会交换宽高并把 (x,y) 放到 (y,x)，数值不变；复数两分量必须一起交换。用非方形图追踪进入机器和返回接口时的形状。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A row machine cannot directly consume columns. Transpose swaps dimensions and moves (x,y) to (y,x) without changing values; both complex components must move together. Track rectangular shapes into the machine and back to the interface. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 复数频谱仪可以处理上一轮的输出，现在把同一台机器沿两条轴复用。用横纹、竖纹与长方形输入检查频率轴是否对应正确。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The complex analyser can process its own output. Reuse it along both axes and check frequency axes with horizontal stripes, vertical stripes and rectangular inputs. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 用长方形测试追踪每一步的宽高，同时保留两条复数分量。
value.en: Track dimensions through the rectangular case and retain both complex components.

value.zh: 二维频谱同时描述两条空间方向；条纹方向与变化方向不同。这里存储顺序仍未移中心，显示时必须按周期索引理解正负频率。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A 2D spectrum describes both spatial directions. Stripe orientation differs from the direction of variation. Arrays remain unshifted; interpret their frequency indices periodically. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

step.why: Introduce components and enum configurations only in the task that needs them; scaffold unfamiliar representations before combined machines

value.zh: 复数频谱仪可以处理上一轮的输出，现在把同一台机器沿两条轴复用。用横纹、竖纹与长方形输入检查频率轴是否对应正确。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The complex analyser can process its own output. Reuse it along both axes and check frequency axes with horizontal stripes, vertical stripes and rectangular inputs. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 用长方形测试追踪每一步的宽高，同时保留两条复数分量。
value.en: Track dimensions through the rectangular case and retain both complex components.

value.zh: 二维频谱同时描述两条空间方向；条纹方向与变化方向不同。这里存储顺序仍未移中心，显示时必须按周期索引理解正负频率。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A 2D spectrum describes both spatial directions. Stripe orientation differs from the direction of variation. Arrays remain unshifted; interpret their frequency indices periodically. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

value.en: Scaling both components equally changes length but preserves direction. Start by comparing a shape with its translation.

value.en: Inspect which table varies by row and which by column. The k=0 coefficient equals the original row mean.

value.zh: 频谱是同一信号的另一种表示。这里零频率在索引 0，k 与 N−k 构成正负频率对，不把未移中心的数组误读为所有索引都代表更高频率。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A spectrum is another representation of the signal. DC is at index 0; k and N−k pair positive and negative frequencies. Increasing unshifted indices do not always mean increasing frequency. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 单纯差分也会响应细碎干扰。三点加权器可以沿另一条轴汇合读数；将它接到双轴差分器，再把两种方向统一到强度测量。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Raw differences also respond to fine nuisance. Use the weighted-line part along the other axis, then combine both directional responses into a strength measurement. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 把求导轴和去干扰轴分开考虑。长度元件已经提供平方、相加和开方，不要求你手算。
value.en: Separate the derivative axis from the smoothing axis. Vector length supplies squaring, addition and square root.

value.zh: Sobel 将差分与垂直方向平滑组合。强度由两个分量共同决定，直接相加会让相反符号抵消；强边缘也不等于已经识别出物体。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Sobel combines differentiation with perpendicular smoothing. Strength uses both components; direct addition can cancel signs. Strong responses do not establish recognised objects. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 三点加权能处理一条线，但斜向和其他形状需要更一般的邻域。工具把重复取样展开为表，你把刚才学会的加权关系扩展到整张权重表。工具不会替你加权求和。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
value.en: A line cannot express every diagonal or local pattern. A helper unfolds repeated sampling into tables. Extend the weighted relation to the entire table; the helper does not calculate a weighted sum. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 每行是一处输出的邻域。先检查读数与权重的对应，再决定如何把一行变成一个结果。
value.en: Each row is one output neighbourhood. Inspect sample/weight correspondence, then decide how to reduce the row.

value.zh: 同一局部处理器能表达平滑、差分和方向响应；变化的是位置权重，不是重新发明一套接线。书写顺序直接对应邻域时是互相关。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
value.en: One local processor can express smoothing, differences and directional responses through its weights. Written weights directly matched to the neighbourhood implement correlation. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 权重已经给出贡献，额外平均会再除以邻域格数；常量和单位核会揭示错误。
value.en: The weights already specify contributions. Averaging divides again by window size; constant and identity cases expose it.

why: Establish edge replication before enhancement and single-cycle phase before variable-frequency wave construction

t.zh: 边界处理和平滑已验证。现在把原图相对平滑图的带符号差异作为细节，再按给定强度组合，区分“平滑后的图”和“被移除的变化”。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Boundary handling and smoothing are verified. Treat the signed difference from the smoothed image as detail and combine it at the supplied strength, distinguishing the smooth image from the removed variation. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 使用给定的归一化权重做双轴平滑，图外延续最近边缘。恒定图的边缘必须仍是同一个读数；变化图仍应发生平滑。
brief.en: Smooth along both axes with the supplied normalised weights, extending nearest edge values outside. Constant-image edges must stay constant; varying images must still be smoothed.

naiveWhy.zh: 补 0 会在恒定图边缘引入不存在的暗读数。延续边缘只改变图外取值，不能跳过图内平滑。
naiveWhy.en: Zero extension invents dark samples at constant-image edges. Edge replication changes outside reads without skipping interior smoothing.

t.zh: 双轴加权已经可用，但补 0 会让恒定图的边缘变暗。先单独更换边界假设：图外维持最近边缘的读数。用恒定图和变化图区分边界效果与平滑效果。 <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The two-axis filter works, but zero extension darkens constant-image edges. First change only the boundary assumption: outside reads retain the nearest edge value. Contrast constant and varying images to separate boundary effects from smoothing. <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 先比较角落与内部，再检查亮点是否仍会扩散；恒定图不变并不等于直接输出原图。
hint.en: Compare corners with the interior, then check whether an impulse still spreads. Preserving a constant image is not the same as passing every image through unchanged.

t.zh: 单周期的相位变化已经验证。现在把整行的周期数也作为输入：它改变位置刻度走过的圈数，相位仍负责共同的角度偏移。用 0、1 和多个周期区分间距与起点。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Single-cycle phase shifts are verified. Now accept cycles per row as an input: it changes how many turns the position scale traverses, while phase remains a shared offset. Compare zero, one and multiple cycles to distinguish spacing from starting phase. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 整行长度表示 1 周，先只产生一个周期。按照给定相位改变起点，不改变周期数；保留波形的正负读数。余弦元件自动计算角度对应的读数。
brief.en: The row length represents one turn. Produce one cycle while changing its starting phase, without changing cycle count. Retain signed values; cosine computes the readings automatically.

naiveWhy.zh: 相位改变同一周期的起点。完全忽略相位会让不同起点得到同一张表；增加整整一周则应回到原来的读数。
naiveWhy.en: Phase changes where a cycle starts. Ignoring it makes different starting phases identical; adding one complete turn should restore the original readings.

t.zh: 频率分析先需要一把可重复的刻度。余弦元件以“周”为角度单位，1 周回到同一读数，四分之一周与半周落在不同位置；数值由元件计算。先只改变起点，观察波形在周期内怎样排列。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Frequency analysis needs a repeatable basis. Cosine takes turns: one turn returns to the same reading, while quarter and half turns occupy different positions. The component computes values. First change the starting phase and inspect arrangement within one cycle. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 相位是所有位置共同的角度偏移；比较四分之一周和整整一周，不需要手算三角函数。
hint.en: Phase is a shared angular offset. Compare a quarter turn with a full turn; no trigonometric calculation is required.

value.zh: 双轴加权已经可用，但补 0 会让恒定图的边缘变暗。先单独更换边界假设：图外维持最近边缘的读数。用恒定图和变化图区分边界效果与平滑效果。 <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The two-axis filter works, but zero extension darkens constant-image edges. First change only the boundary assumption: outside reads retain the nearest edge value. Contrast constant and varying images to separate boundary effects from smoothing. <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 双轴处理器已经能汇合邻居。现在用课程给出的高斯权重处理细碎变化，再把被抑制的细节用于另一种任务。权重和与小数由系统计算，你决定图像之间的关系。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The two-axis processor combines neighbours. Use supplied Gaussian weights to suppress fine variation, then reuse the removed detail for another purpose. Weight arithmetic is supplied; decide the image relationships. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 比较纹理、边缘和常量图。改动大小与要加回的带符号细节承担不同职责。
value.en: Compare texture, edges and constants. Change magnitude and the signed detail to add back serve different purposes.

value.zh: 平滑既压低干扰也损失细节。原图减去平滑图得到带符号的细节，增强它与仅显示改动大小不同；强增强也可能放大噪声。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Smoothing suppresses nuisance and detail. Original minus smooth retains signed detail. Enhancing it differs from displaying change size, and can amplify noise. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 频率分析先需要一把可重复的刻度。余弦元件以“周”为角度单位，1 周回到同一读数，四分之一周与半周落在不同位置；数值由元件计算。先只改变起点，观察波形在周期内怎样排列。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Frequency analysis needs a repeatable basis. Cosine takes turns: one turn returns to the same reading, while quarter and half turns occupy different positions. The component computes values. First change the starting phase and inspect arrangement within one cycle. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 扫描器已经能处理局部变化，但规则条纹可能遍布整幅图，靠局部平滑还会损失有用细节。这章要造频率分析仪，先构造能与条纹比较的波形。负值表示围绕零变化，不是坏像素。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
value.en: The scanner handles local changes, but periodic stripes span the image and local smoothing may remove useful detail. Build a frequency analyser, beginning with waves to compare against stripes. Negative readings represent variation around zero, not invalid pixels. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

value.zh: 先固定相位比较不同周期数，再固定周期数比较不同相位。余弦元件自动完成三角函数计算。
value.en: Hold phase fixed to compare cycle counts, then hold frequency fixed to compare phases. Cosine supplies the arithmetic.

value.zh: 频率控制整行中重复多少次，相位控制同一波形的位置关系。记录数值而不仅是灰度显示，才能保留正负与完整波形。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Frequency controls repetitions across a row; phase controls alignment of that wave. Numeric values retain signs and complete wave shape beyond grayscale display. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

step.why: Establish edge replication before enhancement and single-cycle phase before variable-frequency wave construction

value.zh: 比较纹理、边缘和常量图。改动大小与要加回的带符号细节承担不同职责。
value.en: Compare texture, edges and constants. Change magnitude and the signed detail to add back serve different purposes.

value.zh: 平滑既压低干扰也损失细节。原图减去平滑图得到带符号的细节，增强它与仅显示改动大小不同；强增强也可能放大噪声。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
value.en: Smoothing suppresses nuisance and detail. Original minus smooth retains signed detail. Enhancing it differs from displaying change size, and can amplify noise. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: 有限图像没有图外观测。零、复制、周期和镜像代表不同延续模型；valid 只保留完整邻域，因此输出尺寸依核支持缩小。
body.en: Finite images have no outside observations. Zero, replicate, periodic and reflected extension are different models. Valid output keeps full neighbourhoods and shrinks with support.

body.zh: 常见误解：所有补边只影响外观，或保持原宽高的补边等于 valid。
body.en: Common misconception: Padding only affects appearance, or same-size padding is equivalent to valid output.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp41–45
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp41–45

t.zh: 把图外补成 0 会让恒定图的边缘变暗。本任务假设图像在边缘之外维持最近的边缘读数。检查角落与内部有什么区别，再调整自己的处理器。
t.en: Zero extension can darken constant-image edges. This task assumes the nearest edge reading continues outside. Inspect corners and interior before adjusting your processor.

why: Carry established smoothing and single-cycle constructions into their combined tasks without completing the new relation

step.why: Carry established smoothing and single-cycle constructions into their combined tasks without completing the new relation

why: Merge paired coordinate inputs into one vector input (offset d, radii r)

value.zh: 夹具给出了取样偏移向量 d = (dx, dy)。先按它读取观测图，再与参照比较；图外取 0。
value.en: The fixture supplies a sampling offset vector d = (dx, dy). Read the observation at that offset before comparing with the reference; outside reads are zero.

value.zh: d 的分量为正，表示输出 (x,y) 读取观测的 (x+dx,y+dy)，不表示把亮度加上 dx。
value.en: A positive component of d means output (x,y) reads observation (x+dx,y+dy); it does not add dx to brightness.

value.zh: 按给定偏移向量 d 读取观测，再与参照逐位置比较；图外取 0。
value.en: Read an observation at an offset vector d and compare with the reference, using zero outside.

value.zh: 另一个接口只接受邻域完全在原图内的结果。每轴半径 r = (rx, ry) 已给出，保留有效内部；不用猜测图外读数。
value.en: Another interface accepts only results whose neighbourhood is fully inside. The supplied per-axis radii r = (rx, ry) identify the valid interior; no outside readings are assumed.

value.zh: 系统按 r 的两个分量自动计算宽高，只保留不触及图外的位置。
value.en: The helper computes the dimensions from the two components of r and retains only interior locations.

step.why: Merge paired coordinate inputs into one vector input (offset d, radii r)

value.zh: 系统按 rx、ry 自动计算宽高，只保留不触及图外的位置。
value.en: The helper computes the dimensions from rx and ry and retains only interior locations.

value.zh: 另一个接口只接受邻域完全在原图内的结果。rx、ry 已给出，保留有效内部；不用猜测图外读数。
value.en: Another interface accepts only results whose neighbourhood is fully inside. Supplied rx and ry identify the valid interior; no outside readings are assumed.

value.zh: 按给定 dx、dy 读取观测，再与参照逐位置比较；图外取 0。
value.en: Read an observation at dx,dy offsets and compare with the reference, using zero outside.

value.zh: 正 dx 表示输出 (x,y) 读取观测的 (x+dx,y+dy)，不表示把亮度加上 dx。
value.en: Positive dx means output (x,y) reads observation (x+dx,y+dy); it does not add dx to brightness.

value.zh: 夹具给出了取样偏移 dx、dy。先按它读取观测图，再与参照比较；图外取 0。
value.en: The fixture supplies sampling offsets dx and dy. Read the observation at those offsets before comparing with the reference; outside reads are zero.
